6/-!
7# Hilbert-space martingale CLT layer (package CLT-02)
8
9Source (HRS periodic main paper, Appendix A.4 and Section 3):
10* Remark 3.8 `M:B:rem:multitime` (source lines 1705-1707): joint statistics at several times
11  through a single vector martingale with integrands extended by zero.
12* Remark A.20 `M:B:rem:conditional-coupling` (10536-10539): the DDS coupling given an initial
13  sigma-field.
14* Lemma A.22 `M:B:lem:hilbert-martingale-clt` (10600-10611): Hilbert-valued quantitative
15  martingale CLT in `d_{C²}`, with its conditional form.
16* Corollary A.23 `M:B:lem:hilbert-martingale-w2` (10629-10654): predictable polar coupling
17  and the `W₂` bound.
18* Corollary A.24 `M:B:cor:hilbert-wasserstein-assembly` (10672-10692): adding the initial
19  term and the remainder.
20* Remark A.25 `M:B:rem:clt-complex` (10698-10700): complex and multi-time statistics.
21* Lemma A.27 `M:B:newprob:conditional-heat` (10788-10817): conditional Gaussian interpolation.
22* Corollary A.28 `M:B:newprob:conditional-martingale` (10888-10900): retention of the initial
23  fluctuation law.
24* Lemma A.29 `M:B:newprob:initial-martingale` (10908-10931): initial sum and adapted martingale.
25* Corollary A.30 `M:B:newprob:iid` (10978-10994): independent initial sampling.
26* Remark A.32 `M:B:newprob:several-times` (11037-11055): several observation times.
27
28## Representation decisions (recorded in `docs/ISSUES.md` §B, CLT-02)
29
30* **Hilbert-valued martingales with covariation.** Mathlib has no Hilbert-valued stochastic
31  calculus.  As for `IsVectorMartingaleWithCovariation` (ISSUES §B C1), an `H`-valued continuous
32  square-integrable martingale with predictable tensor quadratic variation
33  `⟨⟨M⟩⟩_t = ∫_0^t Σ_r dr` is represented by its characterising properties
34  (`IsHilbertMartingaleWithCovariation`): every coordinate `⟨M, x⟩` is a martingale, and
35  `⟨M,x⟩⟨M,y⟩ - ∫_0^· Σ_r(x,y) dr` is a martingale for all `x, y ∈ H`.  `Σ_r` is a bounded
36  bilinear form (`H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ`, the form of the operator), nonnegative and trace class
37  in the sense of `IsTraceClassCov` (`HRS/Prob/HilbertCLT.lean`).
38* **Trace norm.** `‖C‖_{𝔖₁}` of a bounded bilinear form is defined by the variational formula
39  `sup ∑_i |C(e_i, f_i)|` over finite orthonormal families `(e_i)`, `(f_i)` (`traceNormForm`);
40  for trace-class forms this is the Schatten-1 norm and the real supremum is attained on a
41  bounded set, so no junk value arises in the statements (all `Σ_r`, `Σ̄_r` are assumed trace
42  class, as in the source).  Measurability of `ω ↦ traceNormForm (Σ_r ω - Σ̄_r)` follows from
43  separability of `H` (countable dense set of orthonormal families); it is a lemma, not a
44  hypothesis.
45* **Cylindrical Brownian motions and Hilbert–Schmidt integrands.** A `U`-cylindrical Brownian
46  motion is represented, through a Hilbert basis `(u_k)_{k ∈ κ}` of the separable space `U`
47  (`κ` countable), by a family of independent real Brownian motions
48  `W : ℝ≥0 → Ω → κ → ℝ`, every finite subfamily being an `IsBrownianFiltration`
49  (`IsCylindricalBrownian`).  An integrand `Φ_r ∈ 𝓛₂(U,H)` is the family `Φ r ω k = Φ_r u_k`
50  with `∑_k ‖Φ_r u_k‖² < ∞` (`IsHSIntegrand`; progressive measurability is used where the source
51  says predictable, since the stochastic library is built on progressive integrands and the
52  statements hold in that generality).  The `H`-valued integral `∫Φ dW` is characterised
53  coordinatewise through the real Itô integrals of `HRS/Stochastic/Integral.lean`
54  (`IsHilbertItoIntegral`), and `Σ_r = Φ_rΦ_r^*` is the form `hsCovForm (Φ r ω)`.
55* **Operator square roots.** `Σ_r^{1/2}` is characterised, not constructed: `IsSqrtOfForm S C`
56  says `S` is self-adjoint, nonnegative, and `⟨S x, S y⟩ = C x y`; this determines the
57  nonnegative square root uniquely.
58* **Enlargements.** "On an enlargement of the probability space" is a probability space `Ω'`
59  with a measure-preserving map `π : Ω' → Ω` and a filtration `ℱ'` containing the pull-back of
60  `ℱ`; all random variables of the original space are pulled back along `π`.  This keeps the joint
61  realisation needed in Corollary A.24 (a copy in law, as in `dds_coupling`, would not).
62* **The metric `d₃`** of `B:newprob:metric` (10763-10773) uses the MAX over the orders
63  `1 ≤ j ≤ 3` of `sup ‖D^j h‖_op` (no bound on `‖h‖_∞` beyond boundedness); it is *not*
64  `smoothDist 3` (SUM over the orders `0..3`).  It is defined here in `ℝ≥0∞` (`d3DistE`) so that
65  it is `∞`, not a junk `0`, when the supremum is unbounded.
66* **Lemma A.27's "local martingale with `E ∫ tr Σ < ∞`"** is, as its proof notes (10822-10823),
67  a square-integrable martingale, and it is represented by `IsVectorMartingaleWithCovariation`
68  (which asserts the martingale property); the hypotheses are equivalent.
69-/

78/-! ### Trace norm of a bilinear form and operator square roots -/
79
80section TraceNorm
81
82variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
83
84/-- Finite orthonormal pairs of families in `H`: the index set of the variational formula for the
85trace norm. -/
86def OrthonormalPairs (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] : Type _ :=
87  {p : (n : ℕ) × (Fin n → H) × (Fin n → H) // Orthonormal ℝ p.2.1 ∧ Orthonormal ℝ p.2.2}
88
89/-- The trace (Schatten-1) norm `‖C‖_{𝔖₁}` of a bounded bilinear form on `H`, by the variational
90formula `sup { ∑_i |C(e_i, f_i)| : (e_i), (f_i) finite orthonormal families }` (equal to
91`tr √(C^*C)` for trace-class `C`; the real supremum is genuine when the set is bounded, which is
92the case for every trace-class form and in particular for every difference of two forms
93satisfying `IsTraceClassCov`). -/
94def traceNormForm (C : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ) : ℝ :=
95  ⨆ p : OrthonormalPairs H, ∑ i, |C (p.1.2.1 i) (p.1.2.2 i)|
96
97/-- The trace `∑_i C(e_i,e_i)` of a form along a Hilbert basis (for nonnegative trace-class
98forms this is `‖C‖_{𝔖₁}`, independently of the basis). -/
99def traceAlong {ι : Type*} (b : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H) (C : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ) : ℝ :=
100  ∑' i, C (b i) (b i)
101
102/-- `S = C^{1/2}`: `S` is a self-adjoint nonnegative bounded operator with
103`⟨S x, S y⟩ = C x y`, i.e. `S^*S = S² = C` as operators.  For a nonnegative bounded form `C`
104this characterises the nonnegative square root uniquely. -/
105structure IsSqrtOfForm (S : H →L[ℝ] H) (C : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ) : Prop where
106  symm : ∀ x y, inner ℝ (S x) y = inner ℝ x (S y)
107  nonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ inner ℝ (S x) x
108  sq : ∀ x y, inner ℝ (S x) (S y) = C x y
109
110/-- The covariance form `Σ = ΦΦ^*` of a Hilbert–Schmidt family `Φ = (Φ u_k)_k`:
111`Σ(x,y) = ∑_k ⟨Φ u_k, x⟩ ⟨Φ u_k, y⟩` (as a sum in the Banach space of bilinear forms; it is
112absolutely convergent when `∑_k ‖Φ u_k‖² < ∞`). -/
113def hsCovForm {κ : Type*} (Φ : κ → H) : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
114  ∑' k, (innerSL ℝ (Φ k)).smulRight (innerSL ℝ (Φ k))
115
116end TraceNorm
117
118/-! ### Hilbert-valued martingales with absolutely continuous tensor covariation -/
119
120section HilbertMartingale
121
122variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
123variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
124  [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]
125
126/-- An initial sigma-field `𝒢 ⊂ ℱ_0` (source line 10510: "we keep that initial sigma-field fixed
127when constructing the independent Gaussian term").  Carried as a subtype so that `𝒢` does not
128become a local `MeasurableSpace` instance shadowing the ambient one. -/
129abbrev InitialSigma (ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ) : Type _ := {𝒢 : MeasurableSpace Ω // 𝒢 ≤ ℱ 0}
130
131/-- A sub-σ-algebra of the ambient one, as a subtype (same reason as `InitialSigma`). -/
132abbrev SubSigma (Ω : Type*) (mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω) : Type _ := {𝒢 : MeasurableSpace Ω // 𝒢 ≤ mΩ}
133
134/-- `M` is a continuous square-integrable `H`-valued martingale on `[0,t]` with `M_0 = 0` and
135predictable tensor quadratic variation `⟨⟨M⟩⟩_τ = ∫_0^τ Σ_r dr`, `Σ_r` a nonnegative trace-class
136form with `E ∫_0^t ‖Σ_r‖_{𝔖₁} dr < ∞` (Lemma A.22's hypotheses, source lines 10601-10605),
137represented coordinatewise: for all `x, y ∈ H`, `⟨M,x⟩` and `⟨M,x⟩⟨M,y⟩ - ∫_0^· Σ_r(x,y) dr` are
138martingales.  The integrability fields record that the Lebesgue integrals the source writes
139exist (otherwise the Bochner integrals below would be junk `0`, ISSUES §E). -/
140structure IsHilbertMartingaleWithCovariation (ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ) (t : ℝ)
141    (M : ℝ → Ω → H) (Sg : ℝ → Ω → (H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ)) : Prop where
142  martingale : ∀ x : H, Martingale (fun τ ω => inner ℝ (M τ ω) x) ℱ P
143  zero : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, M 0 ω = 0
144  cont : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ContinuousOn (fun τ => M τ ω) (Set.Icc 0 t)
145  sq_int : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc 0 t, MemLp (M τ) 2 P
146  sigma_meas : ∀ x y : H, Measurable (Function.uncurry fun σ ω => Sg σ ω x y)
147  sigma_adapted : ∀ σ, ∀ x y : H, Measurable[ℱ σ] (fun ω => Sg σ ω x y)
148  sigma_traceClass : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ∀ σ ∈ Set.Icc 0 t, IsTraceClassCov (Sg σ ω)
149  sigma_int : Integrable (fun ω => ∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 t, traceNormForm (Sg σ ω)) P
150  sigma_pathint : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, IntegrableOn (fun σ => traceNormForm (Sg σ ω)) (Set.Icc 0 t)
151  sigma_entry_int : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ∀ x y : H, IntegrableOn (fun σ => Sg σ ω x y) (Set.Icc 0 t)
152  covariation : ∀ x y : H,
153    Martingale (fun τ ω => inner ℝ (M τ ω) x * inner ℝ (M τ ω) y -
154      ∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 τ, Sg σ ω x y) ℱ P
155
156/-- A deterministic covariance density `Σ̄ : [0,t] → 𝔖₁⁺(H)`: measurable (through its matrix
157elements), nonnegative trace class, and integrable in trace norm (Lemma A.22, line 10606;
158Corollary A.23, line 10638-10639 "strongly measurable with `∫_0^t Tr Σ̄_r dr < ∞`"). -/
159structure IsDetCovDensity (t : ℝ) (sb : ℝ → (H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ)) : Prop where
160  meas : ∀ x y : H, Measurable (fun σ => sb σ x y)
161  traceClass : ∀ σ ∈ Set.Icc 0 t, IsTraceClassCov (sb σ)
162  int : IntegrableOn (fun σ => traceNormForm (sb σ)) (Set.Icc 0 t)
163
164/-- `γ` is the centered Gaussian law on `H` with covariance `∫_0^t Σ̄_r dr`. -/
165def IsGaussianWithIntegratedCov (t : ℝ) (sb : ℝ → (H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ)) (γ : Measure H) :
166    Prop :=
167  IsProbabilityMeasure γ ∧ IsCenteredGaussian γ ∧
168    ∀ x y, covarianceBilin γ x y = ∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 t, sb σ x y
169
170/-- The trace-norm discrepancy `E ∫_0^t ‖Σ_r - Σ̄_r‖_{𝔖₁} dr` (the right-hand sides of
171`B:eq:hilbert-martingale-clt`, `B:eq:hilbert-martingale-w2` and the `D` of Corollary A.24). -/
172def covDiscrepancy (t : ℝ) (Sg : ℝ → Ω → (H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ))
173    (sb : ℝ → (H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ)) : ℝ :=
174  ∫ ω, (∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 t, traceNormForm (Sg σ ω - sb σ)) ∂P
175
176/-! ### Route for Lemma A.22 (as formalised)
177
1781. Reduce to finitely many coordinates: for an orthonormal family `b : Fin d → H` the coordinate
179   process `⟨b_a, M⟩` is an `ℝ^d`-valued martingale with covariation matrix `(Σ(b_a,b_c))`
180   (`isVectorMartingale_coord`); the compression of a trace-class form is contractive in the trace
181   norm (`traceNormMatrix_compMat_le`, via the rank-one decomposition `exists_decomp'` and the
182   bound `sum_abs_le_of_decomp`).
1832. The law of the coordinates of `G` is `multivariateGaussian 0 (∫ Σ̄(b_a,b_c))` by uniqueness of
184   Gaussian measures (`map_coord_gaussian`), and `multivariate_martingale_clt_dc2` gives the bound
185   for `P_K M_t` and `P_K G` (`finite_dim_step`).
1863. For test functions of the `d_{C²}` class (`cbUnitBall_comp_clm` transfers them to `ℝ^d`) the
187   projection error is at most `E‖(I-P_K)M_t‖ + E‖(I-P_K)G‖`, which tends to `0` along the
188   finite-dimensional subspaces `denseSub n` by dominated convergence (`hilbert_clt_core`).
189   The measurability of `(σ,ω) ↦ ‖Σ-Σ̄‖_{𝔖₁}` uses a countable dense family of orthonormal pairs
190   (`measurable_traceNormForm`), so that the Bochner integral `covDiscrepancy` is not a junk `0`
191   (`discrepancy_integrable`).
1924. The conditional statement is obtained from the unconditional one under `P[· | A]` for
193   `A ∈ 𝒢 ⊂ ℱ_0` (`isHilbertMartingale_cond`: conditioning on a set of `ℱ_0` preserves the martingale
194   fields), and then `ae_le_of_setIntegral_le_trim` on the `𝒢`-measurable functions
195   `E[Φ(M_t) | 𝒢] - ∫Φ dγ` and `½ E[∫‖Σ-Σ̄‖ | 𝒢]`.  No finite-dimensional conditional Lindeberg
196   estimate is needed. -/
197
198/-! ### Helper lemmas for Lemma A.22 -/
199
200section A22Aux
201
202open HilbertCLTAux
203
204omit [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H] in
205/-- A trace-class form is a sum of rank-one forms `∑_j ⟨ℓ_j,x⟩⟨ℓ_j,y⟩` with `∑ ‖ℓ_j‖² < ∞`. -/
206lemma IsTraceClassCov.exists_decomp' [SecondCountableTopology H] {C : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ}
207    (hC : IsTraceClassCov C) :
208    ∃ ℓ : ℕ → H, Summable (fun j => ‖ℓ j‖ ^ 2) ∧
209      ∀ x y, HasSum (fun j => inner ℝ (ℓ j) x * inner ℝ (ℓ j) y) (C x y) := by
210  obtain ⟨ι, b, htr⟩ := hC.trace
211  have hA : IsPSDOp (formOp C) :=
212    ⟨fun x y => by
213      rw [inner_formOp, real_inner_comm, inner_formOp, hC.symm],
214     fun x => by rw [inner_formOp]; exact hC.nonneg x⟩
215  obtain ⟨ℓ, hs, hsum⟩ := exists_rank_one_decomp hA b
216    (by simpa only [inner_formOp] using htr)
217  exact ⟨ℓ, hs, fun x y => by simpa only [inner_formOp] using hsum x y⟩
218
219omit [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H] in
220lemma sum_abs_le_of_decomp {C : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ} {ℓ : ℕ → H}
221    (hs : Summable fun j => ‖ℓ j‖ ^ 2)
222    (hC : ∀ x y, HasSum (fun j => inner ℝ (ℓ j) x * inner ℝ (ℓ j) y) (C x y))
223    {n : ℕ} (e f : Fin n → H) (he : Orthonormal ℝ e) (hf : Orthonormal ℝ f) :
224    ∑ i, |C (e i) (f i)| ≤ ∑' j, ‖ℓ j‖ ^ 2 := by
225  classical
226  have hsm : ∀ i, Summable fun j => |inner ℝ (ℓ j) (e i) * inner ℝ (ℓ j) (f i)| := by
227    intro i
228    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun j => abs_nonneg _) (fun j => ?_)
229      (hs.mul_right (‖e i‖ * ‖f i‖))
230    rw [abs_mul]
231    calc |inner ℝ (ℓ j) (e i)| * |inner ℝ (ℓ j) (f i)|
232        ≤ (‖ℓ j‖ * ‖e i‖) * (‖ℓ j‖ * ‖f i‖) := by
233          gcongr <;> exact abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
234      _ = ‖ℓ j‖ ^ 2 * (‖e i‖ * ‖f i‖) := by ring
235  have h1 : ∀ i, |C (e i) (f i)| ≤ ∑' j, |inner ℝ (ℓ j) (e i) * inner ℝ (ℓ j) (f i)| := by
236    intro i
237    rw [← (hC (e i) (f i)).tsum_eq]
238    have := norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm (f := fun j => inner ℝ (ℓ j) (e i) * inner ℝ (ℓ j) (f i))
239      (by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hsm i)
240    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using this
241  calc ∑ i, |C (e i) (f i)|
242      ≤ ∑ i, ∑' j, |inner ℝ (ℓ j) (e i) * inner ℝ (ℓ j) (f i)| :=
243        Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => h1 i
244    _ = ∑' j, ∑ i, |inner ℝ (ℓ j) (e i) * inner ℝ (ℓ j) (f i)| :=
245        (Summable.tsum_finsetSum fun i _ => hsm i).symm
246    _ ≤ ∑' j, ‖ℓ j‖ ^ 2 := by
247      refine Summable.tsum_le_tsum (fun j => ?_) (summable_sum fun i _ => hsm i) hs
248      have hb1 := he.sum_inner_products_le (ℓ j) (s := Finset.univ)
249      have hb2 := hf.sum_inner_products_le (ℓ j) (s := Finset.univ)
250      have ha : ∀ x : H, ‖inner ℝ x (ℓ j)‖ ^ 2 = (inner ℝ (ℓ j) x) ^ 2 := by
251        intro x; rw [real_inner_comm, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
252      simp only [ha] at hb1 hb2
253      have : ∀ i, |inner ℝ (ℓ j) (e i) * inner ℝ (ℓ j) (f i)| ≤
254          (1 / 2) * ((inner ℝ (ℓ j) (e i)) ^ 2 + (inner ℝ (ℓ j) (f i)) ^ 2) := by
255        intro i
256        rw [abs_mul]
257        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|inner ℝ (ℓ j) (e i)| - |inner ℝ (ℓ j) (f i)|),
258          sq_abs (inner ℝ (ℓ j) (e i)), sq_abs (inner ℝ (ℓ j) (f i))]
259      calc ∑ i, |inner ℝ (ℓ j) (e i) * inner ℝ (ℓ j) (f i)|
260          ≤ ∑ i, (1 / 2) * ((inner ℝ (ℓ j) (e i)) ^ 2 + (inner ℝ (ℓ j) (f i)) ^ 2) :=
261            Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => this i
262        _ = (1 / 2) * (∑ i, (inner ℝ (ℓ j) (e i)) ^ 2 + ∑ i, (inner ℝ (ℓ j) (f i)) ^ 2) := by
263            rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
264        _ ≤ ‖ℓ j‖ ^ 2 := by linarith
265
266end A22Aux

268section A22Trace
269
270open HilbertCLTAux
271
272omit [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] in
273lemma bddAbove_pairSum {C : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ} (hC : IsTraceClassCov C) :
274    BddAbove (Set.range fun p : OrthonormalPairs H => ∑ i, |C (p.1.2.1 i) (p.1.2.2 i)|) := by
275  obtain ⟨ℓ, hs, hℓ⟩ := hC.exists_decomp'
276  exact ⟨∑' j, ‖ℓ j‖ ^ 2, by
277    rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩
278    exact sum_abs_le_of_decomp hs hℓ _ _ p.2.1 p.2.2⟩
279
280omit [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] in
281lemma bddAbove_pairSum_sub {C₁ C₂ : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ} (h₁ : IsTraceClassCov C₁)
282    (h₂ : IsTraceClassCov C₂) :
283    BddAbove (Set.range fun p : OrthonormalPairs H =>
284      ∑ i, |(C₁ - C₂) (p.1.2.1 i) (p.1.2.2 i)|) := by
285  obtain ⟨b₁, hb₁⟩ := bddAbove_pairSum h₁
286  obtain ⟨b₂, hb₂⟩ := bddAbove_pairSum h₂
287  refine ⟨b₁ + b₂, ?_⟩
288  rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩
289  have e1 := hb₁ ⟨p, rfl⟩
290  have e2 := hb₂ ⟨p, rfl⟩
291  simp only at e1 e2
292  calc ∑ i, |(C₁ - C₂) (p.1.2.1 i) (p.1.2.2 i)|
293      ≤ ∑ i, (|C₁ (p.1.2.1 i) (p.1.2.2 i)| + |C₂ (p.1.2.1 i) (p.1.2.2 i)|) :=
294        Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => by
295          simpa using abs_sub (C₁ (p.1.2.1 i) (p.1.2.2 i)) (C₂ (p.1.2.1 i) (p.1.2.2 i))
296    _ = _ := Finset.sum_add_distrib
297    _ ≤ b₁ + b₂ := by linarith
298
299omit [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] in
300lemma pairSum_le_traceNormForm {C : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ}
301    (hb : BddAbove (Set.range fun p : OrthonormalPairs H => ∑ i, |C (p.1.2.1 i) (p.1.2.2 i)|))
302    (p : OrthonormalPairs H) : ∑ i, |C (p.1.2.1 i) (p.1.2.2 i)| ≤ traceNormForm C :=
303  le_ciSup hb p
304
305omit [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] in
306lemma traceNormForm_nonneg (C : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ) : 0 ≤ traceNormForm C :=
307  Real.iSup_nonneg fun _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _
308
309omit [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] in
310lemma traceNormForm_sub_le {C₁ C₂ : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ} (h₁ : IsTraceClassCov C₁)
311    (h₂ : IsTraceClassCov C₂) :
312    traceNormForm (C₁ - C₂) ≤ traceNormForm C₁ + traceNormForm C₂ := by
313  refine Real.iSup_le (fun p => ?_) (add_nonneg (traceNormForm_nonneg _) (traceNormForm_nonneg _))
314  have e1 := pairSum_le_traceNormForm (bddAbove_pairSum h₁) p
315  have e2 := pairSum_le_traceNormForm (bddAbove_pairSum h₂) p
316  calc ∑ i, |(C₁ - C₂) (p.1.2.1 i) (p.1.2.2 i)|
317      ≤ ∑ i, (|C₁ (p.1.2.1 i) (p.1.2.2 i)| + |C₂ (p.1.2.1 i) (p.1.2.2 i)|) :=
318        Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => by
319          simpa using abs_sub (C₁ (p.1.2.1 i) (p.1.2.2 i)) (C₂ (p.1.2.1 i) (p.1.2.2 i))
320    _ = _ := Finset.sum_add_distrib
321    _ ≤ _ := by linarith
322
323/-- Compression of a bilinear form to an orthonormal family. -/
324def compMat {d : ℕ} (b : Fin d → H) (C : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ) : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ :=
325  Matrix.of fun a c => C (b a) (b c)
326
327omit [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] in
328lemma traceNormMatrix_compMat_le {d : ℕ} {b : Fin d → H} (hb : Orthonormal ℝ b)
329    {C : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ}
330    (hbdd : BddAbove (Set.range fun p : OrthonormalPairs H => ∑ i, |C (p.1.2.1 i) (p.1.2.2 i)|)) :
331    traceNormMatrix (compMat b C) ≤ traceNormForm C := by
332  classical
333  refine ciSup_le fun U => ?_
334  set e : Fin d → H := fun a => ∑ c, (U : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) c a • b c with he
335  have hU : ∀ a a', ∑ c, (U : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) c a * (U : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) c a' =
336      if a = a' then 1 else 0 := by
337    intro a a'
338    have h1 := Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff'.1 U.2
339    have := congrFun (congrFun h1 a) a'
340    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.star_apply, Matrix.one_apply, star_trivial] at this
341    exact this
342  have hon : Orthonormal ℝ e := by
343    rw [orthonormal_iff_ite]
344    intro a a'
345    simp only [he, sum_inner, inner_sum, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right]
346    have : ∀ c c', inner ℝ (b c) (b c') = if c = c' then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := orthonormal_iff_ite.1 hb
347    simp only [this, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
348    rw [← hU a a']
349    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => by ring
350  have hpair : (⟨⟨d, e, b⟩, hon, hb⟩ : OrthonormalPairs H) ∈ Set.univ := trivial
351  have h1 := pairSum_le_traceNormForm hbdd ⟨⟨d, e, b⟩, hon, hb⟩
352  refine le_trans ?_ h1
353  simp only
354  have htr : Matrix.trace ((compMat b C).transpose * (U : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)) =
355      ∑ a, C (e a) (b a) := by
356    simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, compMat,
357      Matrix.of_apply, he, map_sum, map_smul, sum_apply,
358      smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
359    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => by ring
360  rw [htr]
361  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => le_abs_self _
362
363end A22Trace
364
365section A22Meas
366
367lemma iSup_dense_real {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {f : X → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f)
368    {D : Set X} (hD : Dense D) : ⨆ x, f x = ⨆ d : D, f d := by
369  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty X with hX | hX
370  · haveI : IsEmpty D := ⟨fun d => hX.false d.1⟩
371    simp
372  have hDne : Nonempty D := by
373    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hD.nonempty
374    exact ⟨⟨d, hd⟩⟩
375  have key : ∀ s : ℝ, (∀ d : D, f d ≤ s) → ∀ x, f x ≤ s := by
376    intro s hs x
377    have hcl : IsClosed {x | f x ≤ s} := isClosed_le hf continuous_const
378    have hsub : D ⊆ {x | f x ≤ s} := fun d hd => hs ⟨d, hd⟩
379    have := closure_minimal hsub hcl
380    rw [hD.closure_eq] at this
381    exact this (Set.mem_univ x)
382  by_cases hb : BddAbove (Set.range f)
383  · apply le_antisymm
384    · refine ciSup_le fun x => key _ (fun d => ?_) x
385      exact le_ciSup (f := fun d : D => f d) ⟨hb.some, by rintro _ ⟨d, rfl⟩; exact hb.some_mem ⟨d, rfl⟩⟩ d
386    · exact ciSup_le fun d => le_ciSup hb d.1
387  · have hb' : ¬ BddAbove (Set.range fun d : D => f d) := by
388      rintro ⟨B, hB⟩
389      refine hb ⟨B, ?_⟩
390      rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
391      exact key B (fun d => hB ⟨d, rfl⟩) x
392    rw [Real.iSup_of_not_bddAbove hb, Real.iSup_of_not_bddAbove hb']
393
394omit [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] in
395lemma exists_countable_pairs :
396    ∃ S : Set (OrthonormalPairs H), S.Countable ∧ ∀ C : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ,
397      traceNormForm C = ⨆ s : S, ∑ i, |C (s.1.1.2.1 i) (s.1.1.2.2 i)| := by
398  letI : TopologicalSpace (OrthonormalPairs H) :=
399    inferInstanceAs (TopologicalSpace {p : (n : ℕ) × (Fin n → H) × (Fin n → H) //
400      Orthonormal ℝ p.2.1 ∧ Orthonormal ℝ p.2.2})
401  have : SecondCountableTopology (OrthonormalPairs H) :=
402    (Topology.IsInducing.subtypeVal (Y := (n : ℕ) × (Fin n → H) × (Fin n → H))
403      (t := {p | Orthonormal ℝ p.2.1 ∧ Orthonormal ℝ p.2.2})).secondCountableTopology
404  obtain ⟨S, hSc, hSd⟩ := TopologicalSpace.exists_countable_dense (OrthonormalPairs H)
405  refine ⟨S, hSc, fun C => ?_⟩
406  have hcont : Continuous fun p : OrthonormalPairs H => ∑ i, |C (p.1.2.1 i) (p.1.2.2 i)| := by
407    have h1 : Continuous fun s : (n : ℕ) × (Fin n → H) × (Fin n → H) =>
408        ∑ i : Fin s.1, |C (s.2.1 i) (s.2.2 i)| := by
409      refine continuous_sigma fun n => ?_
410      show Continuous fun a : (Fin n → H) × (Fin n → H) => ∑ i : Fin n, |C (a.1 i) (a.2 i)|
411      fun_prop
412    exact h1.comp continuous_subtype_val
413  exact iSup_dense_real hcont hSd
414
415omit [BorelSpace H] in
416lemma measurable_traceNormForm {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
417    (D : α → H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hD : ∀ x y : H, Measurable fun a => D a x y) :
418    Measurable fun a => traceNormForm (D a) := by
419  obtain ⟨S, hSc, hS⟩ := exists_countable_pairs (H := H)
420  have : Countable S := hSc.to_subtype
421  simp_rw [hS]
422  refine Measurable.iSup fun s => ?_
423  exact Finset.measurable_sum _ fun i _ => (hD _ _).abs
424
425end A22Meas

427section A22J
428
429variable {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ} {t : ℝ} {M : ℝ → Ω → H} {Sg : ℝ → Ω → (H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ)}
430  {sb : ℝ → (H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ)}
431
432lemma measurable_discrepancy_density (hM : IsHilbertMartingaleWithCovariation P ℱ t M Sg)
433    (hsb : IsDetCovDensity t sb) :
434    Measurable (Function.uncurry fun σ ω => traceNormForm (Sg σ ω - sb σ)) := by
435  have := measurable_traceNormForm (H := H) (α := ℝ × Ω)
436    (fun a => Sg a.1 a.2 - sb a.1) (fun x y => by
437      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
438      exact (hM.sigma_meas x y).sub ((hsb.meas x y).comp measurable_fst))
439  exact this
440
441lemma discrepancy_pathint (hM : IsHilbertMartingaleWithCovariation P ℱ t M Sg)
442    (hsb : IsDetCovDensity t sb) :
443    ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, IntegrableOn (fun σ => traceNormForm (Sg σ ω - sb σ)) (Set.Icc 0 t) ∧
444      ∀ σ ∈ Set.Icc 0 t, traceNormForm (Sg σ ω - sb σ) ≤
445        traceNormForm (Sg σ ω) + traceNormForm (sb σ) := by
446  have hmeas := measurable_discrepancy_density P hM hsb
447  filter_upwards [hM.sigma_traceClass, hM.sigma_pathint] with ω hω hpath
448  have hbd : ∀ σ ∈ Set.Icc 0 t, traceNormForm (Sg σ ω - sb σ) ≤
449      traceNormForm (Sg σ ω) + traceNormForm (sb σ) := fun σ hσ =>
450    traceNormForm_sub_le (hω σ hσ) (hsb.traceClass σ hσ)
451  refine ⟨?_, hbd⟩
452  refine Integrable.mono' (hpath.add hsb.int)
453    (hmeas.comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const) |>.aestronglyMeasurable) ?_
454  refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Icc).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun σ hσ => ?_)
455  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (traceNormForm_nonneg _)]
456  exact hbd σ hσ
457
458lemma discrepancy_integrable (hM : IsHilbertMartingaleWithCovariation P ℱ t M Sg)
459    (hsb : IsDetCovDensity t sb) :
460    Integrable (fun ω => ∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 t, traceNormForm (Sg σ ω - sb σ)) P := by
461  have hmeas := measurable_discrepancy_density P hM hsb
462  have hsm : StronglyMeasurable fun ω => ∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 t, traceNormForm (Sg σ ω - sb σ) := by
463    have := (hmeas.comp (measurable_swap (α := Ω) (β := ℝ))).stronglyMeasurable
464    exact this.integral_prod_right' (ν := volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 t))
465  set c : ℝ := ∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 t, traceNormForm (sb σ) with hc
466  refine Integrable.mono' ((hM.sigma_int).add (integrable_const c)) hsm.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
467  filter_upwards [discrepancy_pathint P hM hsb, hM.sigma_pathint] with ω hd hpath
468  obtain ⟨hint1, hbd⟩ := hd
469  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Icc fun σ _ => traceNormForm_nonneg _)]
470  calc ∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 t, traceNormForm (Sg σ ω - sb σ)
471      ≤ ∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 t, (traceNormForm (Sg σ ω) + traceNormForm (sb σ)) :=
472        setIntegral_mono_on hint1 (hpath.add hsb.int) measurableSet_Icc hbd
473    _ = (∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 t, traceNormForm (Sg σ ω)) + c := integral_add hpath hsb.int
474    _ = _ := rfl
475
476end A22J
477
478section A22Comp
479
480lemma cbUnitBall_comp_clm {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
481    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (g : E →L[ℝ] F) (hg : ‖g‖ ≤ 1) {k : ℕ}
482    {Φ : F → ℝ} (hΦ : Φ ∈ CbUnitBall F k) : (Φ ∘ g) ∈ CbUnitBall E k := by
483  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hΦ
484  have hb : ∀ j ≤ k, ∀ x : E, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (Φ ∘ g) x‖ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j Φ (g x)‖ := by
485    intro j hj x
486    rw [g.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right h1 x (by exact_mod_cast hj)]
487    refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le _ _).trans ?_
488    have : ∏ _i : Fin j, ‖g‖ ≤ 1 := by
489      rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]; exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) hg
490    calc _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j Φ (g x)‖ * 1 := by gcongr
491      _ = _ := mul_one _
492  refine ⟨h1.comp g.contDiff, fun j hj => ?_, ?_⟩
493  · obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := h2 j hj
494    exact ⟨B, by rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩; exact (hb j hj x).trans (hB ⟨g x, rfl⟩)⟩
495  · refine le_trans ?_ h3
496    unfold cbNorm
497    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun j hj => ?_
498    have hjk : j ≤ k := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (Finset.mem_range.1 hj)
499    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := h2 j hjk
500    have : Nonempty E := ⟨0⟩
501    refine ciSup_le fun x => (hb j hjk x).trans ?_
502    exact le_ciSup (f := fun z : F => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j Φ z‖) ⟨B, by rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩; exact hB ⟨z, rfl⟩⟩ (g x)
503
504end A22Comp

506section A22Coord
507
508variable {d : ℕ}
509
510/-- The coordinate map `x ↦ (⟨b_a, x⟩)_a ∈ ℝ^d`. -/
511def hmCoordCLM (b : Fin d → H) : H →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
512  (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin d) ℝ).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
513    (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun a => innerSL ℝ (b a))
514
515lemma hmCoordCLM_apply (b : Fin d → H) (x : H) (a : Fin d) :
516    hmCoordCLM b x a = inner ℝ (b a) x := by
517  simp [hmCoordCLM]
518
519/-- The synthesis map `y ↦ ∑_a y_a b_a`. -/
520def embedCLM (b : Fin d → H) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) →L[ℝ] H :=
521  ∑ a, (EuclideanSpace.proj a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (b a)
522
523lemma embedCLM_apply (b : Fin d → H) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
524    embedCLM b y = ∑ a, y a • b a := by
525  simp [embedCLM]
526
527lemma norm_embedCLM_apply {b : Fin d → H} (hb : Orthonormal ℝ b) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
528    ‖embedCLM b y‖ = ‖y‖ := by
529  have h1 : ‖embedCLM b y‖ ^ 2 = ∑ a, (y a) ^ 2 := by
530    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, embedCLM_apply]
531    simp only [sum_inner, inner_sum, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right]
532    have : ∀ c c', inner ℝ (b c) (b c') = if c = c' then (1 : ℝ) else 0 :=
533      orthonormal_iff_ite.1 hb
534    simp only [this, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.sum_ite_eq',
535      Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
536    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => by ring
537  have h2 : ‖y‖ ^ 2 = ∑ a, (y a) ^ 2 := by
538    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
539    simp
540  have := h1.trans h2.symm
541  exact (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).1 this
542
543lemma norm_embedCLM_le {b : Fin d → H} (hb : Orthonormal ℝ b) : ‖embedCLM b‖ ≤ 1 :=
544  ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one fun y => by
545    rw [norm_embedCLM_apply hb, one_mul]
546
547end A22Coord
548
549section A22Mat
550
551lemma measurable_traceNormMatrix {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {d : ℕ}
552    (D : α → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) (hD : ∀ i j, Measurable fun a => D a i j) :
553    Measurable fun a => traceNormMatrix (D a) := by
554  have : SecondCountableTopology (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) :=
555    inferInstanceAs (SecondCountableTopology (Fin d → Fin d → ℝ))
556  have : SecondCountableTopology (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin d) ℝ) :=
557    (Topology.IsInducing.subtypeVal (Y := Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)
558      (t := (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin d) ℝ : Set (Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)))).secondCountableTopology
559  obtain ⟨S, hSc, hSd⟩ := TopologicalSpace.exists_countable_dense (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin d) ℝ)
560  have : Countable S := hSc.to_subtype
561  have hcont : ∀ Q : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ, Continuous fun U : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin d) ℝ =>
562      Matrix.trace (Q.transpose * (U : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)) := by
563    intro Q
564    simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply]
565    exact continuous_finset_sum _ fun i _ => continuous_finset_sum _ fun j _ =>
566      continuous_const.mul (continuous_subtype_val.matrix_elem j i)
567  have heq : ∀ Q, traceNormMatrix Q = ⨆ s : S, Matrix.trace (Q.transpose * (s.1 : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ)) :=
568    fun Q => iSup_dense_real (hcont Q) hSd
569  simp_rw [heq]
570  refine Measurable.iSup fun s => ?_
571  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply]
572  exact Finset.measurable_sum _ fun i _ => Finset.measurable_sum _ fun j _ => (hD j i).mul_const _
573
574lemma posSemidef_gram {d : ℕ} {B : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ} (hsymm : ∀ x y, B x y = B y x)
575    (hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ B x x) (b : Fin d → H) :
576    (Matrix.of fun a c => B (b a) (b c) : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ).PosSemidef := by
577  rw [Matrix.posSemidef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec]
578  refine ⟨?_, fun x => ?_⟩
579  · ext a c
580    simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, hsymm (b a) (b c)]
581  · have : dotProduct (star x) (Matrix.mulVec (Matrix.of fun a c => B (b a) (b c)) x) =
582        B (∑ a, x a • b a) (∑ c, x c • b c) := by
583      simp only [star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Matrix.of_apply, map_sum, map_smul,
584        sum_apply, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
585      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => by
586        rw [hsymm (b c) (b a)]; ring
587    rw [this]
588    exact hnn _
589
590end A22Mat
591
592section A22Vec
593
594variable {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ} {t : ℝ} {M : ℝ → Ω → H} {Sg : ℝ → Ω → (H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ)}
595  {sb : ℝ → (H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ)} {d : ℕ}
596
597lemma isVectorMartingale_coord (hM : IsHilbertMartingaleWithCovariation P ℱ t M Sg)
598    {b : Fin d → H} (hb : Orthonormal ℝ b) :
599    IsVectorMartingaleWithCovariation P ℱ t (fun τ ω => hmCoordCLM b (M τ ω))
600      (fun σ ω => compMat b (Sg σ ω)) := by
601  have hentry : ∀ (σ : ℝ) (ω : Ω) (a c : Fin d), compMat b (Sg σ ω) a c = Sg σ ω (b a) (b c) :=
602    fun _ _ _ _ => rfl
603  have hmeasS : Measurable (Function.uncurry fun σ ω => s1Norm (compMat b (Sg σ ω))) :=
604    measurable_traceNormMatrix (fun a : ℝ × Ω => compMat b (Sg a.1 a.2))
605      (fun i j => hM.sigma_meas (b i) (b j))
606  have hbd : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ∀ σ ∈ Set.Icc 0 t,
607      s1Norm (compMat b (Sg σ ω)) ≤ traceNormForm (Sg σ ω) := by
608    filter_upwards [hM.sigma_traceClass] with ω h σ hσ
609    exact traceNormMatrix_compMat_le hb (bddAbove_pairSum (h σ hσ))
610  have hpath : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, IntegrableOn (fun σ => s1Norm (compMat b (Sg σ ω))) (Set.Icc 0 t) := by
611    filter_upwards [hbd, hM.sigma_pathint] with ω h1 h2
612    refine Integrable.mono' h2
613      (hmeasS.comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
614    refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Icc).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun σ hσ => ?_)
615    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (traceNormMatrix_nonneg _)]
616    exact h1 σ hσ
617  refine
618    { martingale := fun a => ?_
619      zero := ?_
620      cont := ?_
621      sq_int := fun τ hτ => ?_
622      sigma_meas := ?_
623      sigma_adapted := fun σ => ?_
624      sigma_psd := ?_
625      sigma_int := ?_
626      sigma_pathint := ?_
627      sigma_entry_int := ?_
628      covariation := fun a c => ?_ }
629  · have h := hM.martingale (b a)
630    have e : (fun τ ω => hmCoordCLM b (M τ ω) a) = fun τ ω => inner ℝ (M τ ω) (b a) := by
631      funext τ ω; rw [hmCoordCLM_apply, real_inner_comm]
632    show Martingale (fun τ ω => hmCoordCLM b (M τ ω) a) ℱ P
633    rw [e]; exact h
634  · filter_upwards [hM.zero] with ω h
635    show hmCoordCLM b (M 0 ω) = 0
636    rw [h, map_zero]
637  · filter_upwards [hM.cont] with ω h
638    exact (hmCoordCLM b).continuous.comp_continuousOn h
639  · exact (hmCoordCLM b).comp_memLp' (hM.sq_int τ hτ)
640  · refine measurable_pi_iff.2 fun a => measurable_pi_iff.2 fun c => ?_
641    exact hM.sigma_meas (b a) (b c)
642  · letI : MeasurableSpace Ω := ℱ σ
643    refine measurable_pi_iff.2 fun a => measurable_pi_iff.2 fun c => ?_
644    exact hM.sigma_adapted σ (b a) (b c)
645  · filter_upwards [hM.sigma_traceClass] with ω h σ hσ
646    exact posSemidef_gram (h σ hσ).symm (h σ hσ).nonneg b
647  · have hsm : StronglyMeasurable fun ω => ∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 t, s1Norm (compMat b (Sg σ ω)) :=
648      ((hmeasS.comp (measurable_swap (α := Ω) (β := ℝ))).stronglyMeasurable).integral_prod_right'
649        (ν := volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 t))
650    refine Integrable.mono' hM.sigma_int hsm.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
651    filter_upwards [hbd, hpath, hM.sigma_pathint] with ω h1 h2 h3
652    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Icc fun σ _ =>
653      traceNormMatrix_nonneg _)]
654    exact setIntegral_mono_on h2 h3 measurableSet_Icc h1
655  · exact hpath
656  · filter_upwards [hM.sigma_entry_int] with ω h a c
657    exact h (b a) (b c)
658  · have h := hM.covariation (b a) (b c)
659    have e : (fun τ ω => hmCoordCLM b (M τ ω) a * hmCoordCLM b (M τ ω) c -
660        ∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 τ, compMat b (Sg σ ω) a c) = fun τ ω =>
661        inner ℝ (M τ ω) (b a) * inner ℝ (M τ ω) (b c) - ∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 τ, Sg σ ω (b a) (b c) := by
662      funext τ ω; rw [hmCoordCLM_apply, hmCoordCLM_apply, real_inner_comm, real_inner_comm (M τ ω) (b c)]
663      rfl
664    show Martingale (fun τ ω => hmCoordCLM b (M τ ω) a * hmCoordCLM b (M τ ω) c -
665        ∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 τ, compMat b (Sg σ ω) a c) ℱ P
666    rw [e]; exact h
667
668end A22Vec

672variable {t : ℝ} {sb : ℝ → (H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ)} {d : ℕ}

674lemma adjoint_hmCoordCLM (b : Fin d → H) (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
675    (hmCoordCLM b).adjoint u = embedCLM b u := by
676  refine ext_inner_right ℝ fun x => ?_
677  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left, embedCLM_apply, sum_inner]
678  simp only [real_inner_smul_left, PiLp.inner_apply, hmCoordCLM_apply]
679  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
680  simp [mul_comm]
681
682lemma map_coord_gaussian {γ : Measure H} (hγ : IsGaussianWithIntegratedCov t sb γ)
683    {b : Fin d → H} :
684    γ.map (hmCoordCLM b) = ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0
685      (Matrix.of fun i j => ∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 t, sb σ (b i) (b j)) := by
686  obtain ⟨hprob, hcg, hcov⟩ := hγ
687  have hG : IsGaussian γ := hcg.1
688  set S : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ := Matrix.of fun i j => ∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 t, sb σ (b i) (b j)
689    with hSdef
690  have hS : S = Matrix.of fun i j => covarianceBilin γ (b i) (b j) := by
691    ext i j; simp [hSdef, hcov]
692  have hSpsd : S.PosSemidef := by
693    rw [hS]
694    exact posSemidef_gram (B := covarianceBilin γ) (covarianceBilin_comm) (covarianceBilin_self_nonneg) b
695  have hmem : MemLp id 2 γ := IsGaussian.memLp_two_id
696  refine IsGaussian.ext ?_ ?_
697  · rw [integral_id_multivariateGaussian']
698    show ∫ x, x ∂(γ.map (hmCoordCLM b)) = 0
699    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.integral_id_map (hmem.integrable (by simp))]
700    have := HilbertCLTAux.gaussian_mean_zero (H := H) hcg
701    have h0 : ∫ x, x ∂γ = 0 := this
702    rw [h0, map_zero]
703  · ext u v
704    rw [covarianceBilin_multivariateGaussian hSpsd, covarianceBilin_map hmem, adjoint_hmCoordCLM,
705      adjoint_hmCoordCLM, embedCLM_apply, embedCLM_apply]
706    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, sum_apply, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hS, Matrix.of_apply,
707      dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Finset.mul_sum]
708    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
709    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => ?_
710    ring

714section A22FD

716variable {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ} {t : ℝ} {M : ℝ → Ω → H} {Sg : ℝ → Ω → (H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ)}
717  {sb : ℝ → (H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ)} {d : ℕ}
718
719lemma finite_dim_step (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hM : IsHilbertMartingaleWithCovariation P ℱ t M Sg)
720    (hsb : IsDetCovDensity t sb) {γ : Measure H} (hγ : IsGaussianWithIntegratedCov t sb γ)
721    {b : Fin d → H} (hb : Orthonormal ℝ b) {Φ : H → ℝ} (hΦ : Φ ∈ CbUnitBall H 2) :
722    |∫ ω, Φ (embedCLM b (hmCoordCLM b (M t ω))) ∂P -
723        ∫ x, Φ (embedCLM b (hmCoordCLM b x)) ∂γ| ≤ (1 / 2) * covDiscrepancy P t Sg sb := by
724  have hprob : IsProbabilityMeasure γ := hγ.1
725  have hMc := isVectorMartingale_coord P hM hb
726  have hsbmeas : Measurable (fun σ => compMat b (sb σ)) :=
727    measurable_pi_iff.2 fun a => measurable_pi_iff.2 fun c => hsb.meas (b a) (b c)
728  have hsbmeasS : Measurable fun σ => s1Norm (compMat b (sb σ)) :=
729    measurable_traceNormMatrix (fun σ => compMat b (sb σ)) (fun i j => hsb.meas (b i) (b j))
730  have hsbint : IntegrableOn (fun σ => s1Norm (compMat b (sb σ))) (Set.Icc 0 t) := by
731    refine Integrable.mono' hsb.int hsbmeasS.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
732    refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Icc).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun σ hσ => ?_)
733    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (traceNormMatrix_nonneg _)]
734    exact traceNormMatrix_compMat_le hb (bddAbove_pairSum (hsb.traceClass σ hσ))
735  have hsbpsd : ∀ σ ∈ Set.Icc 0 t, (compMat b (sb σ)).PosSemidef := fun σ hσ =>
736    posSemidef_gram (hsb.traceClass σ hσ).symm (hsb.traceClass σ hσ).nonneg b
737  have hdc2 := multivariate_martingale_clt_dc2 P ℱ t ht _ _ hMc (fun σ => compMat b (sb σ))
738    hsbmeas hsbint hsbpsd
739  have hgauss := map_coord_gaussian (b := b) hγ
740  have hΦ' : (Φ ∘ embedCLM b) ∈ CbUnitBall (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) 2 :=
741    cbUnitBall_comp_clm _ (norm_embedCLM_le hb) hΦ
742  have hmt : AEMeasurable (fun ω => hmCoordCLM b (M t ω)) P :=
743    ((hmCoordCLM b).continuous.measurable.comp_aemeasurable
744      (hM.sq_int t ⟨ht, le_rfl⟩).aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable)
745  have hlaw := abs_integral_sub_le_smoothDist hΦ' (law P fun ω => hmCoordCLM b (M t ω))
746    (γ.map (hmCoordCLM b))
747  have hc1 : ∫ z, (Φ ∘ embedCLM b) z ∂(law P fun ω => hmCoordCLM b (M t ω)) =
748      ∫ ω, Φ (embedCLM b (hmCoordCLM b (M t ω))) ∂P :=
749    integral_map hmt (hΦ.1.continuous.comp (embedCLM b).continuous).aestronglyMeasurable
750  have hc2 : ∫ z, (Φ ∘ embedCLM b) z ∂(γ.map (hmCoordCLM b)) =
751      ∫ x, Φ (embedCLM b (hmCoordCLM b x)) ∂γ :=
752    integral_map (hmCoordCLM b).continuous.measurable.aemeasurable
753      (hΦ.1.continuous.comp (embedCLM b).continuous).aestronglyMeasurable
754  rw [hc1, hc2] at hlaw
755  rw [hgauss] at hlaw
756  refine hlaw.trans (le_trans hdc2 ?_)
757  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by norm_num)
758  unfold covDiscrepancy
759  refine integral_mono_of_nonneg (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω =>
760    setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Icc fun σ _ => traceNormMatrix_nonneg _)
761    (discrepancy_integrable P hM hsb) ?_
762  filter_upwards [discrepancy_pathint P hM hsb, hM.sigma_traceClass] with ω hd htc
763  refine integral_mono_of_nonneg ((ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Icc).2
764    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun σ _ => traceNormMatrix_nonneg _)) hd.1 ?_
765  refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Icc).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun σ hσ => ?_)
766  have : compMat b (Sg σ ω) - compMat b (sb σ) = compMat b (Sg σ ω - sb σ) := by
767    ext a c; rfl
768  show s1Norm (compMat b (Sg σ ω) - compMat b (sb σ)) ≤ traceNormForm (Sg σ ω - sb σ)
769  rw [this]
770  exact traceNormMatrix_compMat_le hb (bddAbove_pairSum_sub (htc σ hσ) (hsb.traceClass σ hσ))
771
772end A22FD

774section A22Tail
775
776lemma exists_orthonormal_proj (K : Submodule ℝ H) [FiniteDimensional ℝ K] :
777    ∃ (d : ℕ) (b : Fin d → H), Orthonormal ℝ b ∧
778      ∀ x, embedCLM b (hmCoordCLM b x) = K.starProjection x := by
779  classical
780  let B := stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ K
781  refine ⟨Module.finrank ℝ K, fun a => (B a : H), ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
782  · rw [orthonormal_iff_ite]
783    intro i j
784    have := orthonormal_iff_ite.1 B.orthonormal i j
785    simpa using this
786  · rw [embedCLM_apply, Submodule.starProjection_apply, B.orthogonalProjectionOnto_apply_eq_sum]
787    simp [hmCoordCLM_apply]
788
789lemma hm_tail_bound (ρ : Measure H) [IsProbabilityMeasure ρ] (hρ : MemLp id 2 ρ)
790    (K : Submodule ℝ H) [K.HasOrthogonalProjection] :
791    Integrable (fun x : H => ‖x - K.starProjection x‖) ρ ∧
792    ∫ x, ‖x - K.starProjection x‖ ∂ρ ≤ Real.sqrt (∫ x, ‖x - K.starProjection x‖ ^ 2 ∂ρ) := by
793  set A : H →L[ℝ] H := ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ H - K.starProjection with hA
794  have hAx : ∀ x, A x = x - K.starProjection x := fun x => by simp [hA]
795  have hMem : MemLp (fun x : H => ‖x - K.starProjection x‖) 2 ρ := by
796    have := (A.comp_memLp' hρ).norm
797    simpa [hAx] using this
798  exact ⟨hMem.integrable (by norm_num), integral_le_sqrt ρ hMem⟩
799
800end A22Tail

802section A22Main
803
804variable {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ} {t : ℝ} {M : ℝ → Ω → H} {Sg : ℝ → Ω → (H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ)}
805  {sb : ℝ → (H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ)}
806
807lemma hilbert_clt_core (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hM : IsHilbertMartingaleWithCovariation P ℱ t M Sg)
808    (hsb : IsDetCovDensity t sb) {γ : Measure H} (hγ : IsGaussianWithIntegratedCov t sb γ)
809    {Φ : H → ℝ} (hΦ : Φ ∈ CbUnitBall H 2) :
810    |∫ ω, Φ (M t ω) ∂P - ∫ x, Φ x ∂γ| ≤ (1 / 2) * covDiscrepancy P t Sg sb := by
811  have hprob : IsProbabilityMeasure γ := hγ.1
812  have hGm : MemLp id 2 γ := by
813    have := hγ.2.1.1
814    exact IsGaussian.memLp_two_id
815  have hmt : AEMeasurable (M t) P := (hM.sq_int t ⟨ht, le_rfl⟩).aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable
816  have hρ : MemLp id 2 (law P (M t)) := by
817    rw [memLp_map_measure_iff aestronglyMeasurable_id hmt]
818    exact hM.sq_int t ⟨ht, le_rfl⟩
819  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (law P (M t)) := inferInstance
820  have hΦ1 : Φ ∈ CbUnitBall H 1 := cbUnitBall_anti (by norm_num) hΦ
821  have hlip : LipschitzWith 1 Φ := LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul fun x y => by
822    simpa [dist_eq_norm, Real.dist_eq] using norm_sub_le_of_mem_one hΦ1 x y
823  have hC : ∀ x y, dist (Φ x) (Φ y) ≤ 2 := fun x y => by
824    rw [Real.dist_eq]
825    have h1 := abs_apply_le_of_mem hΦ x
826    have h2 := abs_apply_le_of_mem hΦ y
827    calc |Φ x - Φ y| ≤ |Φ x| + |Φ y| := abs_sub _ _
828      _ ≤ 2 := by linarith
829  have hΦc : Continuous Φ := hΦ.1.continuous
830  set J := covDiscrepancy P t Sg sb with hJ
831  have hρsq := HilbertCLTAux.integrable_sq_norm_of_memLp2 hρ
832  have hγsq := HilbertCLTAux.integrable_sq_norm_of_memLp2 hGm
833  have key : ∀ n : ℕ, |∫ ω, Φ (M t ω) ∂P - ∫ x, Φ x ∂γ| ≤
834      (1 / 2) * J + (Real.sqrt (∫ x, ‖x - (HilbertCLTAux.denseSub (H := H) n).starProjection x‖ ^ 2
835        ∂(law P (M t))) +
836        Real.sqrt (∫ x, ‖x - (HilbertCLTAux.denseSub (H := H) n).starProjection x‖ ^ 2 ∂γ)) := by
837    intro n
838    set K := HilbertCLTAux.denseSub (H := H) n with hK
839    obtain ⟨d, b, hb, hP⟩ := exists_orthonormal_proj K
840    have fd := finite_dim_step P ht hM hsb hγ hb hΦ
841    simp_rw [hP] at fd
842    obtain ⟨hi1, hi2⟩ := hm_tail_bound (law P (M t)) hρ K
843    obtain ⟨hj1, hj2⟩ := hm_tail_bound γ hGm K
844    have t1 := HilbertCLTAux.lip_tail_bound (law P (M t)) K hC hlip hi1
845    have t2 := HilbertCLTAux.lip_tail_bound γ K hC hlip hj1
846    have e1 : ∫ x, Φ x ∂(law P (M t)) = ∫ ω, Φ (M t ω) ∂P :=
847      integral_map hmt hΦc.aestronglyMeasurable
848    have e2 : ∫ x, Φ (K.starProjection x) ∂(law P (M t)) = ∫ ω, Φ (K.starProjection (M t ω)) ∂P :=
849      integral_map hmt (hΦc.comp K.starProjection.continuous).aestronglyMeasurable
850    rw [e1, e2] at t1
851    simp only [NNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at t1 t2
852    have h3 := abs_add_three (∫ ω, Φ (M t ω) ∂P - ∫ ω, Φ (K.starProjection (M t ω)) ∂P)
853      (∫ ω, Φ (K.starProjection (M t ω)) ∂P - ∫ x, Φ (K.starProjection x) ∂γ)
854      (∫ x, Φ (K.starProjection x) ∂γ - ∫ x, Φ x ∂γ)
855    have e3 : ∫ ω, Φ (M t ω) ∂P - ∫ x, Φ x ∂γ =
856        (∫ ω, Φ (M t ω) ∂P - ∫ ω, Φ (K.starProjection (M t ω)) ∂P) +
857        (∫ ω, Φ (K.starProjection (M t ω)) ∂P - ∫ x, Φ (K.starProjection x) ∂γ) +
858        (∫ x, Φ (K.starProjection x) ∂γ - ∫ x, Φ x ∂γ) := by ring
859    rw [e3]
860    rw [abs_sub_comm (∫ x, Φ (K.starProjection x) ∂γ)] at h3
861    have := t2
862    linarith
863  have hT : ∀ (ρ : Measure H) [IsProbabilityMeasure ρ], Integrable (fun x : H => ‖x‖ ^ 2) ρ →
864      Tendsto (fun n => Real.sqrt (∫ x, ‖x - (HilbertCLTAux.denseSub (H := H) n).starProjection x‖ ^ 2
865        ∂ρ)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
866    intro ρ _ hρ'
867    have := (Real.continuous_sqrt.tendsto (0 : ℝ)).comp (HilbertCLTAux.denseSub_tail ρ hρ')
868    rw [Real.sqrt_zero] at this
869    exact this
870  have hlim := tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1 / 2) * J) |>.add
871    ((hT (law P (M t)) hρsq).add (hT γ hγsq))
872  have := ge_of_tendsto' hlim key
873  simpa using this
874
875end A22Main

877section A22Cond
878
879lemma ae_le_of_setIntegral_le_trim {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} (hm : m ≤ mΩ) {f g : Ω → ℝ}
880    (hf : StronglyMeasurable[m] f) (hg : StronglyMeasurable[m] g)
881    (hfi : Integrable f P) (hgi : Integrable g P)
882    (h : ∀ s, MeasurableSet[m] s → ∫ x in s, f x ∂P ≤ ∫ x in s, g x ∂P) : f ≤ᵐ[P] g := by
883  have := @ae_le_of_forall_setIntegral_le Ω m (P.trim hm) f g (hfi.trim hm hf) (hgi.trim hm hg)
884    (fun s hs _ => by
885      rw [← setIntegral_trim hm hf hs, ← setIntegral_trim hm hg hs]
886      exact h s hs)
887  exact ae_of_ae_trim hm this
888
889lemma martingale_cond {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ} {f : ℝ → Ω → ℝ} (hf : Martingale f ℱ P)
890    (h0 : f 0 =ᵐ[P] 0) {A : Set Ω}
891    (hA : MeasurableSet[ℱ 0] A) (hP0 : P A ≠ 0) : Martingale f ℱ (ProbabilityTheory.cond P A) := by
892  have hAm : MeasurableSet A := ℱ.le 0 _ hA
893  refine ⟨hf.1, fun i j hij => ?_⟩
894  have hmi : ℱ i ≤ mΩ := ℱ.le i
895  have hint : ∀ k, Integrable (f k) (ProbabilityTheory.cond P A) := fun k =>
896    ((hf.integrable k).restrict (s := A)).smul_measure (ENNReal.inv_ne_top.2 hP0)
897  -- `f k = 0` a.s. for `k ≤ 0`
898  have hneg : ∀ k, k ≤ 0 → f k =ᵐ[P] 0 := by
899    intro k hk
900    have h1 := hf.2 k 0 hk
901    have h2 : P[f 0 | ℱ k] =ᵐ[P] P[(0 : Ω → ℝ) | ℱ k] := condExp_congr_ae h0
902    rw [condExp_zero] at h2
903    exact h1.symm.trans h2
904  have hset : ∀ s, MeasurableSet[ℱ i] s → ∫ x in s ∩ A, f i x ∂P = ∫ x in s ∩ A, f j x ∂P := by
905    intro s hs
906    by_cases hi : 0 ≤ i
907    · exact hf.setIntegral_eq hij (hs.inter (ℱ.mono hi _ hA))
908    · push_neg at hi
909      have hsA : MeasurableSet[ℱ 0] (s ∩ A) := ((ℱ.mono hi.le) _ hs).inter hA
910      have e1 : ∫ x in s ∩ A, f i x ∂P = 0 := by
911        rw [integral_congr_ae (ae_restrict_of_ae (hneg i hi.le))]; simp
912      rw [e1]
913      by_cases hj : 0 ≤ j
914      · rw [← hf.setIntegral_eq hj hsA, integral_congr_ae (ae_restrict_of_ae h0)]; simp
915      · push_neg at hj
916        rw [integral_congr_ae (ae_restrict_of_ae (hneg j hj.le))]; simp
917  symm
918  refine ae_eq_condExp_of_forall_setIntegral_eq hmi (hint j) (fun s _ _ => (hint i).integrableOn)
919    (fun s hs _ => ?_) (hf.1 i).aestronglyMeasurable
920  have hsm : MeasurableSet s := hmi _ hs
921  simp only [ProbabilityTheory.cond, Measure.restrict_smul, integral_smul_measure]
922  rw [Measure.restrict_restrict hsm, hset s hs]
923
924lemma isHilbertMartingale_cond {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ} {t : ℝ} {M : ℝ → Ω → H}
925    {Sg : ℝ → Ω → (H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ)} (hM : IsHilbertMartingaleWithCovariation P ℱ t M Sg)
926    {A : Set Ω} (hA : MeasurableSet[ℱ 0] A) (hP0 : P A ≠ 0) :
927    IsHilbertMartingaleWithCovariation (ProbabilityTheory.cond P A) ℱ t M Sg := by
928  have hac : ProbabilityTheory.cond P A ≪ P := ProbabilityTheory.cond_absolutelyContinuous
929  have hc : (P A)⁻¹ ≠ ∞ := ENNReal.inv_ne_top.2 hP0
930  have hzero : ∀ x : H, (fun ω => inner ℝ (M 0 ω) x) =ᵐ[P] 0 := fun x => by
931    filter_upwards [hM.zero] with ω h
932    simp [h]
933  refine
934    { martingale := fun x => martingale_cond P (hM.martingale x) (hzero x) hA hP0
935      zero := hac.ae_le hM.zero
936      cont := hac.ae_le hM.cont
937      sq_int := fun τ hτ => ?_
938      sigma_meas := hM.sigma_meas
939      sigma_adapted := hM.sigma_adapted
940      sigma_traceClass := hac.ae_le hM.sigma_traceClass
941      sigma_int := ?_
942      sigma_pathint := hac.ae_le hM.sigma_pathint
943      sigma_entry_int := hac.ae_le hM.sigma_entry_int
944      covariation := fun x y => ?_ }
945  · exact ((hM.sq_int τ hτ).restrict A).smul_measure hc
946  · exact (hM.sigma_int.restrict (s := A)).smul_measure hc
947  · refine martingale_cond P (hM.covariation x y) ?_ hA hP0
948    filter_upwards [hM.zero] with ω h
949    simp [h]
950
951end A22Cond
952
953/-- Lemma A.22 `M:B:lem:hilbert-martingale-clt` (source lines 10600-10611), bound
954`B:eq:hilbert-martingale-clt`: for a continuous square-integrable `H`-valued martingale `M`
955with `M_0 = 0` and tensor quadratic variation `∫_0^t Σ_r dr` (`Σ_r ≥ 0` trace class,
956`E ∫_0^t ‖Σ_r‖_{𝔖₁} < ∞`), a deterministic nonnegative trace-class integrable `Σ̄`, and `G`
957the centered Gaussian element of `H` with covariance `∫_0^t Σ̄_r dr`,
958`d_{C²}(Law M_t, Law G) ≤ ½ E ∫_0^t ‖Σ_r - Σ̄_r‖_{𝔖₁} dr`.
959
960PLAN (proof route, source lines 10613-10620): fix a Hilbert basis `e : ℕ → H`
961(`HilbertCLTAux.exists_hilbertBasis_type`) and the projections `P_n` onto `span (e_0, …, e_{n-1})`.
962The coordinate process `(⟨M, e_a⟩)_{a < n}` is an `ℝ^n`-valued martingale with covariation matrix
963`(Σ_r(e_a, e_b))_{ab}` (`IsVectorMartingaleWithCovariation`; the fields follow from the
964coordinatewise fields here and `traceNormMatrix ≤ traceNormForm` for the compression), so
965`multivariate_martingale_clt_dc2` gives the bound for `P_n M_t` and `P_n G` (the Gaussian
966`multivariateGaussian 0 (∫ Σ̄(e_a,e_b))` is the law of the coordinates of `G`, by
967`IsCenteredGaussian` and `covarianceBilin`).  Compression is contractive in trace norm:
968`traceNormMatrix (Σ(e_a,e_b))_{a,b<n} ≤ traceNormForm Σ` (directly from the variational formulas,
969`le_traceNormMatrix`/`traceNormMatrix_bddAbove`).  For a test function `Φ ∈ CbUnitBall H 2`,
970`|E Φ(M_t) - E Φ(P_n M_t)| ≤ E ‖(I - P_n) M_t‖` (`norm_sub_le_of_mem_one`, `cbUnitBall_anti`),
971and `E ‖(I - P_n) M_t‖² = ∑_{k ≥ n} E ⟨M_t, e_k⟩² = ∑_{k≥n} E ∫_0^t Σ_r(e_k,e_k) dr → 0` by the
972`covariation` martingale at `τ = t` (`integral_mul_martingale`-type lemmas in
973`HRS/Prob/MartingaleLindeberg.lean`) and `IsTraceClassCov.trace` with dominated/monotone
974convergence; the Gaussian tail `E ‖(I-P_n) G‖² = ∑_{k ≥ n} ∫ Σ̄(e_k,e_k)` likewise
975(`HilbertCLTAux.gaussian_tail_bound`, `hasSum_cov_basis`).  Pass `n → ∞`.  Uses
976`smoothDist_le`-type transfer of `smoothDist 2` between `H` restricted to `range P_n` and
977`ℝ^n` (`Φ ∘ ι_n ∈ CbUnitBall (ℝ^n) 2` for the isometry `ι_n`). -/
978theorem hilbert_martingale_clt (ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
979    (M : ℝ → Ω → H) (Sg : ℝ → Ω → (H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ))
980    (hM : IsHilbertMartingaleWithCovariation P ℱ t M Sg)
981    (sb : ℝ → (H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ)) (hsb : IsDetCovDensity t sb)
982    (γ : Measure H) (hγ : IsGaussianWithIntegratedCov t sb γ) :
983    smoothDist 2 (law P (M t)) γ ≤ (1 / 2) * covDiscrepancy P t Sg sb := by
984  have hmt : AEMeasurable (M t) P := (hM.sq_int t ⟨ht, le_rfl⟩).aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable
985  have hJ0 : 0 ≤ covDiscrepancy P t Sg sb :=
986    integral_nonneg fun ω => setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Icc fun σ _ => traceNormForm_nonneg _
987  refine Real.iSup_le (fun Φ => ?_) (by positivity)
988  have e : ∫ z, Φ.1 z ∂(law P (M t)) = ∫ ω, Φ.1 (M t ω) ∂P :=
989    integral_map hmt Φ.2.1.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
990  rw [e]
991  exact hilbert_clt_core P ht hM hsb hγ Φ.2
992
993/-- Lemma A.22, last sentence (source line 10610): "the same assertion holds conditionally on
994an initial sigma-field `𝒢 ⊂ ℱ_0`", i.e. for every test function `Φ` of the `d_{C²}` class,
995almost surely `|E[Φ(M_t) | 𝒢] - E[Φ(G)]| ≤ ½ E[∫_0^t ‖Σ_r - Σ̄_r‖_{𝔖₁} dr | 𝒢]`
996(the conditional law of `M_t` given `𝒢` against the law of `G`; stated for each test function
997because Mathlib has no regular conditional laws on `H`, cf. Lemma A.27 `B:newprob:conditional-bound`
998which is stated in exactly this form).
999
1000PLAN: either (a) the argument of `hilbert_martingale_clt` with `∫ · dP` replaced by `P[· | 𝒢]`
1001throughout (the Lindeberg partition bound of `HRS/Prob/MartingaleLindeberg.lean` conditioned on
1002`𝒢 ⊆ ℱ_0`; this is the finite-dimensional `conditional_gaussian_interpolation` below with `X = 0`
1003after projecting on `span (e_0,…,e_{n-1})`), or (b) `conditional_gaussian_interpolation` applied
1004to the coordinates (with a Gaussian `G` independent of `ℱ_t` built on an enlargement,
1005`exists_enlargement`, and transported back since `P[·|𝒢]` is insensitive to independent
1006enlargement), followed by the same projection/tail argument conditionally. -/
1007theorem hilbert_martingale_clt_cond (ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
1008    (𝒢 : InitialSigma ℱ)
1009    (M : ℝ → Ω → H) (Sg : ℝ → Ω → (H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ))
1010    (hM : IsHilbertMartingaleWithCovariation P ℱ t M Sg)
1011    (sb : ℝ → (H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ)) (hsb : IsDetCovDensity t sb)
1012    (γ : Measure H) (hγ : IsGaussianWithIntegratedCov t sb γ)
1013    (Φ : H → ℝ) (hΦ : Φ ∈ CbUnitBall H 2) :
1014    ∀ᵐ ω ∂P,
1015      |(P[fun ω => Φ (M t ω) | 𝒢.1]) ω - ∫ z, Φ z ∂γ| ≤
1016        (1 / 2) * (P[fun ω => ∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 t, traceNormForm (Sg σ ω - sb σ) | 𝒢.1]) ω := by
1017  have hm : 𝒢.1 ≤ mΩ := 𝒢.2.trans (ℱ.le 0)
1018  have hmt : AEMeasurable (M t) P := (hM.sq_int t ⟨ht, le_rfl⟩).aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable
1019  set X : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => Φ (M t ω) with hX
1020  set g : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => ∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 t, traceNormForm (Sg σ ω - sb σ) with hg
1021  set c : ℝ := ∫ z, Φ z ∂γ with hc
1022  have hΦc : Continuous Φ := hΦ.1.continuous
1023  have hXint : Integrable X P :=
1024    Integrable.of_bound (C := 1) (hΦc.measurable.comp_aemeasurable hmt).aestronglyMeasurable
1025      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => by simpa using abs_apply_le_of_mem hΦ (M t ω))
1026  have hgint : Integrable g P := discrepancy_integrable P hM hsb
1027  -- the weighted inequality on sets of `𝒢`
1028  have hSA : ∀ A, MeasurableSet[𝒢.1] A →
1029      |(∫ ω in A, X ω ∂P) - P.real A * c| ≤ (1 / 2) * ∫ ω in A, g ω ∂P := by
1030    intro A hA
1031    have hAm : MeasurableSet A := hm _ hA
1032    by_cases hP0 : P A = 0
1033    · have : P.restrict A = 0 := Measure.restrict_eq_zero.2 hP0
1034      simp [this, Measure.real, hP0]
1035    · have hAℱ : MeasurableSet[ℱ 0] A := 𝒢.2 _ hA
1036      have : IsProbabilityMeasure (ProbabilityTheory.cond P A) :=
1037        ProbabilityTheory.cond_isProbabilityMeasure hP0
1038      have hMc := isHilbertMartingale_cond P hM hAℱ hP0
1039      have hcore := hilbert_clt_core (ProbabilityTheory.cond P A) ht hMc hsb hγ hΦ
1040      have hI : ∀ F : Ω → ℝ, ∫ ω, F ω ∂(ProbabilityTheory.cond P A) =
1041          ((P A).toReal)⁻¹ * ∫ ω in A, F ω ∂P := by
1042        intro F
1043        simp [ProbabilityTheory.cond, integral_smul_measure, ENNReal.toReal_inv]
1044      unfold covDiscrepancy at hcore
1045      rw [hI, hI] at hcore
1046      have hp : 0 < (P A).toReal := ENNReal.toReal_pos hP0 (measure_ne_top P A)
1047      have hpr : P.real A = (P A).toReal := rfl
1048      rw [hpr]
1049      have e1 : (∫ ω in A, X ω ∂P) - (P A).toReal * c =
1050          (P A).toReal * (((P A).toReal)⁻¹ * ∫ ω in A, X ω ∂P - c) := by
1051        field_simp
1052      rw [e1, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hp]
1053      calc (P A).toReal * |((P A).toReal)⁻¹ * ∫ ω in A, X ω ∂P - c|
1054          ≤ (P A).toReal * ((1 / 2) * (((P A).toReal)⁻¹ * ∫ ω in A, g ω ∂P)) :=
1055            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcore hp.le
1056        _ = _ := by field_simp
1057  set U := P[X | 𝒢.1] with hU
1058  set V := P[g | 𝒢.1] with hV
1059  have hUm : StronglyMeasurable[𝒢.1] U := stronglyMeasurable_condExp
1060  have hVm : StronglyMeasurable[𝒢.1] V := stronglyMeasurable_condExp
1061  have hUi : Integrable U P := integrable_condExp
1062  have hVi : Integrable V P := integrable_condExp
1063  have hsetU : ∀ A, MeasurableSet[𝒢.1] A → ∫ ω in A, U ω ∂P = ∫ ω in A, X ω ∂P :=
1064    fun A hA => setIntegral_condExp hm hXint hA
1065  have hsetV : ∀ A, MeasurableSet[𝒢.1] A → ∫ ω in A, V ω ∂P = ∫ ω in A, g ω ∂P :=
1066    fun A hA => setIntegral_condExp hm hgint hA
1067  have hconst : ∀ A, MeasurableSet A → ∫ ω in A, c ∂P = P.real A * c := fun A hA => by
1068    rw [setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul]
1069  have h1 : (fun ω => U ω - c) ≤ᵐ[P] fun ω => (1 / 2) * V ω := by
1070    refine ae_le_of_setIntegral_le_trim P hm (hUm.sub stronglyMeasurable_const)
1071      (hVm.const_mul _) (hUi.sub (integrable_const c)) (hVi.const_mul _) ?_
1072    intro A hA
1073    have hAm : MeasurableSet A := hm _ hA
1074    rw [integral_sub hUi.integrableOn (integrable_const c).integrableOn, integral_const_mul,
1075      hsetU A hA, hsetV A hA, hconst A hAm]
1076    have := hSA A hA
1077    rw [abs_le] at this
1078    linarith [this.2]
1079  have h2 : (fun ω => c - U ω) ≤ᵐ[P] fun ω => (1 / 2) * V ω := by
1080    refine ae_le_of_setIntegral_le_trim P hm (stronglyMeasurable_const.sub hUm)
1081      (hVm.const_mul _) ((integrable_const c).sub hUi) (hVi.const_mul _) ?_
1082    intro A hA
1083    have hAm : MeasurableSet A := hm _ hA
1084    rw [integral_sub (integrable_const c).integrableOn hUi.integrableOn, integral_const_mul,
1085      hsetU A hA, hsetV A hA, hconst A hAm]
1086    have := hSA A hA
1087    rw [abs_le] at this
1088    linarith [this.1]
1089  filter_upwards [h1, h2] with ω a b
1090  rw [abs_le]
1091  constructor <;> linarith
1092
1093end HilbertMartingale

1095/-! ### Cylindrical Brownian motions, Hilbert–Schmidt integrands and `H`-valued Itô integrals -/
1096
1097section Cylindrical
1098
1099variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} (P : Measure Ω)
1100variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
1101  [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]
1102
1103/-- A `U`-cylindrical Brownian motion with respect to `ℱ`, through a Hilbert basis `(u_k)_{k∈κ}`
1104of the separable space `U`: the real processes `W^k_t = W_t(u_k)` form, for every finite set of
1105indices, a family of independent standard Brownian motions relative to `ℱ`
1106(`IsBrownianFiltration`, `HRS/Stochastic/Brownian.lean`). -/
1107def IsCylindricalBrownian (ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ) {κ : Type*} [Countable κ]
1108    (W : ℝ≥0 → Ω → κ → ℝ) : Prop :=
1109  ∀ s : Finset κ, IsBrownianFiltration P ℱ (fun t ω (k : s) => W t ω k)
1110
1111/-- The `L²` size `E ∫_0^t ∑_k ‖Φ_r u_k‖² dr = E ∫_0^t ‖Φ_r‖²_{𝓛₂(U,H)} dr` in `ℝ≥0∞`. -/
1112def hsSqIntegralOn {κ : Type*} (Φ : ℝ → Ω → κ → H) (t : ℝ) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
1113  ∫⁻ ω, (∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 t, ∑' k, ‖Φ r ω k‖ₑ ^ 2) ∂P
1114
1115/-- A progressive Hilbert–Schmidt integrand `Φ : Ω × [0,t] → 𝓛₂(U,H)` with
1116`E ∫_0^t ‖Φ_r‖²_{𝓛₂(U,H)} dr < ∞` (Corollary A.23, lines 10631-10633; "predictable" in the
1117source, progressive here), given through `Φ_r u_k`. -/
1118structure IsHSIntegrand (ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ) (t : ℝ) {κ : Type*} (Φ : ℝ → Ω → κ → H) :
1119    Prop where
1120  prog : ∀ k, IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => Φ r ω k)
1121  summable : ∀ r ω, Summable fun k => ‖Φ r ω k‖ ^ 2
1122  sq : hsSqIntegralOn P Φ t < ∞
1123
1124/-- `M = ∫_0^· Φ_r dW_r` as an `H`-valued process: continuous, adapted, zero on `(-∞,0]`, and
1125for every `x ∈ H` and `τ ≥ 0` the coordinate `⟨M_τ, x⟩` is the `L²(P)`-limit of the finite sums
1126`∑_{k ∈ s} ∫_0^τ ⟨Φ_r u_k, x⟩ dW^k_r` of real Itô integrals (`HRS.itoIntegral`) along the
1127directed family of finite sets `s`. -/
1128structure IsHilbertItoIntegral (ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ) {κ : Type*} (W : ℝ≥0 → Ω → κ → ℝ)
1129    (Φ : ℝ → Ω → κ → H) (M : ℝ → Ω → H) : Prop where
1130  cont : ∀ ω, Continuous fun τ => M τ ω
1131  adapted : Adapted ℱ M
1132  zero : ∀ τ : ℝ, τ ≤ 0 → ∀ ω, M τ ω = 0
1133  approx : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ → ∀ x : H,
1134    Tendsto (fun s : Finset κ => ∫⁻ ω,
1135        ‖itoIntegral P ℱ (fun t ω (k : s) => W t ω k) (fun r ω (k : s) => inner ℝ (Φ r ω k) x) τ ω
1136          - inner ℝ (M τ ω) x‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P) atTop (𝓝 0)
1137
1138end Cylindrical
1139
1140/-! ### Auxiliary development for Corollary A.23 (polar decomposition, countable Ito integrals)
1141
1142Route: see the plan in the docstring of `hilbert_polar_coupling`.  This block holds the finished
1143(sorry-free) pieces, all independent of the frozen statement:
1144* measurable polar decomposition with Powers-Stormer (`exists_polar_coords`, `powers_stormer`) and its
1145  packaging for a progressive Hilbert-Schmidt integrand (`exists_polar_family`: the square roots
1146  `S r ω`, and the orthonormal coefficient family `ψ j r ω a`, `a : κ ⊕ ι`, with the coordinate
1147  expansions needed for the identification of `M` and for the tail estimates);
1148* the infinite family of independent Wiener sequences (`wMeasure`, `wFiltration`,
1149  `isBrownianFiltration_wFiltration`) and the product filtration (`prodFiltration`), with
1150  `isCylindricalBrownian_prod` (the family `W ∘ fst ⊕ Wiener` is cylindrical Brownian for the product
1151  filtration, by Levy) and `IsCylindricalBrownian.comp_inj` (reindexing along injections);
1152* the countable-index Ito integral `IsItoC` (existence, uniqueness, linearity, isometry, martingale,
1153  conditional isometry, `IsItoC.martingale_sq_sub`, `IsItoC.martingale_mul_sub_const`, pull-out
1154  `IsItoC.block`, finite sums `IsItoC.finset_sum`, elementary integrals `isItoC_elem`);
1155* associativity `isItoIntegral_assoc`: for orthonormal `ψ` and `B^j = ∫ψ^j d𝔚`, the Ito integral
1156  of `f` against `B` is `∫ (∑_j f_j ψ^j) d𝔚`; and `isCylindricalBrownian_of_itoC` (`B` is cylindrical
1157  Brownian, by Levy);
1158* transfer along a measure-preserving map with filtration pull-back (`itoIntegral_comp_π`), and
1159  `indep_zero_cylPath` (a cylindrical Brownian motion is independent of `ℱ 0`).
1160Still to do for a repaired statement (see the attempt-4 finding below): the `H`-valued continuous version
1161of `∫ Sb dB` (Doob `doob_L2_continuous` coordinatewise, `∑_i sup|G^i|² < ∞` a.s.), its Gaussianity and
1162independence of `𝒢` (via `dds_coupling_strong` under the conditional measures `P'(· | A)`, `A ∈ ℱ' 0`,
1163then `Measure.ext_of_charFun`), the transfer of `hM` through `itoIntegral_pad` and `itoIntegral_comp_π`,
1164the `L²` bound (isometry for `B`, `powers_stormer`), and the universe lift of the Hilbert basis index. -/

1166section FragP1
1167open MeasureTheory Filter Topology
1168open scoped ENNReal NNReal BigOperators
1169section PolarOps
1170variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
1171
1172/-- Scalar comparison sequence for the square-root iteration. -/
1173def sqrtScalar : ℕ → ℝ
1174  | 0 => 0
1175  | n + 1 => (1 + sqrtScalar n ^ 2) / 2
1176
1177lemma sqrtScalar_nonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ sqrtScalar n
1178  | 0 => le_rfl
1179  | n + 1 => by simp only [sqrtScalar]; have := sqrtScalar_nonneg n; positivity
1180
1181lemma sqrtScalar_le_one : ∀ n, sqrtScalar n ≤ 1
1182  | 0 => by simp [sqrtScalar]
1183  | n + 1 => by
1184      simp only [sqrtScalar]
1185      have h0 := sqrtScalar_nonneg n
1186      have h1 := sqrtScalar_le_one n
1187      nlinarith
1188
1189lemma sqrtScalar_mono : Monotone sqrtScalar := by
1190  refine monotone_nat_of_le_succ fun n => ?_
1191  simp only [sqrtScalar]
1192  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (sqrtScalar n - 1)]
1193
1194/-- The iteration `Z_{n+1} = (D + Z_n²)/2`, `Z_0 = 0`. -/
1195def sqrtIter (D : H →L[ℝ] H) : ℕ → H →L[ℝ] H
1196  | 0 => 0
1197  | n + 1 => (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (D + sqrtIter D n * sqrtIter D n)
1198
1199omit [CompleteSpace H] in
1200lemma norm_sqrtIter_le {D : H →L[ℝ] H} (hD : ‖D‖ ≤ 1) : ∀ n, ‖sqrtIter D n‖ ≤ sqrtScalar n
1201  | 0 => by simp [sqrtIter, sqrtScalar]
1202  | n + 1 => by
1203      have ih := norm_sqrtIter_le hD n
1204      simp only [sqrtIter, sqrtScalar]
1205      calc ‖(1 / 2 : ℝ) • (D + sqrtIter D n * sqrtIter D n)‖
1206          = (1 / 2) * ‖D + sqrtIter D n * sqrtIter D n‖ := by
1207            rw [norm_smul]; norm_num
1208        _ ≤ (1 / 2) * (‖D‖ + ‖sqrtIter D n‖ * ‖sqrtIter D n‖) := by
1209            gcongr
1210            exact (norm_add_le _ _).trans (by gcongr; exact ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_comp_le _ _)
1211        _ ≤ (1 + sqrtScalar n ^ 2) / 2 := by
1212            have := sqrtScalar_nonneg n
1213            nlinarith [norm_nonneg (sqrtIter D n)]
1214
1215omit [CompleteSpace H] in
1216lemma norm_sqrtIter_succ_sub_le {D : H →L[ℝ] H} (hD : ‖D‖ ≤ 1) :
1217    ∀ n, ‖sqrtIter D (n + 1) - sqrtIter D n‖ ≤ sqrtScalar (n + 1) - sqrtScalar n
1218  | 0 => by
1219      simp only [sqrtIter, sqrtScalar, mul_zero, add_zero, sub_zero, norm_smul]
1220      norm_num
1221      linarith
1222  | n + 1 => by
1223      have ih := norm_sqrtIter_succ_sub_le hD n
1224      have h1 := norm_sqrtIter_le hD n
1225      have h2 := norm_sqrtIter_le hD (n + 1)
1226      have e : sqrtIter D (n + 1 + 1) - sqrtIter D (n + 1) =
1227          (1 / 2 : ℝ) • ((sqrtIter D (n + 1) - sqrtIter D n) * sqrtIter D (n + 1) +
1228            sqrtIter D n * (sqrtIter D (n + 1) - sqrtIter D n)) := by
1229        show (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (D + sqrtIter D (n + 1) * sqrtIter D (n + 1)) -
1230          (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (D + sqrtIter D n * sqrtIter D n) = _
1231        rw [← smul_sub]
1232        congr 1
1233        simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul]
1234        abel
1235      rw [e, norm_smul]
1236      have h3 : ‖(sqrtIter D (n + 1) - sqrtIter D n) * sqrtIter D (n + 1) +
1237            sqrtIter D n * (sqrtIter D (n + 1) - sqrtIter D n)‖ ≤
1238          (sqrtScalar (n + 1) - sqrtScalar n) * (sqrtScalar (n + 1) + sqrtScalar n) := by
1239        refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans ?_
1240        have a1 := ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_comp_le (sqrtIter D (n + 1) - sqrtIter D n)
1241          (sqrtIter D (n + 1))
1242        have a2 := ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_comp_le (sqrtIter D n)
1243          (sqrtIter D (n + 1) - sqrtIter D n)
1244        have := sqrtScalar_nonneg n
1245        have := sqrtScalar_nonneg (n + 1)
1246        have hm := sqrtScalar_mono (Nat.le_succ n)
1247        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def] at *
1248        nlinarith [norm_nonneg (sqrtIter D n), norm_nonneg (sqrtIter D (n + 1)),
1249          norm_nonneg (sqrtIter D (n + 1) - sqrtIter D n),
1250          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ih (norm_nonneg (sqrtIter D (n + 1))),
1251          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih (norm_nonneg (sqrtIter D n)),
1252          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (sub_nonneg.2 hm),
1253          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (sub_nonneg.2 hm)]
1254      have : sqrtScalar (n + 1 + 1) - sqrtScalar (n + 1) =
1255          (1 / 2) * ((sqrtScalar (n + 1) - sqrtScalar n) * (sqrtScalar (n + 1) + sqrtScalar n)) := by
1256        simp only [sqrtScalar]; ring
1257      rw [this]
1258      norm_num
1259      linarith
1260
1261lemma cauchySeq_sqrtIter {D : H →L[ℝ] H} (hD : ‖D‖ ≤ 1) : CauchySeq (sqrtIter D) := by
1262  refine cauchySeq_of_dist_le_of_summable (fun n => sqrtScalar (n + 1) - sqrtScalar n)
1263    (fun n => ?_) ?_
1264  · rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm]; exact norm_sqrtIter_succ_sub_le hD n
1265  · refine summable_of_sum_range_le (c := 1) (fun n => sub_nonneg.2 (sqrtScalar_mono (Nat.le_succ n)))
1266      fun n => ?_
1267    rw [Finset.sum_range_sub]
1268    have := sqrtScalar_le_one n
1269    have := sqrtScalar_nonneg 0
1270    linarith
1271
