1273section SqrtOp
1274open HilbertCLTAux
1275
1276omit [CompleteSpace H] in
1277lemma HilbertCLTAux.IsPSDOp.norm_apply_le {D : H →L[ℝ] H} (hD : IsPSDOp D) (h : ∀ x, inner ℝ (D x) x ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 2)
1278    (x : H) : ‖D x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by
1279  have h1 := hD.cs x (D x)
1280  have h2 := h (D x)
1281  have h3 := h x
1282  have h5 : inner ℝ (D x) (D x) = ‖D x‖ ^ 2 := real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq _
1283  rw [h5] at h1
1284  have h6 : ‖D x‖ ^ 2 * ‖D x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 2 * ‖D x‖ ^ 2 := by
1285    calc ‖D x‖ ^ 2 * ‖D x‖ ^ 2 = (‖D x‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 := by ring
1286      _ ≤ _ := h1
1287      _ ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 2 * ‖D x‖ ^ 2 := mul_le_mul h3 h2 (hD.nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)
1288  by_cases hz : ‖D x‖ = 0
1289  · rw [hz]; exact norm_nonneg _
1290  · have hp : 0 < ‖D x‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
1291    have := le_of_mul_le_mul_right h6 hp
1292    nlinarith [norm_nonneg x, norm_nonneg (D x)]
1293
1294
1295/-- The limit of the iteration. -/
1296def sqrtLimOp (D : H →L[ℝ] H) : H →L[ℝ] H := limUnder atTop (sqrtIter D)
1297
1298lemma tendsto_sqrtIter {D : H →L[ℝ] H} (hD : ‖D‖ ≤ 1) :
1299    Tendsto (sqrtIter D) atTop (𝓝 (sqrtLimOp D)) :=
1300  tendsto_nhds_limUnder (cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete (cauchySeq_sqrtIter hD))
1301
1302lemma tendsto_sqrtIter_apply {D : H →L[ℝ] H} (hD : ‖D‖ ≤ 1) (x : H) :
1303    Tendsto (fun n => sqrtIter D n x) atTop (𝓝 (sqrtLimOp D x)) :=
1304  ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ H x).continuous.tendsto _).comp (tendsto_sqrtIter hD)
1305
1306omit [CompleteSpace H] in
1307lemma sqrtIter_symm {D : H →L[ℝ] H} (hD : ∀ x y, inner ℝ (D x) y = inner ℝ x (D y)) :
1308    ∀ n x y, inner ℝ (sqrtIter D n x) y = inner ℝ x (sqrtIter D n y)
1309  | 0, x, y => by simp [sqrtIter]
1310  | n + 1, x, y => by
1311      have ih := sqrtIter_symm hD n
1312      simp only [sqrtIter, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
1313        ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, inner_add_left,
1314        inner_add_right, hD, ih]
1315      simp
1316
1317lemma sqrtLimOp_symm {D : H →L[ℝ] H} (hD : ∀ x y, inner ℝ (D x) y = inner ℝ x (D y))
1318    (hD1 : ‖D‖ ≤ 1) (x y : H) : inner ℝ (sqrtLimOp D x) y = inner ℝ x (sqrtLimOp D y) := by
1319  have h1 := Filter.Tendsto.inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (tendsto_sqrtIter_apply hD1 x) (tendsto_const_nhds (x := y))
1320  have h2 := Filter.Tendsto.inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (tendsto_const_nhds (x := x)) (tendsto_sqrtIter_apply hD1 y)
1321  refine tendsto_nhds_unique h1 ?_
1322  simpa [sqrtIter_symm hD] using h2
1323
1324lemma norm_sqrtLimOp_le {D : H →L[ℝ] H} (hD1 : ‖D‖ ≤ 1) : ‖sqrtLimOp D‖ ≤ 1 :=
1325  le_of_tendsto ((tendsto_sqrtIter hD1).norm) (Eventually.of_forall fun n =>
1326    (norm_sqrtIter_le hD1 n).trans (sqrtScalar_le_one n))
1327
1328lemma sqrtLimOp_eq {D : H →L[ℝ] H} (hD1 : ‖D‖ ≤ 1) :
1329    sqrtLimOp D = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (D + sqrtLimOp D * sqrtLimOp D) := by
1330  have h1 := (tendsto_sqrtIter hD1)
1331  have h2 : Tendsto (fun n => sqrtIter D (n + 1)) atTop (𝓝 (sqrtLimOp D)) :=
1332    h1.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
1333  have h3 : Tendsto (fun n => sqrtIter D (n + 1)) atTop
1334      (𝓝 ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (D + sqrtLimOp D * sqrtLimOp D))) :=
1335    (tendsto_const_nhds.add (h1.mul h1)).const_smul _
1336  exact tendsto_nhds_unique h2 h3
1337
1338/-- The square root `Y = 1 - lim Z_n` of `1 - D`. -/
1339lemma sqrt_aux {D : H →L[ℝ] H} (hDs : ∀ x y, inner ℝ (D x) y = inner ℝ x (D y)) (hD1 : ‖D‖ ≤ 1) :
1340    IsPSDOp (1 - sqrtLimOp D) ∧ (1 - sqrtLimOp D) * (1 - sqrtLimOp D) = 1 - D := by
1341  have hs := sqrtLimOp_symm hDs hD1
1342  have hn := norm_sqrtLimOp_le hD1
1343  refine ⟨⟨fun x y => ?_, fun x => ?_⟩, ?_⟩
1344  · simp [inner_sub_left, inner_sub_right, hs]
1345  · simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.one_apply, inner_sub_left]
1346    have h1 : inner ℝ (sqrtLimOp D x) x ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
1347      calc inner ℝ (sqrtLimOp D x) x ≤ ‖sqrtLimOp D x‖ * ‖x‖ := real_inner_le_norm _ _
1348        _ ≤ (‖sqrtLimOp D‖ * ‖x‖) * ‖x‖ := by
1349          gcongr; exact ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
1350        _ ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg x]
1351    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]; linarith
1352  · have e := sqrtLimOp_eq hD1
1353    have e2 : sqrtLimOp D * sqrtLimOp D = (2 : ℝ) • sqrtLimOp D - D := by
1354      have := congrArg (fun T => (2 : ℝ) • T) e
1355      simp only [smul_smul] at this
1356      norm_num at this
1357      rw [this]; abel
1358    calc (1 - sqrtLimOp D) * (1 - sqrtLimOp D)
1359        = 1 - (2 : ℝ) • sqrtLimOp D + sqrtLimOp D * sqrtLimOp D := by
1360          simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, one_mul, mul_one, two_smul]; abel
1361      _ = 1 - D := by rw [e2]; abel
1362
1363
1364/-- Square root of a nonnegative symmetric operator, with scale `c`. -/
1365def sqrtOp (c : ℝ) (A : H →L[ℝ] H) : H →L[ℝ] H :=
1366  Real.sqrt c • (1 - sqrtLimOp (1 - c⁻¹ • A))
1367
1368omit [CompleteSpace H] in
1369lemma norm_one_sub_inv_smul_le {A : H →L[ℝ] H} (hA : IsPSDOp A) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
1370    (hAc : ∀ x, inner ℝ (A x) x ≤ c * ‖x‖ ^ 2) : ‖(1 : H →L[ℝ] H) - c⁻¹ • A‖ ≤ 1 := by
1371  have hD : IsPSDOp ((1 : H →L[ℝ] H) - c⁻¹ • A) := by
1372    refine ⟨fun x y => ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
1373    · simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.one_apply,
1374        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, inner_sub_left, inner_smul_left, inner_sub_right,
1375        inner_smul_right, conj_trivial, hA.symm x y]
1376    · simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.one_apply,
1377        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, inner_sub_left, inner_smul_left, conj_trivial,
1378        real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
1379      have := hAc x
1380      have h2 : c⁻¹ * inner ℝ (A x) x ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
1381        calc c⁻¹ * inner ℝ (A x) x ≤ c⁻¹ * (c * ‖x‖ ^ 2) := by gcongr
1382          _ = ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by field_simp
1383      linarith
1384  refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one fun x => ?_
1385  rw [one_mul]
1386  refine hD.norm_apply_le (fun y => ?_) x
1387  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.one_apply,
1388    ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, inner_sub_left, inner_smul_left, conj_trivial,
1389    real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
1390  have := hA.nonneg y
1391  have : 0 ≤ c⁻¹ * inner ℝ (A y) y := by positivity
1392  linarith
1393
1394lemma sqrtOp_spec {A : H →L[ℝ] H} (hA : IsPSDOp A) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
1395    (hAc : ∀ x, inner ℝ (A x) x ≤ c * ‖x‖ ^ 2) :
1396    IsPSDOp (sqrtOp c A) ∧ sqrtOp c A * sqrtOp c A = A := by
1397  have hD1 := norm_one_sub_inv_smul_le hA hc hAc
1398  have hDs : ∀ x y, inner ℝ (((1 : H →L[ℝ] H) - c⁻¹ • A) x) y =
1399      inner ℝ x (((1 : H →L[ℝ] H) - c⁻¹ • A) y) := fun x y => by
1400    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.one_apply,
1401        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, inner_sub_left, inner_smul_left, inner_sub_right,
1402        inner_smul_right, conj_trivial, hA.symm x y]
1403  obtain ⟨hY, hYY⟩ := sqrt_aux hDs hD1
1404  refine ⟨⟨fun x y => ?_, fun x => ?_⟩, ?_⟩
1405  · simp only [sqrtOp, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right,
1406      conj_trivial, hY.symm x y]
1407  · simp only [sqrtOp, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, inner_smul_left, conj_trivial]
1408    exact mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (hY.nonneg x)
1409  · have : sqrtOp c A * sqrtOp c A = (Real.sqrt c * Real.sqrt c) •
1410        ((1 - sqrtLimOp ((1 : H →L[ℝ] H) - c⁻¹ • A)) * (1 - sqrtLimOp ((1 : H →L[ℝ] H) - c⁻¹ • A))) := by
1411      simp only [sqrtOp, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]
1412    rw [this, hYY, Real.mul_self_sqrt hc.le]
1413    ext x
1414    simp [hc.ne']
1415
1416end SqrtOp
1417
1418section OpMeas
1419variable [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]
1420variable {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z]
1421
1422/-- `z ↦ A z` is a strongly measurable operator family. -/
1423def OpMeas (A : Z → H →L[ℝ] H) : Prop := ∀ x, Measurable fun z => A z x
1424
1425lemma measurable_of_inner_basis {ι : Type*} [Countable ι] (b : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H) {f : Z → H}
1426    (hf : ∀ i, Measurable fun z => inner ℝ (b i) (f z)) : Measurable f := by
1427  have hs : ∀ z, Tendsto (fun s : Finset ι => ∑ i ∈ s, inner ℝ (b i) (f z) • b i) atTop (𝓝 (f z)) :=
1428    fun z => by
1429      have := b.hasSum_repr (f z)
1430      simp only [HilbertBasis.repr_apply_apply] at this
1431      exact this
1432  refine measurable_of_tendsto_metrizable' atTop (fun s => ?_) (tendsto_pi_nhds.2 hs)
1433  exact Finset.measurable_sum _ fun i _ => (hf i).smul_const _
1434
1435lemma OpMeas.apply {A : Z → H →L[ℝ] H} (hA : OpMeas A) {v : Z → H} (hv : Measurable v) :
1436    Measurable fun z => A z (v z) := by
1437  obtain ⟨ι, hι, b, -⟩ := HilbertCLTAux.exists_hilbertBasis_type (H := H)
1438  haveI := hι
1439  have hs : ∀ z, Tendsto (fun s : Finset ι => ∑ i ∈ s, inner ℝ (b i) (v z) • A z (b i)) atTop
1440      (𝓝 (A z (v z))) := fun z => by
1441    have := (b.hasSum_repr (v z)).map (A z) (A z).continuous
1442    simp only [Function.comp_def, map_smul, HilbertBasis.repr_apply_apply] at this
1443    exact this
1444  refine measurable_of_tendsto_metrizable' atTop (fun s => ?_) (tendsto_pi_nhds.2 hs)
1445  refine Finset.measurable_sum _ fun i _ => ?_
1446  exact (measurable_const.inner hv).smul (hA (b i))
1447
1448section
1449variable {A B : Z → H →L[ℝ] H}
1450
1451lemma OpMeas.add (hA : OpMeas A) (hB : OpMeas B) : OpMeas fun z => A z + B z :=
1452  fun x => (hA x).add (hB x)
1453
1454lemma OpMeas.sub (hA : OpMeas A) (hB : OpMeas B) : OpMeas fun z => A z - B z :=
1455  fun x => (hA x).sub (hB x)
1456
1457lemma OpMeas.smul {c : Z → ℝ} (hc : Measurable c) (hA : OpMeas A) : OpMeas fun z => c z • A z :=
1458  fun x => hc.smul (hA x)
1459
1460lemma OpMeas.const (T : H →L[ℝ] H) : OpMeas fun _ : Z => T := fun _ => measurable_const
1461
1462lemma OpMeas.mul (hA : OpMeas A) (hB : OpMeas B) : OpMeas fun z => A z * B z :=
1463  fun x => hA.apply (hB x)
1464
1465lemma OpMeas.sqrtIter {D : Z → H →L[ℝ] H} (hD : OpMeas D) :
1466    ∀ n, OpMeas fun z => sqrtIter (D z) n
1467  | 0 => by simpa [HRS.sqrtIter] using OpMeas.const (Z := Z) (0 : H →L[ℝ] H)
1468  | n + 1 => by
1469      have := ((hD.add ((OpMeas.sqrtIter hD n).mul (OpMeas.sqrtIter hD n)))).smul
1470        (measurable_const (a := (1 / 2 : ℝ)))
1471      simpa [HRS.sqrtIter] using this
1472
1473lemma OpMeas.sqrtOp {c : Z → ℝ} (hA : OpMeas A) (hc : Measurable c)
1474    (hAp : ∀ z, HilbertCLTAux.IsPSDOp (A z)) (hcpos : ∀ z, 0 < c z)
1475    (hAc : ∀ z x, inner ℝ (A z x) x ≤ c z * ‖x‖ ^ 2) :
1476    OpMeas fun z => HRS.sqrtOp (c z) (A z) := by
1477  intro x
1478  have hD : OpMeas fun z => (1 : H →L[ℝ] H) - (c z)⁻¹ • A z :=
1479    OpMeas.sub (OpMeas.const 1) (OpMeas.smul hc.inv hA)
1480  have hlim : Measurable fun z => HRS.sqrtLimOp ((1 : H →L[ℝ] H) - (c z)⁻¹ • A z) x := by
1481    refine measurable_of_tendsto_metrizable (f := fun n z => HRS.sqrtIter ((1 : H →L[ℝ] H) - (c z)⁻¹ • A z) n x)
1482      (fun n => (OpMeas.sqrtIter hD n) x) (tendsto_pi_nhds.2 fun z => ?_)
1483    exact HRS.tendsto_sqrtIter_apply (norm_one_sub_inv_smul_le (hAp z) (hcpos z) (hAc z)) x
1484  simp only [HRS.sqrtOp, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply,
1485    ContinuousLinearMap.one_apply]
1486  exact (Measurable.sqrt hc).smul (measurable_const.sub hlim)
1487end
1488end OpMeas
1489
1490section PolarAbs
1491open HilbertCLTAux
1492
1493omit [CompleteSpace H] in
1494lemma HilbertCLTAux.IsPSDOp.norm_apply_le' {D : H →L[ℝ] H} (hD : IsPSDOp D) {m : ℝ} (hm : 0 ≤ m)
1495    (h : ∀ x, inner ℝ (D x) x ≤ m * ‖x‖ ^ 2) (x : H) : ‖D x‖ ≤ m * ‖x‖ := by
1496  have h1 := hD.cs x (D x)
1497  have h2 := h (D x)
1498  have h3 := h x
1499  have h5 : inner ℝ (D x) (D x) = ‖D x‖ ^ 2 := real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq _
1500  rw [h5] at h1
1501  have h6 : ‖D x‖ ^ 2 * ‖D x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (m * ‖x‖ ^ 2) * (m * ‖D x‖ ^ 2) := by
1502    calc ‖D x‖ ^ 2 * ‖D x‖ ^ 2 = (‖D x‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 := by ring
1503      _ ≤ _ := h1
1504      _ ≤ (m * ‖x‖ ^ 2) * (m * ‖D x‖ ^ 2) := mul_le_mul h3 h2 (hD.nonneg _) (by positivity)
1505  by_cases hz : ‖D x‖ = 0
1506  · rw [hz]; positivity
1507  · have hp : 0 < ‖D x‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
1508    have h7 : ‖D x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (m * ‖x‖) ^ 2 := by
1509      have : ‖D x‖ ^ 2 * ‖D x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ((m * ‖x‖) ^ 2) * ‖D x‖ ^ 2 := by
1510        calc _ ≤ _ := h6
1511          _ = _ := by ring
1512      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right this hp
1513    exact le_of_sq_le_sq (by simpa using h7) (by positivity) |> fun h => by
1514      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (D x), mul_nonneg hm (norm_nonneg x)]
1515
1516
1517/-- The regularisation parameters `ε_n = 1/(n+1)`. -/
1518def epsn (n : ℕ) : ℝ := ((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹
1519
1520lemma epsn_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < epsn n := by unfold epsn; positivity
1521
1522lemma tendsto_epsn : Tendsto epsn atTop (𝓝 0) := tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp
1523  (tendsto_atTop_add_const_right _ 1 tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
1524
1525omit [CompleteSpace H] in
1526lemma HilbertCLTAux.IsPSDOp.inner_le_norm {S : H →L[ℝ] H} (x : H) :
1527    inner ℝ (S x) x ≤ ‖S‖ * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
1528  calc inner ℝ (S x) x ≤ ‖S x‖ * ‖x‖ := real_inner_le_norm _ _
1529    _ ≤ (‖S‖ * ‖x‖) * ‖x‖ := by gcongr; exact S.le_opNorm x
1530    _ = _ := by ring
1531
1532/-- `S + ε` is invertible for `S ≥ 0`, `ε > 0`. -/
1533lemma isUnit_add_smul_one {S : H →L[ℝ] H} (hS : IsPSDOp S) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
1534    IsUnit (S + ε • (1 : H →L[ℝ] H)) := by
1535  set c : ℝ := ‖S‖ + ε with hc
1536  have hcpos : 0 < c := by positivity
1537  set E : H →L[ℝ] H := 1 - c⁻¹ • (S + ε • (1 : H →L[ℝ] H)) with hE
1538  have hEapp : ∀ x, E x = x - c⁻¹ • (S x + ε • x) := fun x => by simp [hE]
1539  have hEinner : ∀ x, inner ℝ (E x) x = ‖x‖ ^ 2 - c⁻¹ * (inner ℝ (S x) x + ε * ‖x‖ ^ 2) := fun x => by
1540    rw [hEapp, inner_sub_left, inner_smul_left, inner_add_left, inner_smul_left,
1541      real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
1542    simp
1543  have hEp : IsPSDOp E := by
1544    refine ⟨fun x y => ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
1545    · rw [hEapp, hEapp]
1546      simp only [inner_sub_left, inner_sub_right, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, inner_add_left,
1547        inner_add_right, conj_trivial, hS.symm x y]
1548    · rw [hEinner]
1549      have h1 := HilbertCLTAux.IsPSDOp.inner_le_norm (S := S) x
1550      have h2 : c⁻¹ * (inner ℝ (S x) x + ε * ‖x‖ ^ 2) ≤ c⁻¹ * (c * ‖x‖ ^ 2) := by
1551        gcongr
1552        nlinarith
1553      rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hcpos.ne', one_mul] at h2
1554      linarith
1555  have hm : 0 ≤ 1 - ε / c := by
1556    rw [sub_nonneg, div_le_one hcpos]; rw [hc]; linarith [norm_nonneg S]
1557  have hEn : ‖E‖ ≤ 1 - ε / c := by
1558    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hm fun x => ?_
1559    refine hEp.norm_apply_le' hm (fun y => ?_) x
1560    rw [hEinner]
1561    have h1 := hS.nonneg y
1562    have : c⁻¹ * (inner ℝ (S y) y + ε * ‖y‖ ^ 2) ≥ c⁻¹ * (ε * ‖y‖ ^ 2) := by
1563      gcongr; linarith
1564    have e : (1 - ε / c) * ‖y‖ ^ 2 = ‖y‖ ^ 2 - c⁻¹ * (ε * ‖y‖ ^ 2) := by field_simp
1565    linarith
1566  have hlt : ‖E‖ < 1 := by
1567    have : 0 < ε / c := by positivity
1568    linarith
1569  have h1E : IsUnit (1 - E) := (Units.oneSub E hlt).isUnit
1570  have : S + ε • (1 : H →L[ℝ] H) = c • (1 - E) := by
1571    rw [hE, sub_sub_cancel, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hcpos.ne', one_smul]
1572  rw [this, Algebra.smul_def]
1573  exact (IsUnit.mk0 c hcpos.ne').map (algebraMap ℝ (H →L[ℝ] H)) |>.mul h1E
1574
1575
1576/-- The regularised resolvent `(S + ε_n)⁻¹`. -/
1577def resolvent (S : H →L[ℝ] H) (n : ℕ) : H →L[ℝ] H :=
1578  Ring.inverse (S + epsn n • (1 : H →L[ℝ] H))
1579
1580section Resolvent
1581variable {S : H →L[ℝ] H} (hS : IsPSDOp S) (n : ℕ)
1582include hS
1583
1584lemma resolvent_right (x : H) : S (resolvent S n x) + epsn n • resolvent S n x = x := by
1585  have h := Ring.mul_inverse_cancel _ (isUnit_add_smul_one hS (epsn_pos n))
1586  have := congrArg (fun T : H →L[ℝ] H => T x) h
1587  simpa [resolvent] using this
1588
1589lemma resolvent_left (x : H) : resolvent S n (S x + epsn n • x) = x := by
1590  have h := Ring.inverse_mul_cancel _ (isUnit_add_smul_one hS (epsn_pos n))
1591  have := congrArg (fun T : H →L[ℝ] H => T x) h
1592  simpa [resolvent] using this
1593
1594lemma norm_apply_le_add (w : H) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) : ‖S w‖ ≤ ‖S w + ε • w‖ := by
1595  have h : ‖S w‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖S w + ε • w‖ ^ 2 := by
1596    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, ← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
1597    simp only [inner_add_left, inner_add_right, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, conj_trivial]
1598    have h1 := hS.nonneg w
1599    have h2 : 0 ≤ inner ℝ w w := real_inner_self_nonneg
1600    have e := hS.symm w w
1601    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hε h1, mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hε hε) h2]
1602  exact le_of_sq_le_sq (by simpa using h) (norm_nonneg _) |> fun h => by
1603    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (S w), norm_nonneg (S w + ε • w)]
1604
1605lemma norm_S_resolvent_le (x : H) : ‖S (resolvent S n x)‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by
1606  have := norm_apply_le_add hS (resolvent S n x) (epsn_pos n).le
1607  rwa [resolvent_right hS n x] at this
1608
1609lemma resolvent_symm (x y : H) :
1610    inner ℝ (resolvent S n x) y = inner ℝ x (resolvent S n y) := by
1611  have e1 := resolvent_right hS n y
1612  have e2 := resolvent_right hS n x
1613  calc inner ℝ (resolvent S n x) y
1614      = inner ℝ (resolvent S n x) (S (resolvent S n y) + epsn n • resolvent S n y) := by rw [e1]
1615    _ = inner ℝ (S (resolvent S n x) + epsn n • resolvent S n x) (resolvent S n y) := by
1616        simp only [inner_add_left, inner_add_right, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, conj_trivial,
1617          hS.symm (resolvent S n x) (resolvent S n y)]
1618    _ = _ := by rw [e2]
1619
1620lemma resolvent_of_ker {x : H} (hx : S x = 0) : resolvent S n x = (epsn n)⁻¹ • x := by
1621  have := resolvent_left hS n ((epsn n)⁻¹ • x)
1622  rw [map_smul, hx, smul_zero, zero_add, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (epsn_pos n).ne', one_smul] at this
1623  exact this
1624
1625end Resolvent

1628section LimitOps
1629variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
1630variable {G : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] [CompleteSpace G]
1631
1632lemma exists_clm_of_tendsto (A : ℕ → E →L[ℝ] G) (hb : ∀ n x, ‖A n x‖ ≤ ‖x‖)
1633    (hconv : ∀ x, ∃ y, Tendsto (fun n => A n x) atTop (𝓝 y)) :
1634    ∃ L : E →L[ℝ] G, (∀ x, Tendsto (fun n => A n x) atTop (𝓝 (L x))) := by
1635  choose L hL using hconv
1636  let Lm : E →ₗ[ℝ] G :=
1637    { toFun := L
1638      map_add' := fun x y => tendsto_nhds_unique (hL (x + y)) (by
1639        have := (hL x).add (hL y)
1640        simpa using this)
1641      map_smul' := fun c x => tendsto_nhds_unique (hL (c • x)) (by
1642        have := (hL x).const_smul c
1643        simpa using this) }
1644  have hLb : ∀ x, ‖L x‖ ≤ 1 * ‖x‖ := fun x => by
1645    rw [one_mul]; exact le_of_tendsto' (hL x).norm (fun n => hb n x)
1646  exact ⟨Lm.mkContinuous 1 hLb, hL⟩
1647
1648lemma tendsto_of_dense (A : ℕ → E →L[ℝ] G) (hb : ∀ n x, ‖A n x‖ ≤ ‖x‖) {D : Set E}
1649    (hD : Dense D) (hconv : ∀ x ∈ D, ∃ y, Tendsto (fun n => A n x) atTop (𝓝 y)) (x : E) :
1650    ∃ y, Tendsto (fun n => A n x) atTop (𝓝 y) := by
1651  refine cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete ?_
1652  rw [Metric.cauchySeq_iff']
1653  intro δ hδ
1654  obtain ⟨x', hx'D, hx'⟩ := hD.exists_dist_lt x (show 0 < δ / 3 by positivity)
1655  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hconv x' hx'D
1656  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Metric.cauchySeq_iff'.1 hy.cauchySeq (δ / 3) (by positivity)
1657  refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
1658  have h1 : dist (A n x) (A n x') ≤ dist x x' := by
1659    rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, ← map_sub]
1660    exact hb n _
1661  have h2 := hN n hn
1662  have h3 : dist (A N x) (A N x') ≤ dist x x' := by
1663    rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, ← map_sub]
1664    exact hb N _
1665  calc dist (A n x) (A N x) ≤ dist (A n x) (A n x') + dist (A n x') (A N x') + dist (A N x') (A N x) :=
1666        dist_triangle4 _ _ _ _
1667    _ < δ / 3 + δ / 3 + δ / 3 := by
1668        rw [dist_comm (A N x') (A N x)] at *
1669        have := dist_comm (A N x) (A N x')
1670        linarith
1671    _ = δ := by ring
1672
1673end LimitOps

1675section PolarExist
1676variable {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
1677open HilbertCLTAux
1678
1679/-- Density of `ran S + ker S` for a symmetric operator. -/
1680lemma dense_range_add_ker {S : H →L[ℝ] H} (hS : IsPSDOp S) :
1681    Dense ((LinearMap.range (S : H →ₗ[ℝ] H) ⊔ LinearMap.ker (S : H →ₗ[ℝ] H) : Submodule ℝ H) : Set H) := by
1682  rw [Submodule.dense_iff_topologicalClosure_eq_top, Submodule.topologicalClosure_eq_top_iff,
1683    Submodule.eq_bot_iff]
1684  intro x hx
1685  have h1 : ∀ y, inner ℝ x (S y) = 0 := fun y => by
1686    rw [real_inner_comm]
1687    exact (Submodule.mem_orthogonal _ _).1 hx _ (Submodule.mem_sup_left ⟨y, rfl⟩)
1688  have hSx : S x = 0 := by
1689    apply ext_inner_right ℝ
1690    intro y
1691    rw [hS.symm, h1 y, inner_zero_left]
1692  have := (Submodule.mem_orthogonal _ _).1 hx x (Submodule.mem_sup_right (by simpa using hSx))
1693  exact inner_self_eq_zero.1 (by rw [real_inner_comm]; exact this)
1694
1695end PolarExist

1698end PolarOps

1701section FragP2
1702open MeasureTheory Filter Topology
1703open scoped ENNReal NNReal BigOperators
1704section PolarExist2
1705variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
1706variable {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
1707open HilbertCLTAux
1708
1709lemma resolvent_S_apply {S : H →L[ℝ] H} (hS : IsPSDOp S) (n : ℕ) (y : H) :
1710    resolvent S n (S y) = y - epsn n • resolvent S n y := by
1711  have := resolvent_left hS n y
1712  rw [map_add, map_smul] at this
1713  exact eq_sub_of_add_eq this
1714
1715lemma S_resolvent_apply {S : H →L[ℝ] H} (hS : IsPSDOp S) (n : ℕ) (y : H) :
1716    S (resolvent S n y) = y - epsn n • resolvent S n y := by
1717  exact eq_sub_of_add_eq (resolvent_right hS n y)
1718
1719theorem exists_polar {S : H →L[ℝ] H} (hS : IsPSDOp S) (T : H →L[ℝ] F)
1720    (hT : ∀ x, ‖T x‖ = ‖S x‖) :
1721    ∃ (U : H →L[ℝ] F) (Q : H →L[ℝ] H),
1722      (∀ x, Tendsto (fun n => T (resolvent S n x)) atTop (𝓝 (U x))) ∧
1723      (∀ x, Tendsto (fun n => S (resolvent S n x)) atTop (𝓝 (Q x))) ∧
1724      (∀ x y, inner ℝ (Q x) y = inner ℝ x (Q y)) ∧ (∀ x, Q (Q x) = Q x) ∧
1725      (∀ x, Q (S x) = S x) ∧ (∀ x, U (S x) = T x) ∧ (∀ x, ‖U x‖ = ‖Q x‖) := by
1726  let Qn : ℕ → H →L[ℝ] H := fun n => S ∘L resolvent S n
1727  let Un : ℕ → H →L[ℝ] F := fun n => T ∘L resolvent S n
1728  have hQn : ∀ n x, Qn n x = S (resolvent S n x) := fun n x => rfl
1729  have hUn : ∀ n x, Un n x = T (resolvent S n x) := fun n x => rfl
1730  have hQb : ∀ n x, ‖Qn n x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := fun n x => norm_S_resolvent_le hS n x
1731  have hUb : ∀ n x, ‖Un n x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := fun n x => by
1732    rw [hUn, hT]; exact norm_S_resolvent_le hS n x
1733  have herr : ∀ y, Tendsto (fun n => epsn n • S (resolvent S n y)) atTop (𝓝 0) := fun y => by
1734    rw [tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero]
1735    refine squeeze_zero (fun n => norm_nonneg _) (fun n => ?_)
1736      (by simpa using tendsto_epsn.mul_const ‖y‖)
1737    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (epsn_pos n).le]
1738    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_S_resolvent_le hS n y) (epsn_pos n).le
1739  have key : ∀ y w, S w = 0 → Tendsto (fun n => Qn n (S y + w)) atTop (𝓝 (S y)) ∧
1740      Tendsto (fun n => Un n (S y + w)) atTop (𝓝 (T y)) := by
1741    intro y w hw
1742    have hTw : T w = 0 := by
1743      have := hT w; rw [hw, norm_zero] at this; exact norm_eq_zero.1 this
1744    have eQ : ∀ n, Qn n (S y + w) = S y - epsn n • S (resolvent S n y) := fun n => by
1745      rw [hQn, map_add, map_add, resolvent_of_ker hS n hw, resolvent_S_apply hS n y, map_smul,
1746        hw, smul_zero, add_zero, map_sub, map_smul]
1747    have eU : ∀ n, Un n (S y + w) = T y - epsn n • T (resolvent S n y) := fun n => by
1748      rw [hUn, map_add, resolvent_of_ker hS n hw, resolvent_S_apply hS n y, map_add, map_smul,
1749        hTw, smul_zero, add_zero, map_sub, map_smul]
1750    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
1751    · simp_rw [eQ]
1752      simpa using (tendsto_const_nhds (x := S y)).sub (herr y)
1753    · simp_rw [eU]
1754      have : Tendsto (fun n => epsn n • T (resolvent S n y)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
1755        rw [tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero]
1756        refine squeeze_zero (fun n => norm_nonneg _) (fun n => ?_)
1757          (by simpa using tendsto_epsn.mul_const ‖y‖)
1758        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (epsn_pos n).le, hT]
1759        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_S_resolvent_le hS n y) (epsn_pos n).le
1760      simpa using (tendsto_const_nhds (x := T y)).sub this
1761  have hD := dense_range_add_ker hS
1762  have hmem : ∀ x ∈ ((LinearMap.range (S : H →ₗ[ℝ] H) ⊔ LinearMap.ker (S : H →ₗ[ℝ] H) :
1763      Submodule ℝ H) : Set H), ∃ y w, S w = 0 ∧ x = S y + w := by
1764    intro x hx
1765    obtain ⟨a, ⟨y, rfl⟩, b, hb, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hx
1766    exact ⟨y, b, by simpa using hb, rfl⟩
1767  have hQc := tendsto_of_dense Qn hQb hD (fun x hx => by
1768    obtain ⟨y, w, hw, rfl⟩ := hmem x hx
1769    exact ⟨_, (key y w hw).1⟩)
1770  have hUc := tendsto_of_dense Un hUb hD (fun x hx => by
1771    obtain ⟨y, w, hw, rfl⟩ := hmem x hx
1772    exact ⟨_, (key y w hw).2⟩)
1773  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := exists_clm_of_tendsto Qn hQb hQc
1774  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := exists_clm_of_tendsto Un hUb hUc
1775  have hQS : ∀ x, Q (S x) = S x := fun x => by
1776    have := (key x 0 (by simp)).1
1777    simp only [add_zero] at this
1778    exact tendsto_nhds_unique (hQ _) this
1779  have hUS : ∀ x, U (S x) = T x := fun x => by
1780    have := (key x 0 (by simp)).2
1781    simp only [add_zero] at this
1782    exact tendsto_nhds_unique (hU _) this
1783  refine ⟨U, Q, hU, hQ, ?_, ?_, hQS, hUS, ?_⟩
1784  · intro x y
1785    have h1 := Filter.Tendsto.inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (hQ x) (tendsto_const_nhds (x := y))
1786    have h2 := Filter.Tendsto.inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (tendsto_const_nhds (x := x)) (hQ y)
1787    refine tendsto_nhds_unique h1 (h2.congr fun n => ?_)
1788    show inner ℝ x (S (resolvent S n y)) = inner ℝ (S (resolvent S n x)) y
1789    rw [hS.symm, resolvent_symm hS, resolvent_S_apply hS, S_resolvent_apply hS]
1790  · intro x
1791    have h1 := (Q.continuous.tendsto _).comp (hQ x)
1792    have h2 : (fun n => Q (Qn n x)) = fun n => Qn n x := funext fun n => by
1793      rw [hQn]; exact hQS _
1794    rw [Function.comp_def, h2] at h1
1795    exact tendsto_nhds_unique h1 (hQ x)
1796  · intro x
1797    refine tendsto_nhds_unique (hU x).norm ((hQ x).norm.congr fun n => ?_)
1798    rw [hUn, hQn, hT]
1799
1800end PolarExist2
1801end FragP2

1803section FragP3
1804open MeasureTheory Filter Topology
1805open scoped ENNReal NNReal BigOperators
1806section ResolventMeas
1807variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
1808open HilbertCLTAux
1809
1810/-- Neumann-series data for `S + ε` when `⟪Sx,x⟫ ≤ c₀‖x‖²`. -/
1811lemma neumann_aux {S : H →L[ℝ] H} (hS : IsPSDOp S) {c₀ ε : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 ≤ c₀) (hε : 0 < ε)
1812    (hb : ∀ x, inner ℝ (S x) x ≤ c₀ * ‖x‖ ^ 2) :
1813    ‖(1 : H →L[ℝ] H) - (c₀ + ε)⁻¹ • (S + ε • (1 : H →L[ℝ] H))‖ < 1 ∧
1814    S + ε • (1 : H →L[ℝ] H) =
1815      (c₀ + ε) • (1 - ((1 : H →L[ℝ] H) - (c₀ + ε)⁻¹ • (S + ε • (1 : H →L[ℝ] H)))) := by
1816  set c : ℝ := c₀ + ε with hc
1817  have hcpos : 0 < c := by positivity
1818  set E : H →L[ℝ] H := 1 - c⁻¹ • (S + ε • (1 : H →L[ℝ] H)) with hE
1819  have hEapp : ∀ x, E x = x - c⁻¹ • (S x + ε • x) := fun x => by simp [hE]
1820  have hEinner : ∀ x, inner ℝ (E x) x = ‖x‖ ^ 2 - c⁻¹ * (inner ℝ (S x) x + ε * ‖x‖ ^ 2) := fun x => by
1821    rw [hEapp, inner_sub_left, inner_smul_left, inner_add_left, inner_smul_left,
1822      real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
1823    simp
1824  have hEp : IsPSDOp E := by
1825    refine ⟨fun x y => ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
1826    · rw [hEapp, hEapp]
1827      simp only [inner_sub_left, inner_sub_right, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, inner_add_left,
1828        inner_add_right, conj_trivial, hS.symm x y]
1829    · rw [hEinner]
1830      have h1 := hb x
1831      have h2 : c⁻¹ * (inner ℝ (S x) x + ε * ‖x‖ ^ 2) ≤ c⁻¹ * (c * ‖x‖ ^ 2) := by
1832        gcongr
1833        rw [hc]; nlinarith
1834      rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hcpos.ne', one_mul] at h2
1835      linarith
1836  have hm : 0 ≤ 1 - ε / c := by
1837    rw [sub_nonneg, div_le_one hcpos]; rw [hc]; linarith
1838  have hEn : ‖E‖ ≤ 1 - ε / c := by
1839    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hm fun x => ?_
1840    refine hEp.norm_apply_le' hm (fun y => ?_) x
1841    rw [hEinner]
1842    have h1 := hS.nonneg y
1843    have : c⁻¹ * (inner ℝ (S y) y + ε * ‖y‖ ^ 2) ≥ c⁻¹ * (ε * ‖y‖ ^ 2) := by
1844      gcongr; linarith
1845    have e : (1 - ε / c) * ‖y‖ ^ 2 = ‖y‖ ^ 2 - c⁻¹ * (ε * ‖y‖ ^ 2) := by field_simp
1846    linarith
1847  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
1848  · have : 0 < ε / c := by positivity
1849    linarith
1850  · rw [hE, sub_sub_cancel, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hcpos.ne', one_smul]
1851
1852lemma resolvent_eq_neumann {S : H →L[ℝ] H} (hS : IsPSDOp S) {c₀ : ℝ} (hc₀ : 0 ≤ c₀) (n : ℕ)
1853    (hb : ∀ x, inner ℝ (S x) x ≤ c₀ * ‖x‖ ^ 2) :
1854    resolvent S n = (c₀ + epsn n)⁻¹ •
1855      Ring.inverse (1 - ((1 : H →L[ℝ] H) - (c₀ + epsn n)⁻¹ • (S + epsn n • (1 : H →L[ℝ] H)))) := by
1856  obtain ⟨hlt, heq⟩ := neumann_aux hS hc₀ (epsn_pos n) hb
1857  set c : ℝ := c₀ + epsn n with hc
1858  have hcpos : 0 < c := by have := epsn_pos n; positivity
1859  set E : H →L[ℝ] H := 1 - c⁻¹ • (S + epsn n • (1 : H →L[ℝ] H)) with hE
1860  have h1E : IsUnit (1 - E) := (Units.oneSub E hlt).isUnit
1861  have hl : Ring.inverse (1 - E) * (1 - E) = 1 := Ring.inverse_mul_cancel _ h1E
1862  have hr : (1 - E) * Ring.inverse (1 - E) = 1 := Ring.mul_inverse_cancel _ h1E
1863  have hRl : resolvent S n * (S + epsn n • (1 : H →L[ℝ] H)) = 1 :=
1864    Ring.inverse_mul_cancel _ (isUnit_add_smul_one hS (epsn_pos n))
1865  have hR'r : (S + epsn n • (1 : H →L[ℝ] H)) * (c⁻¹ • Ring.inverse (1 - E)) = 1 := by
1866    rw [heq, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hcpos.ne', one_smul, hr]
1867  calc resolvent S n = resolvent S n * ((S + epsn n • (1 : H →L[ℝ] H)) * (c⁻¹ • Ring.inverse (1 - E))) := by
1868        rw [hR'r, mul_one]
1869    _ = (resolvent S n * (S + epsn n • (1 : H →L[ℝ] H))) * (c⁻¹ • Ring.inverse (1 - E)) := by rw [mul_assoc]
1870    _ = _ := by rw [hRl, one_mul]
1871
1872end ResolventMeas
1873end FragP3
1874
1875section FragP4
1876open MeasureTheory Filter Topology
1877open scoped ENNReal NNReal BigOperators
1878section PolarMeas
1879variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
1880  [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]
1881variable {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z]
1882open HilbertCLTAux
1883
1884lemma OpMeas.pow {A : Z → H →L[ℝ] H} (hA : OpMeas A) : ∀ m : ℕ, OpMeas fun z => A z ^ m
1885  | 0 => by simpa using OpMeas.const (Z := Z) (1 : H →L[ℝ] H)
1886  | m + 1 => by
1887      have := OpMeas.mul (OpMeas.pow hA m) hA
1888      simpa [pow_succ] using this
1889
1890lemma OpMeas.sum_pow {A : Z → H →L[ℝ] H} (hA : OpMeas A) :
1891    ∀ N : ℕ, OpMeas fun z => ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, A z ^ m
1892  | 0 => by simpa using OpMeas.const (Z := Z) (0 : H →L[ℝ] H)
1893  | N + 1 => by
1894      have := OpMeas.add (OpMeas.sum_pow hA N) (OpMeas.pow hA N)
1895      simpa [Finset.sum_range_succ] using this
1896
1897lemma OpMeas.resolvent {A : Z → H →L[ℝ] H} (hA : OpMeas A) {c₀ : Z → ℝ} (hc₀ : Measurable c₀)
1898    (hp : ∀ z, IsPSDOp (A z)) (hc0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ c₀ z)
1899    (hb : ∀ z x, inner ℝ (A z x) x ≤ c₀ z * ‖x‖ ^ 2) (n : ℕ) :
1900    OpMeas fun z => resolvent (A z) n := by
1901  intro x
1902  have hcm : Measurable fun z => (c₀ z + epsn n)⁻¹ := (hc₀.add measurable_const).inv
1903  have hE : OpMeas fun z => (1 : H →L[ℝ] H) - (c₀ z + epsn n)⁻¹ •
1904      (A z + epsn n • (1 : H →L[ℝ] H)) :=
1905    OpMeas.sub (OpMeas.const 1) (OpMeas.smul hcm (OpMeas.add hA (OpMeas.const _)))
1906  have hinv : OpMeas fun z => Ring.inverse (1 - ((1 : H →L[ℝ] H) - (c₀ z + epsn n)⁻¹ •
1907      (A z + epsn n • (1 : H →L[ℝ] H)))) := by
1908    intro y
1909    refine measurable_of_tendsto_metrizable (f := fun N z => (∑ m ∈ Finset.range N,
1910      ((1 : H →L[ℝ] H) - (c₀ z + epsn n)⁻¹ • (A z + epsn n • (1 : H →L[ℝ] H))) ^ m) y)
1911      (fun N => (OpMeas.sum_pow hE N) y) (tendsto_pi_nhds.2 fun z => ?_)
1912    obtain ⟨hlt, -⟩ := neumann_aux (hp z) (hc0 z) (epsn_pos n) (hb z)
1913    have hs := hasSum_geom_series_inverse _ hlt
1914    exact ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ H y).continuous.tendsto _).comp hs.tendsto_sum_nat
1915  have := OpMeas.smul hcm hinv
1916  simp_rw [resolvent_eq_neumann (hp _) (hc0 _) n (hb _)]
1917  exact this x
1918
1919end PolarMeas
1920end FragP4
1921
1922section FragP5
1923open MeasureTheory Filter Topology
1924open scoped ENNReal NNReal BigOperators
1925section HsAdjoint
1926variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
1927variable {κ : Type*}
1928
1929lemma norm_smulRight_innerSL_le (a : H) :
1930    ‖(innerSL ℝ a).smulRight (innerSL ℝ a)‖ ≤ ‖a‖ ^ 2 := by
1931  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.norm_smulRight_apply, innerSL_apply_norm, sq]
1932
1933lemma summable_hsCov {Φ : κ → H} (hΦ : Summable fun k => ‖Φ k‖ ^ 2) :
1934    Summable fun k => (innerSL ℝ (Φ k)).smulRight (innerSL ℝ (Φ k)) := by
1935  have hc : CompleteSpace (H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ) := inferInstance
1936  exact Summable.of_norm_bounded (f := fun k => (innerSL ℝ (Φ k)).smulRight (innerSL ℝ (Φ k))) hΦ
1937    (fun k => norm_smulRight_innerSL_le _)
1938
1939lemma hsCovForm_apply {Φ : κ → H} (hΦ : Summable fun k => ‖Φ k‖ ^ 2) (x y : H) :
1940    hsCovForm Φ x y = ∑' k, inner ℝ (Φ k) x * inner ℝ (Φ k) y := by
1941  have hs := summable_hsCov hΦ
1942  have h1 := (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ (H →L[ℝ] ℝ) x).map_tsum hs
1943  have h2 := (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ y).map_tsum
1944    ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ (H →L[ℝ] ℝ) x).summable hs)
1945  unfold hsCovForm
1946  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply] at h1 h2
1947  rw [h1, h2]
1948  simp [innerSL_apply_apply, mul_comm]

1953lemma memℓp_hsAdjoint (hΦ : Summable fun k => ‖Φ k‖ ^ 2) (x : H) :
1954    Memℓp (fun k => inner ℝ (Φ k) x) 2 := by
1955  refine memℓp_gen ?_
1956  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, Real.rpow_two]
1957  refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun k => by positivity) (fun k => ?_) (hΦ.mul_right (‖x‖ ^ 2))
1958  rw [← mul_pow]
1959  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) ((norm_inner_le_norm _ _)) 2
1960
1961/-- The adjoint `Φ^* : H → ℓ²(κ)`, `x ↦ (⟨Φ_k, x⟩)_k`. -/
1962def hsAdjoint (hΦ : Summable fun k => ‖Φ k‖ ^ 2) : H →L[ℝ] lp (fun _ : κ => ℝ) 2 :=
1963  LinearMap.mkContinuous
1964    { toFun := fun x => ⟨fun k => inner ℝ (Φ k) x, memℓp_hsAdjoint hΦ x⟩
1965      map_add' := fun x y => by
1966        refine lp.ext (funext fun k => ?_)
1967        exact inner_add_right _ _ _
1968      map_smul' := fun c x => by
1969        refine lp.ext (funext fun k => ?_)
1970        exact inner_smul_right _ _ _ }
1971    (Real.sqrt (∑' k, ‖Φ k‖ ^ 2))
1972    (fun x => by
1973      refine lp.norm_le_of_tsum_le (by norm_num) (by positivity) ?_
1974      have hsq : Real.sqrt (∑' k, ‖Φ k‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 = ∑' k, ‖Φ k‖ ^ 2 :=
1975        Real.sq_sqrt (tsum_nonneg fun k => by positivity)
1976      simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, Real.rpow_two, mul_pow, hsq]
1977      rw [← tsum_mul_right]
1978      refine Summable.tsum_le_tsum (fun k => ?_) ((memℓp_hsAdjoint hΦ x).summable (by norm_num) |>.congr
1979        (fun k => by simp [Real.rpow_two])) (hΦ.mul_right _)
1980      rw [← mul_pow]
1981      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) ((norm_inner_le_norm _ _)) 2)
1982
1983lemma hsAdjoint_apply (hΦ : Summable fun k => ‖Φ k‖ ^ 2) (x : H) (k : κ) :
1984    hsAdjoint hΦ x k = inner ℝ (Φ k) x := rfl

1986lemma inner_hsAdjoint (hΦ : Summable fun k => ‖Φ k‖ ^ 2) (x y : H) :
1987    inner ℝ (hsAdjoint hΦ x) (hsAdjoint hΦ y) = hsCovForm Φ x y := by
1988  rw [lp.inner_eq_tsum, hsCovForm_apply hΦ]
1989  refine tsum_congr fun k => ?_
1990  simp [hsAdjoint_apply, mul_comm]

1992lemma norm_hsAdjoint_sq (hΦ : Summable fun k => ‖Φ k‖ ^ 2) (x : H) :
1993    ‖hsAdjoint hΦ x‖ ^ 2 = hsCovForm Φ x x := by
1994  rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, inner_hsAdjoint]

2022lemma hsCovForm_le' (x : H) : hsCovForm Φ x x ≤ (∑' k, ‖Φ k‖ ^ 2) * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
2023  rw [hsCovForm_apply hΦ, ← tsum_mul_right]

2046set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
2047theorem exists_polar_coords {Z : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Z] {ι : Type*} [Countable ι]
2048    (e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H) (Φ : Z → κ → H) (hΦm : ∀ k, Measurable fun z => Φ z k)
2049    (hΦs : ∀ z, Summable fun k => ‖Φ z k‖ ^ 2) :
2050    ∃ (S : Z → H →L[ℝ] H) (coord : Z → H → κ ⊕ ι → ℝ),
2051      OpMeas S ∧ (∀ z, IsSqrtOfForm (S z) (hsCovForm (Φ z))) ∧
2052      (∀ x a, Measurable fun z => coord z x a) ∧
2053      (∀ z x, HasSum (fun a => coord z x a ^ 2) (‖x‖ ^ 2)) ∧
2054      (∀ z x y a, coord z (x + y) a = coord z x a + coord z y a) ∧
2055      (∀ z (c : ℝ) x a, coord z (c • x) a = c * coord z x a) ∧
2056      (∀ z x k, coord z (S z x) (Sum.inl k) = inner ℝ (Φ z k) x) ∧
2057      (∀ z x l, coord z (S z x) (Sum.inr l) = 0) := by
2058  classical
2059  set A : Z → H →L[ℝ] H := fun z => formOp (hsCovForm (Φ z)) with hA
2060  have hAp : ∀ z, IsPSDOp (A z) := fun z => isPSDOp_formOp_hsCov (hΦs z)
2061  have hAinner : ∀ z x y, inner ℝ (A z x) y = ∑' k, inner ℝ (Φ z k) x * inner ℝ (Φ z k) y :=
2062    fun z x y => by rw [hA]; dsimp only; rw [inner_formOp, hsCovForm_apply (hΦs z)]
2063  have hAm : OpMeas A := by
2064    intro x
2065    refine measurable_of_inner_basis e (fun i => ?_)
2066    have : (fun z => inner ℝ (e i) (A z x)) =
2067        fun z => ∑' k, inner ℝ (Φ z k) x * inner ℝ (Φ z k) (e i) := by
2068      funext z; rw [real_inner_comm, hAinner]
2069    rw [this]
2070    exact Measurable.tsum fun k => ((hΦm k).inner measurable_const).mul
2071      ((hΦm k).inner measurable_const)
2072  set c : Z → ℝ := fun z => 1 + ∑' k, ‖Φ z k‖ ^ 2 with hc
2073  have hcm : Measurable c := measurable_const.add (Measurable.tsum fun k => (hΦm k).norm.pow_const 2)
2074  have hcpos : ∀ z, 0 < c z := fun z => by
2075    have : 0 ≤ ∑' k, ‖Φ z k‖ ^ 2 := tsum_nonneg fun k => sq_nonneg _
2076    rw [hc]; dsimp only; linarith
2077  have hAc : ∀ z x, inner ℝ (A z x) x ≤ c z * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := fun z x => by
2078    rw [hA]; dsimp only; rw [inner_formOp]
2079    have := hsCovForm_le' (hΦs z) x
2080    have h2 : (∑' k, ‖Φ z k‖ ^ 2) * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ c z * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
2081      rw [hc]; dsimp only; nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖x‖]
2082    linarith
2083  set S : Z → H →L[ℝ] H := fun z => sqrtOp (c z) (A z) with hS
2084  have hSm : OpMeas S := OpMeas.sqrtOp hAm hcm hAp hcpos hAc
2085  have hSspec : ∀ z, IsPSDOp (S z) ∧ S z * S z = A z := fun z =>
2086    sqrtOp_spec (hAp z) (hcpos z) (hAc z)
2087  have hSsq : ∀ z x y, inner ℝ (S z x) (S z y) = hsCovForm (Φ z) x y := fun z x y => by
2088    rw [(hSspec z).1.symm x (S z y)]
2089    have : S z (S z y) = A z y := by
2090      have := congrArg (fun T : H →L[ℝ] H => T y) (hSspec z).2
2091      simpa using this
2092    rw [this, real_inner_comm, hA]; dsimp only
2093    rw [inner_formOp, hsCovForm_symm' (hΦs z)]
2094  have hS0 : ∀ z x, inner ℝ (S z x) x ≤ Real.sqrt (c z) * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := fun z x => by
2095    have h1 : ‖S z x‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (c z) * ‖x‖ := by
2096      have h2 : ‖S z x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (Real.sqrt (c z) * ‖x‖) ^ 2 := by
2097        rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hSsq z x x, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (hcpos z).le]
2098        have := hsCovForm_le' (hΦs z) x
2099        have h3 : (∑' k, ‖Φ z k‖ ^ 2) * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ c z * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
2100          rw [hc]; dsimp only; nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖x‖]
2101        linarith
2102      exact le_of_sq_le_sq h2 (by positivity)
2103    calc inner ℝ (S z x) x ≤ ‖S z x‖ * ‖x‖ := real_inner_le_norm _ _
2104      _ ≤ (Real.sqrt (c z) * ‖x‖) * ‖x‖ := by gcongr
2105      _ = Real.sqrt (c z) * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by ring
2106  have hR : ∀ n, OpMeas fun z => resolvent (S z) n := fun n =>
2107    OpMeas.resolvent hSm hcm.sqrt (fun z => (hSspec z).1) (fun z => Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hS0 n
2108  have hT : ∀ z x, ‖hsAdjoint (hΦs z) x‖ = ‖S z x‖ := fun z x => by
2109    have h1 : ‖hsAdjoint (hΦs z) x‖ ^ 2 = ‖S z x‖ ^ 2 := by
2110      rw [norm_hsAdjoint_sq, ← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hSsq]
2111    exact le_antisymm (le_of_sq_le_sq h1.le (norm_nonneg _)) (le_of_sq_le_sq h1.ge (norm_nonneg _))
2112  choose U Q hU hQ hQsymm hQQ hQS hUS hUQ using fun z =>
2113    exists_polar (hSspec z).1 (hsAdjoint (hΦs z)) (hT z)
2114  have hUk : ∀ x k, Measurable fun z => (U z x) k := fun x k => by
2115    refine measurable_of_tendsto_metrizable (f := fun n z =>
2116      inner ℝ (Φ z k) (resolvent (S z) n x)) (fun n => (hΦm k).inner (hR n x))
2117      (tendsto_pi_nhds.2 fun z => ?_)
2118    exact ((lp.lipschitzWith_one_eval (E := fun _ : κ => ℝ) 2 k).continuous.tendsto _).comp (hU z x)
2119  have hQm : ∀ x, Measurable fun z => Q z x := fun x =>
2120    measurable_of_tendsto_metrizable (f := fun n z => S z (resolvent (S z) n x))
2121      (fun n => OpMeas.apply hSm (hR n x)) (tendsto_pi_nhds.2 fun z => hQ z x)
2122  refine ⟨S, fun z x => Sum.elim (fun k => (U z x) k) (fun l => inner ℝ (x - Q z x) (e l)), hSm,
2123    fun z => ⟨(hSspec z).1.symm, (hSspec z).1.nonneg, hSsq z⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
2124  · intro x a
2125    rcases a with k | l
2126    · exact hUk x k
2127    · exact (measurable_const.sub (hQm x)).inner measurable_const
2128  · intro z x
2129    have h1 : HasSum (fun k : κ => ((U z x) k) ^ 2) (‖U z x‖ ^ 2) := by
2130      have := lp.hasSum_norm (E := fun _ : κ => ℝ) (p := 2) (by norm_num) (U z x)
2131      simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, Real.rpow_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] at this
2132      exact this
2133    have h2 : HasSum (fun l : ι => inner ℝ (x - Q z x) (e l) ^ 2) (‖x - Q z x‖ ^ 2) := by
2134      have := e.hasSum_inner_mul_inner (x - Q z x) (x - Q z x)
2135      rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at this
2136      convert this using 2 with l
2137      rw [sq, real_inner_comm (x - Q z x) (e l)]
2138    have h3 : HasSum (fun a : κ ⊕ ι => (Sum.elim (fun k => (U z x) k)
2139        (fun l => inner ℝ (x - Q z x) (e l)) a) ^ 2) (‖U z x‖ ^ 2 + ‖x - Q z x‖ ^ 2) := by
2140      have := hasSum_sumElim h1 h2
2141      convert this using 1
2142      funext a; rcases a with k | l <;> rfl
2143    have h4 : ‖U z x‖ ^ 2 + ‖x - Q z x‖ ^ 2 = ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
2144      rw [hUQ z x]
2145      have e1 : inner ℝ (Q z x) (x - Q z x) = 0 := by
2146        rw [inner_sub_right, ← hQQ z x, hQsymm z (Q z x) x, hQQ z x]
2147        simp
2148      have := norm_add_sq_eq_norm_sq_add_norm_sq_real e1
2149      rw [add_sub_cancel] at this
2150      rw [sq, sq, sq]; exact this.symm
2151    rw [h4] at h3
2152    exact h3
2153  · intro z x y a
2154    rcases a with k | l
2155    · simp
2156    · simp only [Sum.elim_inr, map_add, inner_sub_left, inner_add_left]; ring
2157  · intro z c x a
2158    rcases a with k | l
2159    · simp
2160    · simp only [Sum.elim_inr, map_smul, inner_sub_left, inner_smul_left, conj_trivial]; ring
2161  · intro z x k
2162    simp [hUS z x, hsAdjoint_apply]
2163  · intro z x l
2164    simp [hQS z x]
2165

2172section PSCore
2173variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]

2176/-- The vectors `h_i = ∑_a v_i(a) ε_a` for an orthonormal basis `v` of `ℝ^A`. -/
2177def rotVec (v : OrthonormalBasis A ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ A)) (ε : A → H) (i : A) : H :=
2178  ∑ a, v i a • ε a
2179
2180lemma inner_rotVec_left (v : OrthonormalBasis A ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ A)) (ε : A → H) (i : A)
2181    (u : H) : inner ℝ (rotVec v ε i) u = ∑ a, v i a * inner ℝ (ε a) u := by
2182  simp [rotVec, sum_inner, inner_smul_left]
2183
2184lemma inner_rotVec_right (v : OrthonormalBasis A ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ A)) (ε : A → H) (i : A)
2185    (u : H) : inner ℝ u (rotVec v ε i) = ∑ a, v i a * inner ℝ u (ε a) := by
2186  simp [rotVec, inner_sum, inner_smul_right]
2187
2188lemma sum_sq_inner_rotVec (v : OrthonormalBasis A ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ A)) (ε : A → H) (u : H) :
2189    ∑ i, inner ℝ (rotVec v ε i) u ^ 2 = ∑ a, inner ℝ (ε a) u ^ 2 := by
2190  set c : EuclideanSpace ℝ A := WithLp.toLp 2 (fun a => inner ℝ (ε a) u) with hc
2191  have h := v.sum_sq_norm_inner_right c
2192  have h1 : ∀ i, inner ℝ (v i) c = ∑ a, v i a * inner ℝ (ε a) u := fun i => by
2193    simp [hc, PiLp.inner_apply, mul_comm]
2194  have h2 : ‖c‖ ^ 2 = ∑ a, inner ℝ (ε a) u ^ 2 := by
2195    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]; simp [hc]
2196  rw [← h2, ← h]
2197  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
2198  rw [inner_rotVec_left, ← h1, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
2199
2200
2201lemma orthonormal_rotVec (v : OrthonormalBasis A ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ A)) {ε : A → H}
2202    (hε : Orthonormal ℝ ε) : Orthonormal ℝ (rotVec v ε) := by
2203  rw [orthonormal_iff_ite]
2204  intro i l
2205  rw [inner_rotVec_left]
2206  have h1 : ∀ a, inner ℝ (ε a) (rotVec v ε l) = v l a := fun a => by
2207    rw [inner_rotVec_right]
2208    simp [orthonormal_iff_ite.1 hε, Finset.sum_ite_eq]
2209  simp_rw [h1]
2210  have := orthonormal_iff_ite.1 v.orthonormal i l
2211  rw [← this]
2212  simp [PiLp.inner_apply, mul_comm]
2213
2214lemma ps_core (ε : A → H) (hε : Orthonormal ℝ ε) (D Y : H →L[ℝ] H)
2215    (hDs : ∀ x y, inner ℝ (D x) y = inner ℝ x (D y))
2216    (hYs : ∀ x y, inner ℝ (Y x) y = inner ℝ x (Y y))
2217    (hYD : ∀ x, |inner ℝ (D x) x| ≤ inner ℝ (Y x) x) (T K : ℝ)
2218    (hT : ∀ (h : A → H), Orthonormal ℝ h → ∀ s : A → ℝ, (∀ i, s i = 1 ∨ s i = -1) →
2219        ∑ i, s i * inner ℝ (D (h i)) (Y (h i)) ≤ T)
2220    (hK : ∀ (h : A → H), Orthonormal ℝ h → ∑ i, ‖Y (h i)‖ ^ 2 ≤ K) :
2221    ∃ v : OrthonormalBasis A ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ A),
2222      ∑ a, ∑ b, inner ℝ (D (ε a)) (ε b) ^ 2 ≤ T +
2223        Real.sqrt (∑ i, ‖D (rotVec v ε i) - ∑ b, inner ℝ (D (rotVec v ε i)) (ε b) • ε b‖ ^ 2) *
2224          Real.sqrt K := by
2225  set M : Matrix A A ℝ := Matrix.of fun a b => inner ℝ (D (ε a)) (ε b) with hMdef
2226  have hM : M.IsHermitian := by
2227    refine Matrix.IsHermitian.ext fun i j => ?_
2228    simp only [hMdef, Matrix.of_apply, star_trivial]
2229    rw [hDs, real_inner_comm]
2230  set v := hM.eigenvectorBasis with hv
2231  set d := hM.eigenvalues with hd
2232  refine ⟨v, ?_⟩
2233  set h := rotVec v ε with hh
2234  have hon : Orthonormal ℝ h := orthonormal_rotVec v hε
2235  have hDh : ∀ i b, inner ℝ (D (h i)) (ε b) = d i * v i b := fun i b => by
2236    have := congrFun (hM.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis i) b
2237    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at this
2238    rw [hDs, hh, inner_rotVec_left, ← this]
2239    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
2240    simp only [hMdef, Matrix.of_apply]
2241    rw [real_inner_comm (D (ε b)) (ε a), hDs, real_inner_comm]
2242    ring
2243  have hvsq : ∀ i, ∑ b, v i b ^ 2 = 1 := fun i => by
2244    have h1 := v.orthonormal.1 i
2245    have h2 : ‖v i‖ ^ 2 = ∑ b, v i b ^ 2 := by
2246      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]; simp
2247    rw [← h2, h1]; norm_num
2248  have hPD : ∀ i, ∑ b, inner ℝ (D (h i)) (ε b) • ε b = d i • h i := fun i => by
2249    simp_rw [hDh, mul_smul]
2250    rw [← Finset.smul_sum, hh, rotVec]
2251  have hDhh : ∀ i, inner ℝ (D (h i)) (h i) = d i := fun i => by
2252    rw [hh, inner_rotVec_right]
2253    simp_rw [← hh, hDh]
2254    have : ∑ b, v i b * (d i * v i b) = d i * ∑ b, v i b ^ 2 := by
2255      rw [Finset.mul_sum]; refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_; ring
2256    rw [this, hvsq]; ring
2257  set w : A → H := fun i => D (h i) - d i • h i with hw
2258  have hwdef : ∀ i, D (h i) - ∑ b, inner ℝ (D (h i)) (ε b) • ε b = w i := fun i => by
2259    rw [hPD]
2260  set s : A → ℝ := fun i => if 0 ≤ d i then 1 else -1 with hs
2261  have hs1 : ∀ i, s i = 1 ∨ s i = -1 := fun i => by
2262    by_cases hi : 0 ≤ d i <;> simp [hs, hi]
2263  have hsd : ∀ i, s i * d i = |d i| := fun i => by
2264    by_cases hi : 0 ≤ d i
2265    · simp [hs, hi, abs_of_nonneg hi]
2266    · simp [hs, hi, abs_of_neg (not_le.1 hi)]
2267  have hyh : ∀ i, |d i| ≤ inner ℝ (Y (h i)) (h i) := fun i => by
2268    have := hYD (h i); rwa [hDhh] at this
2269  have hkey : ∀ i, d i ^ 2 - ‖w i‖ * ‖Y (h i)‖ ≤ s i * inner ℝ (D (h i)) (Y (h i)) := fun i => by
2270    have e1 : inner ℝ (D (h i)) (Y (h i)) = d i * inner ℝ (h i) (Y (h i)) + inner ℝ (w i) (Y (h i)) := by
2271      rw [hw]; simp only [inner_sub_left, inner_smul_left, conj_trivial]; ring
2272    have e2 : inner ℝ (h i) (Y (h i)) = inner ℝ (Y (h i)) (h i) := real_inner_comm _ _
2273    have e3 : |inner ℝ (w i) (Y (h i))| ≤ ‖w i‖ * ‖Y (h i)‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
2274    have e4 : s i * inner ℝ (w i) (Y (h i)) ≥ -(‖w i‖ * ‖Y (h i)‖) := by
2275      rcases hs1 i with h1 | h1 <;> rw [h1] <;> [skip; skip] <;> nlinarith [abs_le.1 e3]
2276    rw [e1, mul_add, ← mul_assoc, hsd, e2]
2277    have e5 : |d i| * |d i| ≤ |d i| * inner ℝ (Y (h i)) (h i) :=
2278      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hyh i) (abs_nonneg _)
2279    rw [← sq, sq_abs] at e5
2280    nlinarith
2281  have hsum_d : ∑ i, d i ^ 2 = ∑ a, ∑ b, inner ℝ (D (ε a)) (ε b) ^ 2 := by
2282    have h1 : ∀ i, d i ^ 2 = ∑ b, inner ℝ (h i) (D (ε b)) ^ 2 := fun i => by
2283      have : ∀ b, inner ℝ (h i) (D (ε b)) = d i * v i b := fun b => by
2284        rw [← hDs, hDh]
2285      simp_rw [this, mul_pow, ← Finset.mul_sum, hvsq, mul_one]
2286    simp_rw [h1]
2287    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
2288    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
2289    have := sum_sq_inner_rotVec v ε (D (ε b))
2290    rw [← hh] at this
2291    simp_rw [real_inner_comm (D (ε b))] at this ⊢
2292    rw [this]
2293  have hT' := hT h hon s hs1
2294  have hK' := hK h hon
2295  have hCS : ∑ i, ‖w i‖ * ‖Y (h i)‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ i, ‖w i‖ ^ 2) * Real.sqrt K := by
2296    refine (Real.sum_mul_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt _ _ _).trans ?_
2297    gcongr
2298  simp_rw [hwdef]
2299  have := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) => hkey i
2300  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib] at this
2301  linarith

2306section FragPS2
2307open MeasureTheory Filter Topology
2308open scoped ENNReal NNReal BigOperators Matrix
2309section PSLimit
2310variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
2311  [SecondCountableTopology H]
2312variable {A : Type*} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
2313
2314lemma signed_sum_le_traceNormForm {Z : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ}
2315    (hb : BddAbove (Set.range fun p : OrthonormalPairs H => ∑ i, |Z (p.1.2.1 i) (p.1.2.2 i)|))
2316    (h : A → H) (hon : Orthonormal ℝ h) (s : A → ℝ) (hs : ∀ i, s i = 1 ∨ s i = -1) :
2317    ∑ i, s i * Z (h i) (h i) ≤ traceNormForm Z := by
2318  set f : Fin (Fintype.card A) ≃ A := (Fintype.equivFin A).symm with hf
2319  have hon1 : Orthonormal ℝ (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card A) => h (f i)) :=
2320    hon.comp f f.injective
2321  have hon2 : Orthonormal ℝ (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card A) => s (f i) • h (f i)) := by
2322    rw [orthonormal_iff_ite] at hon1 ⊢
2323    intro i j
2324    rw [inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, conj_trivial, ← mul_assoc]
2325    have := hon1 i j
2326    by_cases hij : i = j
2327    · subst hij
2328      rw [if_pos rfl] at this ⊢
2329      rw [this]
2330      rcases hs (f i) with h1 | h1 <;> rw [h1] <;> norm_num
2331    · rw [if_neg hij] at this ⊢
2332      rw [this, mul_zero]
2333  let p : OrthonormalPairs H := ⟨⟨Fintype.card A, fun i => h (f i), fun i => s (f i) • h (f i)⟩,
2334    hon1, hon2⟩
2335  have h1 := pairSum_le_traceNormForm hb p
2336  refine le_trans ?_ h1
2337  simp only [p, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, abs_mul]
2338  rw [Fintype.sum_equiv f (fun i => |s (f i)| * |Z (h (f i)) (h (f i))|)
2339    (fun a => |s a| * |Z (h a) (h a)|) (fun i => rfl)]
2340  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => ?_
2341  rcases hs a with h1 | h1 <;> simp [h1] <;> [exact le_abs_self _; exact neg_le_abs _]
2342
2343section Parseval
2344variable {ι : Type*} (e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H)
2345
2346lemma hasSum_inner_sq (x : H) : HasSum (fun n => inner ℝ x (e n) ^ 2) (‖x‖ ^ 2) := by
2347  have := e.hasSum_inner_mul_inner x x
2348  rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at this
2349  convert this using 2 with n
2350  rw [sq, real_inner_comm x (e n)]
2351
2352lemma sum_norm_sq_swap {L : H →L[ℝ] H} (hL : ∀ x y, inner ℝ (L x) y = inner ℝ x (L y))
2353    (h : A → H) :
2354    ∑ i, ‖L (h i)‖ ^ 2 = ∑' n, ∑ i, inner ℝ (h i) (L (e n)) ^ 2 := by
2355  have h1 : ∀ i, HasSum (fun n => inner ℝ (h i) (L (e n)) ^ 2) (‖L (h i)‖ ^ 2) := fun i => by
2356    convert hasSum_inner_sq e (L (h i)) using 2 with n
2357    rw [real_inner_comm, hL, real_inner_comm]
2358  rw [Summable.tsum_finsetSum (fun i _ => (h1 i).summable)]
2359  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => (h1 i).tsum_eq.symm
2360
2361end Parseval

2363section PSMain
2364variable {ι : Type*} (e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H)
2365
2366lemma norm_sub_sum_sq {B : Type*} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] {ε : B → H} (hε : Orthonormal ℝ ε) (u : H) :
2367    ‖u - ∑ b, inner ℝ u (ε b) • ε b‖ ^ 2 = ‖u‖ ^ 2 - ∑ b, inner ℝ u (ε b) ^ 2 := by
2368  have h1 : inner ℝ u (∑ b, inner ℝ u (ε b) • ε b) = ∑ b, inner ℝ u (ε b) ^ 2 := by
2369    simp only [inner_sum, inner_smul_right, sq]
2370  have h2 : ‖∑ b, inner ℝ u (ε b) • ε b‖ ^ 2 = ∑ b, inner ℝ u (ε b) ^ 2 := by
2371    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
2372    set c : B → ℝ := fun b => inner ℝ u (ε b) with hc
2373    have : inner ℝ (∑ a, c a • ε a) (∑ b, c b • ε b) = ∑ a, ∑ b, c a * c b * inner ℝ (ε a) (ε b) := by
2374      rw [sum_inner]
2375      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
2376      rw [inner_smul_left, inner_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
2377      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
2378      rw [inner_smul_right]; simp only [conj_trivial]; ring
2379    rw [this]
2380    simp only [orthonormal_iff_ite.1 hε, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq,
2381      Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
2382    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
2383    simp [hc, sq]
2384  rw [norm_sub_sq_real, h1, h2]; ring
2385
2386/-- Powers–Størmer inequality `‖√C - √C'‖²_{𝔖₂} ≤ ‖C - C'‖_{𝔖₁}`, in the form needed:
2387for square roots `S, S'` of trace-class forms `C, C'`,
2388`∑_j ‖(S - S') e_j‖² ≤ ‖C - C'‖_{𝔖₁}`. -/
2389theorem powers_stormer {S S' : H →L[ℝ] H} {C C' : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ}
2390    (hS : IsSqrtOfForm S C) (hS' : IsSqrtOfForm S' C') (hC : IsTraceClassCov C)
2391    (hC' : IsTraceClassCov C') (hCe : Summable fun i => C (e i) (e i))
2392    (hCe' : Summable fun i => C' (e i) (e i)) :
2393    Summable (fun j => ‖(S - S') (e j)‖ ^ 2) ∧
2394      ∑' j, ‖(S - S') (e j)‖ ^ 2 ≤ traceNormForm (C - C') := by
2395  classical
2396  set D : H →L[ℝ] H := S - S' with hD
2397  set Y : H →L[ℝ] H := S + S' with hY
2398  have hDs : ∀ x y, inner ℝ (D x) y = inner ℝ x (D y) := fun x y => by
2399    simp only [hD, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, inner_sub_left, inner_sub_right, hS.symm, hS'.symm]
2400  have hYs : ∀ x y, inner ℝ (Y x) y = inner ℝ x (Y y) := fun x y => by
2401    simp only [hY, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, inner_add_left, inner_add_right, hS.symm, hS'.symm]
2402  have hYD : ∀ x, |inner ℝ (D x) x| ≤ inner ℝ (Y x) x := fun x => by
2403    have h1 := hS.nonneg x
2404    have h2 := hS'.nonneg x
2405    simp only [hD, hY, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, inner_sub_left,
2406      inner_add_left]
2407    rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
2408  -- the form `Z = C - C'` along the diagonal
2409  have hZ : ∀ u, (C - C') u u = inner ℝ (D u) (Y u) := fun u => by
2410    have h1 := hS.sq u u
2411    have h2 := hS'.sq u u
2412    simp only [hD, hY, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, inner_sub_left,
2413      inner_add_right, inner_add_left, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_sub', Pi.sub_apply]
2414    rw [real_inner_comm (S' u) (S u)] at *
2415    rw [← h1, ← h2]
2416    ring
2417  have hbdd := bddAbove_pairSum_sub hC hC'
2418  set T : ℝ := traceNormForm (C - C') with hT
2419  have hTbound : ∀ (J : Finset ι) (h : J → H), Orthonormal ℝ h →
2420      ∀ s : J → ℝ, (∀ i, s i = 1 ∨ s i = -1) →
2421        ∑ i, s i * inner ℝ (D (h i)) (Y (h i)) ≤ T := by
2422    intro J h hon s hs
2423    have := signed_sum_le_traceNormForm hbdd h hon s hs
2424    simpa only [hZ] using this
2425  have hSn : ∀ n, ‖S (e n)‖ ^ 2 = C (e n) (e n) := fun n => by
2426    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]; exact hS.sq _ _
2427  have hSn' : ∀ n, ‖S' (e n)‖ ^ 2 = C' (e n) (e n) := fun n => by
2428    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]; exact hS'.sq _ _
2429  have hsq2 : ∀ a b : H, ‖a + b‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖a‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖b‖ ^ 2 := fun a b => by
2430    nlinarith [pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_add_le a b) 2, sq_nonneg (‖a‖ - ‖b‖)]
2431  have hbase : Summable fun n => 2 * C (e n) (e n) + 2 * C' (e n) (e n) :=
2432    (hCe.mul_left 2).add (hCe'.mul_left 2)
2433  have hDsum : Summable fun n => ‖D (e n)‖ ^ 2 := by
2434    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => by positivity) (fun n => ?_) hbase
2435    have := hsq2 (S (e n)) (-S' (e n))
2436    simp only [norm_neg] at this
2437    simp only [hD, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, sub_eq_add_neg]
2438    rw [← hSn, ← hSn']; exact this
2439  have hYsum : Summable fun n => ‖Y (e n)‖ ^ 2 := by
2440    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => by positivity) (fun n => ?_) hbase
2441    have := hsq2 (S (e n)) (S' (e n))
2442    simp only [hY, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply]
2443    rw [← hSn, ← hSn']; exact this
2444  set K : ℝ := ∑' n, ‖Y (e n)‖ ^ 2 with hKdef
2445  have hK : ∀ (J : Finset ι) (h : J → H), Orthonormal ℝ h → ∑ i, ‖Y (h i)‖ ^ 2 ≤ K := by
2446    intro J h hon
2447    rw [sum_norm_sq_swap e hYs h]
2448    refine Summable.tsum_le_tsum (fun n => ?_) ?_ hYsum
2449    · have := hon.sum_inner_products_le (s := Finset.univ) (Y (e n))
2450      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using this
2451    · refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)
2452        (fun n => ?_) hYsum
2453      have := hon.sum_inner_products_le (s := Finset.univ) (Y (e n))
2454      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using this
2455  -- the finite-dimensional step
2456  have hfin : ∀ J : Finset ι,
2457      (∑ a : J, ∑ b : J, inner ℝ (D (e a)) (e b) ^ 2) ≤ ∑ a ∈ J, ‖D (e a)‖ ^ 2 ∧
2458      ∑ a ∈ J, ‖D (e a)‖ ^ 2 ≤ T + Real.sqrt (∑ a ∈ J, ‖D (e a)‖ ^ 2 -
2459        ∑ a : J, ∑ b : J, inner ℝ (D (e a)) (e b) ^ 2) * Real.sqrt K +
2460        (∑ a ∈ J, ‖D (e a)‖ ^ 2 - ∑ a : J, ∑ b : J, inner ℝ (D (e a)) (e b) ^ 2) := by
2461    intro J
2462    set ε : J → H := fun a => e a with hε
2463    have hεon : Orthonormal ℝ ε := e.orthonormal.comp _ Subtype.val_injective
2464    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := ps_core ε hεon D Y hDs hYs hYD T K (fun h hon s hs => hTbound J h hon s hs)
2465      (fun h hon => hK J h hon)
2466    set h : J → H := rotVec v ε with hh
2467    have hhon : Orthonormal ℝ h := orthonormal_rotVec v hεon
2468    have hHS : ∑ i, ‖D (h i)‖ ^ 2 = ∑ a ∈ J, ‖D (e a)‖ ^ 2 := by
2469      rw [sum_norm_sq_swap e hDs h]
2470      have h1 : ∀ n, ∑ i, inner ℝ (h i) (D (e n)) ^ 2 = ∑ a : J, inner ℝ (D (ε a)) (e n) ^ 2 := fun n => by
2471        rw [hh, sum_sq_inner_rotVec v ε (D (e n))]
2472        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
2473        rw [hDs, real_inner_comm]
2474      simp_rw [h1]
2475      have h2 : ∀ a : J, HasSum (fun n => inner ℝ (D (ε a)) (e n) ^ 2) (‖D (ε a)‖ ^ 2) := fun a =>
2476        hasSum_inner_sq e (D (ε a))
2477      rw [Summable.tsum_finsetSum (fun a _ => (h2 a).summable)]
2478      rw [← Finset.sum_coe_sort J (fun a => ‖D (e a)‖ ^ 2)]
2479      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => (h2 a).tsum_eq
2480    have hm : ∑ i, ∑ b : J, inner ℝ (D (h i)) (ε b) ^ 2 =
2481        ∑ a : J, ∑ b : J, inner ℝ (D (e a)) (e b) ^ 2 := by
2482      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
2483      conv_rhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
2484      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
2485      have : ∀ i, inner ℝ (D (h i)) (ε b) = inner ℝ (h i) (D (ε b)) := fun i => hDs _ _
2486      simp_rw [this]
2487      rw [hh, sum_sq_inner_rotVec v ε (D (ε b))]
2488      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
2489      rw [hDs]
2490    have hτ : ∑ i, ‖D (h i) - ∑ b, inner ℝ (D (h i)) (ε b) • ε b‖ ^ 2 =
2491        ∑ a ∈ J, ‖D (e a)‖ ^ 2 - ∑ a : J, ∑ b : J, inner ℝ (D (e a)) (e b) ^ 2 := by
2492      simp_rw [norm_sub_sum_sq hεon, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
2493      rw [hHS, hm]
2494    rw [hτ] at hv
2495    have hτnn : 0 ≤ ∑ a ∈ J, ‖D (e a)‖ ^ 2 - ∑ a : J, ∑ b : J, inner ℝ (D (e a)) (e b) ^ 2 := by
2496      rw [← hτ]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _
2497    refine ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
2498  -- passage to the limit along finite sets
2499  set x : ι × ι → ℝ := fun p => inner ℝ (D (e p.1)) (e p.2) ^ 2 with hx
2500  have hxrow : ∀ a, HasSum (fun b => x (a, b)) (‖D (e a)‖ ^ 2) := fun a => hasSum_inner_sq e (D (e a))
2501  have hxsum : Summable x := by
2502    refine (summable_prod_of_nonneg (fun p => sq_nonneg _)).2 ⟨fun a => (hxrow a).summable, ?_⟩
2503    exact hDsum.congr fun a => ((hxrow a).tsum_eq).symm
2504  have hxtot : ∑' p, x p = ∑' a, ‖D (e a)‖ ^ 2 := by
2505    rw [hxsum.tsum_prod' (fun a => (hxrow a).summable)]
2506    exact tsum_congr fun a => (hxrow a).tsum_eq
2507  have hprod : Tendsto (fun J : Finset ι => J ×ˢ J) atTop atTop := by
2508    refine Filter.tendsto_atTop_atTop.2 fun s => ⟨s.image Prod.fst ∪ s.image Prod.snd, fun J hJ p hp => ?_⟩
2509    refine Finset.mem_product.2 ⟨hJ ?_, hJ ?_⟩
2510    · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hp)
2511    · exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hp)
2512  have hm_eq : ∀ J : Finset ι, ∑ a : J, ∑ b : J, inner ℝ (D (e a)) (e b) ^ 2 = ∑ p ∈ J ×ˢ J, x p := by
2513    intro J
2514    rw [Finset.sum_product]
2515    simp only [hx]
2516    rw [← Finset.sum_coe_sort J]
2517    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
2518    rw [← Finset.sum_coe_sort J]
2519  have hm_lim : Tendsto (fun J : Finset ι => ∑ a : J, ∑ b : J, inner ℝ (D (e a)) (e b) ^ 2) atTop
2520      (𝓝 (∑' a, ‖D (e a)‖ ^ 2)) := by
2521    simp_rw [hm_eq]
2522    rw [← hxtot]
2523    exact hxsum.hasSum.comp hprod
2524  have hHS_lim : Tendsto (fun J : Finset ι => ∑ a ∈ J, ‖D (e a)‖ ^ 2) atTop
2525      (𝓝 (∑' a, ‖D (e a)‖ ^ 2)) := hDsum.hasSum
2526  have hτ_lim : Tendsto (fun J : Finset ι => ∑ a ∈ J, ‖D (e a)‖ ^ 2 -
2527      ∑ a : J, ∑ b : J, inner ℝ (D (e a)) (e b) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
2528    simpa using hHS_lim.sub hm_lim
2529  have hbound_lim : Tendsto (fun J : Finset ι => T + Real.sqrt (∑ a ∈ J, ‖D (e a)‖ ^ 2 -
2530        ∑ a : J, ∑ b : J, inner ℝ (D (e a)) (e b) ^ 2) * Real.sqrt K +
2531        (∑ a ∈ J, ‖D (e a)‖ ^ 2 - ∑ a : J, ∑ b : J, inner ℝ (D (e a)) (e b) ^ 2)) atTop (𝓝 T) := by
2532    have h1 := ((Real.continuous_sqrt.tendsto 0).comp hτ_lim).mul_const (Real.sqrt K)
2533    have h2 := (tendsto_const_nhds (x := T)).add h1 |>.add hτ_lim
2534    simpa using h2
2535  refine ⟨hDsum, hDsum.tsum_le_of_sum_le fun J0 => ?_⟩
2536  refine ge_of_tendsto hbound_lim ?_
2537  filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop J0] with J hJ
2538  calc ∑ a ∈ J0, ‖D (e a)‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ a ∈ J, ‖D (e a)‖ ^ 2 :=
2539        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hJ fun a _ _ => sq_nonneg _
2540    _ ≤ _ := (hfin J).2
2541
2542end PSMain

2544end PSLimit
2545end FragPS2
