2547section FragQ1
2548open MeasureTheory Filter Topology ProbabilityTheory
2549open scoped ENNReal NNReal BigOperators
2550section Padding
2551variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
2552variable {ι₁ ι₂ : Type*} [Fintype ι₁] [Fintype ι₂]
2553
2554/-- Extension by zero of a vector along an injection. -/
2555def padVec (e : ι₁ → ι₂) (v : ι₁ → ℝ) : ι₂ → ℝ := Function.extend e v 0
2556
2557lemma padVec_apply (e : ι₁ → ι₂) (he : Function.Injective e) (v : ι₁ → ℝ) (i : ι₁) :
2558    padVec e v (e i) = v i := he.extend_apply v 0 i
2559
2560lemma padVec_of_notMem (e : ι₁ → ι₂) (v : ι₁ → ℝ) {k : ι₂} (hk : k ∉ Set.range e) :
2561    padVec e v k = 0 := by
2562  unfold padVec
2563  rw [Function.extend_apply' _ _ _ (by simpa using hk)]
2564  rfl
2565
2566lemma sum_padVec {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (e : ι₁ → ι₂) (he : Function.Injective e)
2567    (g : ℝ → M) (hg : g 0 = 0) (v : ι₁ → ℝ) :
2568    ∑ k, g (padVec e v k) = ∑ i, g (v i) := by
2569  symm
2570  refine Fintype.sum_of_injective e he _ _ (fun k hk => ?_) (fun i => ?_)
2571  · rw [padVec_of_notMem e v hk, hg]
2572  · rw [padVec_apply e he]
2573
2574lemma measurable_padVec {α : Type*} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} (e : ι₁ → ι₂) (he : Function.Injective e)
2575    {v : α → ι₁ → ℝ} (hv : Measurable v) : Measurable fun a => padVec e (v a) := by
2576  refine measurable_pi_iff.2 fun k => ?_
2577  by_cases hk : k ∈ Set.range e
2578  · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hk
2579    simp_rw [padVec_apply e he]
2580    exact (measurable_pi_apply i).comp hv
2581  · simp_rw [padVec_of_notMem e _ hk]
2582    exact measurable_const
2583
2584variable {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ}
2585
2586/-- Padding of a simple integrand along an injection of index sets. -/
2587def SimpleIntegrand.pad (e : ι₁ → ι₂) (he : Function.Injective e) (Ψ : SimpleIntegrand ℱ ι₁) :
2588    SimpleIntegrand ℱ ι₂ where
2589  n := Ψ.n
2590  t := Ψ.t
2591  mono := Ψ.mono
2592  nonneg := Ψ.nonneg
2593  ξ := fun i ω => padVec e (Ψ.ξ i ω)
2594  meas := fun i => measurable_padVec (mα := ℱ (Ψ.t i.castSucc)) e he (Ψ.meas i)
2595  bdd := by
2596    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := Ψ.bdd
2597    refine ⟨max C 0, fun i ω k => ?_⟩
2598    by_cases hk : k ∈ Set.range e
2599    · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hk
2600      show |padVec e (Ψ.ξ i ω) (e j)| ≤ max C 0
2601      rw [padVec_apply e he]
2602      exact (hC i ω j).trans (le_max_left _ _)
2603    · show |padVec e (Ψ.ξ i ω) k| ≤ max C 0
2604      rw [padVec_of_notMem e _ hk]
2605      simp
2606
2607lemma SimpleIntegrand.pad_toFun (e : ι₁ → ι₂) (he : Function.Injective e) (Ψ : SimpleIntegrand ℱ ι₁)
2608    (s : ℝ) (ω : Ω) : (Ψ.pad e he).toFun s ω = padVec e (Ψ.toFun s ω) := by
2609  funext k
2610  by_cases hk : k ∈ Set.range e
2611  · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hk
2612    rw [padVec_apply e he, SimpleIntegrand.toFun_apply, SimpleIntegrand.toFun_apply]
2613    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
2614    simp only [SimpleIntegrand.pad, padVec_apply e he]
2615  · rw [padVec_of_notMem e _ hk, SimpleIntegrand.toFun_apply]
2616    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
2617    simp only [SimpleIntegrand.pad, padVec_of_notMem e _ hk]
2618    simp
2619
2620lemma SimpleIntegrand.pad_elemIntegral (e : ι₁ → ι₂) (he : Function.Injective e)
2621    (Ψ : SimpleIntegrand ℱ ι₁) (W : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ι₂ → ℝ) (s : ℝ) (ω : Ω) :
2622    (Ψ.pad e he).elemIntegral W s ω = Ψ.elemIntegral (fun t ω i => W t ω (e i)) s ω := by
2623  unfold SimpleIntegrand.elemIntegral
2624  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
2625  symm
2626  refine Fintype.sum_of_injective e he _ _ (fun k hk => ?_) (fun j => ?_)
2627  · simp only [SimpleIntegrand.pad, padVec_of_notMem e _ hk, zero_mul]
2628  · simp only [SimpleIntegrand.pad, padVec_apply e he]
2629
2630/-- Extension by zero of an integrand along an injection of index sets. -/
2631def padFun (e : ι₁ → ι₂) (Φ : ℝ → Ω → ι₁ → ℝ) : ℝ → Ω → ι₂ → ℝ :=
2632  fun r ω => padVec e (Φ r ω)
2633
2634variable {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
2635
2636lemma isProgressive_padFun (e : ι₁ → ι₂) (he : Function.Injective e) {Φ : ℝ → Ω → ι₁ → ℝ}
2637    (hΦ : IsProgressive ℱ Φ) : IsProgressive ℱ (padFun e Φ) := fun i =>
2638  measurable_padVec e he (hΦ i)
2639
2640lemma sqIntegralOn_padFun (e : ι₁ → ι₂) (he : Function.Injective e) (Φ : ℝ → Ω → ι₁ → ℝ)
2641    (T : ℝ) : sqIntegralOn P (padFun e Φ) T = sqIntegralOn P Φ T := by
2642  unfold sqIntegralOn
2643  refine lintegral_congr fun ω => lintegral_congr fun s => ?_
2644  exact sum_padVec e he (fun x => ‖x‖ₑ ^ 2) (by simp) (Φ s ω)
2645
2646lemma isProgressiveL2_padFun (e : ι₁ → ι₂) (he : Function.Injective e) {Φ : ℝ → Ω → ι₁ → ℝ}
2647    (hΦ : IsProgressiveL2 P ℱ Φ) : IsProgressiveL2 P ℱ (padFun e Φ) :=
2648  ⟨isProgressive_padFun e he hΦ.prog, fun T => by
2649    rw [sqIntegralOn_padFun e he]; exact hΦ.sq T⟩
2650
2651lemma padVec_sub (e : ι₁ → ι₂) (he : Function.Injective e) (a b : ι₁ → ℝ) :
2652    padVec e a - padVec e b = padVec e (a - b) := by
2653  funext k
2654  by_cases hk : k ∈ Set.range e
2655  · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hk
2656    simp [padVec_apply e he]
2657  · simp [padVec_of_notMem e _ hk]
2658
2659theorem itoIntegral_pad (e : ι₁ → ι₂) (he : Function.Injective e) {W₂ : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ι₂ → ℝ}
2660    (hW₂ : IsBrownianFiltration P ℱ W₂)
2661    (hW₁ : IsBrownianFiltration P ℱ (fun t ω i => W₂ t ω (e i))) {Φ : ℝ → Ω → ι₁ → ℝ}
2662    (hΦ : IsProgressiveL2 P ℱ Φ) :
2663    ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ∀ t, itoIntegral P ℱ (fun t ω i => W₂ t ω (e i)) Φ t ω =
2664      itoIntegral P ℱ W₂ (padFun e Φ) t ω := by
2665  have hΦ₂ := isProgressiveL2_padFun e he hΦ
2666  have hM₂ := isItoIntegral_itoIntegral hW₂ hΦ₂
2667  have hM₁ : IsItoIntegral P ℱ (fun t ω i => W₂ t ω (e i)) Φ (itoIntegral P ℱ W₂ (padFun e Φ)) := by
2668    refine isItoIntegral_of_exists_seq hW₁ hΦ (continuous_itoIntegral P ℱ W₂ _)
2669      (adapted_itoIntegral P ℱ W₂ _) (fun t ht ω => itoIntegral_of_nonpos P ℱ W₂ _ ht ω) ?_
2670    intro t ht
2671    obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨ⟩ := exists_fast_approx hΦ
2672    have happ := isApprox_of_fast Ψ hΨ t
2673    refine ⟨Ψ, happ, ?_⟩
2674    have happ2 : IsApprox P (padFun e Φ) (fun n => (Ψ n).pad e he) t := by
2675      unfold IsApprox
2676      refine (happ).congr fun n => ?_
2677      have : (fun s ω => ((Ψ n).pad e he).toFun s ω - padFun e Φ s ω) =
2678          padFun e (fun s ω => (Ψ n).toFun s ω - Φ s ω) := by
2679        funext s ω
2680        simp only [padFun, SimpleIntegrand.pad_toFun]
2681        exact padVec_sub e he _ _
2682      rw [this, sqIntegralOn_padFun e he]
2683    have := hM₂.approx t ht (fun n => (Ψ n).pad e he) happ2
2684    simpa only [SimpleIntegrand.pad_elemIntegral] using this
2685  exact (isItoIntegral_itoIntegral hW₁ hΦ).ae_eq_forall hW₁ hM₁ hΦ |>.mono fun ω h t => h t |>.symm.symm
2686
2687end Padding
2688end FragQ1
2689
2690section FragQ2
2691open MeasureTheory Filter Topology ProbabilityTheory
2692open scoped ENNReal NNReal BigOperators
2693section CtblDef
2694variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ}
2695variable {A : Type*}
2696
2697/-- The family `𝔚` restricted to a finite set of indices. -/
2698def WF (𝔚 : ℝ≥0 → Ω → A → ℝ) (F : Finset A) : ℝ≥0 → Ω → F → ℝ := fun t ω a => 𝔚 t ω a
2699
2700/-- The integrand `ξ` restricted to a finite set of indices. -/
2701def ξF (ξ : ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ) (F : Finset A) : ℝ → Ω → F → ℝ := fun r ω a => ξ r ω a
2702
2703/-- The `L²([0,T] × Ω)` size of the `a`-th coordinate. -/
2704def cT (P : Measure Ω) (ξ : ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ) (a : A) (T : ℝ) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
2705  ∫⁻ ω, (∫⁻ s in Set.Icc 0 T, ‖ξ s ω a‖ₑ ^ 2) ∂P
2706
2707/-- Integrands for the countable-index Itô integral: coordinatewise progressive, with
2708`∑_a E ∫_0^T |ξ_a|² < ∞` for every `T`. -/
2709structure IsCtbl (P : Measure Ω) (ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ) (ξ : ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ) : Prop where
2710  prog : ∀ a, IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => ξ r ω a)
2711  sq : ∀ T : ℝ, ∑' a, cT P ξ a T ≠ ⊤
2712
2713variable {ξ : ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ}
2714
2715lemma isProgressive_ξF (hξ : ∀ a, IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => ξ r ω a)) (F : Finset A) :
2716    IsProgressive ℱ (ξF ξ F) :=
2717  isProgressive_pi (u := fun (a : F) r ω => ξ r ω a) fun a => hξ a
2718
2719lemma measurable_cT_integrand (hξ : ∀ a, IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => ξ r ω a)) (a : A) (T : ℝ) :
2720    Measurable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ‖ξ (min p.1 T) p.2 a‖ₑ ^ 2) :=
2721  (measurable_clamp (hξ a) T).enorm.pow_const 2
2722
2723lemma sqIntegralOn_ξF_eq_sum (hξ : ∀ a, IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => ξ r ω a)) (F : Finset A)
2724    (T : ℝ) : sqIntegralOn P (ξF ξ F) T = ∑ a ∈ F, cT P ξ a T := by
2725  unfold sqIntegralOn cT
2726  have h1 : ∀ ω, ∫⁻ s in Set.Icc 0 T, ∑ a : F, ‖ξF ξ F s ω a‖ₑ ^ 2 =
2727      ∫⁻ s in Set.Icc 0 T, ∑ a ∈ F, ‖ξ (min s T) ω a‖ₑ ^ 2 := fun ω => by
2728    refine setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Icc fun s hs => ?_
2729    rw [← Finset.sum_coe_sort F, min_eq_left hs.2]; rfl
2730  simp_rw [h1]
2731  have h2 : ∀ ω, ∫⁻ s in Set.Icc 0 T, ∑ a ∈ F, ‖ξ (min s T) ω a‖ₑ ^ 2 =
2732      ∑ a ∈ F, ∫⁻ s in Set.Icc 0 T, ‖ξ (min s T) ω a‖ₑ ^ 2 := fun ω =>
2733    lintegral_finset_sum _ fun a _ =>
2734      ((measurable_cT_integrand hξ a T).comp measurable_prodMk_right)
2735  simp_rw [h2]
2736  rw [lintegral_finset_sum]
2737  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
2738    refine lintegral_congr fun ω => ?_
2739    exact setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Icc fun s hs => by rw [min_eq_left hs.2]
2740  · intro a _
2741    exact ((measurable_cT_integrand hξ a T).comp
2742      (measurable_swap (α := Ω) (β := ℝ))).lintegral_prod_right' (ν := volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 T))
2743
2744lemma IsCtbl.progressiveL2 (hξ : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ) (F : Finset A) : IsProgressiveL2 P ℱ (ξF ξ F) := by
2745  refine ⟨isProgressive_ξF hξ.prog F, fun T => ?_⟩
2746  rw [sqIntegralOn_ξF_eq_sum hξ.prog]
2747  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (ENNReal.sum_le_tsum F) (lt_top_iff_ne_top.2 (hξ.sq T))
2748
2749end CtblDef
2750
2751section CtblKL
2752open Classical
2753variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
2754  {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ} {A : Type*} [Countable A] {𝔚 : ℝ≥0 → Ω → A → ℝ} {ξ : ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ}
2755
2756/-- The Itô integral of the restriction of `ξ` to the finite set `F`. -/
2757def ItoF (P : Measure Ω) (ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ) (𝔚 : ℝ≥0 → Ω → A → ℝ) (ξ : ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ)
2758    (F : Finset A) : ℝ → Ω → ℝ :=
2759  itoIntegral P ℱ (WF 𝔚 F) (ξF ξ F)
2760
2761/-- The inclusion of index sets. -/
2762def finIncl {F F' : Finset A} (h : F ⊆ F') : F → F' := fun a => ⟨a, h a.2⟩
2763
2764lemma finIncl_injective {F F' : Finset A} (h : F ⊆ F') : Function.Injective (finIncl h) :=
2765  fun a b hab => Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun x : F' => (x : A)) hab)
2766
2767lemma padFun_ξF {F F' : Finset A} (h : F ⊆ F') (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) (a : F') :
2768    padFun (finIncl h) (ξF ξ F) r ω a = if (a : A) ∈ F then ξ r ω a else 0 := by
2769  by_cases ha : (a : A) ∈ F
2770  · rw [if_pos ha]
2771    have : a = finIncl h ⟨a, ha⟩ := rfl
2772    rw [this, padFun, padVec_apply _ (finIncl_injective h)]
2773    rfl
2774  · rw [if_neg ha]
2775    refine padVec_of_notMem _ _ ?_
2776    rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
2777    exact ha (by simpa using congrArg Subtype.val hb ▸ b.2)
2778
2779lemma ItoF_sub (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ 𝔚) (hξ : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ) {F F' : Finset A}
2780    (h : F ⊆ F') :
2781    ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ∀ t, ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F' t ω - ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F t ω =
2782      itoIntegral P ℱ (WF 𝔚 F') (fun r ω (a : F') => if (a : A) ∈ F then 0 else ξ r ω a) t ω := by
2783  have hpad := itoIntegral_pad (finIncl h) (finIncl_injective h) (hW F') (hW₁ := hW F)
2784    (hξ.progressiveL2 F)
2785  have hsub := itoIntegral_sub (hW F') (hξ.progressiveL2 F')
2786    (isProgressiveL2_padFun (finIncl h) (finIncl_injective h) (hξ.progressiveL2 F))
2787  filter_upwards [hpad, hsub] with ω h1 h2 t
2788  have e : (fun s ω (k : F') => ξF ξ F' s ω k - padFun (finIncl h) (ξF ξ F) s ω k) =
2789      (fun r ω (a : F') => if (a : A) ∈ F then 0 else ξ r ω a) := by
2790    funext s ω a
2791    rw [padFun_ξF h]
2792    by_cases ha : (a : A) ∈ F <;> simp [ha, ξF]
2793  rw [e] at h2
2794  have h3 := h2 t
2795  have h4 := h1 t
2796  calc ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F' t ω - ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F t ω
2797      = itoIntegral P ℱ (fun t ω (k : F') => 𝔚 t ω k) (ξF ξ F') t ω -
2798        itoIntegral P ℱ (fun t ω (k : F') => 𝔚 t ω k) (padFun (finIncl h) (ξF ξ F)) t ω := by
2799        rw [← h4]; rfl
2800    _ = _ := h3.symm
2801
2802end CtblKL
2803end FragQ2
2804
2805section FragQ3
2806open MeasureTheory Filter Topology ProbabilityTheory
2807open scoped ENNReal NNReal BigOperators
2808section FastLimit
2809variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
2810  {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ}
2811
2812theorem ae_fast_of_martingales (D : ℕ → ℝ → Ω → ℝ) (hDm : ∀ n, Martingale (D n) ℱ P)
2813    (hDL2 : ∀ n t, MemLp (D n t) 2 P) (hDc : ∀ n ω, Continuous fun t => D n t ω)
2814    (hb : ∀ n N : ℕ, N ≤ n → ∫⁻ ω, ‖D n (N : ℝ) ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P ≤ ((2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) ^ (3 * n)) :
2815    ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ n0 : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ n0, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) N,
2816      |D n t ω| ≤ (2⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ n := by
2817  rw [ae_all_iff]
2818  intro N
2819  set ε : ℕ → ℝ≥0 := fun n => (2⁻¹ : ℝ≥0) ^ n with hε
2820  set B : ℕ → Set Ω := fun n => if N ≤ n then
2821    {ω | ∃ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) N, (ε n : ℝ) < |D n t ω|} else ∅ with hB
2822  have hBle : ∀ n, P (B n) ≤ ((2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) ^ n := by
2823    intro n
2824    by_cases hNn : N ≤ n
2825    · simp only [hB, hNn, ↓reduceIte]
2826      have hk := kolmogorov_cont (hDm n) (hDL2 n) (hDc n) (N := (N : ℝ)) (by positivity) (ε n)
2827      have hsq := hb n N hNn
2828      have hcoe : ((ε n : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) = ((2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) ^ n := by
2829        simp [hε, ENNReal.inv_pow]
2830      rw [hcoe] at hk
2831      have h1 : ((2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ n) ^ 2 * P {ω | ∃ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) N, (ε n : ℝ) < |D n t ω|} ≤
2832          ((2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ n) ^ 2 * ((2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ n) := by
2833        refine hk.trans (hsq.trans (le_of_eq ?_))
2834        rw [pow_mul]; ring
2835      have hne0 : ((2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ n) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by simp
2836      have hneT : ((2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ n) ^ 2 ≠ ⊤ := by simp
2837      exact (ENNReal.mul_le_mul_iff_right hne0 hneT).1 h1
2838    · simp [hB, hNn]
2839  have hsum : ∑' n, P (B n) ≠ ⊤ := by
2840    refine ne_top_of_le_ne_top ?_ (ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum hBle)
2841    rw [ENNReal.tsum_geometric_two]
2842    norm_num
2843  filter_upwards [ae_eventually_notMem hsum] with ω hω
2844  obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := eventually_atTop.1 hω
2845  refine ⟨max n0 N, fun n hn t ht => ?_⟩
2846  have h1 := hn0 n (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn)
2847  have hNn : N ≤ n := (le_max_right _ _).trans hn
2848  simp only [hB, hNn, ↓reduceIte, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, not_exists, not_and, not_lt] at h1
2849  have := h1 t ht
2850  simpa [hε] using this
2851
2852
2853/-- A sequence of continuous adapted processes with a.s. fast increments converges, a.s. for all
2854times simultaneously, to a continuous adapted process (the filtration being complete). -/
2855theorem exists_continuous_adapted_limit (hℱ : IsCompleteFiltration P ℱ) (I : ℕ → ℝ → Ω → ℝ)
2856    (hc : ∀ n ω, Continuous fun t => I n t ω) (hz : ∀ n t, t ≤ 0 → ∀ ω, I n t ω = 0)
2857    (had : ∀ n t, Measurable[ℱ t] (I n t))
2858    (hfast : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ n0 : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ n0, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) N,
2859      |I (n + 1) t ω - I n t ω| ≤ (2⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ n) :
2860    ∃ M : ℝ → Ω → ℝ, (∀ ω, Continuous fun t => M t ω) ∧ (∀ t ≤ 0, ∀ ω, M t ω = 0) ∧
2861      (∀ t, Measurable[ℱ t] (M t)) ∧
2862      ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ∀ t, Tendsto (fun n => I n t ω) atTop (𝓝 (M t ω)) := by
2863  classical
2864  obtain ⟨C, hCm, hC0, hCG⟩ : ∃ C : Set Ω, MeasurableSet C ∧ P Cᶜ = 0 ∧ ∀ ω ∈ C, ∀ N : ℕ,
2865      ∃ n0 : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ n0, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) N,
2866        |I (n + 1) t ω - I n t ω| ≤ (2⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ n := by
2867    refine ⟨(toMeasurable P {ω | ¬ (∀ N : ℕ, ∃ n0 : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ n0, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) N,
2868        |I (n + 1) t ω - I n t ω| ≤ (2⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ n)})ᶜ,
2869      (measurableSet_toMeasurable _ _).compl, ?_, ?_⟩
2870    · rw [compl_compl, measure_toMeasurable]; exact ae_iff.1 hfast
2871    · intro ω hω
2872      by_contra hcon
2873      exact hω (subset_toMeasurable _ _ hcon)
2874  have hLim : ∀ ω ∈ C, ∃ L : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous L ∧
2875      ∀ t, Tendsto (fun n => I n t ω) atTop (𝓝 (L t)) := fun ω hω =>
2876    exists_continuous_limit (fun n t => I n t ω) (fun n => hc n ω) (fun n t ht => hz n t ht ω)
2877      (hCG ω hω)
2878  let M : ℝ → Ω → ℝ := fun t ω => if ω ∈ C then limUnder atTop (fun n => I n t ω) else 0
2879  have hMlim : ∀ ω ∈ C, ∀ t, Tendsto (fun n => I n t ω) atTop (𝓝 (M t ω)) := by
2880    intro ω hω t
2881    obtain ⟨L, _, hL⟩ := hLim ω hω
2882    have : M t ω = L t := by simp only [M, hω, ↓reduceIte]; exact (hL t).limUnder_eq
2883    rw [this]; exact hL t
2884  have hMcont : ∀ ω, Continuous fun t => M t ω := by
2885    intro ω
2886    by_cases hω : ω ∈ C
2887    · obtain ⟨L, hLc, hL⟩ := hLim ω hω
2888      have : (fun t => M t ω) = L := by
2889        funext t; simp only [M, hω, ↓reduceIte]; exact (hL t).limUnder_eq
2890      rw [this]; exact hLc
2891    · have : (fun t => M t ω) = fun _ => 0 := by funext t; simp [M, hω]
2892      rw [this]; exact continuous_const
2893  have hMzero : ∀ t ≤ 0, ∀ ω, M t ω = 0 := by
2894    intro t ht ω
2895    by_cases hω : ω ∈ C
2896    · have := hMlim ω hω t
2897      simp only [hz _ t ht ω] at this
2898      exact tendsto_nhds_unique tendsto_const_nhds this |>.symm
2899    · simp [M, hω]
2900  have hMad : ∀ t, Measurable[ℱ t] (M t) := by
2901    intro t
2902    have hCt : MeasurableSet[ℱ t] C := by
2903      have := hℱ t Cᶜ hCm.compl hC0
2904      simpa using this.compl
2905    have hf : ∀ n, Measurable[ℱ t] (C.indicator (I n t)) := fun n => (had n t).indicator hCt
2906    refine @measurable_of_tendsto_metrizable Ω ℝ (ℱ t) _ _ _ _ _ _ hf ?_
2907    rw [tendsto_pi_nhds]
2908    intro ω
2909    by_cases hω : ω ∈ C
2910    · simpa [Set.indicator_of_mem hω] using hMlim ω hω t
2911    · simp [M, hω]
2912  refine ⟨M, hMcont, hMzero, hMad, ?_⟩
2913  filter_upwards [(ae_iff.2 hC0 : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ω ∈ C)] with ω hω t using hMlim ω hω t
2914
2915end FastLimit
2916end FragQ3

2918section FragQ4
2919open MeasureTheory Filter Topology ProbabilityTheory
2920open scoped ENNReal NNReal BigOperators
2921section CtblTail
2922open Classical
2923variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
2924  {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ} {A : Type*} [Countable A] {𝔚 : ℝ≥0 → Ω → A → ℝ} {ξ : ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ}
2925
2926/-- The tail `∑_{a ∉ F} E ∫_0^T |ξ_a|²`. -/
2927def tailC (P : Measure Ω) (ξ : ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ) (F : Finset A) (T : ℝ) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
2928  ∑' b, if b ∈ F then 0 else cT P ξ b T
2929
2930lemma cT_mono (P : Measure Ω) (ξ : ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ) (a : A) {T T' : ℝ} (h : T ≤ T') :
2931    cT P ξ a T ≤ cT P ξ a T' :=
2932  lintegral_mono fun ω => lintegral_mono_set (Set.Icc_subset_Icc_right h)
2933
2934lemma tailC_mono_T (F : Finset A) {T T' : ℝ} (h : T ≤ T') : tailC P ξ F T ≤ tailC P ξ F T' :=
2935  ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun b => by
2936    by_cases hb : b ∈ F <;> simp [hb, cT_mono P ξ b h]
2937
2938lemma tailC_anti (T : ℝ) {F F' : Finset A} (h : F ⊆ F') : tailC P ξ F' T ≤ tailC P ξ F T :=
2939  ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun b => by
2940    by_cases hb : b ∈ F
2941    · simp [hb, h hb]
2942    · by_cases hb' : b ∈ F' <;> simp [hb, hb']
2943
2944lemma tailC_tendsto (hξ : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ) (T : ℝ) :
2945    Tendsto (fun F : Finset A => tailC P ξ F T) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
2946  have h := ENNReal.tendsto_tsum_compl_atTop_zero (hξ.sq T)
2947  refine h.congr fun F => ?_
2948  unfold tailC
2949  refine (tsum_subtype {x : A | x ∉ F} (fun b => cT P ξ b T)).trans ?_
2950  refine tsum_congr fun b => ?_
2951  by_cases hb : b ∈ F <;> simp [hb, Set.indicator]
2952
2953lemma sum_diff_le_tailC (T : ℝ) {F F' : Finset A} :
2954    ∑ a ∈ F' \ F, cT P ξ a T ≤ tailC P ξ F T := by
2955  calc ∑ a ∈ F' \ F, cT P ξ a T = ∑ a ∈ F', (if a ∈ F then 0 else cT P ξ a T) := by
2956        rw [Finset.sdiff_eq_filter, Finset.sum_filter]
2957        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
2958        by_cases ha : a ∈ F <;> simp [ha]
2959    _ ≤ tailC P ξ F T := ENNReal.sum_le_tsum F'
2960
2961lemma tailC_le_tsum (F : Finset A) (T : ℝ) : tailC P ξ F T ≤ ∑' b, cT P ξ b T :=
2962  ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun b => by by_cases hb : b ∈ F <;> simp [hb]
2963
2964/-- The integrand `1_{a ∉ F} ξ_a` as an integrand on `A`. -/
2965def ξtail (ξ : ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ) (F : Finset A) : ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ :=
2966  fun r ω a => if a ∈ F then 0 else ξ r ω a
2967
2968lemma cT_ξtail (F : Finset A) (a : A) (T : ℝ) :
2969    cT P (ξtail ξ F) a T = if a ∈ F then 0 else cT P ξ a T := by
2970  by_cases ha : a ∈ F <;> simp [cT, ξtail, ha]
2971
2972lemma isProgressive_ξtail (hξ : ∀ a, IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => ξ r ω a)) (F : Finset A) :
2973    ∀ a, IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => ξtail ξ F r ω a) := fun a => by
2974  by_cases ha : a ∈ F
2975  · simp only [ξtail, ha, if_true]; exact isProgressive_const ℱ (0 : ℝ)
2976  · simp only [ξtail, ha, if_false]; exact hξ a
2977
2978lemma sqIntegralOn_tail_le (hξ : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ) (F F' : Finset A) (T : ℝ) :
2979    sqIntegralOn P (ξF (ξtail ξ F) F') T ≤ tailC P ξ F T := by
2980  rw [sqIntegralOn_ξF_eq_sum (isProgressive_ξtail hξ.prog F)]
2981  simp_rw [cT_ξtail]
2982  exact ENNReal.sum_le_tsum F'
2983
2984lemma isProgressiveL2_tail (hξ : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ) (F F' : Finset A) :
2985    IsProgressiveL2 P ℱ (ξF (ξtail ξ F) F') := by
2986  refine ⟨isProgressive_ξF (isProgressive_ξtail hξ.prog F) F', fun T => ?_⟩
2987  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (sqIntegralOn_tail_le hξ F F' T)
2988    (lt_of_le_of_lt (tailC_le_tsum F T) (lt_top_iff_ne_top.2 (hξ.sq T)))
2989
2990lemma exists_fast_finsets (hξ : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ) :
2991    ∃ G : ℕ → Finset A, Monotone G ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, tailC P ξ (G n) n ≤ ((2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) ^ (3 * n) := by
2992  have : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ F : Finset A, tailC P ξ F n ≤ ((2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) ^ (3 * n) := by
2993    intro n
2994    have hpos : (0 : ℝ≥0∞) < ((2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) ^ (3 * n) := ENNReal.pow_pos (by simp) _
2995    obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := ((tailC_tendsto hξ (n : ℝ)).eventually (gt_mem_nhds hpos)).exists
2996    exact ⟨F, hF.le⟩
2997  choose F hF using this
2998  refine ⟨fun n => (Finset.range (n + 1)).biUnion F, ?_, fun n => ?_⟩
2999  · intro m n hmn
3000    exact Finset.biUnion_subset_biUnion_of_subset_left _ (Finset.range_subset_range.2 (by omega))
3001  · refine (tailC_anti (n : ℝ) ?_).trans (hF n)
3002    exact Finset.subset_biUnion_of_mem F (Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.lt_succ_self n))
3003
3004end CtblTail
3005end FragQ4
3006
3007section FragQ5
3008open MeasureTheory Filter Topology ProbabilityTheory
3009open scoped ENNReal NNReal BigOperators
3010section CtblExist
3011open Classical
3012variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
3013  {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ} {A : Type*} [Countable A] {𝔚 : ℝ≥0 → Ω → A → ℝ} {ξ : ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ}
3014
3015/-- `I` is the Itô integral `∫_0^· ∑_a ξ_a d𝔚^a` of a countable family: a continuous adapted process
3016vanishing on `(-∞, 0]` which is the `L²` limit of the Itô integrals over finite sets of indices. -/
3017structure IsItoC (P : Measure Ω) (ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ) (𝔚 : ℝ≥0 → Ω → A → ℝ)
3018    (ξ : ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ) (I : ℝ → Ω → ℝ) : Prop where
3019  cont : ∀ ω, Continuous fun t => I t ω
3020  adapted : ∀ t, Measurable[ℱ t] (I t)
3021  zero : ∀ t ≤ 0, ∀ ω, I t ω = 0
3022  approx : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → Tendsto (fun F : Finset A =>
3023    ∫⁻ ω, ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F t ω - I t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P) atTop (𝓝 0)
3024
3025theorem exists_isItoC (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ 𝔚) (hξ : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ) :
3026    ∃ I, IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 ξ I := by
3027  obtain ⟨G, hGmono, hG⟩ := exists_fast_finsets hξ
3028  have hℱ : IsCompleteFiltration P ℱ := (hW ∅).complete
3029  set I : ℕ → ℝ → Ω → ℝ := fun n => ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ (G n) with hI
3030  have hIc : ∀ n ω, Continuous fun t => I n t ω := fun n ω =>
3031    continuous_itoIntegral P ℱ _ _ ω
3032  have hIz : ∀ n t, t ≤ 0 → ∀ ω, I n t ω = 0 := fun n t ht ω =>
3033    itoIntegral_of_nonpos P ℱ _ _ ht ω
3034  have hIad : ∀ n t, Measurable[ℱ t] (I n t) := fun n t => adapted_itoIntegral P ℱ _ _ t
3035  have hIm : ∀ n, Martingale (I n) ℱ P := fun n =>
3036    martingale_itoIntegral (hW (G n)) (hξ.progressiveL2 (G n))
3037  have hIL2 : ∀ n t, MemLp (I n t) 2 P := fun n t =>
3038    memLp_two_itoIntegral (hW (G n)) (hξ.progressiveL2 (G n)) t
3039  -- increments
3040  have hDm : ∀ n, Martingale (fun t ω => I (n + 1) t ω - I n t ω) ℱ P := fun n =>
3041    (hIm (n + 1)).sub (hIm n)
3042  have hDL2 : ∀ n t, MemLp (fun ω => I (n + 1) t ω - I n t ω) 2 P := fun n t =>
3043    (hIL2 (n + 1) t).sub (hIL2 n t)
3044  have hDc : ∀ n ω, Continuous fun t => I (n + 1) t ω - I n t ω := fun n ω =>
3045    (hIc (n + 1) ω).sub (hIc n ω)
3046  have hsub : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ∀ t, I (n + 1) t ω - I n t ω =
3047      itoIntegral P ℱ (WF 𝔚 (G (n + 1))) (ξF (ξtail ξ (G n)) (G (n + 1))) t ω := fun n =>
3048    ItoF_sub hW hξ (hGmono (Nat.le_succ n))
3049  have hbL2 : ∀ n (t : ℝ), ∫⁻ ω, ‖I (n + 1) t ω - I n t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P ≤ tailC P ξ (G n) t := by
3050    intro n t
3051    calc ∫⁻ ω, ‖I (n + 1) t ω - I n t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P
3052        = ∫⁻ ω, ‖itoIntegral P ℱ (WF 𝔚 (G (n + 1))) (ξF (ξtail ξ (G n)) (G (n + 1))) t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P :=
3053          lintegral_congr_ae (by filter_upwards [hsub n] with ω hω; rw [hω t])
3054      _ = sqIntegralOn P (ξF (ξtail ξ (G n)) (G (n + 1))) t :=
3055          lintegral_itoIntegral_sq (hW (G (n + 1))) (isProgressiveL2_tail hξ (G n) (G (n + 1))) t
3056      _ ≤ _ := sqIntegralOn_tail_le hξ (G n) (G (n + 1)) t
3057  have hb : ∀ n N : ℕ, N ≤ n → ∫⁻ ω, ‖I (n + 1) (N : ℝ) ω - I n (N : ℝ) ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P ≤
3058      ((2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) ^ (3 * n) := fun n N hNn =>
3059    (hbL2 n N).trans ((tailC_mono_T (G n) (by exact_mod_cast hNn)).trans (hG n))
3060  have hfast := ae_fast_of_martingales (fun n t ω => I (n + 1) t ω - I n t ω) hDm hDL2 hDc hb
3061  obtain ⟨M, hMc, hMz, hMad, hMlim⟩ :=
3062    exists_continuous_adapted_limit hℱ I hIc hIz hIad hfast
3063  refine ⟨M, ⟨hMc, hMad, hMz, fun t ht => ?_⟩⟩
3064  -- `L²` convergence along the chain `G n`
3065  have hmeasI : ∀ n s, AEMeasurable (I n s) P := fun n s =>
3066    ((hIad n s).mono (ℱ.le s) le_rfl).aemeasurable
3067  have h1 : ∀ n, ∫⁻ ω, ‖I n t ω - M t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P ≤ tailC P ξ (G n) t := by
3068    intro n
3069    have := lintegral_enorm_sq_le_liminf (P := P) (X := fun m => I m t) (Y := M t) (Z := I n t)
3070      (fun m => hmeasI m t) (hmeasI n t) (hMlim.mono fun ω hω => hω t)
3071    refine this.trans ?_
3072    refine liminf_le_of_frequently_le' ?_
3073    refine Filter.Eventually.frequently ?_
3074    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop n] with m hm
3075    have hsubm : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ∀ s, ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ (G m) s ω - ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ (G n) s ω =
3076        itoIntegral P ℱ (WF 𝔚 (G m)) (ξF (ξtail ξ (G n)) (G m)) s ω :=
3077      ItoF_sub hW hξ (hGmono hm)
3078    calc ∫⁻ ω, ‖I n t ω - I m t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P
3079        = ∫⁻ ω, ‖itoIntegral P ℱ (WF 𝔚 (G m)) (ξF (ξtail ξ (G n)) (G m)) t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P := by
3080          refine lintegral_congr_ae ?_
3081          filter_upwards [hsubm] with ω hω
3082          rw [← hω t, ← enorm_neg, neg_sub]
3083      _ = sqIntegralOn P (ξF (ξtail ξ (G n)) (G m)) t :=
3084          lintegral_itoIntegral_sq (hW (G m)) (isProgressiveL2_tail hξ (G n) (G m)) t
3085      _ ≤ _ := sqIntegralOn_tail_le hξ (G n) (G m) t
3086  have hu : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 4 * ((2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) ^ (3 * n)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
3087    have hlim : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) ^ (3 * n)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
3088      have := ENNReal.tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (r := ((2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) ^ 3) (by
3089        rw [← ENNReal.inv_pow]; norm_num)
3090      simpa [pow_mul] using this
3091    simpa using ENNReal.Tendsto.const_mul hlim (Or.inr (by norm_num : (4 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ⊤))
3092  rw [ENNReal.tendsto_nhds_zero]
3093  intro ε hε
3094  obtain ⟨n, hn1, hn2⟩ :=
3095    ((hu.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hε)).and (eventually_ge_atTop ⌈t⌉₊)).exists
3096  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (G n)] with F hF
3097  have hsubF : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ∀ s, ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F s ω - ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ (G n) s ω =
3098      itoIntegral P ℱ (WF 𝔚 F) (ξF (ξtail ξ (G n)) F) s ω := ItoF_sub hW hξ hF
3099  have htn : t ≤ (n : ℝ) := (Nat.le_ceil t).trans (by exact_mod_cast hn2)
3100  have htail : tailC P ξ (G n) t ≤ ((2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) ^ (3 * n) :=
3101    (tailC_mono_T (G n) htn).trans (hG n)
3102  have h2 : ∫⁻ ω, ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F t ω - I n t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P ≤ tailC P ξ (G n) t := by
3103    calc ∫⁻ ω, ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F t ω - I n t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P
3104        = ∫⁻ ω, ‖itoIntegral P ℱ (WF 𝔚 F) (ξF (ξtail ξ (G n)) F) t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P :=
3105          lintegral_congr_ae (by filter_upwards [hsubF] with ω hω; rw [← hω t])
3106      _ = sqIntegralOn P (ξF (ξtail ξ (G n)) F) t :=
3107          lintegral_itoIntegral_sq (hW F) (isProgressiveL2_tail hξ (G n) F) t
3108      _ ≤ _ := sqIntegralOn_tail_le hξ (G n) F t
3109  have hmF : Measurable fun ω => ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F t ω - I n t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 :=
3110    ((((adapted_itoIntegral P ℱ _ _ t).mono (ℱ.le t) le_rfl).sub
3111      ((hIad n t).mono (ℱ.le t) le_rfl)).enorm).pow_const 2
3112  calc ∫⁻ ω, ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F t ω - M t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P
3113      ≤ ∫⁻ ω, (2 * ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F t ω - I n t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖I n t ω - M t ω‖ₑ ^ 2) ∂P := by
3114        refine lintegral_mono fun ω => ?_
3115        have := enorm_add_sq_le (ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F t ω - I n t ω) (I n t ω - M t ω)
3116        simpa using this
3117    _ = 2 * ∫⁻ ω, ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F t ω - I n t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P +
3118          2 * ∫⁻ ω, ‖I n t ω - M t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P := by
3119        rw [lintegral_add_left (hmF.const_mul 2), lintegral_const_mul _ hmF,
3120          lintegral_const_mul' _ _ (by norm_num)]
3121    _ ≤ 2 * ((2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) ^ (3 * n) + 2 * ((2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) ^ (3 * n) := by
3122        gcongr
3123        · exact h2.trans htail
3124        · exact (h1 n).trans htail
3125    _ = 4 * ((2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) ^ (3 * n) := by
3126        rw [← add_mul]; norm_num
3127    _ ≤ ε := hn1.le
3128
3129end CtblExist
3130end FragQ5
3131
3132section FragQ6
3133open MeasureTheory Filter Topology ProbabilityTheory
3134open scoped ENNReal NNReal BigOperators
3135section CtblProps
3136open Classical
3137variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
3138  {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ} {A : Type*} [Countable A] {𝔚 : ℝ≥0 → Ω → A → ℝ} {ξ ξ' : ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ}
3139  {I I' : ℝ → Ω → ℝ}
3140
3141lemma aemeasurable_ItoF (F : Finset A) (t : ℝ) : AEMeasurable (ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F t) P :=
3142  ((adapted_itoIntegral P ℱ _ _ t).mono (ℱ.le t) le_rfl).aemeasurable
3143
3144lemma IsItoC.aemeasurable (hI : IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 ξ I) (t : ℝ) : AEMeasurable (I t) P :=
3145  ((hI.adapted t).mono (ℱ.le t) le_rfl).aemeasurable
3146
3147lemma lintegral_enorm_sq_add_le' {X Y : Ω → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X P) (hY : AEMeasurable Y P) :
3148    ∫⁻ ω, ‖X ω + Y ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P ≤ 2 * ∫⁻ ω, ‖X ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P + 2 * ∫⁻ ω, ‖Y ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P := by
3149  calc ∫⁻ ω, ‖X ω + Y ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P ≤ ∫⁻ ω, (2 * ‖X ω‖ₑ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖Y ω‖ₑ ^ 2) ∂P :=
3150        lintegral_mono fun ω => enorm_add_sq_le _ _
3151    _ = _ := by
3152        rw [lintegral_add_left' (hX.enorm.pow_const 2 |>.const_mul 2),
3153          lintegral_const_mul'' _ (hX.enorm.pow_const 2), lintegral_const_mul'' _ (hY.enorm.pow_const 2)]
3154
3155/-- Uniqueness of the countable Itô integral. -/
3156theorem IsItoC.ae_eq_forall (hI : IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 ξ I) (hI' : IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 ξ I') :
3157    ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ∀ t, I t ω = I' t ω := by
3158  refine ae_forall_eq_of_continuous P I I' hI.cont hI'.cont fun t => ?_
3159  rcases le_or_gt t 0 with ht | ht
3160  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => by rw [hI.zero t ht ω, hI'.zero t ht ω]
3161  have h1 := hI.approx t ht.le
3162  have h2 := hI'.approx t ht.le
3163  have hm := (hI.aemeasurable t).sub (hI'.aemeasurable t)
3164  have h0 : ∫⁻ ω, ‖I t ω - I' t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P = 0 := by
3165    refine le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
3166    have h3 : Tendsto (fun F : Finset A => 2 * ∫⁻ ω, ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F t ω - I t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P +
3167        2 * ∫⁻ ω, ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F t ω - I' t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P) atTop (𝓝 (2 * 0 + 2 * 0)) :=
3168      (ENNReal.Tendsto.const_mul h1 (Or.inr (by norm_num))).add
3169        (ENNReal.Tendsto.const_mul h2 (Or.inr (by norm_num)))
3170    simp only [mul_zero, add_zero] at h3
3171    refine ge_of_tendsto' h3 fun F => ?_
3172    have hF := aemeasurable_ItoF (P := P) (ℱ := ℱ) (𝔚 := 𝔚) (ξ := ξ) F t
3173    have := lintegral_enorm_sq_add_le' (P := P) (hF.sub (hI.aemeasurable t)) ((hI'.aemeasurable t).sub hF)
3174    have e : ∀ ω, (ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F t ω - I t ω) + (I' t ω - ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F t ω) = I' t ω - I t ω := fun ω => by ring
3175    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, e] at this
3176    calc ∫⁻ ω, ‖I t ω - I' t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P = ∫⁻ ω, ‖I' t ω - I t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P := by
3177          refine lintegral_congr fun ω => ?_
3178          rw [← enorm_neg, neg_sub]
3179      _ ≤ _ := this
3180      _ = _ := by
3181          congr 2
3182          refine lintegral_congr fun ω => ?_
3183          rw [← enorm_neg, neg_sub]
3184  filter_upwards [ae_eq_zero_of_lintegral_enorm_sq_eq_zero hm h0] with ω hω
3185  simpa [sub_eq_zero] using hω
3186
3187theorem IsItoC.add (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ 𝔚) (hξ : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ) (hξ' : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ')
3188    (hI : IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 ξ I) (hI' : IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 ξ' I') :
3189    IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 (fun r ω a => ξ r ω a + ξ' r ω a) (fun t ω => I t ω + I' t ω) := by
3190  refine ⟨fun ω => (hI.cont ω).add (hI'.cont ω), fun t => (hI.adapted t).add (hI'.adapted t),
3191    fun t ht ω => by simp [hI.zero t ht ω, hI'.zero t ht ω], fun t ht => ?_⟩
3192  have h1 := hI.approx t ht
3193  have h2 := hI'.approx t ht
3194  have hb : Tendsto (fun F : Finset A => 2 * ∫⁻ ω, ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F t ω - I t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P +
3195      2 * ∫⁻ ω, ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ' F t ω - I' t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
3196    have := (ENNReal.Tendsto.const_mul h1 (Or.inr (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ⊤))).add
3197        (ENNReal.Tendsto.const_mul h2 (Or.inr (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ⊤)))
3198    simpa using this
3199  refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds hb (fun _ => bot_le) fun F => ?_
3200  have hae := itoIntegral_add (hW F) (hξ.progressiveL2 F) (hξ'.progressiveL2 F)
3201  have hF := aemeasurable_ItoF (P := P) (ℱ := ℱ) (𝔚 := 𝔚) (ξ := ξ) F t
3202  have hF' := aemeasurable_ItoF (P := P) (ℱ := ℱ) (𝔚 := 𝔚) (ξ := ξ') F t
3203  calc ∫⁻ ω, ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 (fun r ω a => ξ r ω a + ξ' r ω a) F t ω - (I t ω + I' t ω)‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P
3204      = ∫⁻ ω, ‖(ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F t ω - I t ω) + (ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ' F t ω - I' t ω)‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P := by
3205        refine lintegral_congr_ae ?_
3206        filter_upwards [hae] with ω hω
3207        have : ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 (fun r ω a => ξ r ω a + ξ' r ω a) F t ω =
3208            ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F t ω + ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ' F t ω := hω t
3209        rw [this]; congr 2; ring
3210    _ ≤ _ := lintegral_enorm_sq_add_le' (hF.sub (hI.aemeasurable t)) (hF'.sub (hI'.aemeasurable t))
3211
3212theorem IsItoC.sub (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ 𝔚) (hξ : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ) (hξ' : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ')
3213    (hI : IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 ξ I) (hI' : IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 ξ' I') :
3214    IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 (fun r ω a => ξ r ω a - ξ' r ω a) (fun t ω => I t ω - I' t ω) := by
3215  refine ⟨fun ω => (hI.cont ω).sub (hI'.cont ω), fun t => (hI.adapted t).sub (hI'.adapted t),
3216    fun t ht ω => by simp [hI.zero t ht ω, hI'.zero t ht ω], fun t ht => ?_⟩
3217  have h1 := hI.approx t ht
3218  have h2 := hI'.approx t ht
3219  have hb : Tendsto (fun F : Finset A => 2 * ∫⁻ ω, ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F t ω - I t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P +
3220      2 * ∫⁻ ω, ‖-(ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ' F t ω - I' t ω)‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
3221    simp_rw [enorm_neg]
3222    have := (ENNReal.Tendsto.const_mul h1 (Or.inr (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ⊤))).add
3223        (ENNReal.Tendsto.const_mul h2 (Or.inr (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ⊤)))
3224    simpa using this
3225  refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds hb (fun _ => bot_le) fun F => ?_
3226  have hae := itoIntegral_sub (hW F) (hξ.progressiveL2 F) (hξ'.progressiveL2 F)
3227  have hF := aemeasurable_ItoF (P := P) (ℱ := ℱ) (𝔚 := 𝔚) (ξ := ξ) F t
3228  have hF' := aemeasurable_ItoF (P := P) (ℱ := ℱ) (𝔚 := 𝔚) (ξ := ξ') F t
3229  calc ∫⁻ ω, ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 (fun r ω a => ξ r ω a - ξ' r ω a) F t ω - (I t ω - I' t ω)‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P
3230      = ∫⁻ ω, ‖(ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F t ω - I t ω) + -(ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ' F t ω - I' t ω)‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P := by
3231        refine lintegral_congr_ae ?_
3232        filter_upwards [hae] with ω hω
3233        have : ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 (fun r ω a => ξ r ω a - ξ' r ω a) F t ω =
3234            ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F t ω - ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ' F t ω := hω t
3235        rw [this]; congr 2; ring
3236    _ ≤ _ := lintegral_enorm_sq_add_le' (hF.sub (hI.aemeasurable t)) ((hF'.sub (hI'.aemeasurable t)).neg)
3237
3238theorem IsItoC.smul (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ 𝔚) (hξ : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ) (c : ℝ)
3239    (hI : IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 ξ I) :
3240    IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 (fun r ω a => c * ξ r ω a) (fun t ω => c * I t ω) := by
3241  refine ⟨fun ω => (hI.cont ω).const_mul c, fun t => (hI.adapted t).const_mul c,
3242    fun t ht ω => by simp [hI.zero t ht ω], fun t ht => ?_⟩
3243  have h1 := hI.approx t ht
3244  have hb : Tendsto (fun F : Finset A => ‖c‖ₑ ^ 2 * ∫⁻ ω, ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F t ω - I t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P)
3245      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
3246    simpa using ENNReal.Tendsto.const_mul h1 (Or.inr (by simp : ‖c‖ₑ ^ 2 ≠ ⊤))
3247  refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds hb (fun _ => bot_le) fun F => ?_
3248  have hae := itoIntegral_smul (hW F) (hξ.progressiveL2 F) c
3249  have hF := aemeasurable_ItoF (P := P) (ℱ := ℱ) (𝔚 := 𝔚) (ξ := ξ) F t
3250  calc ∫⁻ ω, ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 (fun r ω a => c * ξ r ω a) F t ω - c * I t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P
3251      = ∫⁻ ω, ‖c‖ₑ ^ 2 * ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F t ω - I t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P := by
3252        refine lintegral_congr_ae ?_
3253        filter_upwards [hae] with ω hω
3254        have : ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 (fun r ω a => c * ξ r ω a) F t ω = c * ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F t ω := hω t
3255        rw [this, ← mul_sub, enorm_mul, mul_pow]
3256    _ = _ := lintegral_const_mul'' _ ((hF.sub (hI.aemeasurable t)).enorm.pow_const 2)
3257    _ ≤ _ := le_rfl
3258
3259/-- If `ξ` vanishes outside the finite set `F₀`, its countable integral is the finite one. -/
3260theorem isItoC_of_support (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ 𝔚) (hξ : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ) (F₀ : Finset A)
3261    (h0 : ∀ r ω a, a ∉ F₀ → ξ r ω a = 0) : IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 ξ (ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F₀) := by
3262  refine ⟨fun ω => continuous_itoIntegral P ℱ _ _ ω, fun t => adapted_itoIntegral P ℱ _ _ t,
3263    fun t ht ω => itoIntegral_of_nonpos P ℱ _ _ ht ω, fun t ht => ?_⟩
3264  refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr' ?_
3265  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop F₀] with F hF
3266  have hsub := ItoF_sub hW hξ hF
3267  have hz : ξtail ξ F₀ = fun _ _ _ => 0 := by
3268    funext r ω a
3269    by_cases ha : a ∈ F₀ <;> simp [ξtail, ha, h0 r ω a]
3270  have hconst := itoIntegral_const (hW F) (fun _ : F => (0 : ℝ))
3271  symm
3272  have : ∫⁻ ω, ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F t ω - ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F₀ t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P = ∫⁻ ω, (0 : ℝ≥0∞) ∂P := by
3273    refine lintegral_congr_ae ?_
3274    filter_upwards [hsub, hconst] with ω h1 h2
3275    rw [h1 t]
3276    have : (fun r ω (a : F) => if (a : A) ∈ F₀ then (0 : ℝ) else ξ r ω a) = fun _ _ _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
3277      funext r ω a; by_cases ha : (a : A) ∈ F₀ <;> simp [ha, h0 r ω a]
3278    rw [this]
3279    have h3 : itoIntegral P ℱ (WF 𝔚 F) (fun _ _ (_ : F) => (0 : ℝ)) t ω = 0 :=
3280      (h2 t).trans (by simp)
3281    rw [h3]
3282    simp
3283  rw [this]; simp
3284
3285lemma exists_finset_seq : ∃ F : ℕ → Finset A, Tendsto F atTop atTop :=
3286  Filter.exists_seq_tendsto _
3287
3288theorem IsItoC.memLp (hξ : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ) (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ 𝔚)
3289    (hI : IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 ξ I) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) : MemLp (I t) 2 P := by
3290  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := exists_finset_seq (A := A)
3291  exact memLp_of_tendsto_lintegral (X := fun n => ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ (F n) t)
3292    (hI.aemeasurable t).aestronglyMeasurable
3293    (fun n => memLp_two_itoIntegral (hW (F n)) (hξ.progressiveL2 (F n)) t)
3294    ((hI.approx t ht).comp hF)
3295
3296/-- The `L²`-isometry, upper bound: `E|I_t|² ≤ ∑_a E ∫_0^t |ξ_a|²`. -/
3297theorem IsItoC.lintegral_sq_le (hξ : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ) (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ 𝔚)
3298    (hI : IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 ξ I) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
3299    ∫⁻ ω, ‖I t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P ≤ ∑' a, cT P ξ a t := by
3300  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := exists_finset_seq (A := A)
3301  have hY := hI.memLp hξ hW ht
3302  have hX : ∀ n, MemLp (ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ (F n) t) 2 P := fun n =>
3303    memLp_two_itoIntegral (hW (F n)) (hξ.progressiveL2 (F n)) t
3304  have hlim := tendsto_toLp_of_tendsto_lintegral hX hY ((hI.approx t ht).comp hF)
3305  have hS : ∑' a, cT P ξ a t ≠ ⊤ := hξ.sq t
3306  have hbound : ∀ n, ‖(hX n).toLp (ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ (F n) t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (∑' a, cT P ξ a t).toReal := by
3307    intro n
3308    rw [norm_toLp_sq]
3309    refine ENNReal.toReal_mono hS ?_
3310    have e : ∫⁻ ω, ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ (F n) t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P = sqIntegralOn P (ξF ξ (F n)) t :=
3311      lintegral_itoIntegral_sq (hW (F n)) (hξ.progressiveL2 (F n)) t
3312    rw [e, sqIntegralOn_ξF_eq_sum hξ.prog]
3313    exact ENNReal.sum_le_tsum _
3314  have h2 : ‖hY.toLp (I t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (∑' a, cT P ξ a t).toReal := by
3315    have := (hlim.norm).pow 2
3316    exact le_of_tendsto this (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hbound)
3317  rw [norm_toLp_sq] at h2
3318  have hfin : ∫⁻ ω, ‖I t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P ≠ ⊤ := (lintegral_enorm_sq_lt_top hY).ne
3319  exact (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal hfin hS).1 h2
3320
3321end CtblProps
3322end FragQ6

3324section FragQ7
3325open MeasureTheory Filter Topology ProbabilityTheory
3326open scoped ENNReal NNReal BigOperators
3327section CtblMart
3328open Classical
3329variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
3330  {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ} {A : Type*} [Countable A] {𝔚 : ℝ≥0 → Ω → A → ℝ} {ξ ξ' : ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ}
3331  {I I' : ℝ → Ω → ℝ}
3332
3333/-- `L²` convergence gives convergence of `L²` norms (in `ℝ≥0∞`). -/
3334lemma tendsto_lintegral_sq_of_L2 {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {Y : Ω → ℝ} (hX : ∀ n, MemLp (X n) 2 P)
3335    (hY : MemLp Y 2 P) (h : Tendsto (fun n => ∫⁻ ω, ‖X n ω - Y ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
3336    Tendsto (fun n => ∫⁻ ω, ‖X n ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P) atTop (𝓝 (∫⁻ ω, ‖Y ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P)) := by
3337  have hlim := tendsto_toLp_of_tendsto_lintegral hX hY h
3338  have h2 := (hlim.norm).pow 2
3339  simp_rw [norm_toLp_sq] at h2
3340  have := (ENNReal.tendsto_toReal_iff (fun n => (lintegral_enorm_sq_lt_top (hX n)).ne)
3341    (lintegral_enorm_sq_lt_top hY).ne).1 h2
3342  exact this
3343
3344lemma tendsto_setIntegral_ItoF (hξ : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ) (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ 𝔚)
3345    (hI : IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 ξ I) (u : ℝ) {S : Set Ω} (hS : MeasurableSet S) {F : ℕ → Finset A}
3346    (hF : Tendsto F atTop atTop) :
3347    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ ω in S, ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ (F n) u ω ∂P) atTop (𝓝 (∫ ω in S, I u ω ∂P)) := by
3348  rcases lt_or_ge u 0 with hu | hu
3349  · have e1 : ∀ n, ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ (F n) u = fun _ => 0 := fun n =>
3350      funext fun ω => itoIntegral_of_nonpos P ℱ _ _ hu.le ω
3351    have e2 : I u = fun _ => 0 := funext fun ω => hI.zero u hu.le ω
3352    simp [e1, e2]
3353  · exact tendsto_setIntegral_of_tendsto_lintegral
3354      (fun n => memLp_two_itoIntegral (hW (F n)) (hξ.progressiveL2 (F n)) u)
3355      (hI.memLp hξ hW hu) ((hI.approx u hu).comp hF) hS
3356
3357theorem IsItoC.martingale (hξ : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ) (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ 𝔚)
3358    (hI : IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 ξ I) : Martingale I ℱ P := by
3359  have hsa : StronglyAdapted ℱ I := fun t => (hI.adapted t).stronglyMeasurable
3360  have hMemLp : ∀ t, MemLp (I t) 2 P := fun t => by
3361    rcases lt_or_ge t 0 with ht | ht
3362    · have : I t = fun _ => 0 := funext fun ω => hI.zero t ht.le ω
3363      rw [this]; exact MemLp.zero'
3364    · exact hI.memLp hξ hW ht
3365  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := exists_finset_seq (A := A)
3366  refine ⟨hsa, fun i j hij => ?_⟩
3367  symm
3368  refine ae_eq_condExp_of_forall_setIntegral_eq (ℱ.le i) ((hMemLp j).integrable one_le_two)
3369    (fun s _ _ => ((hMemLp i).integrable one_le_two).integrableOn) (fun s hs _ => ?_)
3370    (hsa i).aestronglyMeasurable
3371  have hsm : MeasurableSet s := ℱ.le i s hs
3372  have h1 := tendsto_setIntegral_ItoF hξ hW hI i hsm hF
3373  have h2 := tendsto_setIntegral_ItoF hξ hW hI j hsm hF
3374  have h3 : ∀ n, ∫ ω in s, ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ (F n) i ω ∂P = ∫ ω in s, ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ (F n) j ω ∂P :=
3375    fun n => (martingale_itoIntegral (hW (F n)) (hξ.progressiveL2 (F n))).setIntegral_eq hij hs
3376  simp_rw [h3] at h1
3377  exact tendsto_nhds_unique h1 h2
3378
3379end CtblMart
3380end FragQ7

3382section FragQ8
3383open MeasureTheory Filter Topology ProbabilityTheory
3384open scoped ENNReal NNReal BigOperators
3385section CtblCond
3386open Classical
3387variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
3388  {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ} {A : Type*} [Countable A] {𝔚 : ℝ≥0 → Ω → A → ℝ} {ξ ξ' : ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ}
3389  {I I' : ℝ → Ω → ℝ}
3390
3391/-- The `L²` size of the `a`-th coordinate on `S × (s, t]`. -/
3392def cS (P : Measure Ω) (ξ : ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ) (a : A) (S : Set Ω) (s t : ℝ) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
3393  ∫⁻ ω in S, (∫⁻ r in Set.Ioc s t, ‖ξ r ω a‖ₑ ^ 2) ∂P
3394
3395lemma sqIntegralOn_restrictFun_eq {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (Φ : ℝ → Ω → ι → ℝ) {s t : ℝ}
3396    (hs : 0 ≤ s) {S : Set Ω} (hS : MeasurableSet S) :
3397    sqIntegralOn P (restrictFun Φ s t S) t =
3398      ∫⁻ ω in S, (∫⁻ r in Set.Ioc s t, ∑ k, ‖Φ r ω k‖ₑ ^ 2) ∂P := by
3399  unfold sqIntegralOn
3400  rw [← lintegral_indicator hS]
3401  refine lintegral_congr fun ω => ?_
3402  by_cases hω : ω ∈ S
3403  · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hω]
3404    have : ∀ r, ∑ k, ‖restrictFun Φ s t S r ω k‖ₑ ^ 2 =
3405        (Set.Ioc s t).indicator (fun r => ∑ k, ‖Φ r ω k‖ₑ ^ 2) r := fun r => by
3406      by_cases hr : r ∈ Set.Ioc s t <;> simp [restrictFun, hω, hr]
3407    simp_rw [this]
3408    rw [lintegral_indicator measurableSet_Ioc, Measure.restrict_restrict measurableSet_Ioc]
3409    have hI : Set.Icc 0 t ∩ Set.Ioc s t = Set.Ioc s t := by
3410      ext r
3411      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_Icc, Set.mem_Ioc]
3412      constructor
3413      · rintro ⟨_, h⟩; exact h
3414      · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩; exact ⟨⟨hs.trans h1.le, h2⟩, h1, h2⟩
3415    rw [Set.inter_comm, hI]
3416  · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hω]
3417    simp [restrictFun, hω]
3418
3419lemma lintegral_finset_sum_Ioc (hξ : ∀ a, IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => ξ r ω a)) (F : Finset A)
3420    {s t : ℝ} (hst : s ≤ t) (S : Set Ω) :
3421    ∫⁻ ω in S, (∫⁻ r in Set.Ioc s t, ∑ a ∈ F, ‖ξ r ω a‖ₑ ^ 2) ∂P =
3422      ∑ a ∈ F, cS P ξ a S s t := by
3423  have hcl : ∀ a ω, ∫⁻ r in Set.Ioc s t, ‖ξ r ω a‖ₑ ^ 2 =
3424      ∫⁻ r in Set.Ioc s t, ‖ξ (min r t) ω a‖ₑ ^ 2 := fun a ω =>
3425    setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioc fun r hr => by rw [min_eq_left hr.2]
3426  have hcl2 : ∀ ω, ∫⁻ r in Set.Ioc s t, ∑ a ∈ F, ‖ξ r ω a‖ₑ ^ 2 =
3427      ∫⁻ r in Set.Ioc s t, ∑ a ∈ F, ‖ξ (min r t) ω a‖ₑ ^ 2 := fun ω =>
3428    setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioc fun r hr => by simp only [min_eq_left hr.2]
3429  simp_rw [hcl2]
3430  have h2 : ∀ ω, ∫⁻ r in Set.Ioc s t, ∑ a ∈ F, ‖ξ (min r t) ω a‖ₑ ^ 2 =
3431      ∑ a ∈ F, ∫⁻ r in Set.Ioc s t, ‖ξ (min r t) ω a‖ₑ ^ 2 := fun ω =>
3432    lintegral_finset_sum _ fun a _ =>
3433      ((measurable_cT_integrand hξ a t).comp measurable_prodMk_right)
3434  simp_rw [h2]
3435  rw [lintegral_finset_sum]
3436  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
3437    unfold cS
3438    exact lintegral_congr fun ω => (hcl a ω).symm
3439  · intro a _
3440    exact ((measurable_cT_integrand hξ a t).comp
3441      (measurable_swap (α := Ω) (β := ℝ))).lintegral_prod_right' (ν := volume.restrict (Set.Ioc s t))
3442
3443lemma ItoF_lintegral_sub_sq (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ 𝔚) (hξ : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ)
3444    (F : Finset A) {s t : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t) {S : Set Ω} (hSm : MeasurableSet[ℱ s] S) :
3445    ∫⁻ ω in S, ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F t ω - ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F s ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P = ∑ a ∈ F, cS P ξ a S s t := by
3446  have hSm' : MeasurableSet S := ℱ.le s _ hSm
3447  have hΦ := hξ.progressiveL2 F
3448  have hM := isItoIntegral_itoIntegral (hW F) hΦ
3449  have hR := hM.restrict (hW F) hΦ hs hst hSm
3450  have h : ∫⁻ ω, ‖(if ω ∈ S then ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F (min t t) ω - ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F (min t s) ω else 0)‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P =
3451      sqIntegralOn P (restrictFun (ξF ξ F) s t S) t := hR.lintegral_sq (hW F) (hΦ.restrictFun hSm) t
3452  rw [sqIntegralOn_restrictFun_eq _ hs hSm'] at h
3453  have e1 : ∀ ω, ‖(if ω ∈ S then ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F (min t t) ω - ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F (min t s) ω else 0)‖ₑ ^ 2 =
3454      S.indicator (fun ω => ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F t ω - ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F s ω‖ₑ ^ 2) ω := fun ω => by
3455    by_cases hω : ω ∈ S <;> simp [hω, min_self, min_eq_right hst]
3456  simp_rw [e1] at h
3457  rw [lintegral_indicator hSm'] at h
3458  rw [h]
3459  have := lintegral_finset_sum_Ioc (P := P) hξ.prog F hst S
3460  rw [← this]
3461  refine lintegral_congr fun ω => ?_
3462  refine lintegral_congr fun r => ?_
3463  exact Finset.sum_coe_sort F (fun a => ‖ξ r ω a‖ₑ ^ 2)
3464
3465/-- Conditional isometry for the countable Itô integral (in `ℝ≥0∞`):
3466`E[1_S |I_t - I_s|²] = ∑_a E[1_S ∫_s^t |ξ_a|²]`, `S ∈ ℱ_s`. -/
3467theorem IsItoC.lintegral_set_sub_sq (hξ : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ) (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ 𝔚)
3468    (hI : IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 ξ I) {s t : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t) {S : Set Ω}
3469    (hSm : MeasurableSet[ℱ s] S) :
3470    ∫⁻ ω in S, ‖I t ω - I s ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P = ∑' a, cS P ξ a S s t := by
3471  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := exists_finset_seq (A := A)
3472  have hSm' : MeasurableSet S := ℱ.le s _ hSm
3473  have hts : 0 ≤ t := hs.trans hst
3474  -- `L²` convergence of the restricted differences
3475  set Dn : ℕ → Ω → ℝ := fun n ω => S.indicator (fun ω => ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ (F n) t ω - ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ (F n) s ω) ω
3476    with hDn
3477  set Dinf : Ω → ℝ := S.indicator (fun ω => I t ω - I s ω) with hDinf
3478  have hDL2 : ∀ n, MemLp (Dn n) 2 P := fun n =>
3479    (((memLp_two_itoIntegral (hW (F n)) (hξ.progressiveL2 (F n)) t).sub
3480      (memLp_two_itoIntegral (hW (F n)) (hξ.progressiveL2 (F n)) s)).indicator hSm')
3481  have hDinfL2 : MemLp Dinf 2 P := ((hI.memLp hξ hW hts).sub (hI.memLp hξ hW hs)).indicator hSm'
3482  have hconv : Tendsto (fun n => ∫⁻ ω, ‖Dn n ω - Dinf ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
3483    have h1 := (hI.approx t hts).comp hF
3484    have h2 := (hI.approx s hs).comp hF
3485    have hb : Tendsto (fun n => 2 * ∫⁻ ω, ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ (F n) t ω - I t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P +
3486        2 * ∫⁻ ω, ‖-(ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ (F n) s ω - I s ω)‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
3487      simp_rw [enorm_neg]
3488      have := (ENNReal.Tendsto.const_mul h1 (Or.inr (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ⊤))).add
3489        (ENNReal.Tendsto.const_mul h2 (Or.inr (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ⊤)))
3490      simpa using this
3491    refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds hb (fun _ => bot_le)
3492      fun n => ?_
3493    have ha := aemeasurable_ItoF (P := P) (ℱ := ℱ) (𝔚 := 𝔚) (ξ := ξ) (F n) t
3494    have hb' := aemeasurable_ItoF (P := P) (ℱ := ℱ) (𝔚 := 𝔚) (ξ := ξ) (F n) s
3495    calc ∫⁻ ω, ‖Dn n ω - Dinf ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P
3496        ≤ ∫⁻ ω, ‖(ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ (F n) t ω - I t ω) + -(ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ (F n) s ω - I s ω)‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P := by
3497          refine lintegral_mono fun ω => ?_
3498          by_cases hω : ω ∈ S
3499          · simp only [hDn, hDinf, Set.indicator_of_mem hω]
3500            refine le_of_eq ?_
3501            congr 2; ring
3502          · simp [hDn, hDinf, Set.indicator_of_notMem hω]
3503      _ ≤ _ := lintegral_enorm_sq_add_le' (ha.sub (hI.aemeasurable t)) ((hb'.sub (hI.aemeasurable s)).neg)
3504  have hlim := tendsto_lintegral_sq_of_L2 hDL2 hDinfL2 hconv
3505  have hfin : ∀ n, ∫⁻ ω, ‖Dn n ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P = ∑ a ∈ F n, cS P ξ a S s t := fun n => by
3506    rw [← ItoF_lintegral_sub_sq hW hξ (F n) hs hst hSm, ← lintegral_indicator hSm']
3507    refine lintegral_congr fun ω => ?_
3508    by_cases hω : ω ∈ S <;> simp [hDn, hω]
3509  simp_rw [hfin] at hlim
3510  have hsum : Tendsto (fun n => ∑ a ∈ F n, cS P ξ a S s t) atTop (𝓝 (∑' a, cS P ξ a S s t)) :=
3511    (ENNReal.summable.hasSum).comp hF
3512  have e : ∫⁻ ω, ‖Dinf ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P = ∫⁻ ω in S, ‖I t ω - I s ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P := by
3513    rw [← lintegral_indicator hSm']
3514    refine lintegral_congr fun ω => ?_
3515    by_cases hω : ω ∈ S <;> simp [hDinf, hω]
3516  rw [← e]
3517  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hlim hsum
3518
3519end CtblCond
3520end FragQ8
3521
3522section FragR1
3523open MeasureTheory Filter Topology ProbabilityTheory
3524open scoped ENNReal NNReal BigOperators
3525section ProdMart
3526variable {Ω₁ Ω₂ : Type*} {m₁ : MeasurableSpace Ω₁} {m₂ : MeasurableSpace Ω₂}
3527  {P₁ : Measure Ω₁} {P₂ : Measure Ω₂} [IsProbabilityMeasure P₁] [IsProbabilityMeasure P₂]
3528
3529/-- The product filtration `ℱ_t = σ(ℱ¹_t × ℱ²_t) ∨ nullSets`. -/
3530def prodFiltration (P₁ : Measure Ω₁) (P₂ : Measure Ω₂) (ℱ₁ : Filtration ℝ m₁)
3531    (ℱ₂ : Filtration ℝ m₂) : Filtration ℝ (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Ω₁ × Ω₂)) where
3532  seq t := (MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.fst (ℱ₁ t) ⊔ MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.snd (ℱ₂ t)) ⊔
3533    nullSets (P₁.prod P₂)
3534  mono' := fun s t hst => sup_le_sup_right (sup_le_sup (MeasurableSpace.comap_mono (ℱ₁.mono hst))
3535    (MeasurableSpace.comap_mono (ℱ₂.mono hst))) _
3536  le' := fun t => sup_le (sup_le ((MeasurableSpace.comap_mono (ℱ₁.le t)).trans measurable_fst.comap_le)
3537    ((MeasurableSpace.comap_mono (ℱ₂.le t)).trans measurable_snd.comap_le)) (nullSets_le _)
3538
3539lemma setIntegral_prodMul_eq {Y Y' : Ω₁ → ℝ} {Z Z' : Ω₂ → ℝ} (hY : Integrable Y P₁)
3540    (hY' : Integrable Y' P₁) (hZ : Integrable Z P₂) (hZ' : Integrable Z' P₂) {A₁ : Set Ω₁}
3541    {A₂ : Set Ω₂} (h1 : ∫ x in A₁, Y x ∂P₁ = ∫ x in A₁, Y' x ∂P₁)
3542    (h2 : ∫ x in A₂, Z x ∂P₂ = ∫ x in A₂, Z' x ∂P₂) :
3543    ∫ p in A₁ ×ˢ A₂, Y p.1 * Z p.2 ∂(P₁.prod P₂) = ∫ p in A₁ ×ˢ A₂, Y' p.1 * Z' p.2 ∂(P₁.prod P₂) := by
3544  rw [setIntegral_prod_mul, setIntegral_prod_mul, h1, h2]
3545
3546set_option warn.classDefReducibility false in
3547/-- The σ-algebra `σ(ℱ¹_s × ℱ²_s)` of the product. -/
3548def prodSigma (ℱ₁ : Filtration ℝ m₁) (ℱ₂ : Filtration ℝ m₂) (s : ℝ) : MeasurableSpace (Ω₁ × Ω₂) :=
3549  MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.fst (ℱ₁ s) ⊔ MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.snd (ℱ₂ s)
3550
3551lemma prodSigma_le (ℱ₁ : Filtration ℝ m₁) (ℱ₂ : Filtration ℝ m₂) (s : ℝ) :
3552    prodSigma ℱ₁ ℱ₂ s ≤ (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Ω₁ × Ω₂)) :=
3553  sup_le ((MeasurableSpace.comap_mono (ℱ₁.le s)).trans measurable_fst.comap_le)
3554    ((MeasurableSpace.comap_mono (ℱ₂.le s)).trans measurable_snd.comap_le)
3555
3556/-- Two integrable functions with equal integrals over all measurable rectangles of
3557`ℱ¹_s × ℱ²_s` have equal integrals over all sets of the product σ-algebra. -/
3558lemma setIntegral_eq_of_rectangles (ℱ₁ : Filtration ℝ m₁) (ℱ₂ : Filtration ℝ m₂) (s : ℝ)
3559    {f g : Ω₁ × Ω₂ → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f (P₁.prod P₂))
3560    (hg : Integrable g (P₁.prod P₂))
3561    (hrect : ∀ A₁ A₂, MeasurableSet[ℱ₁ s] A₁ → MeasurableSet[ℱ₂ s] A₂ →
3562      ∫ p in A₁ ×ˢ A₂, f p ∂(P₁.prod P₂) = ∫ p in A₁ ×ˢ A₂, g p ∂(P₁.prod P₂))
3563    {S : Set (Ω₁ × Ω₂)} (hS : MeasurableSet[prodSigma ℱ₁ ℱ₂ s] S) :
3564    ∫ p in S, f p ∂(P₁.prod P₂) = ∫ p in S, g p ∂(P₁.prod P₂) := by
3565  have h𝒟le := prodSigma_le ℱ₁ ℱ₂ s
3566  let p : Set (Set (Ω₁ × Ω₂)) :=
3567    {S | ∃ A₁ A₂, MeasurableSet[ℱ₁ s] A₁ ∧ MeasurableSet[ℱ₂ s] A₂ ∧ S = A₁ ×ˢ A₂}
3568  have hπ : IsPiSystem p := by
3569    rintro _ ⟨a, b, ha, hb, rfl⟩ _ ⟨a', b', ha', hb', rfl⟩ _
3570    exact ⟨a ∩ a', b ∩ b', @MeasurableSet.inter _ (ℱ₁ s) _ _ ha ha',
3571      @MeasurableSet.inter _ (ℱ₂ s) _ _ hb hb', by ext; simp; tauto⟩
3572  have hrectS : ∀ a b, MeasurableSet[ℱ₁ s] a → MeasurableSet[ℱ₂ s] b →
3573      MeasurableSet[prodSigma ℱ₁ ℱ₂ s] (a ×ˢ b) := by
3574    intro a b ha hb
3575    have e : a ×ˢ b = Prod.fst ⁻¹' a ∩ Prod.snd ⁻¹' b := by ext; simp
3576    rw [e]
3577    exact @MeasurableSet.inter _ (prodSigma ℱ₁ ℱ₂ s) _ _
3578      (le_sup_left (a := MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.fst (ℱ₁ s))
3579        (b := MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.snd (ℱ₂ s)) _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩)
3580      (le_sup_right (a := MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.fst (ℱ₁ s))
3581        (b := MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.snd (ℱ₂ s)) _ ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩)
3582  have hgen : prodSigma ℱ₁ ℱ₂ s = MeasurableSpace.generateFrom p := by
3583    apply le_antisymm
3584    · refine sup_le ?_ ?_
3585      · rintro _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
3586        exact MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_generateFrom ⟨a, Set.univ, ha,
3587          @MeasurableSet.univ _ (ℱ₂ s), by ext; simp⟩
3588      · rintro _ ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
3589        exact MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_generateFrom ⟨Set.univ, b,
3590          @MeasurableSet.univ _ (ℱ₁ s), hb, by ext; simp⟩
3591    · refine MeasurableSpace.generateFrom_le ?_
3592      rintro _ ⟨a, b, ha, hb, rfl⟩
3593      exact hrectS a b ha hb
3594  have htot : ∫ q, f q ∂(P₁.prod P₂) = ∫ q, g q ∂(P₁.prod P₂) := by
3595    have := hrect Set.univ Set.univ (@MeasurableSet.univ _ (ℱ₁ s)) (@MeasurableSet.univ _ (ℱ₂ s))
3596    simpa using this
3597  refine MeasurableSpace.induction_on_inter (m := prodSigma ℱ₁ ℱ₂ s)
3598    (C := fun S _ => ∫ x in S, f x ∂(P₁.prod P₂) = ∫ x in S, g x ∂(P₁.prod P₂)) hgen hπ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
3599    S hS
3600  · simp
3601  · rintro _ ⟨a, b, ha, hb, rfl⟩
3602    exact hrect a b ha hb
3603  · intro t ht h
3604    have ht' : MeasurableSet t := h𝒟le _ ht
3605    have e1 := integral_add_compl ht' hf
3606    have e2 := integral_add_compl ht' hg
3607    linarith
3608  · intro u hdisj hu h
3609    have hu' : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (u i) := fun i => h𝒟le _ (hu i)
3610    rw [integral_iUnion hu' hdisj hf.integrableOn, integral_iUnion hu' hdisj hg.integrableOn]
3611    exact tsum_congr h
3612
3613/-- The product of independent martingales (with respect to their own filtrations) is a
3614martingale for the product filtration. -/
3615theorem martingale_mul_prod (ℱ₁ : Filtration ℝ m₁) (ℱ₂ : Filtration ℝ m₂)
3616    {Y : ℝ → Ω₁ → ℝ} {Z : ℝ → Ω₂ → ℝ} (hY : Martingale Y ℱ₁ P₁) (hZ : Martingale Z ℱ₂ P₂) :
3617    Martingale (fun t (p : Ω₁ × Ω₂) => Y t p.1 * Z t p.2) (prodFiltration P₁ P₂ ℱ₁ ℱ₂)
3618      (P₁.prod P₂) := by
3619  have hint : ∀ t, Integrable (fun p : Ω₁ × Ω₂ => Y t p.1 * Z t p.2) (P₁.prod P₂) := fun t =>
3620    (hY.integrable t).mul_prod (hZ.integrable t)
3621  have hsm : ∀ t, StronglyMeasurable[prodSigma ℱ₁ ℱ₂ t]
3622      (fun p : Ω₁ × Ω₂ => Y t p.1 * Z t p.2) := fun t => by
3623    refine Measurable.stronglyMeasurable ?_
3624    have h1 : Measurable[prodSigma ℱ₁ ℱ₂ t] (fun p : Ω₁ × Ω₂ => Y t p.1) :=
3625      ((hY.1 t).measurable.comp (comap_measurable (Prod.fst : Ω₁ × Ω₂ → Ω₁))).mono le_sup_left le_rfl
3626    have h2 : Measurable[prodSigma ℱ₁ ℱ₂ t] (fun p : Ω₁ × Ω₂ => Z t p.2) :=
3627      ((hZ.1 t).measurable.comp (comap_measurable (Prod.snd : Ω₁ × Ω₂ → Ω₂))).mono le_sup_right le_rfl
3628    exact h1.mul h2
3629  refine ⟨fun t => (hsm t).mono le_sup_left, fun s r hsr => ?_⟩
3630  have e1 : (P₁.prod P₂)[fun p : Ω₁ × Ω₂ => Y r p.1 * Z r p.2 | prodFiltration P₁ P₂ ℱ₁ ℱ₂ s]
3631      =ᵐ[P₁.prod P₂] (P₁.prod P₂)[fun p : Ω₁ × Ω₂ => Y r p.1 * Z r p.2 | prodSigma ℱ₁ ℱ₂ s] :=
3632    condExp_sup_nullSets (prodSigma_le ℱ₁ ℱ₂ s) _
3633  refine e1.trans ?_
3634  symm
3635  refine ae_eq_condExp_of_forall_setIntegral_eq (prodSigma_le ℱ₁ ℱ₂ s) (hint r)
3636    (fun S _ _ => (hint s).integrableOn) (fun S hS _ => ?_) (hsm s).aestronglyMeasurable
3637  exact setIntegral_eq_of_rectangles ℱ₁ ℱ₂ s (hint s) (hint r) (fun A₁ A₂ hA₁ hA₂ =>
3638    setIntegral_prodMul_eq (hY.integrable s) (hY.integrable r) (hZ.integrable s) (hZ.integrable r)
3639      (hY.setIntegral_eq hsr hA₁) (hZ.setIntegral_eq hsr hA₂)) hS
3640
3641end ProdMart
3642end FragR1
3643
3644section FragR2
3645open MeasureTheory Filter Topology ProbabilityTheory
3646open scoped ENNReal NNReal BigOperators
3647section InfWiener
3648universe u
3649variable (ι : Type u)
3650
3651/-- The law of a family of independent Wiener sequences indexed by `ι`. -/
3652abbrev wMeasure : Measure (ι → WienerSeq) := Measure.infinitePi fun _ : ι => wienerMeasure
3653
3654set_option warn.classDefReducibility false in
3655/-- The σ-algebra generated by all coordinate paths up to time `τ`, with the null sets. -/
3656def wSigma (τ : ℝ) : MeasurableSpace (ι → WienerSeq) :=
3657  (⨆ (r : ℝ≥0) (_ : (r : ℝ) ≤ τ) (i : ι),
3658    MeasurableSpace.comap (fun ω : ι → WienerSeq => wienerPath r (ω i)) inferInstance) ⊔
3659    nullSets (wMeasure ι)
3660
3661lemma wSigma_mono {ι : Type u} {s t : ℝ} (hst : s ≤ t) : wSigma ι s ≤ wSigma ι t := by
3662  unfold wSigma
3663  refine sup_le_sup_right ?_ _
3664  refine iSup_le fun r => iSup_le fun hr => ?_
3665  exact le_iSup_of_le r (le_iSup_of_le (hr.trans hst) le_rfl)
3666
3667lemma wSigma_le {ι : Type u} (τ : ℝ) : wSigma ι τ ≤ (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (ι → WienerSeq)) := by
3668  unfold wSigma
3669  refine sup_le (iSup_le fun r => iSup_le fun _ => iSup_le fun i => ?_) (nullSets_le _)
3670  have h : Measurable fun ω : ι → WienerSeq => wienerPath r (ω i) :=
3671    (measurable_wienerPath r).comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
3672  exact h.comap_le
3673
3674/-- The filtration generated by the family of independent Wiener paths. -/
3675def wFiltration : Filtration ℝ (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (ι → WienerSeq)) where
3676  seq := wSigma ι
3677  mono' := fun _ _ hst => wSigma_mono (ι := ι) hst
3678  le' := wSigma_le (ι := ι)
3679
3680variable {ι}
3681
3682lemma wFiltration_complete : IsCompleteFiltration (wMeasure ι) (wFiltration ι) := by
3683  intro t s hs hP
3684  have h1 : MeasurableSet[nullSets (wMeasure ι)] s :=
3685    MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_generateFrom ⟨hs, hP⟩
3686  exact (le_sup_right : nullSets (wMeasure ι) ≤ wSigma ι t) s h1
3687
3688lemma comap_wCoord_le (t : ℝ≥0) (τ : ℝ) (hτ : (t : ℝ) ≤ τ) (i : ι) :
3689    MeasurableSpace.comap (fun ω : ι → WienerSeq => wienerPath t (ω i)) inferInstance ≤
3690      wFiltration ι τ :=
3691  (le_iSup_of_le t (le_iSup_of_le hτ (le_iSup (f := fun i : ι => MeasurableSpace.comap (fun ω : ι → WienerSeq => wienerPath t (ω i)) inferInstance) i)) :
3692      MeasurableSpace.comap (fun ω : ι → WienerSeq => wienerPath t (ω i)) inferInstance ≤ _).trans
3693    (le_sup_left : _ ≤ wSigma ι τ)
3694
3695lemma measurable_wCoord (t : ℝ≥0) (τ : ℝ) (hτ : (t : ℝ) ≤ τ) (i : ι) :
3696    Measurable[wFiltration ι τ] (fun ω : ι → WienerSeq => wienerPath t (ω i)) :=
3697  Measurable.of_comap_le (comap_wCoord_le t τ hτ i)
3698
3699lemma comap_fun_le {Ξ : Type*} {M : MeasurableSpace Ξ} {F : Type*} {β : F → Type*}
3700    [∀ k, MeasurableSpace (β k)] (g : Ξ → ∀ k, β k)
3701    (h : ∀ k, MeasurableSpace.comap (fun ω => g ω k) inferInstance ≤ M) :
3702    MeasurableSpace.comap g inferInstance ≤ M := by
3703  show MeasurableSpace.comap g MeasurableSpace.pi ≤ M
3704  rw [MeasurableSpace.pi, MeasurableSpace.comap_iSup, iSup_le_iff]
3705  intro k
3706  rw [MeasurableSpace.comap_comp]
3707  exact h k
3708
3709lemma comap_wienerPath_le (t : ℝ≥0) (i : ι) :
3710    MeasurableSpace.comap (fun ω : ι → WienerSeq => wienerPath t (ω i)) inferInstance ≤
3711      MeasurableSpace.comap (fun ω : ι → WienerSeq => ω i) inferInstance := by
3712  rw [show (fun ω : ι → WienerSeq => wienerPath t (ω i)) =
3713    (fun x : WienerSeq => wienerPath t x) ∘ (fun ω : ι → WienerSeq => ω i) from rfl,
3714    ← MeasurableSpace.comap_comp]
3715  exact MeasurableSpace.comap_mono (measurable_wienerPath t).comap_le
3716
3717lemma isBrownianFiltration_wFiltration (F : Finset ι) :
3718    IsBrownianFiltration (wMeasure ι) (wFiltration ι)
3719      (fun t ω (i : F) => wienerPath t (ω i)) := by
3720  classical
3721  set ν : Measure (ι → WienerSeq) := wMeasure ι with hν
3722  set W : ℝ≥0 → (ι → WienerSeq) → F → ℝ := fun t ω i => wienerPath t (ω i) with hWdef
3723  have hW : ∀ t, Measurable (W t) := fun t =>
3724    Measurable.of_eval fun i => (measurable_wienerPath t).comp ((measurable_pi_apply (i : ι)))
3725  have hW0 : ∀ ω, W 0 ω = 0 := fun ω => funext fun k => wienerPath_zero _
3726  have hWc : ∀ ω, Continuous fun t => W t ω := fun ω =>
3727    continuous_pi fun k => continuous_wienerPath _
3728  have hev : ∀ i : ι, MeasurePreserving (fun ω : ι → WienerSeq => ω i) ν wienerMeasure :=
3729    fun i => measurePreserving_eval_infinitePi (fun _ : ι => wienerMeasure) i
3730  have hB : ∀ k : F, IsBrownianReal (fun t ω => W t ω k) ν := fun k =>
3731    IsBrownianReal.comp_measurePreserving (hev k) isPreBrownianReal_wienerPath
3732      continuous_wienerPath
3733  have hpath : Measurable fun (ω : WienerSeq) (t : ℝ≥0) => wienerPath t ω :=
3734    Measurable.of_eval measurable_wienerPath
3735  have hind0 : iIndepFun (fun (i : ι) (ω : ι → WienerSeq) => fun t : ℝ≥0 => wienerPath t (ω i)) ν :=
3736    iIndepFun_infinitePi (P := fun _ : ι => wienerMeasure)
3737      (X := fun _ => fun ω t => wienerPath t ω) fun _ => hpath
3738  have hind : iIndepFun (fun (k : F) ω => fun t : ℝ≥0 => W t ω k) ν :=
3739    hind0.precomp (g := fun k : F => (k : ι)) Subtype.val_injective
3740  set X₀ : (ι → WienerSeq) → ({i // i ∉ F} → WienerSeq) := fun ω i => ω i.1 with hX₀def
3741  have hX₀ : Measurable X₀ := measurable_pi_iff.2 fun i => measurable_pi_apply i.1
3742  have hind' : iIndep (fun i : ι => MeasurableSpace.comap (fun ω : ι → WienerSeq => ω i) inferInstance) ν := by
3743    have := iIndepFun_infinitePi (P := fun _ : ι => wienerMeasure) (X := fun _ => (id : WienerSeq → WienerSeq))
3744      (fun _ => measurable_id)
3745    exact this
3746  have hX₀W : IndepFun X₀ (fun ω => fun t => W t ω) ν := by
3747    have h1 := indep_iSup_of_disjoint (fun i => (measurable_pi_apply i).comap_le) hind'
3748      (S := {i | i ∉ F}) (T := (F : Set ι)) (by
3749        rw [Set.disjoint_left]; intro a ha hb; exact ha hb)
3750    rw [IndepFun_iff_Indep]
3751    refine indep_of_indep_of_le_right (indep_of_indep_of_le_left h1 ?_) ?_
3752    · refine comap_fun_le X₀ fun k => ?_
3753      exact le_iSup₂_of_le k.1 k.2 le_rfl
3754    · refine comap_fun_le _ fun t => comap_fun_le _ fun k => ?_
3755      exact (comap_wienerPath_le t (k : ι)).trans (le_iSup₂_of_le (k : ι) k.2 le_rfl)
3756  have hG := isBrownianFiltration_generated ν W hW hB hind hW0 hWc X₀ hX₀ hX₀W
3757  refine hG.of_le_of_adapted (fun u => ?_) wFiltration_complete (fun u => ?_)
3758  · refine sup_le (iSup_le fun r => iSup_le fun hr => iSup_le fun i => ?_) le_sup_right
3759    by_cases hi : i ∈ F
3760    · refine le_trans ?_ ((le_iSup₂_of_le r hr le_rfl : MeasurableSpace.comap (W r) inferInstance ≤ _).trans
3761        (le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left))
3762      rw [show (fun ω : ι → WienerSeq => wienerPath r (ω i)) =
3763        (fun v : F → ℝ => v ⟨i, hi⟩) ∘ W r from rfl, ← MeasurableSpace.comap_comp]
3764      exact MeasurableSpace.comap_mono (measurable_pi_apply _).comap_le
3765    · refine le_trans ?_ (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left)
3766      refine (comap_wienerPath_le r i).trans ?_
3767      rw [show (fun ω : ι → WienerSeq => ω i) =
3768        (fun v : {i // i ∉ F} → WienerSeq => v ⟨i, hi⟩) ∘ X₀ from rfl, ← MeasurableSpace.comap_comp]
3769      exact MeasurableSpace.comap_mono (measurable_pi_apply _).comap_le
3770  · refine Measurable.of_comap_le (comap_fun_le _ fun k => ?_)
3771    exact comap_wCoord_le (ι := ι) u u le_rfl (k : ι)
3772end InfWiener
3773end FragR2

3775section FragR3
3776open MeasureTheory Filter Topology ProbabilityTheory
3777open scoped ENNReal NNReal BigOperators
3778section ProdBM
3779open Classical
3780
3781variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
3782  {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ} {κ : Type*} [Countable κ] {W : ℝ≥0 → Ω → κ → ℝ}
3783
3784lemma IsCylindricalBrownian.martingale_coord (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ W) (k : κ) :
3785    Martingale (fun (t : ℝ) ω => ofNNRealTime W t ω k) ℱ P := by
3786  have h := (hW {k}).martingale ⟨k, by simp⟩
3787  exact h
3788
3789lemma IsCylindricalBrownian.martingale_mul_sub (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ W) (k l : κ) :
3790    Martingale (fun (t : ℝ) ω => ofNNRealTime W t ω k * ofNNRealTime W t ω l -
3791      if k = l then max t 0 else 0) ℱ P := by
3792  by_cases hkl : k = l
3793  · subst hkl
3794    have h := (hW {k}).martingale_sq_sub ⟨k, by simp⟩
3795    simpa [sq] using h
3796  · have h := (hW {k, l}).martingale_mul (k := ⟨k, by simp⟩) (l := ⟨l, by simp⟩)
3797      (fun h => hkl (congrArg Subtype.val h))
3798    simpa [hkl] using h
3799
3800lemma IsCylindricalBrownian.measurable_coord (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ W) (t : ℝ≥0) (k : κ) :
3801    Measurable[ℱ t] (fun ω => W t ω k) := by
3802  have h := (hW {k}).adapted t
3803  exact (measurable_pi_apply (⟨k, by simp⟩ : ({k} : Finset κ))).comp h
3804
3805end ProdBM

3807section ProdBM2
3808open Classical
3809
3810variable {Ω₁ Ω₂ : Type*} {m₁ : MeasurableSpace Ω₁} {m₂ : MeasurableSpace Ω₂}
3811  {P₁ : Measure Ω₁} {P₂ : Measure Ω₂} [IsProbabilityMeasure P₁] [IsProbabilityMeasure P₂]
3812  {ℱ₁ : Filtration ℝ m₁} {ℱ₂ : Filtration ℝ m₂} {κ ι : Type*} [Countable κ] [Countable ι]
3813  {W₁ : ℝ≥0 → Ω₁ → κ → ℝ} {W₂ : ℝ≥0 → Ω₂ → ι → ℝ}
3814
3815/-- The combined family on the index set `κ ⊕ ι`. -/
3816def sumFam (W₁ : ℝ≥0 → Ω₁ → κ → ℝ) (W₂ : ℝ≥0 → Ω₂ → ι → ℝ) : ℝ≥0 → Ω₁ × Ω₂ → κ ⊕ ι → ℝ :=
3817  fun t p a => Sum.elim (fun k => W₁ t p.1 k) (fun i => W₂ t p.2 i) a
3818
3819lemma comap_fst_le_prod {f : Ω₁ → ℝ} {t : ℝ} (hf : Measurable[ℱ₁ t] f) :
3820    MeasurableSpace.comap (fun p : Ω₁ × Ω₂ => f p.1) inferInstance ≤
3821      prodFiltration P₁ P₂ ℱ₁ ℱ₂ t := by
3822  rw [show (fun p : Ω₁ × Ω₂ => f p.1) = f ∘ Prod.fst from rfl, ← MeasurableSpace.comap_comp]
3823  exact (MeasurableSpace.comap_mono hf.comap_le).trans (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left)
3824
3825lemma comap_snd_le_prod {f : Ω₂ → ℝ} {t : ℝ} (hf : Measurable[ℱ₂ t] f) :
3826    MeasurableSpace.comap (fun p : Ω₁ × Ω₂ => f p.2) inferInstance ≤
3827      prodFiltration P₁ P₂ ℱ₁ ℱ₂ t := by
3828  rw [show (fun p : Ω₁ × Ω₂ => f p.2) = f ∘ Prod.snd from rfl, ← MeasurableSpace.comap_comp]
3829  exact (MeasurableSpace.comap_mono hf.comap_le).trans (le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left)
3830
3831theorem isCylindricalBrownian_prod (h₁ : IsCylindricalBrownian P₁ ℱ₁ W₁)
3832    (h₂ : IsCylindricalBrownian P₂ ℱ₂ W₂) :
3833    IsCylindricalBrownian (P₁.prod P₂) (prodFiltration P₁ P₂ ℱ₁ ℱ₂) (sumFam W₁ W₂) := by
3834  intro s
3835  have hmart : ∀ a : κ ⊕ ι, Martingale (fun (t : ℝ) (p : Ω₁ × Ω₂) =>
3836      ofNNRealTime (sumFam W₁ W₂) t p a) (prodFiltration P₁ P₂ ℱ₁ ℱ₂) (P₁.prod P₂) := by
3837    intro a
3838    rcases a with k | i
3839    · have := martingale_mul_prod (P₁ := P₁) (P₂ := P₂) ℱ₁ ℱ₂ (h₁.martingale_coord k)
3840        (martingale_const ℱ₂ P₂ (1 : ℝ))
3841      convert this using 2 with t p
3842      simp [sumFam]
3843    · have := martingale_mul_prod (P₁ := P₁) (P₂ := P₂) ℱ₁ ℱ₂ (martingale_const ℱ₁ P₁ (1 : ℝ))
3844        (h₂.martingale_coord i)
3845      convert this using 2 with t p
3846      simp [sumFam]
3847  have hqv : ∀ a b : κ ⊕ ι, Martingale (fun (t : ℝ) (p : Ω₁ × Ω₂) =>
3848      ofNNRealTime (sumFam W₁ W₂) t p a * ofNNRealTime (sumFam W₁ W₂) t p b -
3849        if a = b then max t 0 else 0) (prodFiltration P₁ P₂ ℱ₁ ℱ₂) (P₁.prod P₂) := by
3850    intro a b
3851    rcases a with k | i <;> rcases b with l | j
3852    · have := martingale_mul_prod (P₁ := P₁) (P₂ := P₂) ℱ₁ ℱ₂ (h₁.martingale_mul_sub k l)
3853        (martingale_const ℱ₂ P₂ (1 : ℝ))
3854      convert this using 2 with t p
3855      simp [sumFam]
3856    · have := martingale_mul_prod (P₁ := P₁) (P₂ := P₂) ℱ₁ ℱ₂ (h₁.martingale_coord k)
3857        (h₂.martingale_coord j)
3858      convert this using 2 with t p
3859      simp [sumFam]
3860    · have := martingale_mul_prod (P₁ := P₁) (P₂ := P₂) ℱ₁ ℱ₂ (h₁.martingale_coord l)
3861        (h₂.martingale_coord i)
3862      convert this using 2 with t p
3863      simp [sumFam, mul_comm]
3864    · have := martingale_mul_prod (P₁ := P₁) (P₂ := P₂) ℱ₁ ℱ₂ (martingale_const ℱ₁ P₁ (1 : ℝ))
3865        (h₂.martingale_mul_sub i j)
3866      convert this using 2 with t p
3867      simp [sumFam]
3868  refine levy_characterization (P₁.prod P₂) (prodFiltration P₁ P₂ ℱ₁ ℱ₂) ?_ _ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
3869  · intro t S hS hP
3870    have h1 : MeasurableSet[nullSets (P₁.prod P₂)] S :=
3871      MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_generateFrom ⟨hS, hP⟩
3872    exact (le_sup_right : nullSets (P₁.prod P₂) ≤ prodFiltration P₁ P₂ ℱ₁ ℱ₂ t) S h1
3873  · intro t
3874    refine Measurable.of_comap_le (comap_fun_le _ fun a => ?_)
3875    rcases a with ⟨a | i, ha⟩
3876    · exact comap_fst_le_prod (h₁.measurable_coord t a)
3877    · exact comap_snd_le_prod (h₂.measurable_coord t i)
3878  · intro p
3879    funext a
3880    rcases a with ⟨a | i, ha⟩
3881    · have := congrFun ((h₁ {a}).zero p.1) ⟨a, by simp⟩
3882      simpa [sumFam] using this
3883    · have := congrFun ((h₂ {i}).zero p.2) ⟨i, by simp⟩
3884      simpa [sumFam] using this
3885  · intro p
3886    refine continuous_pi fun a => ?_
3887    rcases a with ⟨a | i, ha⟩
3888    · exact (continuous_apply (⟨a, by simp⟩ : ({a} : Finset κ))).comp ((h₁ {a}).cont p.1)
3889    · exact (continuous_apply (⟨i, by simp⟩ : ({i} : Finset ι))).comp ((h₂ {i}).cont p.2)
3890  · intro a
3891    exact hmart a.1
3892  · intro a b
3893    have := hqv a.1 b.1
3894    convert this using 3
3895    by_cases hab : a = b
3896    · rw [if_pos hab, if_pos (congrArg Subtype.val hab)]; rfl
3897    · rw [if_neg hab, if_neg (fun h => hab (Subtype.ext h))]; rfl
3898
3899end ProdBM2
3900end FragR3

3902section FragR4
3903open MeasureTheory Filter Topology ProbabilityTheory

3906open Classical
3907variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ}
3908  {A : Type*} {ξ ξ' : ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ}

3910lemma measurable_inner_Ioc (hξ : ∀ a, IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => ξ r ω a)) (a : A) (s t : ℝ) :
3911    Measurable (fun ω => ∫⁻ r in Set.Ioc s t, ‖ξ r ω a‖ₑ ^ 2) := by
3912  have h := ((measurable_cT_integrand hξ a t).comp
3913    (measurable_swap (α := Ω) (β := ℝ))).lintegral_prod_right' (ν := volume.restrict (Set.Ioc s t))
3914  have e : (fun ω => ∫⁻ r in Set.Ioc s t, ‖ξ r ω a‖ₑ ^ 2) =
3915      fun ω => ∫⁻ r in Set.Ioc s t, ‖ξ (min r t) ω a‖ₑ ^ 2 := by
3916    funext ω
3917    exact setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioc fun r hr => by rw [min_eq_left hr.2]
3918  rw [e]
3919  exact h
3920
3921lemma measurable_inner_Icc (hξ : ∀ a, IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => ξ r ω a)) (a : A) (T : ℝ) :
3922    Measurable (fun ω => ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 T, ‖ξ r ω a‖ₑ ^ 2) := by
3923  have h := ((measurable_cT_integrand hξ a T).comp
3924    (measurable_swap (α := Ω) (β := ℝ))).lintegral_prod_right' (ν := volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 T))
3925  have e : (fun ω => ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 T, ‖ξ r ω a‖ₑ ^ 2) =
3926      fun ω => ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 T, ‖ξ (min r T) ω a‖ₑ ^ 2 := by
3927    funext ω
3928    exact setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Icc fun r hr => by rw [min_eq_left hr.2]
3929  rw [e]
3930  exact h
3931
3932lemma measurable_slice_enorm_sq (hξ : ∀ a, IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => ξ r ω a)) (a : A) (ω : Ω) :
3933    Measurable (fun r => ‖ξ r ω a‖ₑ ^ 2) :=
3934  (measurable_slice (hξ a) ω).enorm.pow_const 2
3935
3936lemma cT_add_le (hξ : ∀ a, IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => ξ r ω a))
3937    (hξ' : ∀ a, IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => ξ' r ω a)) (a : A) (T : ℝ) :
3938    cT P (fun r ω a => ξ r ω a + ξ' r ω a) a T ≤ 2 * cT P ξ a T + 2 * cT P ξ' a T := by
3939  unfold cT
3940  have hm := measurable_inner_Icc hξ a T
3941  have hm' := measurable_inner_Icc hξ' a T
3942  calc ∫⁻ ω, (∫⁻ s in Set.Icc 0 T, ‖ξ s ω a + ξ' s ω a‖ₑ ^ 2) ∂P
3943      ≤ ∫⁻ ω, (2 * (∫⁻ s in Set.Icc 0 T, ‖ξ s ω a‖ₑ ^ 2) + 2 * (∫⁻ s in Set.Icc 0 T, ‖ξ' s ω a‖ₑ ^ 2)) ∂P := by
3944        refine lintegral_mono fun ω => ?_
3945        calc ∫⁻ s in Set.Icc 0 T, ‖ξ s ω a + ξ' s ω a‖ₑ ^ 2
3946            ≤ ∫⁻ s in Set.Icc 0 T, (2 * ‖ξ s ω a‖ₑ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖ξ' s ω a‖ₑ ^ 2) :=
3947              lintegral_mono fun s => enorm_add_sq_le _ _
3948          _ = _ := by
3949              rw [lintegral_add_left ((measurable_slice_enorm_sq hξ a ω).const_mul 2),
3950                lintegral_const_mul _ (measurable_slice_enorm_sq hξ a ω),
3951                lintegral_const_mul _ (measurable_slice_enorm_sq hξ' a ω)]
3952    _ = _ := by
3953        rw [lintegral_add_left (hm.const_mul 2), lintegral_const_mul _ hm,
3954          lintegral_const_mul _ hm']
3955
3956lemma IsCtbl.add (hξ : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ) (hξ' : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ') :
3957    IsCtbl P ℱ (fun r ω a => ξ r ω a + ξ' r ω a) := by
3958  refine ⟨fun a => (hξ.prog a).add (hξ'.prog a), fun T => ?_⟩
3959  refine ne_top_of_le_ne_top (b := ∑' a, (2 * cT P ξ a T + 2 * cT P ξ' a T)) ?_
3960    (ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun a => cT_add_le hξ.prog hξ'.prog a T)
3961  rw [ENNReal.tsum_add, ENNReal.tsum_mul_left, ENNReal.tsum_mul_left]
3962  exact ENNReal.add_ne_top.2 ⟨ENNReal.mul_ne_top (by norm_num) (hξ.sq T),
3963    ENNReal.mul_ne_top (by norm_num) (hξ'.sq T)⟩
3964
3965lemma IsCtbl.mul_bdd (hξ : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ) {w : ℝ → Ω → ℝ} (hw : IsProgressive ℱ w) {C : ℝ}
3966    (hC : ∀ r ω, |w r ω| ≤ C) : IsCtbl P ℱ (fun r ω a => w r ω * ξ r ω a) := by
3967  refine ⟨fun a => hw.mul (hξ.prog a), fun T => ?_⟩
3968  have hle : ∀ a, cT P (fun r ω a => w r ω * ξ r ω a) a T ≤ ‖C‖ₑ ^ 2 * cT P ξ a T := by
3969    intro a
3970    unfold cT
3971    rw [← lintegral_const_mul' _ _ (by simp)]
3972    refine lintegral_mono fun ω => ?_
3973    rw [← lintegral_const_mul _ (measurable_slice_enorm_sq hξ.prog a ω)]
3974    refine lintegral_mono fun s => ?_
3975    rw [enorm_mul, mul_pow]
3976    gcongr
3977    rw [← ofReal_norm, ← ofReal_norm]
3978    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by simpa using (hC s ω).trans (le_abs_self C))
3979  refine ne_top_of_le_ne_top (b := ∑' a, ‖C‖ₑ ^ 2 * cT P ξ a T) ?_ (ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum hle)
3980  rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_left]
3981  exact ENNReal.mul_ne_top (by simp) (hξ.sq T)
3982
3983lemma tsum_cS_eq [Countable A] (hξ : ∀ a, IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => ξ r ω a)) {S : Set Ω}
3984    (s t : ℝ) :
3985    ∑' a, cS P ξ a S s t = ∫⁻ ω in S, (∫⁻ r in Set.Ioc s t, ∑' a, ‖ξ r ω a‖ₑ ^ 2) ∂P := by
3986  unfold cS
3987  rw [← lintegral_tsum (fun a => (measurable_inner_Ioc hξ a s t).aemeasurable)]
3988  refine lintegral_congr fun ω => ?_
3989  rw [← lintegral_tsum (fun a => (measurable_slice_enorm_sq hξ a ω).aemeasurable)]
3990
3991lemma measurable_inner_set (hξ : ∀ a, IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => ξ r ω a)) (a : A) {R : Set ℝ}
3992    (hR : MeasurableSet R) {T : ℝ} (hRT : R ⊆ Set.Iic T) :
3993    Measurable (fun ω => ∫⁻ r in R, ‖ξ r ω a‖ₑ ^ 2) := by
3994  have h := ((measurable_cT_integrand hξ a T).comp
3995    (measurable_swap (α := Ω) (β := ℝ))).lintegral_prod_right' (ν := volume.restrict R)
3996  have e : (fun ω => ∫⁻ r in R, ‖ξ r ω a‖ₑ ^ 2) =
3997      fun ω => ∫⁻ r in R, ‖ξ (min r T) ω a‖ₑ ^ 2 := by
3998    funext ω
3999    exact setLIntegral_congr_fun hR fun r hr => by rw [min_eq_left (hRT hr)]
4000  rw [e]
4001  exact h
4002
4003lemma tsum_lintegral_set_eq [Countable A] (hξ : ∀ a, IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => ξ r ω a))
4004    {S : Set Ω} {R : Set ℝ} (hR : MeasurableSet R) {T : ℝ} (hRT : R ⊆ Set.Iic T) :
4005    ∑' a, ∫⁻ ω in S, (∫⁻ r in R, ‖ξ r ω a‖ₑ ^ 2) ∂P =
4006      ∫⁻ ω in S, (∫⁻ r in R, ∑' a, ‖ξ r ω a‖ₑ ^ 2) ∂P := by
4007  rw [← lintegral_tsum (fun a => (measurable_inner_set hξ a hR hRT).aemeasurable)]
4008  refine lintegral_congr fun ω => ?_
4009  rw [← lintegral_tsum (fun a => (measurable_slice_enorm_sq hξ a ω).aemeasurable)]
4010
4011lemma enorm_tsum_sq_of_hasSum {f : A → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (h : HasSum (fun a => f a ^ 2) c) :
4012    ∑' a, ‖f a‖ₑ ^ 2 = ENNReal.ofReal c := by
4013  have h0 : 0 ≤ c := h.nonneg fun a => sq_nonneg _
4014  rw [← h.tsum_eq, ENNReal.ofReal_tsum_of_nonneg (fun a => sq_nonneg _) h.summable]
4015  exact tsum_congr fun a => (enorm_sq_eq_ofReal _)
4016
4017lemma lintegral_ofReal_ne_top [IsProbabilityMeasure P] [Countable A] (hξ : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ) {g : ℝ → ℝ}
4018    (hg : ∀ r ω, ∑' a, ‖ξ r ω a‖ₑ ^ 2 = ENNReal.ofReal (g r)) (T : ℝ) :
4019    ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 T, ENNReal.ofReal (g r) ≠ ⊤ := by
4020  have h := hξ.sq T
4021  unfold cT at h
4022  have e := tsum_lintegral_set_eq (S := Set.univ) (P := P) hξ.prog measurableSet_Icc
4023    (fun r hr => hr.2 : Set.Icc 0 T ⊆ Set.Iic T)
4024  simp only [Measure.restrict_univ] at e
4025  rw [e] at h
4026  simpa [hg] using h
