4030section SqMart
4031open Classical
4032variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
4033  {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ} {A : Type*} [Countable A] {𝔚 : ℝ≥0 → Ω → A → ℝ} {ξ ξ' : ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ}
4034  {I I' : ℝ → Ω → ℝ}
4035
4036/-- The deterministic bracket `∫_0^t g`. -/
4037def Gint (g : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ := (∫⁻ r in Set.Ioc 0 t, ENNReal.ofReal (g r)).toReal
4038
4039lemma Gint_of_nonpos (g : ℝ → ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≤ 0) : Gint g t = 0 := by
4040  simp [Gint, Set.Ioc_eq_empty (not_lt.2 ht)]
4041
4042lemma Gint_sub {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hfin : ∀ T, ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 T, ENNReal.ofReal (g r) ≠ ⊤) {s t : ℝ}
4043    (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t) :
4044    Gint g t - Gint g s = (∫⁻ r in Set.Ioc s t, ENNReal.ofReal (g r)).toReal := by
4045  have hsplit : (∫⁻ r in Set.Ioc 0 t, ENNReal.ofReal (g r)) =
4046      (∫⁻ r in Set.Ioc 0 s, ENNReal.ofReal (g r)) + (∫⁻ r in Set.Ioc s t, ENNReal.ofReal (g r)) := by
4047    rw [← Set.Ioc_union_Ioc_eq_Ioc hs hst, lintegral_union measurableSet_Ioc
4048      (Set.Ioc_disjoint_Ioc_of_le le_rfl)]
4049  have h1 : ∫⁻ r in Set.Ioc 0 s, ENNReal.ofReal (g r) ≠ ⊤ :=
4050    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (hfin t) (lintegral_mono_set (fun r hr => ⟨hr.1.le, hr.2.trans hst⟩))
4051  have h2 : ∫⁻ r in Set.Ioc s t, ENNReal.ofReal (g r) ≠ ⊤ :=
4052    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (hfin t) (lintegral_mono_set (fun r hr => ⟨hs.trans hr.1.le, hr.2⟩))
4053  unfold Gint
4054  rw [hsplit, ENNReal.toReal_add h1 h2]
4055  ring
4056
4057theorem IsItoC.martingale_sq_sub (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ 𝔚) (hξ : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ)
4058    (hI : IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 ξ I) {g : ℝ → ℝ}
4059    (hg : ∀ r ω, ∑' a, ‖ξ r ω a‖ₑ ^ 2 = ENNReal.ofReal (g r)) :
4060    Martingale (fun t ω => I t ω ^ 2 - Gint g t) ℱ P := by
4061  have hfin := lintegral_ofReal_ne_top hξ hg
4062  have hM := hI.martingale hξ hW
4063  have hM2 : ∀ t, MemLp (I t) 2 P := fun t => by
4064    rcases le_or_gt 0 t with ht | ht
4065    · exact hI.memLp hξ hW ht
4066    · have : I t = fun _ => 0 := funext fun ω => hI.zero t ht.le ω
4067      rw [this]; exact MemLp.zero
4068  refine martingale_sq_sub_aux (A := fun t _ => Gint g t) hM hM2
4069    (fun t => measurable_const) (fun t => integrable_const _)
4070    (fun t ht ω => by simp [hI.zero t ht ω, Gint_of_nonpos g ht]) ?_
4071  intro s t hs hst
4072  have hc : P[fun ω => Gint g t - Gint g s | ℱ s] = fun _ => Gint g t - Gint g s :=
4073    condExp_const (ℱ.le s) _
4074  rw [hc]
4075  symm
4076  refine ae_eq_condExp_of_forall_setIntegral_eq (ℱ.le s)
4077    (((hM2 t).sub (hM2 s)).integrable_sq) (fun S _ _ => integrable_const _ |>.integrableOn)
4078    (fun S hS _ => ?_) (aestronglyMeasurable_const)
4079  have hSm : MeasurableSet S := ℱ.le s S hS
4080  have h1 := hI.lintegral_set_sub_sq hξ hW hs hst hS
4081  rw [tsum_cS_eq hξ.prog (S := S) s t] at h1
4082  have e2 : ∫⁻ ω in S, (∫⁻ r in Set.Ioc s t, ∑' a, ‖ξ r ω a‖ₑ ^ 2) ∂P =
4083      P S * ∫⁻ r in Set.Ioc s t, ENNReal.ofReal (g r) := by
4084    simp_rw [hg]
4085    rw [lintegral_const, Measure.restrict_apply_univ]
4086    ring
4087  rw [e2] at h1
4088  rw [setIntegral_const, Gint_sub hfin hs hst]
4089  have hnn : 0 ≤ᵐ[P.restrict S] fun ω => (I t ω - I s ω) ^ 2 := Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => sq_nonneg _
4090  rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae hnn
4091    (((hM2 t).sub (hM2 s)).integrable_sq.aestronglyMeasurable.restrict)]
4092  have e3 : ∫⁻ ω in S, ENNReal.ofReal ((I t ω - I s ω) ^ 2) ∂P =
4093      ∫⁻ ω in S, ‖I t ω - I s ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P :=
4094    lintegral_congr fun ω => (enorm_sq_eq_ofReal _).symm
4095  rw [e3, h1, ENNReal.toReal_mul]
4096  simp [Measure.real, smul_eq_mul]
4097
4098lemma Gint_const {k : ℝ} (hk : 0 ≤ k) (t : ℝ) : Gint (fun _ => k) t = k * max t 0 := by
4099  unfold Gint
4100  rw [lintegral_const, Measure.restrict_apply_univ, Real.volume_Ioc, ENNReal.toReal_mul,
4101    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hk, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal']
4102  simp [sub_zero]
4103
4104theorem IsItoC.martingale_mul_sub_const (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ 𝔚) (hξ : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ)
4105    (hξ' : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ') (hI : IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 ξ I) (hI' : IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 ξ' I') {c : ℝ}
4106    (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c ≤ 1)
4107    (h1 : ∀ r ω, HasSum (fun a => ξ r ω a ^ 2) 1) (h2 : ∀ r ω, HasSum (fun a => ξ' r ω a ^ 2) 1)
4108    (h3 : ∀ r ω, HasSum (fun a => ξ r ω a * ξ' r ω a) c) :
4109    Martingale (fun t ω => I t ω * I' t ω - c * max t 0) ℱ P := by
4110  have hp := (hI.add hW hξ hξ' hI')
4111  have hm := (hI.sub hW hξ hξ' hI')
4112  have hpC := hξ.add hξ'
4113  have hmC : IsCtbl P ℱ (fun r ω a => ξ r ω a - ξ' r ω a) := by
4114    have := hξ.add (hξ'.mul_bdd (w := fun _ _ => (-1 : ℝ)) (isProgressive_const ℱ _) (C := 1)
4115      (fun _ _ => by simp))
4116    convert this using 3 with r ω a
4117    ring
4118  have hsp : ∀ r ω, HasSum (fun a => (ξ r ω a + ξ' r ω a) ^ 2) (2 + 2 * c) := fun r ω => by
4119    have := ((h1 r ω).add (h2 r ω)).add ((h3 r ω).mul_left 2)
4120    convert this using 1
4121    · funext a; ring
4122    · ring
4123  have hsm : ∀ r ω, HasSum (fun a => (ξ r ω a - ξ' r ω a) ^ 2) (2 - 2 * c) := fun r ω => by
4124    have := ((h1 r ω).add (h2 r ω)).sub ((h3 r ω).mul_left 2)
4125    convert this using 1
4126    · funext a; ring
4127    · ring
4128  have Mp := hp.martingale_sq_sub hW hpC (g := fun _ => 2 + 2 * c)
4129    (fun r ω => enorm_tsum_sq_of_hasSum (hsp r ω))
4130  have Mm := hm.martingale_sq_sub hW hmC (g := fun _ => 2 - 2 * c)
4131    (fun r ω => enorm_tsum_sq_of_hasSum (hsm r ω))
4132  have key := (Mp.sub Mm).smul (1 / 4 : ℝ)
4133  convert key using 1
4134  funext t ω
4135  simp only [Gint_const (by linarith : 0 ≤ 2 + 2 * c), Gint_const (by linarith : 0 ≤ 2 - 2 * c),
4136    Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
4137  ring
4138
4139end SqMart
4140end FragR4

4142section FragR5
4143open MeasureTheory Filter Topology ProbabilityTheory
4144open scoped ENNReal NNReal BigOperators
4145section Block
4146open Classical
4147variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
4148  {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ} {A : Type*} [Countable A] {𝔚 : ℝ≥0 → Ω → A → ℝ} {ξ ξ' : ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ}
4149  {I I' : ℝ → Ω → ℝ}
4150
4151lemma isProgressive_block {a a' : ℝ} {c : Ω → ℝ} (hc : Measurable[ℱ a] c) :
4152    IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => c ω * (Set.Ioc a a').indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) r) := by
4153  intro i
4154  letI : MeasurableSpace (Set.Iic i × Ω) := Subtype.instMeasurableSpace.prod (ℱ i)
4155  by_cases hai : a ≤ i
4156  · have h1 : Measurable fun p : Set.Iic i × Ω => c p.2 :=
4157      (hc.mono (ℱ.mono hai) le_rfl).comp measurable_snd
4158    have h2 : Measurable fun p : Set.Iic i × Ω => (Set.Ioc a a').indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (p.1 : ℝ) :=
4159      (measurable_const.indicator measurableSet_Ioc).comp (measurable_subtype_coe.comp measurable_fst)
4160    exact h1.mul h2
4161  · have : (fun p : Set.Iic i × Ω => c p.2 * (Set.Ioc a a').indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (p.1 : ℝ)) =
4162        fun _ => 0 := by
4163      funext p
4164      have : (p.1 : ℝ) ∉ Set.Ioc a a' := fun h => hai (h.1.le.trans p.1.2)
4165      simp [this]
4166    show Measurable fun p : Set.Iic i × Ω => c p.2 * (Set.Ioc a a').indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (p.1 : ℝ)
4167    rw [this]
4168    exact measurable_const
4169
4170lemma block_eq (c : Ω → ℝ) (a a' : ℝ) (ξ : ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) (b : A) :
4171    c ω * (Set.Ioc a a').indicator (fun _ => ξ r ω b) r =
4172      (c ω * (Set.Ioc a a').indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) r) * ξ r ω b := by
4173  by_cases h : r ∈ Set.Ioc a a' <;> simp [h]
4174
4175theorem IsCtbl.block (hξ : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ) {a a' : ℝ} {c : Ω → ℝ} (hc : Measurable[ℱ a] c) {C : ℝ}
4176    (hC : ∀ ω, |c ω| ≤ C) :
4177    IsCtbl P ℱ (fun r ω b => c ω * (Set.Ioc a a').indicator (fun _ => ξ r ω b) r) := by
4178  have := hξ.mul_bdd (isProgressive_block (a' := a') hc) (C := |C|) (fun r ω => by
4179    by_cases h : r ∈ Set.Ioc a a'
4180    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem h]
4181      simpa using (hC ω).trans (le_abs_self C)
4182    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem h]
4183      simp)
4184  have e : (fun r ω b => c ω * (Set.Ioc a a').indicator (fun _ => ξ r ω b) r) =
4185      fun r ω b => (c ω * (Set.Ioc a a').indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) r) * ξ r ω b := by
4186    funext r ω b
4187    exact block_eq c a a' ξ r ω b
4188  rw [e]
4189  exact this
4190
4191theorem IsItoC.block (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ 𝔚) (hξ : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ)
4192    (hI : IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 ξ I) {a a' : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (haa' : a ≤ a') {c : Ω → ℝ}
4193    (hc : Measurable[ℱ a] c) {C : ℝ} (hC : ∀ ω, |c ω| ≤ C) :
4194    IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 (fun r ω b => c ω * (Set.Ioc a a').indicator (fun _ => ξ r ω b) r)
4195      (fun t ω => c ω * (I (min t a') ω - I (min t a) ω)) := by
4196  refine ⟨fun ω => continuous_const.mul (((hI.cont ω).comp (continuous_id.min continuous_const)).sub
4197      ((hI.cont ω).comp (continuous_id.min continuous_const))), fun t => ?_,
4198    fun t ht ω => by simp [hI.zero _ ((min_le_left _ _).trans ht), hI.zero _ ((min_le_left _ _).trans ht)],
4199    fun t ht => ?_⟩
4200  · by_cases hat : a ≤ t
4201    · have h1 : Measurable[ℱ t] c := hc.mono (ℱ.mono hat) le_rfl
4202      have h2 : Measurable[ℱ t] (I (min t a')) :=
4203        (hI.adapted (min t a')).mono (ℱ.mono (min_le_left _ _)) le_rfl
4204      have h3 : Measurable[ℱ t] (I (min t a)) :=
4205        (hI.adapted (min t a)).mono (ℱ.mono (min_le_left _ _)) le_rfl
4206      exact h1.mul (h2.sub h3)
4207    · have : (fun ω => c ω * (I (min t a') ω - I (min t a) ω)) = fun _ => 0 := by
4208        funext ω
4209        have e1 : min t a' = t := min_eq_left (by linarith [not_le.1 hat])
4210        have e2 : min t a = t := min_eq_left (not_le.1 hat).le
4211        rw [e1, e2]; simp
4212      show Measurable[ℱ t] fun ω => c ω * (I (min t a') ω - I (min t a) ω)
4213      rw [this]; exact measurable_const
4214  · set u' := min t a' with hu'
4215    set u := min t a with hu
4216    have hu'0 : 0 ≤ u' := le_min ht (ha.trans haa')
4217    have hu0 : 0 ≤ u := le_min ht ha
4218    have h1 := hI.approx u' hu'0
4219    have h2 := hI.approx u hu0
4220    have hb : Tendsto (fun F : Finset A => ‖C‖ₑ ^ 2 * (2 * ∫⁻ ω, ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F u' ω - I u' ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P +
4221        2 * ∫⁻ ω, ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F u ω - I u ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
4222      have := ENNReal.Tendsto.const_mul
4223        ((ENNReal.Tendsto.const_mul h1 (Or.inr (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ⊤))).add
4224          (ENNReal.Tendsto.const_mul h2 (Or.inr (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ⊤)))) (Or.inr (by simp : ‖C‖ₑ ^ 2 ≠ ⊤))
4225      simpa using this
4226    refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds hb (fun _ => bot_le) fun F => ?_
4227    have hae := itoIntegral_blockInt (hW F) (hξ.progressiveL2 F) ha haa' hc hC t
4228    have hF1 := aemeasurable_ItoF (P := P) (ℱ := ℱ) (𝔚 := 𝔚) (ξ := ξ) F u'
4229    have hF2 := aemeasurable_ItoF (P := P) (ℱ := ℱ) (𝔚 := 𝔚) (ξ := ξ) F u
4230    have hD1 : AEMeasurable (fun ω => ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F u' ω - I u' ω) P :=
4231      hF1.sub (hI.aemeasurable u')
4232    have hD2 : AEMeasurable (fun ω => ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F u ω - I u ω) P :=
4233      hF2.sub (hI.aemeasurable u)
4234    calc ∫⁻ ω, ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 (fun r ω b => c ω * (Set.Ioc a a').indicator (fun _ => ξ r ω b) r) F t ω -
4235            c ω * (I u' ω - I u ω)‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P
4236        = ∫⁻ ω, ‖c ω‖ₑ ^ 2 * ‖(ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F u' ω - I u' ω) + -(ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F u ω - I u ω)‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P := by
4237          refine lintegral_congr_ae ?_
4238          filter_upwards [hae] with ω hω
4239          have : ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 (fun r ω b => c ω * (Set.Ioc a a').indicator (fun _ => ξ r ω b) r) F t ω =
4240              c ω * (ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F u' ω - ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F u ω) := hω
4241          have e : c ω * (ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F u' ω - ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F u ω) - c ω * (I u' ω - I u ω) =
4242              c ω * ((ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F u' ω - I u' ω) + -(ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F u ω - I u ω)) := by ring
4243          rw [this, e, enorm_mul, mul_pow]
4244      _ ≤ ∫⁻ ω, ‖C‖ₑ ^ 2 * (2 * ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F u' ω - I u' ω‖ₑ ^ 2 +
4245            2 * ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F u ω - I u ω‖ₑ ^ 2) ∂P := by
4246          refine lintegral_mono fun ω => ?_
4247          have hcc : ‖c ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ‖C‖ₑ ^ 2 := by
4248            gcongr
4249            rw [← ofReal_norm, ← ofReal_norm]
4250            exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by simpa using (hC ω).trans (le_abs_self C))
4251          have hs := enorm_add_sq_le (ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F u' ω - I u' ω) (-(ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F u ω - I u ω))
4252          rw [enorm_neg] at hs
4253          exact mul_le_mul' hcc hs
4254      _ = _ := by
4255          have hA1 : AEMeasurable (fun ω => 2 * ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F u' ω - I u' ω‖ₑ ^ 2) P :=
4256            (hD1.enorm.pow_const 2).const_mul 2
4257          rw [lintegral_const_mul' _ _ (by simp),
4258            lintegral_add_left' hA1 (fun ω => 2 * ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 ξ F u ω - I u ω‖ₑ ^ 2),
4259            lintegral_const_mul'' _ (hD1.enorm.pow_const 2), lintegral_const_mul'' _ (hD2.enorm.pow_const 2)]
4260
4261end Block
4262end FragR5

4264section FragR6
4265open MeasureTheory Filter Topology ProbabilityTheory
4266open scoped ENNReal NNReal BigOperators
4267section ElemInt
4268open Classical
4269variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
4270  {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ} {A : Type*} [Countable A] {𝔚 : ℝ≥0 → Ω → A → ℝ} {ξ ξ' : ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ}
4271  {I I' : ℝ → Ω → ℝ}
4272
4273lemma isCtbl_zero : IsCtbl P ℱ (fun (_ : ℝ) (_ : Ω) (_ : A) => (0 : ℝ)) := by
4274  refine ⟨fun a => isProgressive_const ℱ (0 : ℝ), fun T => ?_⟩
4275  simp [cT]
4276
4277theorem isItoC_zero (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ 𝔚) :
4278    IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 (fun (_ : ℝ) (_ : Ω) (_ : A) => (0 : ℝ)) (fun _ _ => 0) := by
4279  refine ⟨fun ω => continuous_const, fun t => measurable_const, fun t _ ω => rfl, fun t ht => ?_⟩
4280  have : ∀ F : Finset A, ∫⁻ ω, ‖ItoF P ℱ 𝔚 (fun (_ : ℝ) (_ : Ω) (_ : A) => (0 : ℝ)) F t ω - 0‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P = 0 := by
4281    intro F
4282    simp only [sub_zero]
4283    have := lintegral_itoIntegral_sq (hW F) ((isCtbl_zero (P := P) (ℱ := ℱ) (A := A)).progressiveL2 F) t
4284    simp only [ItoF]
4285    refine (this.trans ?_ : _ = _)
4286    simp [sqIntegralOn, ξF]
4287  simp_rw [this]
4288  exact tendsto_const_nhds
4289
4290theorem IsItoC.finset_sum (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ 𝔚) {γ : Type*} (S : Finset γ)
4291    (ξs : γ → ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ) (Is : γ → ℝ → Ω → ℝ) (hξ : ∀ c ∈ S, IsCtbl P ℱ (ξs c))
4292    (hI : ∀ c ∈ S, IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 (ξs c) (Is c)) :
4293    IsCtbl P ℱ (fun r ω a => ∑ c ∈ S, ξs c r ω a) ∧
4294      IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 (fun r ω a => ∑ c ∈ S, ξs c r ω a) (fun t ω => ∑ c ∈ S, Is c t ω) := by
4295  induction S using Finset.induction_on with
4296  | empty => exact ⟨by simpa using isCtbl_zero, by simpa using isItoC_zero hW⟩
4297  | insert c S hc ih =>
4298    obtain ⟨ih1, ih2⟩ := ih (fun d hd => hξ d (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hd))
4299      (fun d hd => hI d (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hd))
4300    have h1 := hξ c (Finset.mem_insert_self c S)
4301    have h2 := hI c (Finset.mem_insert_self c S)
4302    have e1 : (fun r ω a => ∑ d ∈ insert c S, ξs d r ω a) =
4303        fun r ω a => ξs c r ω a + ∑ d ∈ S, ξs d r ω a := by
4304      funext r ω a; rw [Finset.sum_insert hc]
4305    have e2 : (fun t ω => ∑ d ∈ insert c S, Is d t ω) =
4306        fun t ω => Is c t ω + ∑ d ∈ S, Is d t ω := by
4307      funext t ω; rw [Finset.sum_insert hc]
4308    rw [e1, e2]
4309    exact ⟨h1.add ih1, h2.add hW h1 ih1 ih2⟩
4310
4311lemma IsItoC.coe_toNNReal (hI : IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 ξ I) (x : ℝ) :
4312    I ((Real.toNNReal x : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) = I x := by
4313  rcases le_or_gt x 0 with hx | hx
4314  · rw [Real.toNNReal_of_nonpos hx]
4315    simp only [NNReal.coe_zero]
4316    funext ω
4317    rw [hI.zero 0 le_rfl ω, hI.zero x hx ω]
4318  · rw [Real.coe_toNNReal x hx.le]
4319
4320theorem isItoC_elem (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ 𝔚) {J : Type*} [Fintype J]
4321    (ψ : J → ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ) (Bj : J → ℝ → Ω → ℝ) (hψ : ∀ j, IsCtbl P ℱ (ψ j))
4322    (hB : ∀ j, IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 (ψ j) (Bj j)) (Ξ : SimpleIntegrand ℱ J) :
4323    IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 (fun r ω a => ∑ j, Ξ.toFun r ω j * ψ j r ω a)
4324      (Ξ.elemIntegral (fun t ω j => Bj j (t : ℝ) ω)) := by
4325  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := Ξ.bdd
4326  have ht0 : ∀ i : Fin Ξ.n, 0 ≤ Ξ.t i.castSucc := fun i =>
4327    Ξ.nonneg.trans (Ξ.mono (Fin.zero_le _))
4328  have hmono : ∀ i : Fin Ξ.n, Ξ.t i.castSucc ≤ Ξ.t i.succ := fun i =>
4329    Ξ.mono (Fin.castSucc_le_succ i)
4330  have key := IsItoC.finset_sum hW (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin Ξ.n × J))
4331    (fun p r ω a => Ξ.ξ p.1 ω p.2 * (Set.Ioc (Ξ.t p.1.castSucc) (Ξ.t p.1.succ)).indicator
4332      (fun _ => ψ p.2 r ω a) r)
4333    (fun p t ω => Ξ.ξ p.1 ω p.2 * (Bj p.2 (min t (Ξ.t p.1.succ)) ω -
4334      Bj p.2 (min t (Ξ.t p.1.castSucc)) ω))
4335    (fun p _ => (hψ p.2).block (a := Ξ.t p.1.castSucc) (a' := Ξ.t p.1.succ)
4336      (c := fun ω => Ξ.ξ p.1 ω p.2) ((measurable_pi_apply p.2).comp (Ξ.meas p.1)) (C := C)
4337      (fun ω => hC p.1 ω p.2))
4338    (fun p _ => (hB p.2).block hW (hψ p.2) (ht0 p.1) (hmono p.1)
4339      ((measurable_pi_apply p.2).comp (Ξ.meas p.1)) (C := C) (fun ω => hC p.1 ω p.2))
4340  have e1 : (fun r ω a => ∑ j, Ξ.toFun r ω j * ψ j r ω a) =
4341      fun r ω a => ∑ p ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin Ξ.n × J)), Ξ.ξ p.1 ω p.2 *
4342        (Set.Ioc (Ξ.t p.1.castSucc) (Ξ.t p.1.succ)).indicator (fun _ => ψ p.2 r ω a) r := by
4343    funext r ω a
4344    simp only [SimpleIntegrand.toFun, Finset.sum_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
4345    rw [Finset.univ_product_univ.symm, Finset.sum_product_right]
4346    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
4347    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
4348    by_cases h : r ∈ Set.Ioc (Ξ.t i.castSucc) (Ξ.t i.succ) <;> simp [h]
4349  have e2 : Ξ.elemIntegral (fun t ω j => Bj j (t : ℝ) ω) =
4350      fun t ω => ∑ p ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin Ξ.n × J)), Ξ.ξ p.1 ω p.2 *
4351        (Bj p.2 (min t (Ξ.t p.1.succ)) ω - Bj p.2 (min t (Ξ.t p.1.castSucc)) ω) := by
4352    funext t ω
4353    simp only [SimpleIntegrand.elemIntegral, (hB _).coe_toNNReal, min_comm t]
4354    rw [Finset.univ_product_univ.symm, Finset.sum_product]
4355  rw [e1, e2]
4356  exact key.2
4357
4358end ElemInt
4359end FragR6

4361section FragR7
4362open MeasureTheory Filter Topology ProbabilityTheory

4364section Assoc
4365open Classical
4366variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
4367  {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ} {A : Type*} [Countable A] {𝔚 : ℝ≥0 → Ω → A → ℝ}
4368  {J : Type*} [Fintype J] {ψ : J → ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ}
4369
4370lemma hasSum_comb_sq (d : J → ℝ) (u : J → A → ℝ)
4371    (hu : ∀ j j', HasSum (fun a => u j a * u j' a) (if j = j' then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) :
4372    HasSum (fun a => (∑ j, d j * u j a) ^ 2) (∑ j, d j ^ 2) := by
4373  have h : ∀ j j', HasSum (fun a => d j * d j' * (u j a * u j' a))
4374      (d j * d j' * (if j = j' then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) := fun j j' => (hu j j').mul_left _
4375  have h2 : HasSum (fun a => ∑ j, ∑ j', d j * d j' * (u j a * u j' a))
4376      (∑ j, ∑ j', d j * d j' * (if j = j' then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) :=
4377    hasSum_sum fun j _ => hasSum_sum fun j' _ => h j j'
4378  convert h2 using 1
4379  · funext a
4380    rw [sq, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
4381    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j' _ => ?_
4382    ring
4383  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
4384    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
4385    · simp [sq]
4386    · intro j' _ hj'; simp [Ne.symm hj']
4387    · simp
4388
4389variable (hψ : ∀ j, ∀ a, IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => ψ j r ω a))
4390include hψ
4391
4392lemma tsum_cT_comb (hortho : ∀ r ω j j', HasSum (fun a => ψ j r ω a * ψ j' r ω a)
4393      (if j = j' then (1 : ℝ) else 0))
4394    {d : ℝ → Ω → J → ℝ} (hd : IsProgressive ℱ d) (T : ℝ) :
4395    ∑' a, cT P (fun r ω a => ∑ j, d r ω j * ψ j r ω a) a T = sqIntegralOn P d T := by
4396  have hprog : ∀ a, IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => ∑ j, d r ω j * ψ j r ω a) := fun a =>
4397    IsProgressive.finsetSum fun j _ => (isProgressive_coord hd j).mul (hψ j a)
4398  unfold cT
4399  have e := tsum_lintegral_set_eq (S := Set.univ) (P := P) (ξ := fun r ω a => ∑ j, d r ω j * ψ j r ω a)
4400    hprog measurableSet_Icc (fun r hr => hr.2 : Set.Icc 0 T ⊆ Set.Iic T)
4401  simp only [Measure.restrict_univ] at e
4402  rw [e]
4403  unfold sqIntegralOn
4404  refine lintegral_congr fun ω => setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Icc fun r hr => ?_
4405  rw [enorm_tsum_sq_of_hasSum (hasSum_comb_sq (d r ω) (fun j a => ψ j r ω a) (hortho r ω)),
4406    ← enorm_sum_sq, Real.enorm_eq_ofReal (Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => sq_nonneg _)]
4407
4408lemma isCtbl_comb (hortho : ∀ r ω j j', HasSum (fun a => ψ j r ω a * ψ j' r ω a)
4409      (if j = j' then (1 : ℝ) else 0))
4410    {d : ℝ → Ω → J → ℝ} (hd : IsProgressiveL2 P ℱ d) :
4411    IsCtbl P ℱ (fun r ω a => ∑ j, d r ω j * ψ j r ω a) :=
4412  ⟨fun a => IsProgressive.finsetSum fun j _ => (isProgressive_coord hd.prog j).mul (hψ j a),
4413    fun T => by
4414      rw [tsum_cT_comb hψ hortho hd.prog T]
4415      exact (hd.sq T).ne⟩
4416
4417end Assoc

4419section Assoc2
4420open Classical
4421variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
4422  {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ} {A : Type*} [Countable A] {𝔚 : ℝ≥0 → Ω → A → ℝ}
4423  {J : Type*} [Fintype J] {ψ : J → ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ}
4424
4425theorem isItoIntegral_assoc (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ 𝔚)
4426    (hψ' : ∀ j, IsCtbl P ℱ (ψ j)) {Bj : J → ℝ → Ω → ℝ} (hB : ∀ j, IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 (ψ j) (Bj j))
4427    (hBr : IsBrownianFiltration P ℱ (fun t ω j => Bj j (t : ℝ) ω))
4428    (hortho : ∀ r ω j j', HasSum (fun a => ψ j r ω a * ψ j' r ω a) (if j = j' then (1 : ℝ) else 0))
4429    {f : ℝ → Ω → J → ℝ} (hf : IsProgressiveL2 P ℱ f) {Y : ℝ → Ω → ℝ}
4430    (hY : IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 (fun r ω a => ∑ j, f r ω j * ψ j r ω a) Y) :
4431    IsItoIntegral P ℱ (fun t ω j => Bj j (t : ℝ) ω) f Y := by
4432  have hψp : ∀ j a, IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => ψ j r ω a) := fun j a => (hψ' j).prog a
4433  refine isItoIntegral_of_exists_seq hBr hf hY.cont (fun t => hY.adapted t)
4434    (fun t ht ω => hY.zero t ht ω) fun t ht => ?_
4435  obtain ⟨Ξ, hΞ⟩ := exists_simple_approx P ℱ f hf.prog t (hf.sq t)
4436  refine ⟨Ξ, hΞ, ?_⟩
4437  have hfC := isCtbl_comb hψp hortho hf
4438  have hbound : ∀ n, ∫⁻ ω, ‖(Ξ n).elemIntegral (fun t ω j => Bj j (t : ℝ) ω) t ω - Y t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P ≤
4439      sqIntegralOn P (fun s ω => (Ξ n).toFun s ω - f s ω) t := by
4440    intro n
4441    have hI := isItoC_elem hW ψ Bj hψ' hB (Ξ n)
4442    have hΞC := isCtbl_comb hψp hortho (IsProgressiveL2.simple P (Ξ n))
4443    have hd := hI.sub hW hΞC hfC hY
4444    have hdC : IsProgressiveL2 P ℱ (fun s ω => (Ξ n).toFun s ω - f s ω) :=
4445      (IsProgressiveL2.simple P (Ξ n)).sub hf
4446    have hdCt := isCtbl_comb hψp hortho hdC
4447    have e : (fun r ω a => ∑ j, (Ξ n).toFun r ω j * ψ j r ω a - ∑ j, f r ω j * ψ j r ω a) =
4448        fun r ω a => ∑ j, ((Ξ n).toFun r ω j - f r ω j) * ψ j r ω a := by
4449      funext r ω a
4450      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
4451      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by ring
4452    rw [e] at hd
4453    have := hd.lintegral_sq_le hdCt hW ht
4454    rw [tsum_cT_comb hψp hortho hdC.prog t] at this
4455    exact this
4456  exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds hΞ (fun _ => bot_le) hbound
4457
4458end Assoc2
4459end FragR7

4464section LevyItoC
4465open Classical
4466variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
4467  {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ} {A : Type*} [Countable A] {𝔚 : ℝ≥0 → Ω → A → ℝ}
4468  {J : Type*} [Countable J] {ψ : J → ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ}
4469
4470theorem isCylindricalBrownian_of_itoC (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ 𝔚)
4471    (hψ : ∀ j, IsCtbl P ℱ (ψ j)) {Bj : J → ℝ → Ω → ℝ} (hB : ∀ j, IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 (ψ j) (Bj j))
4472    (hortho : ∀ r ω i j, HasSum (fun a => ψ i r ω a * ψ j r ω a) (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) :
4473    IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ (fun t ω j => Bj j (t : ℝ) ω) := by
4474  intro s
4475  have hcoe : ∀ (j : J) (t : ℝ) (ω : Ω), Bj j ((Real.toNNReal t : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) ω = Bj j t ω :=
4476    fun j t ω => congrFun ((hB j).coe_toNNReal t) ω
4477  have hc : ∀ (k : s) (t : ℝ) (ω : Ω),
4478      ofNNRealTime (fun (t : ℝ≥0) ω (j : s) => Bj j (t : ℝ) ω) t ω k = Bj k t ω :=
4479    fun k t ω => hcoe k t ω
4480  refine levy_characterization P ℱ (hW ∅).complete _ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
4481  · intro t
4482    refine Measurable.of_comap_le (comap_fun_le _ fun k => ?_)
4483    exact ((hB k).adapted (t : ℝ)).comap_le
4484  · intro ω
4485    funext k
4486    exact (hB k).zero 0 le_rfl ω
4487  · intro ω
4488    exact continuous_pi fun k => (hB k).cont ω |>.comp NNReal.continuous_coe
4489  · intro k
4490    have := (hB k).martingale (hψ k) hW
4491    convert this using 2 with t
4492    funext ω
4493    exact hc k t ω
4494  · intro k l
4495    have h1 : ∀ r ω, HasSum (fun a => ψ k r ω a ^ 2) 1 := fun r ω => by
4496      have := hortho r ω k k
4497      simpa [sq] using this
4498    have h2 : ∀ r ω, HasSum (fun a => ψ l r ω a ^ 2) 1 := fun r ω => by
4499      have := hortho r ω l l
4500      simpa [sq] using this
4501    have := (hB k).martingale_mul_sub_const hW (hψ k) (hψ l) (hB l)
4502      (c := if (k : J) = l then 1 else 0) (by split_ifs <;> norm_num) (by split_ifs <;> norm_num)
4503      h1 h2 (fun r ω => hortho r ω k l)
4504    convert this using 2 with t
4505    funext ω
4506    simp only [ofNNRealTime_apply]
4507    rw [hcoe k.1 t ω, hcoe l.1 t ω]
4508    by_cases h : (k : J) = l
4509    · have h' : k = l := Subtype.ext h
4510      simp [h, h']
4511    · have h' : ¬ k = l := fun e => h (congrArg Subtype.val e)
4512      simp [h, h']
4513
4514end LevyItoC
4515end FragR8

4520section CylCoords
4521open Classical
4522variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
4523  {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ} {κ : Type*} [Countable κ] {W : ℝ≥0 → Ω → κ → ℝ}
4524
4525lemma IsCylindricalBrownian.zero_coord (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ W) (ω : Ω) (k : κ) :
4526    W 0 ω k = 0 := by
4527  have := congrFun ((hW {k}).zero ω) ⟨k, by simp⟩
4528  simpa using this
4529
4530lemma IsCylindricalBrownian.continuous_coord (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ W) (ω : Ω) (k : κ) :
4531    Continuous fun t => W t ω k :=
4532  (continuous_apply (⟨k, by simp⟩ : ({k} : Finset κ))).comp ((hW {k}).cont ω)
4533
4534theorem isCylindricalBrownian_of_coords (hcomplete : IsCompleteFiltration P ℱ)
4535    (hadapted : ∀ (t : ℝ≥0) (k : κ), Measurable[ℱ t] (fun ω => W t ω k))
4536    (h0 : ∀ ω k, W 0 ω k = 0) (hcont : ∀ ω k, Continuous fun t => W t ω k)
4537    (hmart : ∀ k, Martingale (fun (t : ℝ) ω => ofNNRealTime W t ω k) ℱ P)
4538    (hqv : ∀ k l, Martingale (fun (t : ℝ) ω => ofNNRealTime W t ω k * ofNNRealTime W t ω l -
4539      if k = l then max t 0 else 0) ℱ P) :
4540    IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ W := by
4541  intro s
4542  refine levy_characterization P ℱ hcomplete _ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
4543  · intro t
4544    refine Measurable.of_comap_le (comap_fun_le _ fun k => ?_)
4545    exact (hadapted t k).comap_le
4546  · intro ω; funext k; exact h0 ω k
4547  · intro ω; exact continuous_pi fun k => hcont ω k
4548  · intro k; exact hmart k
4549  · intro k l
4550    have := hqv k l
4551    convert this using 2 with t
4552    funext ω
4553    by_cases h : k = l
4554    · have h' : (k : κ) = l := congrArg Subtype.val h
4555      simp [h, h']
4556    · have h' : ¬ (k : κ) = l := fun e => h (Subtype.ext e)
4557      simp [h, h']
4558
4559theorem IsCylindricalBrownian.comp_inj {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω}
4560    [IsProbabilityMeasure P] {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ} {A : Type*} [Countable A]
4561    {𝔚 : ℝ≥0 → Ω → A → ℝ} (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ 𝔚) {γ : Type*} [Countable γ]
4562    (X : γ → A) (hX : Function.Injective X) :
4563    IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ (fun t ω c => 𝔚 t ω (X c)) := by
4564  refine isCylindricalBrownian_of_coords (hW ∅).complete (fun t c => hW.measurable_coord t (X c))
4565    (fun ω c => hW.zero_coord ω (X c)) (fun ω c => hW.continuous_coord ω (X c))
4566    (fun c => hW.martingale_coord (X c)) (fun c d => ?_)
4567  have := hW.martingale_mul_sub (X c) (X d)
4568  by_cases h : c = d
4569  · subst h; simpa using this
4570  · have h' : ¬ X c = X d := fun e => h (hX e)
4571    simpa [h, h'] using this
4572
4573end CylCoords
4574end FragR9

4576section FragR10
4577open MeasureTheory Filter Topology ProbabilityTheory
4578open scoped ENNReal NNReal BigOperators
4579section Trans
4580open Classical
4581variable {Ω Ω' : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {mΩ' : MeasurableSpace Ω'} {P : Measure Ω}
4582  {P' : Measure Ω'} [IsProbabilityMeasure P] [IsProbabilityMeasure P'] {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ}
4583  {ℱ' : Filtration ℝ mΩ'} {π : Ω' → Ω} {s : Type*} [Fintype s]
4584
4585/-- Pull-back of a simple integrand along a map that is measurable for the filtrations. -/
4586def SimpleIntegrand.comapπ (π : Ω' → Ω) (hπ : ∀ t, Measurable[ℱ' t, ℱ t] π) (Ψ : SimpleIntegrand ℱ s) :
4587    SimpleIntegrand ℱ' s where
4588  n := Ψ.n
4589  t := Ψ.t
4590  mono := Ψ.mono
4591  nonneg := Ψ.nonneg
4592  ξ := fun i ω' => Ψ.ξ i (π ω')
4593  meas := fun i => (Ψ.meas i).comp (hπ _)
4594  bdd := by obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := Ψ.bdd; exact ⟨C, fun i ω k => hC i (π ω) k⟩
4595
4596lemma SimpleIntegrand.comapπ_toFun (hπ : ∀ t, Measurable[ℱ' t, ℱ t] π) (Ψ : SimpleIntegrand ℱ s)
4597    (r : ℝ) (ω' : Ω') : (Ψ.comapπ π hπ).toFun r ω' = Ψ.toFun r (π ω') := rfl
4598
4599lemma SimpleIntegrand.comapπ_elem (hπ : ∀ t, Measurable[ℱ' t, ℱ t] π) (Ψ : SimpleIntegrand ℱ s)
4600    (W : ℝ≥0 → Ω → s → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (ω' : Ω') :
4601    (Ψ.comapπ π hπ).elemIntegral (fun t ω' k => W t (π ω') k) r ω' = Ψ.elemIntegral W r (π ω') := rfl
4602
4603lemma isProgressive_comp_π (hπ : ∀ t, Measurable[ℱ' t, ℱ t] π) {β : Type*} [MeasurableSpace β]
4604    {g : ℝ → Ω → β} (hg : IsProgressive ℱ g) : IsProgressive ℱ' (fun r ω' => g r (π ω')) := by
4605  intro i
4606  letI : MeasurableSpace (Set.Iic i × Ω') := Subtype.instMeasurableSpace.prod (ℱ' i)
4607  letI : MeasurableSpace (Set.Iic i × Ω) := Subtype.instMeasurableSpace.prod (ℱ i)
4608  have h1 : Measurable (fun p : Set.Iic i × Ω' => (p.1, π p.2)) :=
4609    measurable_fst.prodMk ((hπ i).comp measurable_snd)
4610  exact (hg i).comp h1
4611
4612lemma sqIntegralOn_comp_π (hπ : ∀ t, Measurable[ℱ' t, ℱ t] π) (hπp : MeasurePreserving π P' P)
4613    {g : ℝ → Ω → s → ℝ} (hg : IsProgressive ℱ g) (T : ℝ) :
4614    sqIntegralOn P' (fun r ω' => g r (π ω')) T = sqIntegralOn P g T := by
4615  rw [sqIntegralOn_eq_clamp, sqIntegralOn_eq_clamp]
4616  have hm := measurable_lintegral_sqSum hg T
4617  exact hπp.lintegral_comp hm
4618
4619theorem itoIntegral_comp_π (hπ : ∀ t, Measurable[ℱ' t, ℱ t] π) (hπp : MeasurePreserving π P' P)
4620    {W : ℝ≥0 → Ω → s → ℝ} (hW : IsBrownianFiltration P ℱ W)
4621    (hW' : IsBrownianFiltration P' ℱ' (fun t ω' k => W t (π ω') k))
4622    {g : ℝ → Ω → s → ℝ} (hg : IsProgressiveL2 P ℱ g) :
4623    ∀ᵐ ω' ∂P', ∀ t, itoIntegral P' ℱ' (fun t ω' k => W t (π ω') k) (fun r ω' k => g r (π ω') k) t ω' =
4624      itoIntegral P ℱ W g t (π ω') := by
4625  have hg' : IsProgressiveL2 P' ℱ' (fun r ω' k => g r (π ω') k) :=
4626    ⟨isProgressive_comp_π hπ hg.prog, fun T => by
4627      rw [sqIntegralOn_comp_π hπ hπp hg.prog T]; exact hg.sq T⟩
4628  have hI := isItoIntegral_itoIntegral hW hg
4629  have hM' : IsItoIntegral P' ℱ' (fun t ω' k => W t (π ω') k) (fun r ω' k => g r (π ω') k)
4630      (fun t ω' => itoIntegral P ℱ W g t (π ω')) := by
4631    refine isItoIntegral_of_exists_seq hW' hg' (fun ω' => hI.cont (π ω'))
4632      (fun t => (hI.adapted t).comp (hπ t)) (fun t ht ω' => hI.zero t ht (π ω')) fun t ht => ?_
4633    obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨ⟩ := exists_simple_approx P ℱ g hg.prog t (hg.sq t)
4634    refine ⟨fun n => (Ψ n).comapπ π hπ, ?_, ?_⟩
4635    · unfold IsApprox
4636      have : ∀ n, sqIntegralOn P' (fun r ω' => (Ψ n).toFun r (π ω') - g r (π ω')) t =
4637          sqIntegralOn P (fun r ω => (Ψ n).toFun r ω - g r ω) t := fun n =>
4638        sqIntegralOn_comp_π hπ hπp (g := fun r ω => (Ψ n).toFun r ω - g r ω)
4639          (isProgressive_sub (Ψ n).isProgressive_toFun hg.prog) t
4640      simpa only [SimpleIntegrand.comapπ_toFun, this] using hΨ
4641    · have h1 := hI.approx t ht Ψ hΨ
4642      have : ∀ n, ∫⁻ ω', ‖((Ψ n).comapπ π hπ).elemIntegral (fun t ω' k => W t (π ω') k) t ω' -
4643          itoIntegral P ℱ W g t (π ω')‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P' =
4644          ∫⁻ ω, ‖(Ψ n).elemIntegral W t ω - itoIntegral P ℱ W g t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P := fun n => by
4645        have hm : Measurable fun ω => ‖(Ψ n).elemIntegral W t ω - itoIntegral P ℱ W g t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 :=
4646          ((((SimpleIntegrand.adapted_elemIntegral hW (Ψ n) t).mono (ℱ.le t) le_rfl).sub
4647            ((adapted_itoIntegral P ℱ W g t).mono (ℱ.le t) le_rfl)).enorm).pow_const 2
4648        exact hπp.lintegral_comp hm
4649      simpa only [this] using h1
4650  exact (hM'.ae_eq_forall hW' (isItoIntegral_itoIntegral hW' hg') hg').mono fun ω' h t => (h t).symm
4651
4652end Trans
4653end FragR10

4655section FragR11
4656open MeasureTheory Filter Topology ProbabilityTheory
4657open scoped ENNReal NNReal BigOperators
4658section PathIndep
4659open Classical
4660variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
4661  {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ} {γ : Type*} [Fintype γ] {β : ℝ≥0 → Ω → γ → ℝ}
4662
4663set_option warn.classDefReducibility false in
4664/-- The σ-algebra generated by `β_τ`, `τ ∈ T`. -/
4665def pathSigmaFin (β : ℝ≥0 → Ω → γ → ℝ) (T : Finset ℝ≥0) : MeasurableSpace Ω :=
4666  ⨆ τ ∈ T, MeasurableSpace.comap (β τ) inferInstance
4667
4668lemma pathSigmaFin_mono {T T' : Finset ℝ≥0} (h : T ⊆ T') : pathSigmaFin β T ≤ pathSigmaFin β T' :=
4669  iSup₂_le fun r hr => le_iSup₂_of_le (f := fun r (_ : r ∈ T') =>
4670    MeasurableSpace.comap (β r) inferInstance) r (h hr) le_rfl
4671
4672theorem indep_zero_pathSigmaFin (hβ : IsBrownianFiltration P ℱ β) (T : Finset ℝ≥0) :
4673    Indep (ℱ 0) (pathSigmaFin β T) P := by
4674  induction T using Finset.induction_on_max with
4675  | empty =>
4676    have : pathSigmaFin β ∅ = ⊥ := by simp [pathSigmaFin]
4677    rw [this]
4678    exact indep_bot_right _
4679  | insert a s ha ih =>
4680    have hβm : ∀ τ : ℝ≥0, MeasurableSpace.comap (β τ) inferInstance ≤ ℱ (τ : ℝ) := fun τ =>
4681      (hβ.adapted τ).comap_le
4682    rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hs
4683    · -- single time
4684      have h1 := hβ.indep_incr 0 a (by positivity)
4685      have e : (fun ω => β a ω - β 0 ω) = β a := by funext ω; simp [hβ.zero]
4686      rw [e] at h1
4687      have : pathSigmaFin β (insert a ∅) = MeasurableSpace.comap (β a) inferInstance := by
4688        simp [pathSigmaFin]
4689      rw [this]
4690      exact h1.symm
4691    · set m := s.max' hs with hm
4692      have hmle : ∀ r ∈ s, r ≤ m := fun r hr => s.le_max' r hr
4693      have hma : m ≤ a := (ha m (s.max'_mem hs)).le
4694      have hCle : pathSigmaFin β s ≤ ℱ (m : ℝ) :=
4695        iSup₂_le fun r hr => (hβm r).trans (ℱ.mono (by exact_mod_cast hmle r hr))
4696      have hmeas : MeasurableSpace.comap (fun ω => β a ω - β m ω) inferInstance ≤ mΩ :=
4697        Measurable.comap_le ((hβ.measurable a).sub (hβ.measurable m))
4698      have hD : Indep (MeasurableSpace.comap (fun ω => β a ω - β m ω) inferInstance)
4699          (ℱ 0 ⊔ pathSigmaFin β s) P :=
4700        indep_of_indep_of_le_right (hβ.indep_incr m a hma)
4701          (sup_le (ℱ.mono (by exact_mod_cast m.2)) hCle)
4702      have h3 := indep_sup_right_of_indep (M0 := MeasurableSpace.comap (fun ω => β a ω - β m ω) inferInstance)
4703        (M1 := ℱ 0) (M2 := pathSigmaFin β s) P hmeas (ℱ.le 0) (iSup₂_le fun r hr => (hβm r).trans (ℱ.le _))
4704        ih hD
4705      refine indep_of_indep_of_le_right h3 ?_
4706      -- pathSigmaFin (insert a s) ≤ D ⊔ C
4707      unfold pathSigmaFin
4708      refine iSup₂_le fun r hr => ?_
4709      rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hr with rfl | hr'
4710      · have hd : Measurable[MeasurableSpace.comap (fun ω => β r ω - β m ω) inferInstance ⊔ pathSigmaFin β s]
4711            (fun ω => β r ω - β m ω) :=
4712          (comap_measurable (fun ω => β r ω - β m ω)).mono le_sup_left le_rfl
4713        have hm' : Measurable[MeasurableSpace.comap (fun ω => β r ω - β m ω) inferInstance ⊔ pathSigmaFin β s]
4714            (β m) :=
4715          (comap_measurable (β m)).mono (le_sup_of_le_right (le_iSup₂_of_le (f := fun τ (_ : τ ∈ s) =>
4716            MeasurableSpace.comap (β τ) inferInstance) m (s.max'_mem hs) le_rfl)) le_rfl
4717        have h1 := hd.add hm'
4718        have e : ((fun ω => β r ω - β m ω) + β m) = β r := by funext ω; simp
4719        rw [e] at h1
4720        exact h1.comap_le
4721      · exact le_sup_of_le_right (le_iSup₂_of_le (f := fun τ (_ : τ ∈ s) =>
4722          MeasurableSpace.comap (β τ) inferInstance) r hr' le_rfl)
4723
4724end PathIndep
4725
4726section PathIndep2
4727open Classical
4728variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
4729  {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ} {J : Type*} [Countable J] {B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → J → ℝ}
4730
4731lemma comap_coord_le_comap_pi {Ξ : Type*} {s : Type*} (g : Ξ → s → ℝ) (k : s) :
4732    MeasurableSpace.comap (fun ω => g ω k) inferInstance ≤ MeasurableSpace.comap g inferInstance := by
4733  rw [show (fun ω => g ω k) = (fun v : s → ℝ => v k) ∘ g from rfl, ← MeasurableSpace.comap_comp]
4734  exact MeasurableSpace.comap_mono (measurable_pi_apply k).comap_le
4735
4736theorem indep_zero_cylPath (hB : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ B) :
4737    Indep (ℱ 0) (⨆ (τ : ℝ≥0) (k : J), MeasurableSpace.comap (fun ω => B τ ω k) inferInstance) P := by
4738  -- finite coordinate sets
4739  set N : Finset J → MeasurableSpace Ω := fun s =>
4740    ⨆ T : Finset ℝ≥0, pathSigmaFin (fun t ω (k : s) => B t ω k) T with hN
4741  have hNle : ∀ s, N s ≤ mΩ := fun s =>
4742    iSup_le fun T => iSup₂_le fun τ _ => ((hB s).measurable τ).comap_le
4743  have hNi : ∀ s, Indep (N s) (ℱ 0) P := fun s => by
4744    refine indep_iSup_of_directed_le (fun T => (indep_zero_pathSigmaFin (hB s) T).symm)
4745      (fun T => iSup₂_le fun τ _ => ((hB s).measurable τ).comap_le) (ℱ.le 0) ?_
4746    intro T T'
4747    exact ⟨T ∪ T', pathSigmaFin_mono Finset.subset_union_left, pathSigmaFin_mono Finset.subset_union_right⟩
4748  have hNmono : Monotone N := by
4749    intro s s' hss'
4750    refine iSup_le fun T => ?_
4751    -- coordinates of s are coordinates of s'
4752    refine iSup₂_le fun τ hτ => ?_
4753    refine le_trans ?_ (le_iSup_of_le T (le_iSup₂_of_le τ hτ le_rfl))
4754    refine comap_fun_le _ fun k => ?_
4755    exact comap_coord_le_comap_pi (fun ω (j : s') => B τ ω j) ⟨k, hss' k.2⟩
4756  have hbig : Indep (⨆ s : Finset J, N s) (ℱ 0) P :=
4757    indep_iSup_of_directed_le hNi hNle (ℱ.le 0) (hNmono.directed_le)
4758  refine (indep_of_indep_of_le_left hbig ?_).symm
4759  refine iSup₂_le fun τ k => ?_
4760  refine le_trans ?_ (le_iSup N {k})
4761  refine le_trans ?_ (le_iSup_of_le {τ} (le_iSup₂_of_le τ (by simp) le_rfl))
4762  exact comap_coord_le_comap_pi (fun ω (j : ({k} : Finset J)) => B τ ω j) ⟨k, by simp⟩
4763
4764end PathIndep2
4765end FragR11

4767section FragR12
4768open MeasureTheory Filter Topology ProbabilityTheory
4769open scoped ENNReal NNReal BigOperators
4770section PolarFam
4771open Classical
4772variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
4773  [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]
4774variable {κ : Type*} [Countable κ] {ι : Type*} [Countable ι]
4775
4776/-- Properties of a coordinate map into `ℓ²`: linear isometry coordinatewise. -/
4777structure CoordProps (c : H → κ ⊕ ι → ℝ) : Prop where
4778  sq : ∀ x, HasSum (fun a => c x a ^ 2) (‖x‖ ^ 2)
4779  add : ∀ x y a, c (x + y) a = c x a + c y a
4780  smul : ∀ (r : ℝ) x a, c (r • x) a = r * c x a
4781
4782lemma CoordProps.sub {c : H → κ ⊕ ι → ℝ} (hc : CoordProps c) (x y : H) (a : κ ⊕ ι) :
4783    c (x - y) a = c x a - c y a := by
4784  have h := hc.add (x - y) y a
4785  rw [sub_add_cancel] at h
4786  linarith
4787
4788lemma CoordProps.sum {c : H → κ ⊕ ι → ℝ} (hc : CoordProps c) {γ : Type*} (s : Finset γ) (v : γ → H)
4789    (a : κ ⊕ ι) : c (∑ j ∈ s, v j) a = ∑ j ∈ s, c (v j) a := by
4790  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
4791  | empty =>
4792    have := hc.smul 0 0 a
4793    simpa using this
4794  | insert j s hj ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert hj, Finset.sum_insert hj, hc.add, ih]
4795
4796lemma CoordProps.abs_le {c : H → κ ⊕ ι → ℝ} (hc : CoordProps c) (x : H) (a : κ ⊕ ι) :
4797    |c x a| ≤ ‖x‖ := by
4798  have h1 : c x a ^ 2 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
4799    have := le_hasSum (hc.sq x) a (fun b _ => sq_nonneg _)
4800    exact this
4801  exact abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' h1 (norm_nonneg _) |> fun h => _root_.abs_le.2 h
4802
4803lemma CoordProps.hasSum_mul {c : H → κ ⊕ ι → ℝ} (hc : CoordProps c) (x y : H) :
4804    HasSum (fun a => c x a * c y a) (inner ℝ x y) := by
4805  have h1 := hc.sq (x + y)
4806  have h2 := hc.sq (x - y)
4807  have h3 := (h1.sub h2).mul_left (1 / 4 : ℝ)
4808  convert h3 using 1
4809  · funext a
4810    rw [hc.add, hc.sub]; ring
4811  · have := re_inner_eq_norm_add_mul_self_sub_norm_sub_mul_self_div_four (𝕜 := ℝ) x y
4812    simp only [RCLike.re_to_real] at this
4813    rw [this]
4814    ring
4815
4816/-- The coordinate functional as a continuous linear map. -/
4817def CoordProps.toCLM {c : H → κ ⊕ ι → ℝ} (hc : CoordProps c) (a : κ ⊕ ι) : H →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
4818  LinearMap.mkContinuous
4819    { toFun := fun v => c v a
4820      map_add' := fun x y => hc.add x y a
4821      map_smul' := fun r x => by simpa using hc.smul r x a } 1 (fun v => by
4822    simpa using hc.abs_le v a)
4823
4824lemma CoordProps.toCLM_apply {c : H → κ ⊕ ι → ℝ} (hc : CoordProps c) (a : κ ⊕ ι) (v : H) :
4825    hc.toCLM a v = c v a := rfl
4826
4827/-- The space of square-summable families. -/
4828abbrev SumFam (κ H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] := {z : κ → H // Summable fun k => ‖z k‖ ^ 2}
4829
4830theorem exists_polar_family {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ}
4831    (e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H) (Φ : ℝ → Ω → κ → H)
4832    (hΦp : ∀ k, IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => Φ r ω k))
4833    (hΦs : ∀ r ω, Summable fun k => ‖Φ r ω k‖ ^ 2) :
4834    ∃ (S : ℝ → Ω → H →L[ℝ] H) (ψ : ι → ℝ → Ω → κ ⊕ ι → ℝ),
4835      (∀ r ω, IsSqrtOfForm (S r ω) (hsCovForm (Φ r ω))) ∧
4836      (∀ x y, IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => inner ℝ (S r ω x) y)) ∧
4837      (∀ j a, IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => ψ j r ω a)) ∧
4838      (∀ r ω i j, HasSum (fun a => ψ i r ω a * ψ j r ω a) (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) ∧
4839      (∀ x r ω a, HasSum (fun j => inner ℝ (S r ω (e j)) x * ψ j r ω a)
4840        (Sum.elim (fun k => inner ℝ (Φ r ω k) x) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) a)) ∧
4841      (∀ x r ω, HasSum (fun j => inner ℝ (S r ω (e j)) x ^ 2) (‖S r ω x‖ ^ 2)) ∧
4842      (∀ (s : Finset ι) x r ω, HasSum (fun a => (Sum.elim (fun k => inner ℝ (Φ r ω k) x)
4843          (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) a - ∑ j ∈ s, inner ℝ (S r ω (e j)) x * ψ j r ω a) ^ 2)
4844        (∑' j, if j ∈ s then 0 else inner ℝ (S r ω (e j)) x ^ 2)) := by
4845  obtain ⟨S₀, coord, hSm, hSq, hcm, hcsq, hcadd, hcsmul, hcl, hcr⟩ :=
4846    exists_polar_coords (Z := SumFam κ H) e (fun z k => z.1 k)
4847      (fun k => (measurable_pi_apply k).comp measurable_subtype_coe) (fun z => z.2)
4848  have hc : ∀ z, CoordProps (coord z) := fun z => ⟨hcsq z, hcadd z, hcsmul z⟩
4849  set Φ' : ℝ → Ω → SumFam κ H := fun r ω => ⟨Φ r ω, hΦs r ω⟩ with hΦ'
4850  have hΦ'p : IsProgressive ℱ Φ' := fun i => by
4851    letI : MeasurableSpace (Set.Iic i × Ω) := Subtype.instMeasurableSpace.prod (ℱ i)
4852    exact Measurable.subtype_mk (measurable_pi_iff.2 fun k => hΦp k i)
4853  have hSsymm : ∀ z x y, inner ℝ (S₀ z x) y = inner ℝ x (S₀ z y) := fun z x y => (hSq z).symm x y
4854  refine ⟨fun r ω => S₀ (Φ' r ω), fun j r ω a => coord (Φ' r ω) (e j) a, fun r ω => hSq _,
4855    fun x y i => by
4856      letI : MeasurableSpace (Set.Iic i × Ω) := Subtype.instMeasurableSpace.prod (ℱ i)
4857      exact ((hSm x).comp (hΦ'p i)).inner measurable_const,
4858    fun j a i => by
4859      letI : MeasurableSpace (Set.Iic i × Ω) := Subtype.instMeasurableSpace.prod (ℱ i)
4860      exact (hcm (e j) a).comp (hΦ'p i), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
4861  · intro r ω i j
4862    have := (hc (Φ' r ω)).hasSum_mul (e i) (e j)
4863    rwa [orthonormal_iff_ite.1 e.orthonormal i j] at this
4864  · intro x r ω a
4865    set z := Φ' r ω with hz
4866    have h1 := ((e.hasSum_repr (S₀ z x)).mapL ((hc z).toCLM a))
4867    have h2 : (hc z).toCLM a (S₀ z x) = Sum.elim (fun k => inner ℝ (Φ r ω k) x) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) a := by
4868      rw [CoordProps.toCLM_apply]
4869      rcases a with k | l
4870      · exact hcl z x k
4871      · exact hcr z x l
4872    rw [h2] at h1
4873    convert h1 using 1
4874    funext j
4875    rw [map_smul, CoordProps.toCLM_apply, smul_eq_mul, HilbertBasis.repr_apply_apply,
4876      ← hSsymm z (e j) x, real_inner_comm]
4877  · intro x r ω
4878    have := e.hasSum_inner_mul_inner (S₀ (Φ' r ω) x) (S₀ (Φ' r ω) x)
4879    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at this
4880    convert this using 1
4881    funext j
4882    show inner ℝ (S₀ (Φ' r ω) (e j)) x ^ 2 = _
4883    rw [hSsymm _ (e j) x, sq, real_inner_comm (S₀ (Φ' r ω) x) (e j)]
4884  · intro s x r ω
4885    set z := Φ' r ω with hz
4886    set v : H := S₀ z x - ∑ j ∈ s, inner ℝ (S₀ z (e j)) x • e j with hv
4887    have hcv : ∀ a, coord z v a = Sum.elim (fun k => inner ℝ (Φ r ω k) x) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) a -
4888        ∑ j ∈ s, inner ℝ (S₀ z (e j)) x * coord z (e j) a := by
4889      intro a
4890      rw [hv, (hc z).sub, (hc z).sum]
4891      have h2 : coord z (S₀ z x) a = Sum.elim (fun k => inner ℝ (Φ r ω k) x) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) a := by
4892        rcases a with k | l
4893        · exact hcl z x k
4894        · exact hcr z x l
4895      rw [h2]
4896      congr 1
4897      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
4898      rw [hcsmul]
4899    have h1 := (hc z).sq v
4900    have h2 := e.hasSum_inner_mul_inner v v
4901    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at h2
4902    have h3 : ∀ j, inner ℝ v (e j) = if j ∈ s then 0 else inner ℝ (S₀ z (e j)) x := by
4903      intro j
4904      rw [hv, inner_sub_left, sum_inner]
4905      simp only [inner_smul_left, conj_trivial]
4906      have : ∀ j', inner ℝ (e j') (e j) = if j' = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := fun j' =>
4907        orthonormal_iff_ite.1 e.orthonormal j' j
4908      simp only [this]
4909      have hj' : inner ℝ (S₀ z (e j)) x = inner ℝ (S₀ z x) (e j) := by
4910        rw [hSsymm z (e j) x, real_inner_comm]
4911      by_cases hj : j ∈ s <;> simp [hj, mul_ite, Finset.sum_ite_eq', ← hj']
4912    have h4 : HasSum (fun j => (if j ∈ s then 0 else inner ℝ (S₀ z (e j)) x ^ 2))
4913        (‖v‖ ^ 2) := by
4914      convert h2 using 1
4915      funext j
4916      rw [h3 j, real_inner_comm v (e j), h3 j]
4917      by_cases hj : j ∈ s <;> simp [hj, sq]
4918    rw [h4.tsum_eq]
4919    convert h1 using 1
4920    funext a
4921    simp only []
4922    rw [hcv a]
4923
4924end PolarFam
4925end FragR12

4929/-! ### Auxiliary development for Corollary A.23, part 2 (CLT-02c attempt 5)
4930
4931The `H`-valued continuous Ito integral `G` of a deterministic integrand against the cylindrical
4932Brownian motion `B` (`pc_hvalued`, Doob coordinatewise, `PCDetData`, `pc_exists_G`), its
4933Gaussianity and independence of `ℱ 0` (`pc_law_cond` through `dds_coupling_strong` under the
4934conditional measures `P(· | A)`, `pc_G_gaussian`), the transfer of `hM` to the integral against `B`
4935(`pc_Z_isItoC`, `pc_bridge`, through `itoIntegral_pad`, `itoIntegral_comp_π` and associativity), the
4936`L²` bound (`pc_L2_bound`, `powers_stormer`) and the identification of the discrepancy integral
4937(`pc_lintegral_covDisc`). -/
4938
4939section A23Hilb
4940open HilbertCLTAux
4941
4942variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
4943  [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]
4944

4946/-- A Hilbert basis of `H` indexed by a countable type in an arbitrary universe. -/
4947lemma exists_hilbertBasis_ulift.{u} :
4948    ∃ (ι : Type u) (_ : Countable ι) (_ : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H), True := by
4949  obtain ⟨ι₀, hc, b, -⟩ := HilbertCLTAux.exists_hilbertBasis_type (H := H)
4950  have := hc
4951  have hv : Orthonormal ℝ (fun j : ULift.{u} ι₀ => (b j.down : H)) :=
4952    b.orthonormal.comp _ ULift.down_injective
4953  refine ⟨ULift.{u} ι₀, inferInstance, HilbertBasis.mkOfOrthogonalEqBot hv ?_, trivial⟩
4954  have hrange : Set.range (fun j : ULift.{u} ι₀ => (b j.down : H)) = Set.range (fun i : ι₀ => (b i : H)) := by
4955    ext x; constructor
4956    · rintro ⟨j, rfl⟩; exact ⟨j.down, rfl⟩
4957    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact ⟨ULift.up i, rfl⟩
4958  rw [hrange, ← Submodule.orthogonal_closure, b.dense_span]
4959  exact Submodule.top_orthogonal_eq_bot
4960
4961omit [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H] in
4962lemma hasSum_diag_decomp {κ ι : Type*} {ℓ : κ → H} (hs : Summable fun j => ‖ℓ j‖ ^ 2)
4963    (e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H) :
4964    HasSum (fun i => ∑' j, inner ℝ (ℓ j) (e i) ^ 2) (∑' j, ‖ℓ j‖ ^ 2) := by
4965  have hrow : ∀ j, HasSum (fun i => inner ℝ (ℓ j) (e i) ^ 2) (‖ℓ j‖ ^ 2) := fun j => by
4966    have := e.hasSum_inner_mul_inner (ℓ j) (ℓ j)
4967    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at this
4968    have h2 : (fun i => inner ℝ (ℓ j) (e i) ^ 2) =
4969        fun i => inner ℝ (ℓ j) (e i) * inner ℝ (e i) (ℓ j) := by
4970      funext i; rw [sq, real_inner_comm (e i) (ℓ j)]
4971    rw [h2]; exact this
4972  have hsum : Summable (fun p : κ × ι => inner ℝ (ℓ p.1) (e p.2) ^ 2) := by
4973    rw [summable_prod_of_nonneg (fun p => sq_nonneg _)]
4974    exact ⟨fun j => (hrow j).summable, by simpa [(hrow _).tsum_eq] using hs⟩
4975  set f : ι × κ → ℝ := fun p => inner ℝ (ℓ p.2) (e p.1) ^ 2 with hf
4976  have hsw : Summable f := by
4977    have := hsum.comp_injective (Equiv.prodComm ι κ).injective
4978    exact this
4979  have h1 : HasSum (fun i => ∑' j, f (i, j)) (∑' p, f p) :=
4980    hsw.hasSum.prod_fiberwise (fun i => (hsw.prod_factor i).hasSum)
4981  have h2 : ∑' p, f p = ∑' j, ‖ℓ j‖ ^ 2 := by
4982    have : ∑' p, f p = ∑' p : κ × ι, inner ℝ (ℓ p.1) (e p.2) ^ 2 :=
4983      (Equiv.prodComm ι κ).tsum_eq (fun p : κ × ι => inner ℝ (ℓ p.1) (e p.2) ^ 2)
4984    rw [this, hsum.tsum_prod' (fun j => (hrow j).summable)]
4985    exact tsum_congr fun j => (hrow j).tsum_eq
4986  rw [← h2]
4987  exact h1
4988
4989lemma IsTraceClassCov.hasSum_basis {C : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ} (hC : IsTraceClassCov C) {ι : Type*}
4990    (e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H) :
4991    ∃ T : ℝ, HasSum (fun i => C (e i) (e i)) T ∧ ∀ x, C x x ≤ T * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
4992  obtain ⟨ℓ, hs, hℓ⟩ := hC.exists_decomp'
4993  have hd : ∀ x, C x x = ∑' j, inner ℝ (ℓ j) x ^ 2 := fun x => by
4994    rw [← (hℓ x x).tsum_eq]; exact tsum_congr fun j => (sq _).symm
4995  refine ⟨∑' j, ‖ℓ j‖ ^ 2, ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
4996  · have := hasSum_diag_decomp hs e
4997    convert this using 2 with i
4998    exact hd (e i)
4999  · rw [hd x, ← tsum_mul_right]
5000    refine Summable.tsum_le_tsum (fun j => ?_) ?_ (hs.mul_right _)
5001    · rw [← mul_pow, ← sq_abs (inner ℝ (ℓ j) x)]
5002      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _) 2
5003    · exact (hℓ x x).summable.congr fun j => (sq _).symm
5004
5005lemma isTraceClassCov_hsCovForm {κ : Type*} [Countable κ] {Φ : κ → H}
5006    (hΦ : Summable fun k => ‖Φ k‖ ^ 2) : IsTraceClassCov (hsCovForm Φ) := by
5007  refine ⟨hsCovForm_symm' hΦ, hsCovForm_nonneg' hΦ, ?_⟩
5008  obtain ⟨ι, -, b, -⟩ := HilbertCLTAux.exists_hilbertBasis_type (H := H)
5009  refine ⟨ι, b, ?_⟩
5010  refine (hasSum_diag_decomp hΦ b).summable.congr fun i => ?_
5011  rw [hsCovForm_apply hΦ]
5012  exact tsum_congr fun k => (sq _)
5013
5014lemma exists_sqrt_density {ι : Type*} [Countable ι] (e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H) (t : ℝ)
5015    (sb : ℝ → (H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ)) (hsb : IsDetCovDensity t sb) :
5016    ∃ Sb : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H, OpMeas Sb ∧ (∀ r ∉ Set.Icc 0 t, Sb r = 0) ∧
5017      ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 t, IsSqrtOfForm (Sb r) (sb r) := by
5018  classical
5019  set A : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H := fun r => if r ∈ Set.Icc 0 t then formOp (sb r) else 0 with hA
5020  have hAp : ∀ r, IsPSDOp (A r) := by
5021    intro r
5022    by_cases hr : r ∈ Set.Icc 0 t
5023    · simp only [hA, hr, ite_true]
5024      exact ⟨fun x y => by
5025        rw [inner_formOp, real_inner_comm, inner_formOp, (hsb.traceClass r hr).symm],
5026        fun x => by rw [inner_formOp]; exact (hsb.traceClass r hr).nonneg x⟩
5027    · simp only [hA, hr, ite_false]
5028      exact ⟨fun x y => by simp, fun x => by simp⟩
5029  have hAm : OpMeas A := by
5030    intro x
5031    refine measurable_of_inner_basis e (fun i => ?_)
5032    have : (fun r => inner ℝ (e i) (A r x)) =
5033        fun r => (Set.Icc 0 t).indicator (fun r => sb r x (e i)) r := by
5034      funext r
5035      by_cases hr : r ∈ Set.Icc 0 t
5036      · simp only [hA, hr, ite_true, Set.indicator_of_mem]
5037        rw [real_inner_comm, inner_formOp]
5038      · have h0 : A r = 0 := by simp only [hA, hr, ite_false]
5039        rw [h0, Set.indicator_of_notMem hr]
5040        simp
5041    rw [this]
5042    exact (hsb.meas x (e i)).indicator measurableSet_Icc
5043  set c : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => 1 + (Set.Icc 0 t).indicator (fun r => ∑' i, sb r (e i) (e i)) r with hc
5044  have hcm : Measurable c :=
5045    measurable_const.add ((Measurable.tsum fun i => hsb.meas (e i) (e i)).indicator measurableSet_Icc)
5046  have hcpos : ∀ r, 0 < c r := by
5047    intro r
5048    by_cases hr : r ∈ Set.Icc 0 t
5049    · have : 0 ≤ ∑' i, sb r (e i) (e i) := tsum_nonneg fun i => (hsb.traceClass r hr).nonneg _
5050      simp only [hc, hr, Set.indicator_of_mem]
5051      linarith
5052    · simp [hc, hr]
5053  have hAc : ∀ r x, inner ℝ (A r x) x ≤ c r * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
5054    intro r x
5055    by_cases hr : r ∈ Set.Icc 0 t
5056    · obtain ⟨T, hT, hb⟩ := (hsb.traceClass r hr).hasSum_basis e
5057      simp only [hA, hr, ite_true, inner_formOp, hc, Set.indicator_of_mem, hT.tsum_eq]
5058      have := hb x
5059      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖x‖]
5060    · simp only [hA, hr, ite_false]
5061      simp only [zero_apply, inner_zero_left]
5062      have := hcpos r
5063      positivity
5064  set S0 : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H := fun r => sqrtOp (c r) (A r) with hS0
5065  have hS0m : OpMeas S0 := OpMeas.sqrtOp hAm hcm hAp hcpos hAc
5066  refine ⟨fun r => if r ∈ Set.Icc 0 t then S0 r else 0, ?_, fun r hr => by simp [hr], fun r hr => ?_⟩
5067  · intro x
5068    have : (fun r => (if r ∈ Set.Icc 0 t then S0 r else 0) x) =
5069        (Set.Icc 0 t).indicator (fun r => S0 r x) := by
5070      funext r
5071      by_cases hr : r ∈ Set.Icc 0 t <;> simp [hr]
5072    rw [this]
5073    exact (hS0m x).indicator measurableSet_Icc
5074  simp only [hr, ite_true]
5075  have hspec := sqrtOp_spec (hAp r) (hcpos r) (hAc r)
5076  refine ⟨hspec.1.symm, hspec.1.nonneg, fun x y => ?_⟩
5077  rw [hspec.1.symm x (sqrtOp (c r) (A r) y)]
5078  have : sqrtOp (c r) (A r) (sqrtOp (c r) (A r) y) = A r y := by
5079    have := congrArg (fun T : H →L[ℝ] H => T y) hspec.2
5080    simpa using this
5081  rw [this]
5082  simp only [hA, hr, ite_true]
5083  rw [real_inner_comm, inner_formOp, (hsb.traceClass r hr).symm]
5084
5085lemma IsTraceClassCov.tsum_basis_le {C : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ} (hC : IsTraceClassCov C) {ι : Type*}
5086    (e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H) : ∑' i, C (e i) (e i) ≤ traceNormForm C := by
5087  classical
5088  obtain ⟨T, hT, -⟩ := hC.hasSum_basis e
5089  rw [hT.tsum_eq]
5090  refine hasSum_le_of_sum_le hT (fun F => ?_)
5091  have := signed_sum_le_traceNormForm (Z := C) (bddAbove_pairSum hC) (fun i : F => e i)
5092    (e.orthonormal.comp _ Subtype.val_injective) (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => Or.inl rfl)
5093  have h2 : ∑ i : F, (1 : ℝ) * C (e i) (e i) = ∑ i ∈ F, C (e i) (e i) := by
5094    simp only [one_mul]
5095    exact Finset.sum_coe_sort F (fun i => C (e i) (e i))
5096  rw [h2] at this
5097  exact this
5098
5099end A23Hilb

5190  calc ∑ k ∈ F, ‖inner ℝ (Φ k) x‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ k ∈ F, ‖Φ k‖ₑ ^ 2 * ‖x‖ₑ ^ 2 :=

5214    (ENNReal.mul_lt_top (hΦ T).sq (lt_top_iff_ne_top.2 (pc_enorm_sq_ne_top x)))

5216lemma pc_ae_ne_zero : ∀ᵐ r ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), r ≠ 0 := by
5217  rw [ae_iff]; simp
5218
5219lemma pc_kill_eq {W : ℝ≥0 → Ω → κ → ℝ} (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ W) {Φ : ℝ → Ω → κ → H}
5220    (hΦ : ∀ T, IsHSIntegrand P ℱ T Φ) (x : H) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (F : Finset κ) :
5221    ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ →
5222      itoIntegral P ℱ (fun s ω (k : F) => W s ω k)
5223        (fun r ω (k : F) => if r ≤ t then inner ℝ (Φ r ω k) x else 0) τ ω =
5224      itoIntegral P ℱ (fun s ω (k : F) => W s ω k) (fun r ω (k : F) => inner ℝ (Φ r ω k) x)
5225        (min τ t) ω := by
5226  set u : ℝ → Ω → F → ℝ := fun r ω (k : F) => inner ℝ (Φ r ω k) x with hu
5227  have hL := pc_isProgressiveL2_inner hΦ x F
5228  have hW' := hW F
5229  set g : ℝ → Ω → F → ℝ := fun r ω k => if r ≤ t then u r ω k else 0 with hg
5230  set ind : ℝ → Ω → F → ℝ := fun s ω => Set.indicator (Set.Ioc 0 t) (fun _ => u s ω) s with hind0
5231  have hind : ind = fun r ω k => if r ∈ Set.Ioc 0 t then u r ω k else 0 := by
5232    funext r ω k
5233    simp only [hind0, Set.indicator_apply]
5234    split_ifs <;> rfl
5235  have hLg : IsProgressiveL2 P ℱ g := by
5236    have := pc_isProgressiveL2_ite hL (measurableSet_Iic (a := t))
5237    simpa [hg] using this
5238  have hLind : IsProgressiveL2 P ℱ ind := by
5239    rw [hind]; exact pc_isProgressiveL2_ite hL measurableSet_Ioc
5240  have hcong := itoIntegral_congr hW' hLg hLind (fun T => by
5241    unfold sqIntegralOn
5242    have hz : ∀ᵐ r ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 T)), r ≠ 0 := ae_restrict_of_ae pc_ae_ne_zero
5243    have hz3 : ∀ᵐ r ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 T)), r ∈ Set.Icc 0 T :=
5244      ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc
5245    have hz2 : ∀ ω, ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 T, ∑ k, ‖(g r ω - ind r ω) k‖ₑ ^ 2 = 0 := by
5246      intro ω
5247      rw [lintegral_congr_ae (g := fun _ => 0)]
5248      · simp
5249      · filter_upwards [hz, hz3] with r h1 h2
5250        have hr : 0 < r := lt_of_le_of_ne h2.1 (Ne.symm h1)
5251        have : g r ω = ind r ω := by
5252          rw [hind]; simp only [hg]
5253          by_cases hrt : r ≤ t
5254          · simp [hrt, hr]
5255          · simp [hrt]
5256        simp [this]
5257    exact (lintegral_congr hz2).trans lintegral_zero)
5258  have hI := itoIntegral_indicator_Ioc hW' hL (le_refl 0) ht
5259  filter_upwards [hcong, hI] with ω h1 h2 τ hτ
5260  have e1 := h1 τ
5261  have e2 := h2 τ
5262  have h0 : itoIntegral P ℱ (fun s ω (k : F) => W s ω k) u (min τ 0) ω = 0 :=
5263    itoIntegral_of_nonpos _ _ _ _ (min_le_right _ _) ω
5264  rw [h0, sub_zero] at e2
5265  exact e1.trans e2

5267section PC3B
5268variable {Ω' : Type*} {mΩ' : MeasurableSpace Ω'} {P' : Measure Ω'} [IsProbabilityMeasure P']
5269  {ℱ' : Filtration ℝ mΩ'} {π : Ω' → Ω}
5270variable {ι : Type*} [Countable ι]
5271
5272/-- The killed coordinate integrand `1_{r ≤ t} ⟨Φ_r u_k, x⟩` on `κ ⊕ ι`, supported on `κ`. -/
5273def pcXi (t : ℝ) (Φ : ℝ → Ω → κ → H) (x : H) (ι : Type*) : ℝ → Ω → κ ⊕ ι → ℝ :=
5274  fun r ω => Sum.elim (fun k => if r ≤ t then inner ℝ (Φ r ω k) x else 0) (fun _ => 0)
5275
5276lemma pc_isProgressiveL2_comp (hπm : ∀ s, Measurable[ℱ' s, ℱ s] π) (hπp : MeasurePreserving π P' P)
5277    {s : Type*} [Fintype s] {g : ℝ → Ω → s → ℝ} (hg : IsProgressiveL2 P ℱ g) :
5278    IsProgressiveL2 P' ℱ' (fun r ω' k => g r (π ω') k) :=
5279  ⟨isProgressive_comp_π hπm hg.prog, fun T => by
5280    rw [sqIntegralOn_comp_π hπm hπp hg.prog]; exact hg.sq T⟩
5281
5282lemma pc_ItoF_pad {𝔚' : ℝ≥0 → Ω' → κ ⊕ ι → ℝ} (h𝔚 : IsCylindricalBrownian P' ℱ' 𝔚')
5283    (hπm : ∀ s, Measurable[ℱ' s, ℱ s] π) (hπp : MeasurePreserving π P' P) {Φ : ℝ → Ω → κ → H}
5284    (hΦ : ∀ T, IsHSIntegrand P ℱ T Φ) (x : H) (t : ℝ) (F' : Finset (κ ⊕ ι)) :
5285    ∀ᵐ ω' ∂P', ∀ τ, ItoF P' ℱ' 𝔚' (fun r ω' => pcXi t Φ x ι r (π ω')) F' τ ω' =
5286      itoIntegral P' ℱ'
5287        (fun s ω' (k : F'.preimage Sum.inl Sum.inl_injective.injOn) => 𝔚' s ω' (Sum.inl k))
5288        (fun r ω' (k : F'.preimage Sum.inl Sum.inl_injective.injOn) =>
5289          if r ≤ t then inner ℝ (Φ r (π ω') k) x else 0) τ ω' := by
5290  classical
5291  set Fκ := F'.preimage Sum.inl Sum.inl_injective.injOn with hFκ
5292  let ε : Fκ → F' := fun k => ⟨Sum.inl k, Finset.mem_preimage.1 k.2⟩
5293  have hε : Function.Injective ε := fun a b h =>
5294    Subtype.ext (Sum.inl_injective (congrArg Subtype.val h))
5295  have hLg : IsProgressiveL2 P' ℱ' (fun r ω' (k : Fκ) =>
5296      if r ≤ t then inner ℝ (Φ r (π ω') k) x else 0) := by
5297    have := pc_isProgressiveL2_comp hπm hπp
5298      (pc_isProgressiveL2_ite (pc_isProgressiveL2_inner hΦ x Fκ) (measurableSet_Iic (a := t)))
5299    simpa using this
5300  have h1 := itoIntegral_pad ε hε (W₂ := fun s ω' (a : F') => 𝔚' s ω' a) (h𝔚 F')
5301    ((h𝔚.comp_inj Sum.inl Sum.inl_injective) Fκ) hLg
5302  have hpad : padFun ε (fun r ω' (k : Fκ) => if r ≤ t then inner ℝ (Φ r (π ω') k) x else 0) =
5303      ξF (fun r ω' => pcXi t Φ x ι r (π ω')) F' := by
5304    funext r ω' a
5305    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := a
5306    rcases b with k | l
5307    · have : (⟨Sum.inl k, hb⟩ : F') = ε ⟨k, Finset.mem_preimage.2 hb⟩ := rfl
5308      simp only [padFun, ξF, pcXi]
5309      rw [this, padVec_apply ε hε]
5310      rfl
5311    · have hn : (⟨Sum.inr l, hb⟩ : F') ∉ Set.range ε := by
5312        rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
5313        exact Sum.inl_ne_inr (congrArg Subtype.val hk)
5314      simp only [padFun, ξF, pcXi]
5315      rw [padVec_of_notMem ε _ hn]
5316      rfl
5317  filter_upwards [h1] with ω' h τ
5318  show itoIntegral P' ℱ' (WF 𝔚' F') (ξF (fun r ω' => pcXi t Φ x ι r (π ω')) F') τ ω' = _
5319  rw [← hpad]
5320  exact (h τ).symm
5321
5322theorem pc_Z_isItoC {W : ℝ≥0 → Ω → κ → ℝ} (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ W)
5323    {Φ : ℝ → Ω → κ → H} (hΦ : ∀ T, IsHSIntegrand P ℱ T Φ) {M : ℝ → Ω → H}
5324    (hM : IsHilbertItoIntegral P ℱ W Φ M) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t)
5325    (hπm : ∀ s, Measurable[ℱ' s, ℱ s] π) (hπp : MeasurePreserving π P' P)
5326    {𝔚' : ℝ≥0 → Ω' → κ ⊕ ι → ℝ} (h𝔚 : IsCylindricalBrownian P' ℱ' 𝔚')
5327    (h𝔚l : ∀ s ω' k, 𝔚' s ω' (Sum.inl k) = W s (π ω') k) (x : H) :
5328    IsItoC P' ℱ' 𝔚' (fun r ω' => pcXi t Φ x ι r (π ω'))
5329      (fun τ ω' => inner ℝ (M (min τ t) (π ω')) x) := by
5330  classical
5331  refine ⟨fun ω' => ?_, fun τ => ?_, fun τ hτ ω' => ?_, fun τ hτ => ?_⟩
5332  · exact ((hM.cont (π ω')).comp (continuous_id.min continuous_const)).inner continuous_const
5333  · have h1 : Measurable[ℱ τ] (M (min τ t)) :=
5334      (hM.adapted (min τ t)).mono (ℱ.mono (min_le_left τ t)) le_rfl
5335    exact (h1.inner measurable_const).comp (hπm τ)
5336  · simp [hM.zero (min τ t) ((min_le_left τ t).trans hτ) (π ω')]
5337  · have hlim := hM.approx (min τ t) (le_min hτ ht) x
5338    have hcomp := hlim.comp (tendsto_finset_preimage_atTop_atTop
5339      (Sum.inl_injective (α := κ) (β := ι)))
5340    refine hcomp.congr (fun F' => ?_)
5341    set Fκ := F'.preimage Sum.inl Sum.inl_injective.injOn with hFκ
5342    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
5343    -- the functions on Ω
5344    set u : ℝ → Ω → Fκ → ℝ := fun r ω (k : Fκ) => inner ℝ (Φ r ω k) x with hu
5345    set gΩ : ℝ → Ω → Fκ → ℝ := fun r ω k => if r ≤ t then u r ω k else 0 with hgΩ
5346    have hgL : IsProgressiveL2 P ℱ gΩ := by
5347      have := pc_isProgressiveL2_ite (pc_isProgressiveL2_inner hΦ x Fκ) (measurableSet_Iic (a := t))
5348      simpa [hgΩ, hu] using this
5349    have hWF : IsBrownianFiltration P ℱ (fun s ω (k : Fκ) => W s ω k) := hW Fκ
5350    have hWF' : IsBrownianFiltration P' ℱ' (fun s ω' (k : Fκ) => W s (π ω') k) := by
5351      have := (h𝔚.comp_inj Sum.inl Sum.inl_injective) Fκ
5352      have e : (fun s ω' (k : Fκ) => 𝔚' s ω' (Sum.inl (k : κ))) =
5353          (fun s ω' (k : Fκ) => W s (π ω') k) := by
5354        funext s ω' k; exact h𝔚l s ω' k
5355      rw [← e]; exact this
5356    have hK2 := itoIntegral_comp_π hπm hπp hWF hWF' hgL
5357    have hK1 := hπp.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (pc_kill_eq hW hΦ x ht Fκ)
5358    have hK3 := pc_ItoF_pad h𝔚 hπm hπp hΦ x t F'
5359    have hWeq : (fun s ω' (k : Fκ) => 𝔚' s ω' (Sum.inl (k : κ))) =
5360        (fun s ω' (k : Fκ) => W s (π ω') k) := by
5361      funext s ω' k; exact h𝔚l s ω' k
5362    have hae : ∀ᵐ ω' ∂P', ‖ItoF P' ℱ' 𝔚' (fun r ω' => pcXi t Φ x ι r (π ω')) F' τ ω' -
5363          inner ℝ (M (min τ t) (π ω')) x‖ₑ ^ 2 =
5364        (fun ω => ‖itoIntegral P ℱ (fun s ω (k : Fκ) => W s ω k) u (min τ t) ω -
5365          inner ℝ (M (min τ t) ω) x‖ₑ ^ 2) (π ω') := by
5366      filter_upwards [hK3, hK2, hK1] with ω' h3 h2 h1
5367      rw [h3 τ, hWeq]
5368      have e := (h2 τ).trans (h1 τ hτ)
5369      rw [e]
5370    have hmeas : Measurable (fun ω => ‖itoIntegral P ℱ (fun s ω (k : Fκ) => W s ω k) u (min τ t) ω -
5371          inner ℝ (M (min τ t) ω) x‖ₑ ^ 2) :=
5372      ((((adapted_itoIntegral P ℱ (fun s ω (k : Fκ) => W s ω k) u (min τ t)).mono (ℱ.le _) le_rfl).sub
5373        (((hM.adapted (min τ t)).mono (ℱ.le _) le_rfl).inner measurable_const)).enorm).pow_const 2
5374    rw [lintegral_congr_ae hae, hπp.lintegral_comp hmeas]
5375
5376end PC3B
5377end PC3

5379section PC4
5380open Classical
5381
5382variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
5383  {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ} {A : Type*} [Countable A] {ι : Type*} [Countable ι]
5384
5385lemma pc_isCtbl_sub {ξ ξ' : ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ} (hξ : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ) (hξ' : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ') :
5386    IsCtbl P ℱ (fun r ω a => ξ r ω a - ξ' r ω a) := by
5387  have h := hξ.add (hξ'.mul_bdd (w := fun _ _ => (-1 : ℝ)) (isProgressive_const ℱ _) (C := 1)
5388    (fun r ω => by simp))
5389  convert h using 3 with r ω a
5390  ring
5391
5392theorem pc_bridge {𝔚 : ℝ≥0 → Ω → A → ℝ} (h𝔚 : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ 𝔚)
5393    {ψ : ι → ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ} (hψ : ∀ j, IsCtbl P ℱ (ψ j))
5394    {Bj : ι → ℝ → Ω → ℝ} (hB : ∀ j, IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 (ψ j) (Bj j))
5395    (hBr : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ (fun t ω j => Bj j (t : ℝ) ω))
5396    (hortho : ∀ r ω i j, HasSum (fun a => ψ i r ω a * ψ j r ω a) (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0))
5397    {f : ℝ → Ω → ι → ℝ} (hf : IsCtbl P ℱ f)
5398    {Ξ : ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ} (hΞ : IsCtbl P ℱ Ξ) {Z : ℝ → Ω → ℝ} (hZ : IsItoC P ℱ 𝔚 Ξ Z)
5399    (hsum : ∀ r ω, Summable fun j => f r ω j ^ 2)
5400    (hE2 : ∀ (s : Finset ι) r ω, HasSum
5401      (fun a => (Ξ r ω a - ∑ j ∈ s, f r ω j * ψ j r ω a) ^ 2)
5402      (∑' j, if j ∈ s then 0 else f r ω j ^ 2))
5403    (τ : ℝ) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) :
5404    Tendsto (fun s : Finset ι => ∫⁻ ω, ‖itoIntegral P ℱ
5405      (fun t ω (k : s) => (fun t ω j => Bj j (t : ℝ) ω) t ω k) (fun r ω (k : s) => f r ω k) τ ω
5406        - Z τ ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
5407  have hbound : ∀ s : Finset ι, ∫⁻ ω, ‖itoIntegral P ℱ
5408      (fun t ω (k : s) => (fun t ω j => Bj j (t : ℝ) ω) t ω k) (fun r ω (k : s) => f r ω k) τ ω
5409        - Z τ ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P ≤ tailC P f s τ := by
5410    intro s
5411    -- the finite-family data
5412    set ψs : s → ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ := fun j => ψ (j : ι) with hψs
5413    set fs : ℝ → Ω → s → ℝ := fun r ω (k : s) => f r ω k with hfs
5414    have hfL : IsProgressiveL2 P ℱ fs := hf.progressiveL2 s
5415    have hortho_s : ∀ r ω (j j' : s), HasSum (fun a => ψs j r ω a * ψs j' r ω a)
5416        (@ite ℝ (j = j') (Classical.propDecidable _) 1 0) := fun r ω j j' => by
5417      have := hortho r ω j j'
5418      by_cases h : j = j'
5419      · subst h; simpa using this
5420      · have h' : (j : ι) ≠ j' := fun e => h (Subtype.ext e)
5421        simpa [h, h'] using this
5422    have hψprog : ∀ (j : s) a, IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => ψs j r ω a) := fun j a => (hψ j).prog a
5423    have hΞs : IsCtbl P ℱ (fun r ω a => ∑ j : s, fs r ω j * ψs j r ω a) :=
5424      isCtbl_comb hψprog hortho_s hfL
5425    obtain ⟨Y, hY⟩ := exists_isItoC h𝔚 hΞs
5426    have hassoc := isItoIntegral_assoc (ψ := ψs) h𝔚 (fun j => hψ j) (Bj := fun j => Bj j)
5427      (fun j => hB j) (hBr s) hortho_s hfL hY
5428    have hae := IsItoIntegral.ae_eq_forall (hBr s) (isItoIntegral_itoIntegral (hBr s) hfL) hassoc hfL
5429    have hdiff := IsItoC.sub h𝔚 hΞ hΞs hZ hY
5430    have hΞd : IsCtbl P ℱ (fun r ω a => Ξ r ω a - ∑ j : s, fs r ω j * ψs j r ω a) :=
5431      pc_isCtbl_sub hΞ hΞs
5432    have hsq := hdiff.lintegral_sq_le hΞd h𝔚 hτ
5433    have hRHS : ∑' a, cT P (fun r ω a => Ξ r ω a - ∑ j : s, fs r ω j * ψs j r ω a) a τ =
5434        tailC P f s τ := by
5435      rw [pc_tsum_cT hΞd.prog τ]
5436      have e : ∀ r ω, ∑' a, ‖Ξ r ω a - ∑ j : s, fs r ω j * ψs j r ω a‖ₑ ^ 2 =
5437          ∑' j, ‖ξtail f s r ω j‖ₑ ^ 2 := by
5438        intro r ω
5439        have hfun : ∀ a, Ξ r ω a - ∑ j : s, fs r ω j * ψs j r ω a =
5440            Ξ r ω a - ∑ j ∈ s, f r ω j * ψ j r ω a := fun a => by
5441          rw [Finset.sum_coe_sort s (fun j => f r ω j * ψ j r ω a)]
5442        have h1 : HasSum (fun a => (Ξ r ω a - ∑ j : s, fs r ω j * ψs j r ω a) ^ 2)
5443            (∑' j, if j ∈ s then 0 else f r ω j ^ 2) := by
5444          simp only [hfun]; exact hE2 s r ω
5445        have hfun2 : (fun j => (ξtail f s r ω j) ^ 2) = fun j => if j ∈ s then 0 else f r ω j ^ 2 := by
5446          funext j; unfold ξtail; split_ifs <;> simp
5447        have hs' : Summable (fun j => if j ∈ s then (0 : ℝ) else f r ω j ^ 2) :=
5448          Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun j => by split_ifs <;> simp [sq_nonneg])
5449            (fun j => by split_ifs <;> simp [sq_nonneg]) (hsum r ω)
5450        have h2 : HasSum (fun j => (ξtail f s r ω j) ^ 2) (∑' j, if j ∈ s then 0 else f r ω j ^ 2) := by
5451          rw [hfun2]; exact hs'.hasSum
5452        rw [enorm_tsum_sq_of_hasSum h1, enorm_tsum_sq_of_hasSum h2]
5453      calc ∫⁻ ω, (∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 τ, ∑' a,
5454              ‖Ξ r ω a - ∑ j : s, fs r ω j * ψs j r ω a‖ₑ ^ 2) ∂P
5455          = ∫⁻ ω, (∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 τ, ∑' j, ‖ξtail f s r ω j‖ₑ ^ 2) ∂P :=
5456            lintegral_congr fun ω => lintegral_congr fun r => e r ω
5457        _ = ∑' j, cT P (ξtail f s) j τ := (pc_tsum_cT (isProgressive_ξtail hf.prog s) τ).symm
5458        _ = tailC P f s τ := tsum_congr fun j => cT_ξtail s j τ
5459    rw [hRHS] at hsq
5460    calc ∫⁻ ω, ‖itoIntegral P ℱ (fun t ω (k : s) => (fun t ω j => Bj j (t : ℝ) ω) t ω k)
5461          (fun r ω (k : s) => f r ω k) τ ω - Z τ ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P
5462        = ∫⁻ ω, ‖(Z τ ω - Y τ ω)‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P := by
5463          refine lintegral_congr_ae ?_
5464          filter_upwards [hae] with ω h
5465          rw [h τ, enorm_sub_rev]
5466      _ ≤ tailC P f s τ := hsq
5467  exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds (tailC_tendsto hf τ)
5468    (fun s => bot_le) hbound
5469
5470end PC4

5472section PC6
5473open Classical
5474
5475/-- A countable dense subset of `[0,N]` (together with the endpoints). -/
5476def pcD (N : ℝ) : Set ℝ := (Set.Ioo 0 N ∩ Set.range ((↑) : ℚ → ℝ)) ∪ {0, N}
5477
5478lemma pcD_countable (N : ℝ) : (pcD N).Countable :=
5479  (((Set.countable_range _).mono Set.inter_subset_right).union
5480    (Set.toFinite ({0, N} : Set ℝ)).countable)
5481
5482lemma pcD_subset {N : ℝ} (hN : 0 ≤ N) : pcD N ⊆ Set.Icc 0 N := by
5483  rintro d (⟨hd, -⟩ | hd)
5484  · exact ⟨hd.1.le, hd.2.le⟩
5485  · rcases hd with rfl | rfl
5486    · exact ⟨le_rfl, hN⟩
5487    · exact ⟨hN, le_rfl⟩
5488
5489lemma pc_iSup_icc_eq {I : ℝ → ℝ} (hc : Continuous I) {N : ℝ} (hN : 0 ≤ N) :
5490    (⨆ τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) N, ‖I τ‖ₑ) = ⨆ d ∈ pcD N, ‖I d‖ₑ := by
5491  refine le_antisymm ?_ (biSup_mono (pcD_subset hN))
5492  set c := ⨆ d ∈ pcD N, ‖I d‖ₑ with hc'
5493  have hcl : IsClosed {τ | ‖I τ‖ₑ ≤ c} := isClosed_le hc.enorm continuous_const
5494  have hDsub' : pcD N ⊆ {τ | ‖I τ‖ₑ ≤ c} := fun d hd =>
5495    le_iSup₂ (f := fun d (_ : d ∈ pcD N) => ‖I d‖ₑ) d hd
5496  have h1 : closure (pcD N) ⊆ {τ | ‖I τ‖ₑ ≤ c} := closure_minimal hDsub' hcl
5497  refine iSup₂_le fun τ hτ => ?_
5498  have : τ ∈ closure (pcD N) := by
5499    by_cases h0 : τ = 0 ∨ τ = N
5500    · exact subset_closure (Or.inr (by rcases h0 with h | h <;> simp [h]))
5501    · push_neg at h0
5502      have hτ' : τ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 N := ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hτ.1 (Ne.symm h0.1), lt_of_le_of_ne hτ.2 h0.2⟩
5503      have := Rat.denseRange_cast.open_subset_closure_inter (isOpen_Ioo (a := (0:ℝ)) (b := N)) hτ'
5504      exact closure_mono Set.subset_union_left this
5505  exact h1 this
5506
5507lemma pc_measurable_iSup_icc {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {I : ℝ → Ω → ℝ}
5508    (hc : ∀ ω, Continuous fun τ => I τ ω) (hm : ∀ τ, Measurable (I τ)) (N : ℝ) :
5509    Measurable fun ω => ⨆ τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) N, ‖I τ ω‖ₑ := by
5510  rcases lt_or_ge N 0 with hN | hN
5511  · have : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) N = ∅ := Set.Icc_eq_empty (not_le.2 hN)
5512    simp [this]
5513  · have e : (fun ω => ⨆ τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) N, ‖I τ ω‖ₑ) =
5514        fun ω => ⨆ d ∈ pcD N, ‖I d ω‖ₑ := funext fun ω => pc_iSup_icc_eq (hc ω) hN
5515    rw [e]
5516    have : Countable (pcD N) := (pcD_countable N).to_subtype
5517    have e2 : (fun ω => ⨆ d ∈ pcD N, ‖I d ω‖ₑ) = fun ω => ⨆ d : pcD N, ‖I d ω‖ₑ :=
5518      funext fun ω => iSup_subtype'
5519    rw [e2]
5520    exact Measurable.iSup fun d => (hm d).enorm
