5522section PCVec
5523variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
5524variable {ι : Type*}
5525
5526lemma pc_memℓp {c : ι → ℝ} (h : Summable fun i => c i ^ 2) : Memℓp c 2 := by
5527  refine memℓp_gen ?_
5528  simpa [Real.rpow_two] using h
5529
5530/-- The vector `∑ c_i e_i` for a square-summable coefficient family (`0` otherwise). -/
5531def pcVec (e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H) (c : ι → ℝ) : H :=
5532  if h : Summable (fun i => c i ^ 2) then e.repr.symm ⟨c, pc_memℓp h⟩ else 0
5533
5534lemma pcVec_hasSum (e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H) {c : ι → ℝ} (h : Summable fun i => c i ^ 2) :
5535    HasSum (fun i => c i • e i) (pcVec e c) := by
5536  simp only [pcVec, dif_pos h]
5537  exact e.hasSum_repr_symm ⟨c, pc_memℓp h⟩
5538
5539lemma pcVec_inner_basis (e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H) {c : ι → ℝ} (h : Summable fun i => c i ^ 2)
5540    (i : ι) : inner ℝ (pcVec e c) (e i) = c i := by
5541  have := (pcVec_hasSum e h).mapL (innerSL ℝ (e i))
5542  have h2 : ∀ k, inner ℝ (e i) (c k • e k) = c k * inner ℝ (e i) (e k) := fun k => by
5543    rw [real_inner_smul_right]
5544  classical
5545  have h3 : ∀ k, inner ℝ (e i) (e k) = if i = k then (1:ℝ) else 0 := fun k => by
5546    rw [orthonormal_iff_ite.1 e.orthonormal]
5547  simp only [innerSL_apply_apply, h2, h3] at this
5548  have h4 : ∀ k, c k * (if i = k then (1:ℝ) else 0) = if i = k then c k else 0 := fun k => by
5549    split_ifs <;> simp
5550  simp only [h4] at this
5551  have h5 : HasSum (fun k => if i = k then c k else 0) (c i) := by
5552    have := hasSum_single (f := fun k => if i = k then c k else 0) i
5553      (fun k hk => by simp [Ne.symm hk])
5554    simpa using this
5555  rw [real_inner_comm]
5556  exact (this.unique h5)
5557
5558lemma pcVec_hasSum_sq (e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H) {c : ι → ℝ} (h : Summable fun i => c i ^ 2) :
5559    HasSum (fun i => c i ^ 2) (‖pcVec e c‖ ^ 2) := by
5560  have := e.hasSum_inner_mul_inner (pcVec e c) (pcVec e c)
5561  rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at this
5562  convert this using 2 with i
5563  have h6 : inner ℝ (e i) (pcVec e c) = c i := by
5564    rw [real_inner_comm]; exact pcVec_inner_basis e h i
5565  rw [h6, pcVec_inner_basis e h i, sq]
5566
5567lemma pcVec_hasSum_inner (e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H) {c : ι → ℝ} (h : Summable fun i => c i ^ 2)
5568    (x : H) : HasSum (fun i => c i * inner ℝ (e i) x) (inner ℝ (pcVec e c) x) := by
5569  have := (pcVec_hasSum e h).mapL (innerSL ℝ x)
5570  simp only [innerSL_apply_apply, real_inner_smul_right] at this
5571  rw [real_inner_comm] at this
5572  convert this using 2 with i
5573  rw [real_inner_comm]
5574
5575lemma pcVec_zero (e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H) : pcVec e (fun _ => 0) = 0 := by
5576  have h : Summable fun i : ι => ((fun _ => (0:ℝ)) i) ^ 2 := by simpa using summable_zero
5577  have := pcVec_hasSum e h
5578  simp only [zero_smul] at this
5579  exact this.unique hasSum_zero
5580
5581lemma summable_sq_sub {c d : ι → ℝ} (hc : Summable fun i => c i ^ 2) (hd : Summable fun i => d i ^ 2) :
5582    Summable fun i => (c i - d i) ^ 2 := by
5583  refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun i => sq_nonneg _) (fun i => ?_)
5584    ((hc.mul_left 2).add (hd.mul_left 2))
5585  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (c i + d i)]
5586
5587lemma pcVec_sub (e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H) {c d : ι → ℝ} (hc : Summable fun i => c i ^ 2)
5588    (hd : Summable fun i => d i ^ 2) : pcVec e (fun i => c i - d i) = pcVec e c - pcVec e d := by
5589  have h1 := (pcVec_hasSum e hc).sub (pcVec_hasSum e hd)
5590  have h2 := pcVec_hasSum e (summable_sq_sub hc hd)
5591  simp only [sub_smul] at h2
5592  exact h2.unique h1
5593
5594lemma pcVec_finsupp (e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H) (c : ι → ℝ) (F : Finset ι) :
5595    pcVec e (fun i => if i ∈ F then c i else 0) = ∑ i ∈ F, c i • e i := by
5596  classical
5597  have hs : Summable fun i => ((fun i => if i ∈ F then c i else 0) i) ^ 2 :=
5598    summable_of_ne_finset_zero (s := F) fun i hi => by simp [hi]
5599  have h1 := pcVec_hasSum e hs
5600  have h2 : HasSum (fun i => (if i ∈ F then c i else 0) • e i) (∑ i ∈ F, c i • e i) := by
5601    have h3 : HasSum (fun i => (if i ∈ F then c i else 0) • e i)
5602        (∑ i ∈ F, (if i ∈ F then c i else 0) • e i) :=
5603      hasSum_sum_of_ne_finset_zero (fun i hi => by simp [hi])
5604    convert h3 using 1
5605    exact (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => by simp [hi]).symm
5606  exact h1.unique h2
5607
5608lemma pc_tsum_compl_eq (f : ι → ℝ) (F : Finset ι) :
5609    ∑' b : {x // x ∉ F}, f b = ∑' i, if i ∈ F then 0 else f i := by
5610  have := tsum_subtype ({x | x ∉ F} : Set ι) f
5611  rw [show (∑' b : {x // x ∉ F}, f b) = ∑' x : ({x | x ∉ F} : Set ι), f x from rfl, this]
5612  refine tsum_congr fun i => ?_
5613  by_cases hi : i ∈ F <;> simp [Set.indicator, hi]
5614
5615theorem pc_continuous_pcVec (e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H) (c : ℝ → ι → ℝ)
5616    (hcont : ∀ i, Continuous fun τ => c τ i) (hzero : ∀ (i : ι) (τ : ℝ), τ ≤ 0 → c τ i = 0)
5617    (σ : ℕ → ι → ℝ) (hσ0 : ∀ N i, 0 ≤ σ N i) (hσs : ∀ N, Summable fun i => σ N i ^ 2)
5618    (hb : ∀ (N : ℕ) (i : ι) (τ : ℝ), 0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ N → |c τ i| ≤ σ N i) :
5619    Continuous fun τ => pcVec e (c τ) := by
5620  classical
5621  have hb' : ∀ (N : ℕ) (i : ι) (τ : ℝ), τ ≤ N → |c τ i| ≤ σ N i := fun N i τ hτ => by
5622    by_cases h0 : 0 ≤ τ
5623    · exact hb N i τ h0 hτ
5624    · rw [hzero i τ (not_le.1 h0).le]; simpa using hσ0 N i
5625  have hs : ∀ τ, Summable fun i => c τ i ^ 2 := fun τ => by
5626    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_ge τ
5627    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun i => sq_nonneg _) (fun i => ?_) (hσs N)
5628    rw [← sq_abs (c τ i)]
5629    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (hb' N i τ hN) 2
5630  -- the finite-sum approximants
5631  set D : Finset ι → ℝ → H := fun F τ => ∑ i ∈ F, c τ i • e i with hD
5632  have hDc : ∀ F, Continuous (D F) := fun F =>
5633    continuous_finsetSum _ fun i _ => (hcont i).smul continuous_const
5634  have hdist : ∀ (N : ℕ) (F : Finset ι) (τ : ℝ), τ ≤ N →
5635      ‖pcVec e (c τ) - D F τ‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∑' i, if i ∈ F then 0 else σ N i ^ 2 := by
5636    intro N F τ hτ
5637    have h1 : pcVec e (c τ) - D F τ = pcVec e (fun i => if i ∈ F then 0 else c τ i) := by
5638      have hsF : Summable fun i => ((fun i => if i ∈ F then c τ i else 0) i) ^ 2 :=
5639        summable_of_ne_finset_zero (s := F) fun i hi => by simp [hi]
5640      have := pcVec_sub e (hs τ) hsF
5641      rw [pcVec_finsupp] at this
5642      rw [hD]; simp only
5643      rw [← this]
5644      congr 1
5645      funext i
5646      by_cases hi : i ∈ F <;> simp [hi]
5647    have hsq : Summable fun i => ((fun i => if i ∈ F then (0:ℝ) else c τ i) i) ^ 2 :=
5648      Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun i => sq_nonneg _) (fun i => by
5649        by_cases hi : i ∈ F <;> simp [hi, sq_nonneg]) (hs τ)
5650    rw [h1, ← (pcVec_hasSum_sq e hsq).tsum_eq]
5651    have hsσ : Summable fun i => if i ∈ F then (0:ℝ) else σ N i ^ 2 :=
5652      Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun i => by by_cases hi : i ∈ F <;> simp [hi, sq_nonneg])
5653        (fun i => by by_cases hi : i ∈ F <;> simp [hi, sq_nonneg]) (hσs N)
5654    refine Summable.tsum_le_tsum (fun i => ?_) hsq hsσ
5655    by_cases hi : i ∈ F
5656    · simp [hi]
5657    · simp only [hi, if_false]
5658      rw [← sq_abs (c τ i)]
5659      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (hb' N i τ hτ) 2
5660  have htail : ∀ N : ℕ, Tendsto (fun F : Finset ι => ∑' i, if i ∈ F then 0 else σ N i ^ 2) atTop
5661      (𝓝 0) := by
5662    intro N
5663    have := tendsto_tsum_compl_atTop_zero (fun i => σ N i ^ 2)
5664    exact this.congr fun F => pc_tsum_compl_eq (fun i => σ N i ^ 2) F
5665  have hunif : ∀ N : ℕ, TendstoUniformlyOn D (fun τ => pcVec e (c τ)) atTop
5666      (Set.Icc (-(N : ℝ)) N) := by
5667    intro N
5668    rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
5669    intro ε hε
5670    have := (htail N).eventually (gt_mem_nhds (show (0:ℝ) < ε ^ 2 by positivity))
5671    filter_upwards [this] with F hF τ hτ
5672    rw [dist_eq_norm]
5673    exact lt_of_pow_lt_pow_left₀ 2 hε.le (lt_of_le_of_lt (hdist N F τ hτ.2) hF)
5674  have hcon : ∀ N : ℕ, ContinuousOn (fun τ => pcVec e (c τ)) (Set.Icc (-(N : ℝ)) N) := fun N =>
5675    (hunif N).continuousOn (Eventually.frequently (Eventually.of_forall fun F => (hDc F).continuousOn))
5676  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
5677  intro τ₀
5678  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (|τ₀| + 1)
5679  have hmem : Set.Icc (-(N : ℝ)) N ∈ 𝓝 τ₀ :=
5680    Icc_mem_nhds (by linarith [neg_abs_le τ₀]) (by linarith [le_abs_self τ₀])
5681  exact (hcon N).continuousAt hmem
5682
5683end PCVec
5684
5685section PCHv
5686variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
5687  {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ}
5688variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
5689  [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]
5690variable {ι : Type*} [Countable ι]
5691
5692lemma pc_summable_of_enorm_tsum_ne_top {c : ι → ℝ} (h : ∑' i, ‖c i‖ₑ ^ 2 ≠ ⊤) :
5693    Summable fun i => c i ^ 2 := by
5694  refine (ENNReal.summable_toReal h).congr fun i => ?_
5695  rw [enorm_sq_eq_ofReal, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (sq_nonneg _)]
5696
5697theorem pc_hvalued (hℱ : IsCompleteFiltration P ℱ) (e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H)
5698    (I : ι → ℝ → Ω → ℝ) (hcont : ∀ i ω, Continuous fun τ => I i τ ω)
5699    (hadapt : ∀ i τ, Measurable[ℱ τ] (I i τ)) (hzero : ∀ i τ, τ ≤ 0 → ∀ ω, I i τ ω = 0)
5700    (hdoob : ∀ N : ℕ, ∑' i, ∫⁻ ω, (⨆ τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) N, ‖I i τ ω‖ₑ) ^ 2 ∂P ≠ ⊤) :
5701    ∃ G : ℝ → Ω → H, (∀ ω, Continuous fun τ => G τ ω) ∧ (∀ τ, Measurable[ℱ τ] (G τ)) ∧
5702      (∀ τ, τ ≤ 0 → ∀ ω, G τ ω = 0) ∧
5703      ∀ τ, ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, Summable (fun i => I i τ ω ^ 2) ∧ G τ ω = pcVec e (fun i => I i τ ω) := by
5704  classical
5705  set s : ι → ℕ → Ω → ℝ≥0∞ := fun i N ω => ⨆ τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) N, ‖I i τ ω‖ₑ with hs
5706  have hsm : ∀ i N, Measurable (s i N) := fun i N =>
5707    pc_measurable_iSup_icc (hcont i) (fun τ => (hadapt i τ).mono (ℱ.le τ) le_rfl) N
5708  set T : ℕ → Ω → ℝ≥0∞ := fun N ω => ∑' i, (s i N ω) ^ 2 with hT
5709  have hTm : ∀ N, Measurable (T N) := fun N =>
5710    Measurable.ennreal_tsum fun i => (hsm i N).pow_const 2
5711  have hTfin : ∀ N, ∫⁻ ω, T N ω ∂P ≠ ⊤ := fun N => by
5712    simp only [hT]
5713    rw [lintegral_tsum fun i => ((hsm i N).pow_const 2).aemeasurable]
5714    exact hdoob N
5715  have hae : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ∀ N, T N ω < ⊤ := ae_all_iff.2 fun N => ae_lt_top (hTm N) (hTfin N)
5716  set Good : Set Ω := {ω | ∀ N, T N ω < ⊤} with hGood
5717  have hGoodm : MeasurableSet Good := by
5718    have : Good = ⋂ N, {ω | T N ω < ⊤} := by ext; simp [hGood]
5719    rw [this]
5720    exact MeasurableSet.iInter fun N => measurableSet_lt (hTm N) measurable_const
5721  have hGoodc : ∀ τ, MeasurableSet[ℱ τ] Good := fun τ =>
5722    MeasurableSet.of_compl (hℱ τ _ hGoodm.compl (ae_iff.1 hae))
5723  have hsfin : ∀ ω ∈ Good, ∀ i N, s i N ω ≠ ⊤ := by
5724    intro ω hω i N hne
5725    have h1 : (s i N ω) ^ 2 ≤ T N ω := ENNReal.le_tsum (f := fun i => (s i N ω) ^ 2) i
5726    have h2 : (s i N ω) ^ 2 = ⊤ := by rw [hne]; exact ENNReal.top_pow (by norm_num)
5727    exact absurd (h2 ▸ h1) (not_le.2 (hω N))
5728  have hle : ∀ ω (i : ι) (N : ℕ) (τ : ℝ), 0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ N → ‖I i τ ω‖ₑ ≤ s i N ω := fun ω i N τ h0 hN =>
5729    le_iSup₂ (f := fun τ (_ : τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) N) => ‖I i τ ω‖ₑ) τ ⟨h0, hN⟩
5730  have hsumm : ∀ ω ∈ Good, ∀ τ, Summable (fun i => I i τ ω ^ 2) := by
5731    intro ω hω τ
5732    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_ge τ
5733    refine pc_summable_of_enorm_tsum_ne_top (ne_top_of_le_ne_top (hω N).ne ?_)
5734    refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun i => ?_
5735    by_cases hτ : 0 ≤ τ
5736    · have := hle ω i N τ hτ hN
5737      gcongr
5738    · have : I i τ ω = 0 := hzero i τ (not_le.1 hτ).le ω
5739      simp [this]
5740  set G : ℝ → Ω → H := fun τ ω => if ω ∈ Good then pcVec e (fun i => I i τ ω) else 0 with hG
5741  refine ⟨G, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
5742  · intro ω
5743    by_cases hω : ω ∈ Good
5744    · simp only [hG, hω, ite_true]
5745      refine pc_continuous_pcVec e (fun τ i => I i τ ω) (fun i => hcont i ω)
5746        (fun i τ hτ => hzero i τ hτ ω) (fun N i => (s i N ω).toReal) (fun N i => ENNReal.toReal_nonneg)
5747        (fun N => ?_) (fun N i τ h0 hN => ?_)
5748      · have := ENNReal.summable_toReal (hω N).ne
5749        refine this.congr fun i => ?_
5750        simp [ENNReal.toReal_pow]
5751      · have h1 := ENNReal.toReal_mono (hsfin ω hω i N) (hle ω i N τ h0 hN)
5752        rwa [toReal_enorm, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
5753    · have : (fun τ => G τ ω) = fun _ => 0 := by funext τ; simp [hG, hω]
5754      rw [this]; exact continuous_const
5755  · intro τ
5756    letI : MeasurableSpace Ω := ℱ τ
5757    have hf : ∀ F : Finset ι,
5758        Measurable (Good.indicator (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ F, I i τ ω • e i)) := fun F =>
5759      (Finset.measurable_sum _ fun i _ => (hadapt i τ).smul_const (e i)).indicator (hGoodc τ)
5760    refine measurable_of_tendsto_metrizable' (atTop : Filter (Finset ι)) hf
5761      (tendsto_pi_nhds.2 fun ω => ?_)
5762    by_cases hω : ω ∈ Good
5763    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hω, hG, hω, ite_true]
5764      exact pcVec_hasSum e (hsumm ω hω τ)
5765    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hω, hG, hω, ite_false]
5766      exact tendsto_const_nhds
5767  · intro τ hτ ω
5768    by_cases hω : ω ∈ Good
5769    · simp only [hG, hω, ite_true]
5770      have : (fun i => I i τ ω) = fun _ => 0 := funext fun i => hzero i τ hτ ω
5771      rw [this]; exact pcVec_zero e
5772    · simp [hG, hω]
5773  · intro τ
5774    filter_upwards [hae] with ω hω
5775    have hωG : ω ∈ Good := hω
5776    exact ⟨hsumm ω hωG τ, by simp [hG, hωG]⟩
5777
5778end PCHv
5779end PC6
5780
5781section PC7a
5782
5783lemma pc_ae_eq_of_limits {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P] {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ}
5784    {Y Z : Ω → ℝ} (hX : ∀ n, AEMeasurable (X n) P) (hZ : AEMeasurable Z P)
5785    (hY : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, Tendsto (fun n => X n ω) atTop (𝓝 (Y ω)))
5786    (hXZ : Tendsto (fun n => ∫⁻ ω, ‖X n ω - Z ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P) atTop (𝓝 0)) : Y =ᵐ[P] Z := by
5787  have hYm : AEMeasurable Y P := aemeasurable_of_tendsto_metrizable_ae atTop hX hY
5788  have h1 : ∫⁻ ω, ‖Y ω - Z ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P ≤ liminf (fun n => ∫⁻ ω, ‖X n ω - Z ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P) atTop := by
5789    calc ∫⁻ ω, ‖Y ω - Z ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P = ∫⁻ ω, liminf (fun n => ‖X n ω - Z ω‖ₑ ^ 2) atTop ∂P := by
5790          refine lintegral_congr_ae ?_
5791          filter_upwards [hY] with ω hω
5792          have : Tendsto (fun n => ‖X n ω - Z ω‖ₑ ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 (‖Y ω - Z ω‖ₑ ^ 2)) :=
5793            ((ENNReal.continuous_pow 2).tendsto _).comp
5794              ((continuous_enorm.tendsto _).comp (hω.sub_const (Z ω)))
5795          exact this.liminf_eq.symm
5796      _ ≤ _ := lintegral_liminf_le' fun n => ((hX n).sub hZ).enorm.pow_const 2
5797  rw [hXZ.liminf_eq] at h1
5798  have h0 : ∫⁻ ω, ‖Y ω - Z ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P = 0 := le_antisymm h1 bot_le
5799  filter_upwards [ae_eq_zero_of_lintegral_enorm_sq_eq_zero (hYm.sub hZ) h0] with ω h
5800  simpa [sub_eq_zero] using h
5801
5802end PC7a
5803
5804section PC7
5805open Classical HilbertCLTAux
5806
5807variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
5808  {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ}
5809variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
5810  [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]
5811variable {ι : Type*} [Countable ι]
5812
5813/-- Data for a deterministic operator-valued integrand `Sb` on `[0,t]` against `B`. -/
5814structure PCDetData (e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H) (t : ℝ) (Sb : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H) (T : ℝ → ℝ) : Prop where
5815  meas : OpMeas Sb
5816  zero : ∀ r, r ∉ Set.Icc 0 t → Sb r = 0
5817  parseval : ∀ r x, HasSum (fun j => inner ℝ (Sb r (e j)) x ^ 2) (‖Sb r x‖ ^ 2)
5818  bound : ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 t, ∀ x, ‖Sb r x‖ ^ 2 ≤ T r * ‖x‖ ^ 2
5819  trace : ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 t, HasSum (fun i => ‖Sb r (e i)‖ ^ 2) (T r)
5820  Tmeas : Measurable T
5821  Tnonneg : ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 t, 0 ≤ T r
5822  Tint : IntegrableOn T (Set.Icc 0 t)
5823
5824/-- The deterministic integrand `1_{r ≤ t} ⟨Sb_r e_j, x⟩`. -/
5825def fSb (e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H) (t : ℝ) (Sb : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H) (x : H) :
5826    ℝ → Ω → ι → ℝ := fun r _ j => if r ≤ t then inner ℝ (Sb r (e j)) x else 0
5827
5828variable {e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H} {t : ℝ} {Sb : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H} {T : ℝ → ℝ}
5829
5830lemma PCDetData.prog (hD : PCDetData e t Sb T) (x : H) (j : ι) :
5831    IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => fSb (Ω := Ω) e t Sb x r ω j) :=
5832  pc_isProgressive_det (g := fun r => if r ≤ t then inner ℝ (Sb r (e j)) x else 0)
5833    (Measurable.ite measurableSet_Iic ((hD.meas (e j)).inner measurable_const) measurable_const)
5834
5835lemma PCDetData.tsum_eq (hD : PCDetData e t Sb T) (x : H) (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) :
5836    ∑' j, ‖fSb e t Sb x r ω j‖ₑ ^ 2 = ENNReal.ofReal (if r ≤ t then ‖Sb r x‖ ^ 2 else 0) := by
5837  by_cases hr : r ≤ t
5838  · simp only [fSb, hr, ite_true]
5839    exact enorm_tsum_sq_of_hasSum (hD.parseval r x)
5840  · simp [fSb, hr]
5841
5842lemma PCDetData.tsum_le (hD : PCDetData e t Sb T) (x : H) (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) :
5843    ∑' j, ‖fSb e t Sb x r ω j‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤
5844      ENNReal.ofReal ((Set.Icc 0 t).indicator (fun r => T r * ‖x‖ ^ 2) r) := by
5845  rw [hD.tsum_eq x r ω]
5846  by_cases hr : r ∈ Set.Icc 0 t
5847  · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hr]
5848    refine ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_
5849    simp only [hr.2, ite_true]
5850    exact hD.bound r hr x
5851  · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hr, hD.zero r hr]
5852    simp

5854lemma PCDetData.lintegral_bound_lt (hD : PCDetData e t Sb T) (x : H) (N : ℝ) :
5855    ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 N, ENNReal.ofReal ((Set.Icc 0 t).indicator (fun r => T r * ‖x‖ ^ 2) r) < ⊤ := by
5856  have h1 : Integrable ((Set.Icc 0 t).indicator (fun r => T r * ‖x‖ ^ 2)) volume :=
5857    (integrable_indicator_iff measurableSet_Icc).2 (hD.Tint.mul_const _)
5858  exact h1.integrableOn.lintegral_lt_top

5860lemma PCDetData.ctbl (hD : PCDetData e t Sb T) (x : H) :
5861    IsCtbl P ℱ (fSb (Ω := Ω) e t Sb x) :=
5862  pc_isCtbl_of_le (hD.prog x)
5863    (g := fun r _ => ENNReal.ofReal ((Set.Icc 0 t).indicator (fun r => T r * ‖x‖ ^ 2) r))
5864    (fun r ω => hD.tsum_le x r ω) (fun N => by
5865      rw [lintegral_const, measure_univ, mul_one]

5875    ∑' j, cT P (fSb (Ω := Ω) e t Sb x) j N =
5876      ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 N, ENNReal.ofReal (if r ≤ t then ‖Sb r x‖ ^ 2 else 0) := by

5881lemma PCDetData.sum_trace_le (hD : PCDetData e t Sb T) (r : ℝ) :
5882    ∑' i, ENNReal.ofReal (if r ≤ t then ‖Sb r (e i)‖ ^ 2 else 0) ≤
5883      ENNReal.ofReal ((Set.Icc 0 t).indicator T r) := by
5884  by_cases hr : r ∈ Set.Icc 0 t
5885  · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hr]
5886    simp only [hr.2, ite_true]
5887    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_tsum_of_nonneg (fun i => sq_nonneg _) (hD.trace r hr).summable,
5888      (hD.trace r hr).tsum_eq]
5889  · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hr]
5890    have : ∀ i, (if r ≤ t then ‖Sb r (e i)‖ ^ 2 else 0) = 0 := fun i => by
5891      by_cases h : r ≤ t
5892      · have : r < 0 := by
5893          by_contra h0
5894          exact hr ⟨not_lt.1 h0, h⟩
5895        simp [hD.zero r hr]
5896      · simp [h]
5897    simp [this]

5899lemma PCDetData.doob_sum (hD : PCDetData e t Sb T) {B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ι → ℝ}
5900    (hB : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ B) {I : ι → ℝ → Ω → ℝ}
5901    (hI : ∀ i, IsItoC P ℱ B (fSb e t Sb (e i)) (I i)) (N : ℕ) :
5902    ∑' i, ∫⁻ ω, (⨆ τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) N, ‖I i τ ω‖ₑ) ^ 2 ∂P ≠ ⊤ := by
5903  have hterm : ∀ i, ∫⁻ ω, (⨆ τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) N, ‖I i τ ω‖ₑ) ^ 2 ∂P ≤
5904      4 * ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 (N : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (if r ≤ t then ‖Sb r (e i)‖ ^ 2 else 0) := by
5905    intro i
5906    have hM : Martingale (I i) ℱ P := (hI i).martingale (hD.ctbl _) hB
5907    have hL2 : ∀ τ, MemLp (I i τ) 2 P := fun τ => by
5908      by_cases hτ : 0 ≤ τ
5909      · exact (hI i).memLp (hD.ctbl _) hB hτ
5910      · have : I i τ = fun _ => 0 := funext fun ω => (hI i).zero τ (not_le.1 hτ).le ω
5911        rw [this]; exact MemLp.zero
5912    have h1 := SimpleIntegrand.doob_L2_continuous hM (hI i).cont hL2 (N : ℝ)
5913    have h2 := (hI i).lintegral_sq_le (hD.ctbl _) hB (Nat.cast_nonneg N)
5914    rw [hD.tsum_cT_eq ℱ] at h2
5915    exact h1.trans (by gcongr)
5916  refine ne_top_of_le_ne_top (b := 4 * ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 (N : ℝ),
5917    ENNReal.ofReal ((Set.Icc 0 t).indicator T r)) ?_ ?_
5918  · exact ENNReal.mul_ne_top (by norm_num) (hD.lintegral_T_lt N).ne
5919  calc ∑' i, ∫⁻ ω, (⨆ τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) N, ‖I i τ ω‖ₑ) ^ 2 ∂P
5920      ≤ ∑' i, 4 * ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 (N : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (if r ≤ t then ‖Sb r (e i)‖ ^ 2 else 0) :=
5921        ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum hterm
5922    _ = 4 * ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 (N : ℝ), ∑' i, ENNReal.ofReal (if r ≤ t then ‖Sb r (e i)‖ ^ 2 else 0) := by
5923        rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_left, lintegral_tsum]
5924        intro i
5925        refine (Measurable.ennreal_ofReal ?_).aemeasurable
5926        exact Measurable.ite measurableSet_Iic (((hD.meas (e i)).norm).pow_const 2) measurable_const
5927    _ ≤ _ := by
5928        gcongr with r
5929        exact hD.sum_trace_le r

5931lemma PCDetData.scalar_le (hD : PCDetData e t Sb T) (z : H) (r : ℝ) :
5932    ENNReal.ofReal (if r ≤ t then ‖Sb r z‖ ^ 2 else 0) ≤
5933      ENNReal.ofReal (‖z‖ ^ 2) * ENNReal.ofReal ((Set.Icc 0 t).indicator T r) := by
5934  by_cases hr : r ∈ Set.Icc 0 t
5935  · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hr, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (sq_nonneg _)]
5936    simp only [hr.2, ite_true]
5937    refine ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_
5938    calc ‖Sb r z‖ ^ 2 ≤ T r * ‖z‖ ^ 2 := hD.bound r hr z
5939      _ = ‖z‖ ^ 2 * T r := mul_comm _ _
5940  · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hr]
5941    have : (if r ≤ t then ‖Sb r z‖ ^ 2 else 0) = 0 := by
5942      by_cases h : r ≤ t
5943      · have : r < 0 := by
5944          by_contra h0
5945          exact hr ⟨not_lt.1 h0, h⟩
5946        simp [hD.zero r hr]
5947      · simp [h]
5948    simp [this]

5950lemma fSb_comb (e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H) (t : ℝ) (Sb : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H) (c : ι → ℝ) (F : Finset ι)
5951    (x : H) (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) (j : ι) :
5952    ∑ i ∈ F, c i * fSb e t Sb (e i) r ω j - fSb e t Sb x r ω j =
5953      fSb e t Sb (∑ i ∈ F, c i • e i - x) r ω j := by
5954  by_cases h : r ≤ t
5955  · simp [fSb, h, inner_sub_right, inner_sum, inner_smul_right]
5956  · simp [fSb, h]
5957
5958lemma PCDetData.comb_tendsto (hD : PCDetData e t Sb T) {B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ι → ℝ}
5959    (hB : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ B) {I : ι → ℝ → Ω → ℝ}
5960    (hI : ∀ i, IsItoC P ℱ B (fSb e t Sb (e i)) (I i)) {J : ℝ → Ω → ℝ} (x : H)
5961    (hJ : IsItoC P ℱ B (fSb e t Sb x) J) {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) :
5962    Tendsto (fun F : Finset ι => ∫⁻ ω, ‖(∑ i ∈ F, inner ℝ (e i) x * I i τ ω) - J τ ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P)
5963      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
5964  set c : ι → ℝ := fun i => inner ℝ (e i) x with hc
5965  have hcomb : ∀ F : Finset ι, ∫⁻ ω, ‖(∑ i ∈ F, c i * I i τ ω) - J τ ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P ≤
5966      ENNReal.ofReal (‖∑ i ∈ F, c i • e i - x‖ ^ 2) *
5967        ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 τ, ENNReal.ofReal ((Set.Icc 0 t).indicator T r) := by
5968    intro F
5969    obtain ⟨hξF, hIF⟩ := IsItoC.finset_sum hB F (fun i => fun r ω j => c i * fSb e t Sb (e i) r ω j)
5970      (fun i => fun τ ω => c i * I i τ ω)
5971      (fun i _ => (hD.ctbl (Ω := Ω) (ℱ := ℱ) (e i)).mul_bdd (w := fun _ _ => c i)
5972        (isProgressive_const ℱ _) (C := |c i|) (fun r ω => le_rfl))
5973      (fun i _ => (hI i).smul hB (hD.ctbl (e i)) (c i))
5974    have hdiff := IsItoC.sub hB hξF (hD.ctbl x) hIF hJ
5975    have hΞd := pc_isCtbl_sub hξF (hD.ctbl (Ω := Ω) (ℱ := ℱ) x)
5976    have h1 := hdiff.lintegral_sq_le hΞd hB hτ
5977    have hfun : (fun r (ω : Ω) j => ∑ i ∈ F, c i * fSb e t Sb (e i) r ω j - fSb e t Sb x r ω j) =
5978        fSb e t Sb (∑ i ∈ F, c i • e i - x) := by
5979      funext r ω j; exact fSb_comb e t Sb c F x r ω j
5980    rw [hfun, hD.tsum_cT_eq ℱ] at h1
5981    refine h1.trans ?_
5982    rw [← lintegral_const_mul' _ _ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top]
5983    exact lintegral_mono fun r => hD.scalar_le _ r
5984  have hlim : Tendsto (fun F : Finset ι => ‖∑ i ∈ F, c i • e i - x‖) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
5985    have h2 : HasSum (fun i => c i • e i) x := by
5986      have := e.hasSum_repr x
5987      convert this using 2 with i
5988      simp [hc, HilbertBasis.repr_apply_apply]
5989    exact tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.1 (show Tendsto (fun F : Finset ι => ∑ i ∈ F, c i • e i)
5990      atTop (𝓝 x) from h2)
5991  have hK : ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 τ, ENNReal.ofReal ((Set.Icc 0 t).indicator T r) ≠ ⊤ :=
5992    (hD.lintegral_T_lt τ).ne
5993  have hlim2 : Tendsto (fun F : Finset ι => ENNReal.ofReal (‖∑ i ∈ F, c i • e i - x‖ ^ 2) *
5994      ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 τ, ENNReal.ofReal ((Set.Icc 0 t).indicator T r)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
5995    have h3 : Tendsto (fun F : Finset ι => ENNReal.ofReal (‖∑ i ∈ F, c i • e i - x‖ ^ 2)) atTop
5996        (𝓝 0) := by
5997      have := (ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.tendsto (0 ^ 2 : ℝ)).comp (hlim.pow 2)
5998      have e0 : ENNReal.ofReal ((0 : ℝ) ^ 2) = 0 := by simp
5999      rw [e0] at this
6000      exact this
6001    have := ENNReal.Tendsto.mul_const h3 (Or.inr hK)
6002    simpa using this
6003  exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds hlim2 (fun F => bot_le) hcomb
6004
6005theorem pc_exists_G (hD : PCDetData e t Sb T) {B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ι → ℝ}
6006    (hB : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ B) :
6007    ∃ G : ℝ → Ω → H,
6008      IsHilbertItoIntegral P ℱ B (fun r (_ : Ω) j => if r ≤ t then Sb r (e j) else 0) G ∧
6009      ∀ x : H, ∃ J : ℝ → Ω → ℝ, IsItoC P ℱ B (fSb e t Sb x) J ∧
6010        ∀ τ, 0 ≤ τ → (fun ω => inner ℝ (G τ ω) x) =ᵐ[P] J τ := by
6011  classical
6012  have hex : ∀ i, ∃ J, IsItoC P ℱ B (fSb e t Sb (e i)) J := fun i => exists_isItoC hB (hD.ctbl _)
6013  choose I hI using hex
6014  obtain ⟨G, hGc, hGa, hG0, hGae⟩ := pc_hvalued (hB ∅).complete e I (fun i ω => (hI i).cont ω)
6015    (fun i τ => (hI i).adapted τ) (fun i τ hτ ω => (hI i).zero τ hτ ω) (hD.doob_sum hB hI)
6016  have hJex : ∀ x : H, ∃ J : ℝ → Ω → ℝ, IsItoC P ℱ B (fSb e t Sb x) J ∧
6017      ∀ τ, 0 ≤ τ → (fun ω => inner ℝ (G τ ω) x) =ᵐ[P] J τ := by
6018    intro x
6019    obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ := exists_isItoC hB (hD.ctbl (Ω := Ω) (ℱ := ℱ) x)
6020    refine ⟨J, hJ, fun τ hτ => ?_⟩
6021    obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := exists_finset_seq (A := ι)
6022    have hImeas : ∀ i, Measurable (I i τ) := fun i => ((hI i).adapted τ).mono (ℱ.le τ) le_rfl
6023    refine pc_ae_eq_of_limits (X := fun n ω => ∑ i ∈ F n, inner ℝ (e i) x * I i τ ω)
6024      (fun n => (Finset.measurable_sum _ fun i _ => (hImeas i).const_mul _).aemeasurable)
6025      (((hJ.adapted τ).mono (ℱ.le τ) le_rfl).aemeasurable) ?_ ?_
6026    · filter_upwards [hGae τ] with ω hω
6027      obtain ⟨hsum, hGω⟩ := hω
6028      have := pcVec_hasSum_inner e hsum x
6029      rw [← hGω] at this
6030      have h2 : Tendsto (fun s : Finset ι => ∑ i ∈ s, I i τ ω * inner ℝ (e i) x) atTop
6031          (𝓝 (inner ℝ (G τ ω) x)) := this
6032      simp only [mul_comm (inner ℝ (e _) x)]
6033      exact h2.comp hF
6034    · exact (hD.comb_tendsto hB hI x hJ hτ).comp hF
6035  choose J hJ using hJex
6036  refine ⟨G, ⟨hGc, hGa, hG0, fun τ hτ x => ?_⟩, fun x => ⟨J x, (hJ x).1, (hJ x).2⟩⟩
6037  have hlim := (hJ x).1.approx τ hτ
6038  refine hlim.congr (fun F => lintegral_congr_ae ?_)
6039  filter_upwards [(hJ x).2 τ hτ] with ω h
6040  have hItoF : ItoF P ℱ B (fSb e t Sb x) F =
6041      itoIntegral P ℱ (fun t ω (k : F) => B t ω k)
6042        (fun r ω (k : F) => inner ℝ ((fun r (_ : Ω) j => if r ≤ t then Sb r (e j) else 0) r ω k) x) := by
6043    unfold ItoF WF ξF
6044    congr 1
6045    funext r ω k
6046    by_cases hr : r ≤ t <;> simp [fSb, hr]
6047  rw [hItoF]
6048  show ‖itoIntegral P ℱ (fun t ω (k : F) => B t ω k)
6049        (fun r ω (k : F) => inner ℝ ((fun r (_ : Ω) j => if r ≤ t then Sb r (e j) else 0) r ω k) x) τ ω
6050      - J x τ ω‖ₑ ^ 2 = _
6051  rw [← h]
6052
6053end PC7

6058lemma pc_Gint_eq {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg0 : ∀ r, 0 ≤ g r) (hgm : Measurable g) {τ : ℝ} :
6059    Gint g τ = ∫ r in Set.Ioc 0 τ, g r := by
6060  unfold Gint
6061  rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae (Eventually.of_forall hg0) hgm.aestronglyMeasurable]
6062
6063lemma pc_Gint_continuousOn {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg0 : ∀ r, 0 ≤ g r) (hgm : Measurable g) {t : ℝ}
6064    (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hint : IntegrableOn g (Set.Icc 0 t)) : ContinuousOn (Gint g) (Set.Icc 0 t) := by
6065  have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun b => ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..b, g x) (Set.uIcc 0 t) :=
6066    intervalIntegral.continuousOn_primitive_interval'
6067      (IntegrableOn.intervalIntegrable (by rwa [Set.uIcc_of_le ht])) (by simp [ht])
6068  rw [Set.uIcc_of_le ht] at h1
6069  refine h1.congr fun τ hτ => ?_
6070  rw [pc_Gint_eq hg0 hgm]
6071  exact (intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hτ.1).symm

6073lemma pc_Gint_monotoneOn {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg0 : ∀ r, 0 ≤ g r) (hgm : Measurable g) {t : ℝ}
6074    (hint : IntegrableOn g (Set.Icc 0 t)) : MonotoneOn (Gint g) (Set.Icc 0 t) := by
6075  intro a ha b hb hab
6076  rw [pc_Gint_eq hg0 hgm, pc_Gint_eq hg0 hgm]
6077  refine setIntegral_mono_set (hint.mono_set (fun r hr => ⟨hr.1.le, hr.2.trans hb.2⟩))
6078    (Eventually.of_forall hg0) ?_
6079  exact (Set.Ioc_subset_Ioc_right hab).eventuallyLE

6081section PC8b
6082variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
6083  {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ}
6084
6085theorem pc_law_cond {M : ℝ → Ω → ℝ} {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) {a : ℝ → ℝ}
6086    (hMart : Martingale M ℱ P) (hcont : ∀ ω, Continuous fun τ => M τ ω) (hzero : ∀ ω, M 0 ω = 0)
6087    (hL2 : ∀ τ, MemLp (M τ) 2 P)
6088    (hMa : Martingale (fun τ ω => M τ ω ^ 2 - a τ) ℱ P) (ha0 : a 0 = 0)
6089    (hac : ContinuousOn a (Set.Icc 0 t)) (ham : MonotoneOn a (Set.Icc 0 t)) {A0 : Set Ω}
6090    (hA0 : MeasurableSet[ℱ 0] A0) (hP0 : P A0 ≠ 0) :
6091    law (ProbabilityTheory.cond P A0) (M t) = gaussianLaw (a t) := by
6092  haveI : IsProbabilityMeasure (ProbabilityTheory.cond P A0) :=
6093    ProbabilityTheory.cond_isProbabilityMeasure hP0
6094  set Q := ProbabilityTheory.cond P A0 with hQ
6095  have hMQ : Martingale M ℱ Q :=
6096    martingale_cond P hMart (Eventually.of_forall hzero) hA0 hP0
6097  have hMaQ : Martingale (fun τ ω => M τ ω ^ 2 - a τ) ℱ Q :=
6098    martingale_cond P hMa (Eventually.of_forall fun ω => by simp [hzero ω, ha0]) hA0 hP0
6099  have hQP : Q ≪ P := ProbabilityTheory.cond_absolutelyContinuous
6100  have hcsm : IsContSqMartingale Q ℱ t M :=
6101    ⟨hMQ, Eventually.of_forall hzero, Eventually.of_forall fun ω => (hcont ω).continuousOn,
6102      fun τ _ => ((hL2 τ).restrict A0).smul_measure (ENNReal.inv_ne_top.2 hP0)⟩
6103  have hqv : IsQuadraticVariation Q ℱ t M (fun τ _ => a τ) :=
6104    ⟨fun τ => measurable_const, Eventually.of_forall fun _ => ha0,
6105      Eventually.of_forall fun _ => hac, Eventually.of_forall fun _ => ham, hMaQ⟩
6106  have hat : 0 ≤ a t := by
6107    have := ham ⟨le_rfl, ht⟩ ⟨ht, le_rfl⟩ ht
6108    rwa [ha0] at this
6109  obtain ⟨Ω'', _, P'', hP'', M', A', β, hM'm, hA'm, -, hjoint, hid, hlaw, -⟩ :=
6110    dds_coupling_strong Q ℱ t ht M (fun τ _ => a τ) hcsm hqv (integrable_const _) (a t) hat
6111  have hMm : Measurable (M t) := (hMart.1 t).measurable.mono (ℱ.le t) le_rfl
6112  have hpair : Measurable (fun ω' => (M' ω', A' ω')) := hM'm.prodMk hA'm
6113  have hms : MeasurableSet {p : ℝ × ℝ | ¬ p.2 = a t} :=
6114    (measurableSet_eq_fun measurable_snd measurable_const).compl
6115  have hA'ae : ∀ᵐ ω' ∂P'', A' ω' = a t := by
6116    rw [ae_iff]
6117    have h1 : P'' {ω' | ¬ A' ω' = a t} = (law P'' (fun ω' => (M' ω', A' ω')))
6118        {p : ℝ × ℝ | ¬ p.2 = a t} := by
6119      unfold law
6120      rw [Measure.map_apply hpair hms]
6121      rfl
6122    rw [h1, hjoint]
6123    unfold law
6124    rw [Measure.map_apply (hMm.prodMk measurable_const) hms]
6125    simp
6126  have hae : M' =ᵐ[P''] β (Real.toNNReal (a t)) := by
6127    filter_upwards [hid, hA'ae] with ω h1 h2
6128    rw [h1, h2]
6129  calc law Q (M t) = (law P'' (fun ω' => (M' ω', A' ω'))).map Prod.fst := by
6130        rw [hjoint]; unfold law
6131        rw [Measure.map_map measurable_fst (hMm.prodMk measurable_const)]
6132        rfl
6133    _ = law P'' M' := by
6134        unfold law
6135        rw [Measure.map_map measurable_fst hpair]
6136        rfl
6137    _ = law P'' (β (Real.toNNReal (a t))) := Measure.map_congr hae
6138    _ = gaussianLaw (a t) := hlaw
6139
6140end PC8b
6141end PC8

6144open Classical HilbertCLTAux

6146variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
6147  {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ}
6148variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
6149  [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]
6150variable {ι : Type*} [Countable ι]
6151variable {e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H} {t : ℝ} {Sb : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H} {T : ℝ → ℝ}
6152
6153lemma pc_ext_of_marginals {μ ν : Measure H} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
6154    (h : ∀ x : H, μ.map (fun z => inner ℝ x z) = ν.map (fun z => inner ℝ x z)) : μ = ν := by
6155  refine Measure.ext_of_charFunDual (funext fun L => ?_)
6156  set y := (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ H).symm L with hy
6157  have hL : (L : H → ℝ) = fun z => inner ℝ y z := by
6158    funext z; rw [hy, InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply]
6159  rw [charFunDual_eq_charFun_map_one, charFunDual_eq_charFun_map_one, hL, h y]

6161/-- The deterministic bracket integrand `1_{r ≤ t} ‖Sb_r x‖²`. -/
6162def gSb (t : ℝ) (Sb : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H) (x : H) : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => if r ≤ t then ‖Sb r x‖ ^ 2 else 0
6163
6164lemma gSb_nonneg (x : H) (r : ℝ) : 0 ≤ gSb t Sb x r := by
6165  unfold gSb; split_ifs <;> positivity
6166
6167lemma PCDetData.gSb_meas (hD : PCDetData e t Sb T) (x : H) : Measurable (gSb t Sb x) :=
6168  Measurable.ite measurableSet_Iic (((hD.meas x).norm).pow_const 2) measurable_const
6169
6170lemma PCDetData.gSb_int (hD : PCDetData e t Sb T) (x : H) :
6171    IntegrableOn (gSb t Sb x) (Set.Icc 0 t) := by
6172  refine (hD.Tint.mul_const (‖x‖ ^ 2)).mono' (hD.gSb_meas x).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
6173  refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Icc).2 (Eventually.of_forall fun r hr => ?_)
6174  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (gSb_nonneg x r)]
6175  simp only [gSb, hr.2, ite_true]
6176  exact hD.bound r hr x
6177
6178lemma PCDetData.law_J (hD : PCDetData e t Sb T) {B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ι → ℝ}
6179    (hB : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ B) {x : H} {J : ℝ → Ω → ℝ}
6180    (hJ : IsItoC P ℱ B (fSb e t Sb x) J) (ht : 0 ≤ t) {A0 : Set Ω}
6181    (hA0 : MeasurableSet[ℱ 0] A0) (hP0 : P A0 ≠ 0) :
6182    law (ProbabilityTheory.cond P A0) (J t) = gaussianLaw (Gint (gSb t Sb x) t) := by
6183  have hL2 : ∀ τ, MemLp (J τ) 2 P := fun τ => by
6184    by_cases hτ : 0 ≤ τ
6185    · exact hJ.memLp (hD.ctbl _) hB hτ
6186    · have : J τ = fun _ => 0 := funext fun ω => hJ.zero τ (not_le.1 hτ).le ω
6187      rw [this]; exact MemLp.zero
6188  exact pc_law_cond ht (hJ.martingale (hD.ctbl x) hB) hJ.cont (fun ω => hJ.zero 0 le_rfl ω) hL2
6189    (hJ.martingale_sq_sub hB (hD.ctbl x) (fun r ω => hD.tsum_eq x r ω))
6190    (Gint_of_nonpos _ le_rfl)
6191    (pc_Gint_continuousOn (gSb_nonneg (t := t) (Sb := Sb) x) (hD.gSb_meas x) ht (hD.gSb_int x))
6192    (pc_Gint_monotoneOn (gSb_nonneg (t := t) (Sb := Sb) x) (hD.gSb_meas x) (hD.gSb_int x)) hA0 hP0
6193
6194lemma PCDetData.v_eq (hD : PCDetData e t Sb T) (z : H) :
6195    Gint (gSb t Sb z) t = ∫ r in Set.Icc 0 t, ‖Sb r z‖ ^ 2 := by
6196  rw [pc_Gint_eq (gSb_nonneg z) (hD.gSb_meas z), ← integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc]
6197  refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Icc fun r hr => ?_
6198  simp [gSb, hr.2]
6199
6200lemma PCDetData.norm_sq_int (hD : PCDetData e t Sb T) (z : H) :
6201    IntegrableOn (fun r => ‖Sb r z‖ ^ 2) (Set.Icc 0 t) := by
6202  refine (hD.gSb_int z).congr_fun (fun r hr => ?_) measurableSet_Icc
6203  simp [gSb, hr.2]
6204
6205theorem pc_G_gaussian (hD : PCDetData e t Sb T) {B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ι → ℝ}
6206    (hB : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ B) {G : ℝ → Ω → H}
6207    (hG : ∀ x : H, ∃ J : ℝ → Ω → ℝ, IsItoC P ℱ B (fSb e t Sb x) J ∧
6208      ∀ τ, 0 ≤ τ → (fun ω => inner ℝ (G τ ω) x) =ᵐ[P] J τ)
6209    (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hGm : Measurable (G t)) (𝒢 : InitialSigma ℱ) :
6210    Indep 𝒢.1 (MeasurableSpace.comap (G t) inferInstance) P ∧
6211      IsCenteredGaussian (law P (G t)) ∧
6212      ∀ x y, covarianceBilin (law P (G t)) x y = ∫ r in Set.Icc 0 t, inner ℝ (Sb r x) (Sb r y) := by
6213  classical
6214  set v : H → ℝ := fun x => Gint (gSb t Sb x) t with hv
6215  have hv0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ v x := fun x => ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
6216  have hmarg : ∀ x : H, ∀ A0 : Set Ω, MeasurableSet[ℱ 0] A0 → P A0 ≠ 0 →
6217      (ProbabilityTheory.cond P A0).map (fun ω => inner ℝ x (G t ω)) = gaussianLaw (v x) := by
6218    intro x A0 hA0 hP0
6219    obtain ⟨J, hJ, hae⟩ := hG x
6220    haveI : IsProbabilityMeasure (ProbabilityTheory.cond P A0) :=
6221      ProbabilityTheory.cond_isProbabilityMeasure hP0
6222    have hQP : ProbabilityTheory.cond P A0 ≪ P := ProbabilityTheory.cond_absolutelyContinuous
6223    have h1 : (fun ω => inner ℝ x (G t ω)) =ᵐ[ProbabilityTheory.cond P A0] J t := by
6224      filter_upwards [hQP.ae_le (hae t ht)] with ω h
6225      rw [real_inner_comm]; exact h
6226    rw [Measure.map_congr h1]
6227    exact hD.law_J hB hJ ht hA0 hP0
6228  have hmargP : ∀ x : H, P.map (fun ω => inner ℝ x (G t ω)) = gaussianLaw (v x) := by
6229    intro x
6230    have := hmarg x Set.univ MeasurableSet.univ (by simp)
6231    rwa [ProbabilityTheory.cond_univ] at this
6232  have hlawQ : ∀ A0 : Set Ω, MeasurableSet[ℱ 0] A0 → P A0 ≠ 0 →
6233      (ProbabilityTheory.cond P A0).map (G t) = P.map (G t) := by
6234    intro A0 hA0 hP0
6235    haveI := ProbabilityTheory.cond_isProbabilityMeasure hP0
6236    haveI : IsProbabilityMeasure (P.map (G t)) := (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff hGm.aemeasurable).2 inferInstance
6237    haveI : IsProbabilityMeasure ((ProbabilityTheory.cond P A0).map (G t)) :=
6238      (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff hGm.aemeasurable).2 inferInstance
6239    refine pc_ext_of_marginals fun x => ?_
6240    have hm1 : Measurable (fun z : H => inner ℝ x z) := measurable_const.inner measurable_id
6241    rw [Measure.map_map hm1 hGm, Measure.map_map hm1 hGm]
6242    exact (hmarg x A0 hA0 hP0).trans (hmargP x).symm
6243  have hindep : Indep 𝒢.1 (MeasurableSpace.comap (G t) inferInstance) P := by
6244    rw [Indep_iff]
6245    rintro A S hA ⟨Bset, hBm, rfl⟩
6246    have hA0 : MeasurableSet[ℱ 0] A := 𝒢.2 _ hA
6247    have hAm : MeasurableSet A := (ℱ.le 0) _ hA0
6248    by_cases hP0 : P A = 0
6249    · rw [hP0, zero_mul]; exact measure_mono_null Set.inter_subset_left hP0
6250    · have h1 := hlawQ A hA0 hP0
6251      have h2 : (ProbabilityTheory.cond P A) (G t ⁻¹' Bset) = P (G t ⁻¹' Bset) := by
6252        have := congrArg (fun μ => μ Bset) h1
6253        simpa [Measure.map_apply hGm hBm] using this
6254      rw [ProbabilityTheory.cond_apply hAm] at h2
6255      calc P (A ∩ G t ⁻¹' Bset) = P A * ((P A)⁻¹ * P (A ∩ G t ⁻¹' Bset)) := by
6256            rw [← mul_assoc, ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel hP0 (measure_ne_top _ _), one_mul]
6257        _ = P A * P (G t ⁻¹' Bset) := by rw [h2]
6258  have hmapL : ∀ L : H →L[ℝ] ℝ, (law P (G t)).map L =
6259      gaussianReal 0 (v ((InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ H).symm L)).toNNReal := by
6260    intro L
6261    set y := (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ H).symm L with hy
6262    have hL : (L : H → ℝ) = fun z => inner ℝ y z := by
6263      funext z; rw [hy, InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply]
6264    unfold law
6265    rw [Measure.map_map L.continuous.measurable hGm]
6266    have : (⇑L ∘ G t) = fun ω => inner ℝ y (G t ω) := by funext ω; simp [hL]
6267    rw [this]; exact hmargP y
6268  have hgauss : IsGaussian (law P (G t)) := isGaussian_of_map_eq_gaussianReal fun L => ⟨0, _, hmapL L⟩
6269  have hcent : ∀ L : StrongDual ℝ H, ∫ z, L z ∂(law P (G t)) = 0 := by
6270    intro L
6271    have h1 : ∫ z, L z ∂(law P (G t)) = ∫ w, w ∂((law P (G t)).map L) :=
6272      (integral_map L.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable aestronglyMeasurable_id).symm
6273    rw [h1, hmapL L]; exact integral_id_gaussianReal
6274  have hcg : IsCenteredGaussian (law P (G t)) := ⟨hgauss, hcent⟩
6275  refine ⟨hindep, hcg, ?_⟩
6276  haveI := hgauss
6277  have hmemLp := IsGaussian.memLp_id (law P (G t)) 2 (by norm_num)
6278  have hmean := gaussian_mean_zero hcg
6279  have hL2 : ∀ z : H, MemLp (fun ω => inner ℝ z (G t ω)) 2 P := fun z => by
6280    have h1 := IsGaussian.memLp_dual (law P (G t)) (innerSL ℝ z) 2 (by norm_num)
6281    have h2 : MemLp (fun w => innerSL ℝ z w) 2 (P.map (G t)) := h1
6282    exact (memLp_map_measure_iff (innerSL ℝ z).continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
6283      hGm.aemeasurable).1 h2
6284  have hcov : ∀ x y, covarianceBilin (law P (G t)) x y =
6285      ∫ ω, inner ℝ x (G t ω) * inner ℝ y (G t ω) ∂P := by
6286    intro x y
6287    rw [covarianceBilin_apply hmemLp]
6288    have h0 : ∫ z : H, (id z) ∂(law P (G t)) = 0 := hmean
6289    rw [h0]
6290    simp only [sub_zero, id]
6291    unfold law
6292    exact integral_map hGm.aemeasurable (((measurable_const.inner measurable_id).mul
6293      (measurable_const.inner measurable_id)).aestronglyMeasurable)
6294  have hsq : ∀ z, ∫ ω, inner ℝ z (G t ω) ^ 2 ∂P = v z := by
6295    intro z
6296    have hm1 : Measurable (fun z' : H => inner ℝ z z') := measurable_const.inner measurable_id
6297    have h1 : ∫ ω, inner ℝ z (G t ω) ^ 2 ∂P =
6298        ∫ w, w ^ 2 ∂(P.map (fun ω => inner ℝ z (G t ω))) := by
6299      have hm2 : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun w : ℝ => w ^ 2)
6300          (P.map (fun ω => inner ℝ z (G t ω))) := (measurable_id.pow_const 2).aestronglyMeasurable
6301      exact (integral_map (f := fun w : ℝ => w ^ 2) (hm1.comp hGm).aemeasurable hm2).symm
6302    rw [h1, hmargP z]
6303    unfold gaussianLaw
6304    rw [integral_sq_gaussianReal_zero, Real.coe_toNNReal _ (hv0 z)]
6305  intro x y
6306  rw [hcov]
6307  have hxy : ∫ ω, inner ℝ x (G t ω) * inner ℝ y (G t ω) ∂P = (v (x + y) - v x - v y) / 2 := by
6308    have hI : ∀ z, Integrable (fun ω => inner ℝ z (G t ω) ^ 2) P := fun z => (hL2 z).integrable_sq
6309    have hprod : Integrable (fun ω => inner ℝ x (G t ω) * inner ℝ y (G t ω)) P :=
6310      (hL2 x).integrable_mul (hL2 y)
6311    have e1 : ∀ ω, inner ℝ (x + y) (G t ω) ^ 2 = inner ℝ x (G t ω) ^ 2 +
6312        2 * (inner ℝ x (G t ω) * inner ℝ y (G t ω)) + inner ℝ y (G t ω) ^ 2 := by
6313      intro ω; rw [inner_add_left]; ring
6314    have h3 := hsq (x + y)
6315    simp_rw [e1] at h3
6316    have hIx : Integrable (fun ω => inner ℝ x (G t ω) ^ 2) P := hI x
6317    have hIy : Integrable (fun ω => inner ℝ y (G t ω) ^ 2) P := hI y
6318    have hB' : Integrable (fun ω => 2 * (inner ℝ x (G t ω) * inner ℝ y (G t ω))) P :=
6319      hprod.const_mul 2
6320    have hAB : Integrable (fun ω => inner ℝ x (G t ω) ^ 2 +
6321        2 * (inner ℝ x (G t ω) * inner ℝ y (G t ω))) P := hIx.add hB'
6322    rw [integral_add hAB hIy, integral_add hIx hB', integral_const_mul, hsq x, hsq y] at h3
6323    linarith
6324  have hR : ∫ r in Set.Icc 0 t, inner ℝ (Sb r x) (Sb r y) = (v (x + y) - v x - v y) / 2 := by
6325    simp only [hv, hD.v_eq]
6326    have e2 : ∀ r, inner ℝ (Sb r x) (Sb r y) =
6327        (‖Sb r (x + y)‖ ^ 2 - ‖Sb r x‖ ^ 2 - ‖Sb r y‖ ^ 2) / 2 := by
6328      intro r; rw [map_add, norm_add_sq_real]; ring
6329    simp_rw [e2]
6330    have h1 : IntegrableOn (fun r => ‖Sb r (x + y)‖ ^ 2) (Set.Icc 0 t) := hD.norm_sq_int _
6331    have h2 : IntegrableOn (fun r => ‖Sb r x‖ ^ 2) (Set.Icc 0 t) := hD.norm_sq_int _
6332    have h3 : IntegrableOn (fun r => ‖Sb r y‖ ^ 2) (Set.Icc 0 t) := hD.norm_sq_int _
6333    have h12 : IntegrableOn (fun r => ‖Sb r (x + y)‖ ^ 2 - ‖Sb r x‖ ^ 2) (Set.Icc 0 t) := h1.sub h2
6334    rw [integral_div, integral_sub h12 h3, integral_sub h1 h2]
6335  rw [hxy, hR]
6336
6337end PC9
6338
6339section PC10
6340open Classical HilbertCLTAux
6341
6342variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
6343  {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ}
6344variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
6345  [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]
6346variable {ι : Type*} [Countable ι]
6347variable {e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H} {t : ℝ} {Sb : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H} {T : ℝ → ℝ}
6348
6349lemma pc_enorm_sq_vec (v : H) : ‖v‖ₑ ^ 2 = ENNReal.ofReal (‖v‖ ^ 2) := by
6350  rw [← ofReal_norm_eq_enorm, ENNReal.ofReal_pow (norm_nonneg _)]
6351
6352lemma pc_enorm_sq_tsum (e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H) (v : H) :
6353    ‖v‖ₑ ^ 2 = ∑' i, ‖inner ℝ v (e i)‖ₑ ^ 2 := by
6354  rw [enorm_tsum_sq_of_hasSum (hasSum_inner_sq e v), pc_enorm_sq_vec]
6355
6356/-- The pair family `D(r, ω, (i,j)) = 1_{r ≤ t} ⟨(S'_r - Sb_r) e_j, e_i⟩`. -/
6357def pcDfam (e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H) (t : ℝ) (S' : ℝ → Ω → H →L[ℝ] H) (Sb : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H) :
6358    ℝ → Ω → ι × ι → ℝ :=
6359  fun r ω p => if r ≤ t then inner ℝ ((S' r ω - Sb r) (e p.2)) (e p.1) else 0
6360
6361theorem pc_L2_bound (hD : PCDetData e t Sb T) {B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ι → ℝ}
6362    (hB : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ B) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
6363    (S' : ℝ → Ω → H →L[ℝ] H)
6364    (hSprog : ∀ x y, IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => inner ℝ (S' r ω x) y))
6365    (hfS : ∀ x, IsCtbl P ℱ (fun r ω j => if r ≤ t then inner ℝ (S' r ω (e j)) x else 0))
6366    {Z : H → ℝ → Ω → ℝ}
6367    (hZ : ∀ x, IsItoC P ℱ B (fun r ω j => if r ≤ t then inner ℝ (S' r ω (e j)) x else 0) (Z x))
6368    {G : ℝ → Ω → H}
6369    (hG : ∀ x : H, ∃ J : ℝ → Ω → ℝ, IsItoC P ℱ B (fSb e t Sb x) J ∧
6370      ∀ τ, 0 ≤ τ → (fun ω => inner ℝ (G τ ω) x) =ᵐ[P] J τ)
6371    (hGm : Measurable (G t)) {M' : Ω → H} (hM'm : Measurable M')
6372    (hMZ : ∀ x, (fun ω => inner ℝ (M' ω) x) =ᵐ[P] Z x t)
6373    (dd : ℝ → Ω → ℝ)
6374    (hdd : ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 t, ∀ ω, Summable (fun j => ‖(S' r ω - Sb r) (e j)‖ ^ 2) ∧
6375      ∑' j, ‖(S' r ω - Sb r) (e j)‖ ^ 2 ≤ dd r ω) :
6376    ∫⁻ ω, ‖M' ω - G t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P ≤ ∫⁻ ω, (∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 t, ENNReal.ofReal (dd r ω)) ∂P := by
6377  have hDfun : ∀ i : ι, (fun r ω (j : ι) => pcDfam e t S' Sb r ω (i, j)) =
6378      fun r ω (j : ι) => (if r ≤ t then inner ℝ (S' r ω (e j)) (e i) else 0) -
6379        fSb e t Sb (e i) r ω j := by
6380    intro i; funext r ω j
6381    by_cases hr : r ≤ t <;> simp [pcDfam, fSb, hr, inner_sub_left]
6382  -- the per-coordinate bound
6383  have hcoord : ∀ i : ι, ∫⁻ ω, ‖inner ℝ (M' ω - G t ω) (e i)‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P ≤
6384      ∑' j, cT P (fun r ω (j : ι) => pcDfam e t S' Sb r ω (i, j)) j t := by
6385    intro i
6386    obtain ⟨J, hJ, hae⟩ := hG (e i)
6387    have hdiff := IsItoC.sub hB (hfS (e i)) (hD.ctbl (Ω := Ω) (ℱ := ℱ) (e i)) (hZ (e i)) hJ
6388    have hΞd := pc_isCtbl_sub (hfS (e i)) (hD.ctbl (Ω := Ω) (ℱ := ℱ) (e i))
6389    have h1 := hdiff.lintegral_sq_le hΞd hB ht
6390    rw [← hDfun i] at h1
6391    refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) h1
6392    refine lintegral_congr_ae ?_
6393    filter_upwards [hMZ (e i), hae t ht] with ω h1 h2
6394    rw [inner_sub_left, h1, h2]
6395  have hprog : ∀ p : ι × ι, IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => pcDfam e t S' Sb r ω p) := by
6396    intro p
6397    have h1 : IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => inner ℝ (S' r ω (e p.2)) (e p.1)) := hSprog _ _
6398    have h2 : IsProgressive ℱ (fun r (_ : Ω) => inner ℝ (Sb r (e p.2)) (e p.1)) :=
6399      pc_isProgressive_det ((hD.meas _).inner measurable_const)
6400    have h3 : IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => inner ℝ (S' r ω (e p.2)) (e p.1) -
6401        inner ℝ (Sb r (e p.2)) (e p.1)) := fun i => (h1 i).sub (h2 i)
6402    have h4 := pc_isProgressive_ite (β := ℝ) h3 (measurableSet_Iic (a := t))
6403    convert h4 using 3 with r ω
6404    simp [pcDfam, inner_sub_left]
6405  calc ∫⁻ ω, ‖M' ω - G t ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P
6406      = ∫⁻ ω, ∑' i, ‖inner ℝ (M' ω - G t ω) (e i)‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P :=
6407        lintegral_congr fun ω => pc_enorm_sq_tsum e _
6408    _ = ∑' i, ∫⁻ ω, ‖inner ℝ (M' ω - G t ω) (e i)‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P := by
6409        rw [lintegral_tsum]
6410        intro i
6411        exact (((hM'm.sub hGm).inner measurable_const).enorm.pow_const 2).aemeasurable
6412    _ ≤ ∑' i, ∑' j, cT P (fun r ω (j : ι) => pcDfam e t S' Sb r ω (i, j)) j t :=
6413        ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum hcoord
6414    _ = ∑' p : ι × ι, cT P (pcDfam e t S' Sb) p t := by
6415        exact (ENNReal.tsum_prod (f := fun i j => cT P (pcDfam e t S' Sb) (i, j) t)).symm
6416    _ = ∫⁻ ω, (∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 t, ∑' p, ‖pcDfam e t S' Sb r ω p‖ₑ ^ 2) ∂P := pc_tsum_cT hprog t
6417    _ ≤ ∫⁻ ω, (∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 t, ENNReal.ofReal (dd r ω)) ∂P := by
6418        refine lintegral_mono fun ω => setLIntegral_mono' measurableSet_Icc fun r hr => ?_
6419        obtain ⟨hsum, hle⟩ := hdd r hr ω
6420        have hrt : r ≤ t := hr.2
6421        have : ∀ p : ι × ι, pcDfam e t S' Sb r ω p = inner ℝ ((S' r ω - Sb r) (e p.2)) (e p.1) := by
6422          intro p; simp [pcDfam, hrt]
6423        simp_rw [this]
6424        have hp : ∑' p : ι × ι, ‖inner ℝ ((S' r ω - Sb r) (e p.2)) (e p.1)‖ₑ ^ 2 =
6425            ∑' i, ∑' j, ‖inner ℝ ((S' r ω - Sb r) (e j)) (e i)‖ₑ ^ 2 :=
6426          ENNReal.tsum_prod (f := fun i j => ‖inner ℝ ((S' r ω - Sb r) (e j)) (e i)‖ₑ ^ 2)
6427        rw [hp, ENNReal.tsum_comm]
6428        calc ∑' j, ∑' i, ‖inner ℝ ((S' r ω - Sb r) (e j)) (e i)‖ₑ ^ 2
6429            = ∑' j, ‖(S' r ω - Sb r) (e j)‖ₑ ^ 2 :=
6430              tsum_congr fun j => (pc_enorm_sq_tsum e _).symm
6431          _ = ∑' j, ENNReal.ofReal (‖(S' r ω - Sb r) (e j)‖ ^ 2) :=
6432              tsum_congr fun j => pc_enorm_sq_vec _
6433          _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∑' j, ‖(S' r ω - Sb r) (e j)‖ ^ 2) :=
6434              (ENNReal.ofReal_tsum_of_nonneg (fun j => sq_nonneg _) hsum).symm
6435          _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (dd r ω) := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hle
6436
6437end PC10
6438
6439section PC11
6440open Classical HilbertCLTAux
6441
6442variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
6443  [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]
6444
6445lemma traceNormForm_le_basis_trace {ι : Type*} {C : H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ} (hC : IsTraceClassCov C)
6446    (e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H) : traceNormForm C ≤ ∑' i, C (e i) (e i) := by
6447  obtain ⟨ℓ, hs, hℓ⟩ := hC.exists_decomp'
6448  have hd : ∀ x, C x x = ∑' j, inner ℝ (ℓ j) x ^ 2 := fun x => by
6449    rw [← (hℓ x x).tsum_eq]; exact tsum_congr fun j => (sq _).symm
6450  have h1 : ∑' i, C (e i) (e i) = ∑' j, ‖ℓ j‖ ^ 2 := by
6451    rw [← (hasSum_diag_decomp hs e).tsum_eq]
6452    exact tsum_congr fun i => hd (e i)
6453  refine Real.iSup_le (fun p => ?_) (tsum_nonneg fun i => hC.nonneg _)
6454  rw [h1]
6455  exact sum_abs_le_of_decomp hs hℓ _ _ p.2.1 p.2.2
6456
6457lemma traceNormForm_hsCov_le {κ : Type*} [Countable κ] {Φ : κ → H}
6458    (hΦ : Summable fun k => ‖Φ k‖ ^ 2) : traceNormForm (hsCovForm Φ) ≤ ∑' k, ‖Φ k‖ ^ 2 := by
6459  obtain ⟨ι₀, -, b, -⟩ := HilbertCLTAux.exists_hilbertBasis_type (H := H)
6460  refine (traceNormForm_le_basis_trace (isTraceClassCov_hsCovForm hΦ) b).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
6461  rw [← (hasSum_diag_decomp hΦ b).tsum_eq]
6462  refine tsum_congr fun i => ?_
6463  rw [hsCovForm_apply hΦ]
6464  exact tsum_congr fun k => (sq _).symm
6465
6466end PC11
6467
6468section PC11b
6469open Classical HilbertCLTAux
6470
6471variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
6472  {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ}
6473variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
6474  [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]
6475variable {κ : Type*} [Countable κ]
6476
6477lemma pc_enorm_sq_vec' (v : H) : ‖v‖ₑ ^ 2 = ENNReal.ofReal (‖v‖ ^ 2) := by
6478  rw [← ofReal_norm_eq_enorm, ENNReal.ofReal_pow (norm_nonneg _)]
6479
6480lemma pc_meas_covDisc {Φ : ℝ → Ω → κ → H} (hΦ : ∀ T, IsHSIntegrand P ℱ T Φ) (t : ℝ)
6481    (sb : ℝ → (H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ)) (hsb : IsDetCovDensity t sb) :
6482    Measurable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => traceNormForm (hsCovForm (Φ (min p.1 t) p.2) - sb p.1)) := by
6483  refine measurable_traceNormForm (D := fun p : ℝ × Ω => hsCovForm (Φ (min p.1 t) p.2) - sb p.1)
6484    (fun x y => ?_)
6485  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
6486  have e1 : (fun p : ℝ × Ω => hsCovForm (Φ (min p.1 t) p.2) x y) = fun p : ℝ × Ω =>
6487      ∑' k, inner ℝ (Φ (min p.1 t) p.2 k) x * inner ℝ (Φ (min p.1 t) p.2 k) y := by
6488    funext p; exact hsCovForm_apply ((hΦ t).summable _ _) x y
6489  have e2 : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => hsCovForm (Φ (min p.1 t) p.2) x y) := by
6490    rw [e1]
6491    exact Measurable.tsum fun k => (((measurable_clamp ((hΦ t).prog k) t).inner measurable_const).mul
6492      ((measurable_clamp ((hΦ t).prog k) t).inner measurable_const))
6493  exact e2.sub ((hsb.meas x y).comp measurable_fst)
6494
6495theorem pc_lintegral_covDisc {Φ : ℝ → Ω → κ → H} (hΦ : ∀ T, IsHSIntegrand P ℱ T Φ) {t : ℝ}
6496    (ht : 0 ≤ t) (sb : ℝ → (H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ)) (hsb : IsDetCovDensity t sb) :
6497    ∫⁻ ω, (∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 t, ENNReal.ofReal
6498        (traceNormForm (hsCovForm (Φ r ω) - sb r))) ∂P =
6499      ENNReal.ofReal (covDiscrepancy P t (fun r ω => hsCovForm (Φ r ω)) sb) := by
6500  set d : ℝ → Ω → ℝ := fun r ω => traceNormForm (hsCovForm (Φ r ω) - sb r) with hd
6501  set dc : ℝ × Ω → ℝ := fun p => traceNormForm (hsCovForm (Φ (min p.1 t) p.2) - sb p.1) with hdc
6502  have hdcm : Measurable dc := pc_meas_covDisc hΦ t sb hsb
6503  have hdc_eq : ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 t, ∀ ω, dc (r, ω) = d r ω := fun r hr ω => by
6504    simp only [hdc, hd, min_eq_left hr.2]
6505  have hd0 : ∀ r ω, 0 ≤ d r ω := fun r ω => traceNormForm_nonneg _
6506  -- measurability of the sections
6507  have hsm : ∀ ω, Measurable fun r => dc (r, ω) := fun ω => hdcm.comp measurable_prodMk_right
6508  -- trace of the covariation
6509  set tr : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => traceNormForm (sb r) with htr
6510  have htrm : Measurable tr := measurable_traceNormForm (α := ℝ) sb hsb.meas
6511  have hbound : ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 t, ∀ ω, d r ω ≤ (∑' k, ‖Φ r ω k‖ ^ 2) + tr r := by
6512    intro r hr ω
6513    have h1 := traceNormForm_sub_le (isTraceClassCov_hsCovForm ((hΦ t).summable r ω))
6514      (hsb.traceClass r hr)
6515    have h2 := traceNormForm_hsCov_le ((hΦ t).summable r ω)
6516    simp only [hd, htr]
6517    linarith
6518  -- finiteness of the double lintegral
6519  have hL : ∫⁻ ω, (∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 t, ENNReal.ofReal (d r ω)) ∂P < ⊤ := by
6520    have hA : ∫⁻ ω, (∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 t, ENNReal.ofReal (∑' k, ‖Φ r ω k‖ ^ 2)) ∂P < ⊤ := by
6521      have : ∀ r ω, ENNReal.ofReal (∑' k, ‖Φ r ω k‖ ^ 2) = ∑' k, ‖Φ r ω k‖ₑ ^ 2 := fun r ω => by
6522        rw [ENNReal.ofReal_tsum_of_nonneg (fun k => sq_nonneg _) ((hΦ t).summable r ω)]
6523        exact tsum_congr fun k => (pc_enorm_sq_vec' _).symm
6524      simp_rw [this]
6525      exact (hΦ t).sq
6526    have hB : ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 t, ENNReal.ofReal (tr r) < ⊤ := hsb.int.lintegral_lt_top
6527    calc ∫⁻ ω, (∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 t, ENNReal.ofReal (d r ω)) ∂P
6528        ≤ ∫⁻ ω, ((∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 t, ENNReal.ofReal (∑' k, ‖Φ r ω k‖ ^ 2)) +
6529            ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 t, ENNReal.ofReal (tr r)) ∂P := by
6530          refine lintegral_mono fun ω => ?_
6531          rw [← lintegral_add_right _ (htrm.ennreal_ofReal)]
6532          refine setLIntegral_mono' measurableSet_Icc fun r hr => ?_
6533          refine (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hbound r hr ω)).trans ?_
6534          exact ENNReal.ofReal_add_le
6535      _ = _ := by rw [lintegral_add_right _ measurable_const, lintegral_const, measure_univ, mul_one]
6536      _ < ⊤ := ENNReal.add_lt_top.2 ⟨hA, hB⟩
6537  set F : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => ∫ r in Set.Icc 0 t, d r ω with hF
6538  have hFeq : ∀ ω, F ω = ∫ r in Set.Icc 0 t, dc (r, ω) := fun ω =>
6539    setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Icc fun r hr => (hdc_eq r hr ω).symm
6540  have hFm : StronglyMeasurable F := by
6541    have h1 : StronglyMeasurable fun ω => ∫ r in Set.Icc 0 t, dc (r, ω) :=
6542      (hdcm.comp (measurable_swap (α := Ω) (β := ℝ))).stronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'
6543        (ν := volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 t))
6544    have : F = fun ω => ∫ r in Set.Icc 0 t, dc (r, ω) := funext hFeq
6545    rw [this]; exact h1
6546  set Lr : Ω → ℝ≥0∞ := fun ω => ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 t, ENNReal.ofReal (d r ω) with hLr
6547  have hLrm : Measurable Lr := by
6548    have h1 : Measurable fun ω => ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 t, ENNReal.ofReal (dc (r, ω)) :=
6549      (hdcm.ennreal_ofReal.comp (measurable_swap (α := Ω) (β := ℝ))).lintegral_prod_right'
6550        (ν := volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 t))
6551    have : Lr = fun ω => ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 t, ENNReal.ofReal (dc (r, ω)) := by
6552      funext ω
6553      exact setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Icc fun r hr => by rw [hdc_eq r hr ω]
6554    rw [this]; exact h1
6555  have hae : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, Lr ω < ⊤ := ae_lt_top hLrm hL.ne
6556  have hint : ∀ ω, Lr ω < ⊤ → IntegrableOn (fun r => d r ω) (Set.Icc 0 t) := fun ω hω => by
6557    refine ⟨((hsm ω).aestronglyMeasurable).congr
6558      ((ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Icc).2 (Eventually.of_forall fun r hr => hdc_eq r hr ω)), ?_⟩
6559    unfold HasFiniteIntegral
6560    simp_rw [Real.enorm_of_nonneg (hd0 _ ω)]
6561    exact hω
6562  have hF0 : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ F ω := fun ω => setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Icc fun r _ => hd0 r ω
6563  have hFL : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ENNReal.ofReal (F ω) = Lr ω := by
6564    filter_upwards [hae] with ω hω
6565    exact ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (hint ω hω) (Eventually.of_forall fun r => hd0 r ω)
6566  have hFint : Integrable F P := by
6567    refine ⟨hFm.aestronglyMeasurable, ?_⟩
6568    unfold HasFiniteIntegral
6569    calc ∫⁻ ω, ‖F ω‖ₑ ∂P = ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (F ω) ∂P :=
6570          lintegral_congr fun ω => by rw [Real.enorm_of_nonneg (hF0 ω)]
6571      _ = ∫⁻ ω, Lr ω ∂P := lintegral_congr_ae hFL
6572      _ < ⊤ := hL
6573  show ∫⁻ ω, Lr ω ∂P = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ ω, F ω ∂P)
6574  rw [ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hFint (Eventually.of_forall hF0)]
6575  exact (lintegral_congr_ae hFL).symm
6576
6577end PC11b
6578
6579section PC12
6580open Classical HilbertCLTAux
6581
6582variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
6583  {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ}
6584variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
6585  [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]
6586variable {κ : Type*} [Countable κ] {ι : Type*} [Countable ι]
6587
6588lemma pc_isCtbl_of_HS {A : Type*} [Countable A] {ξ : ℝ → Ω → A → ℝ} {Φ : ℝ → Ω → κ → H}
6589    (hΦ : ∀ T, IsHSIntegrand P ℱ T Φ) (x : H)
6590    (hprog : ∀ a, IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => ξ r ω a))
6591    (hle : ∀ r ω, ∑' a, ‖ξ r ω a‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ (∑' k, ‖Φ r ω k‖ₑ ^ 2) * ‖x‖ₑ ^ 2) : IsCtbl P ℱ ξ :=
6592  pc_isCtbl_of_le hprog (g := fun r ω => (∑' k, ‖Φ r ω k‖ₑ ^ 2) * ‖x‖ₑ ^ 2) hle (fun T => by
6593    have h1 : ∫⁻ ω, (∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 T, (∑' k, ‖Φ r ω k‖ₑ ^ 2) * ‖x‖ₑ ^ 2) ∂P =
6594        hsSqIntegralOn P Φ T * ‖x‖ₑ ^ 2 := by
6595      unfold hsSqIntegralOn
6596      rw [← lintegral_mul_const' _ _ (pc_enorm_sq_ne_top x)]
6597      refine lintegral_congr fun ω => ?_
6598      rw [lintegral_mul_const' _ _ (pc_enorm_sq_ne_top x)]
6599    rw [h1]
6600    exact (ENNReal.mul_lt_top (hΦ T).sq (lt_top_iff_ne_top.2 (pc_enorm_sq_ne_top x))).ne)
6601
6602lemma pc_ctbl_S {Φ : ℝ → Ω → κ → H} (hΦ : ∀ T, IsHSIntegrand P ℱ T Φ) (e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H)
6603    {S : ℝ → Ω → H →L[ℝ] H}
6604    (hSsq : ∀ r ω, IsSqrtOfForm (S r ω) (hsCovForm (Φ r ω)))
6605    (hSprog : ∀ x y, IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => inner ℝ (S r ω x) y)) (t : ℝ) (x : H)
6606    (hpar : ∀ r ω x, HasSum (fun j => inner ℝ (S r ω (e j)) x ^ 2) (‖S r ω x‖ ^ 2)) :
6607    IsCtbl P ℱ (fun r ω (j : ι) => if r ≤ t then inner ℝ (S r ω (e j)) x else 0) := by
6608  refine pc_isCtbl_of_HS hΦ x (fun j => ?_) (fun r ω => ?_)
6609  · have := pc_isProgressive_ite (β := ℝ) (hSprog (e j) x) (measurableSet_Iic (a := t))
6610    simpa using this
6611  · by_cases hr : r ≤ t
6612    · simp only [hr, ite_true]
6613      rw [enorm_tsum_sq_of_hasSum (hpar r ω x)]
6614      have h1 : ‖S r ω x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (∑' k, ‖Φ r ω k‖ ^ 2) * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
6615        have := (hSsq r ω).sq x x
6616        rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at this
6617        rw [this]
6618        exact hsCovForm_le' ((hΦ 0).summable r ω) x
6619      calc ENNReal.ofReal (‖S r ω x‖ ^ 2) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((∑' k, ‖Φ r ω k‖ ^ 2) * ‖x‖ ^ 2) :=
6620            ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal h1
6621        _ = (∑' k, ‖Φ r ω k‖ₑ ^ 2) * ‖x‖ₑ ^ 2 := by
6622            rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (tsum_nonneg fun k => sq_nonneg _),
6623              ENNReal.ofReal_tsum_of_nonneg (fun k => sq_nonneg _) ((hΦ 0).summable r ω),
6624              pc_enorm_sq_vec' x]
6625            congr 1
6626            exact tsum_congr fun k => (pc_enorm_sq_vec' _).symm
6627    · simp [hr]
6628
6629lemma pc_ctbl_pcXi {Φ : ℝ → Ω → κ → H} (hΦ : ∀ T, IsHSIntegrand P ℱ T Φ) (x : H) (t : ℝ) :
6630    IsCtbl P ℱ (pcXi t Φ x ι) := by
6631  refine pc_isCtbl_of_HS hΦ x (fun a => ?_) (fun r ω => ?_)
6632  · rcases a with k | l
6633    · have h0 : IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => inner ℝ (Φ r ω k) x) :=
6634        fun i => ((hΦ 0).prog k i).inner measurable_const
6635      have := pc_isProgressive_ite (β := ℝ) h0 (measurableSet_Iic (a := t))
6636      simpa [pcXi] using this
6637    · simpa [pcXi] using isProgressive_const ℱ (0 : ℝ)
6638  · rw [Summable.tsum_sum ENNReal.summable ENNReal.summable]
6639    have h2 : ∑' l : ι, ‖(pcXi t Φ x ι r ω) (Sum.inr l)‖ₑ ^ 2 = 0 := by
6640      simp [pcXi]
6641    rw [h2, add_zero, ← ENNReal.tsum_mul_right]
6642    refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun k => ?_
6643    by_cases hr : r ≤ t
6644    · simp only [pcXi, Sum.elim_inl, hr, ite_true]
6645      exact pc_enorm_inner_sq_le _ _
6646    · simp [pcXi, hr]
6647
6648lemma pc_meas_Lr {Φ : ℝ → Ω → κ → H} (hΦ : ∀ T, IsHSIntegrand P ℱ T Φ) (t : ℝ)
6649    (sb : ℝ → (H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ)) (hsb : IsDetCovDensity t sb) :
6650    Measurable (fun ω => ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 t,
6651      ENNReal.ofReal (traceNormForm (hsCovForm (Φ r ω) - sb r))) := by
6652  have hdcm := pc_meas_covDisc hΦ t sb hsb
6653  have h1 : Measurable fun ω => ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 t,
6654      ENNReal.ofReal (traceNormForm (hsCovForm (Φ (min r t) ω) - sb r)) :=
6655    (hdcm.ennreal_ofReal.comp (measurable_swap (α := Ω) (β := ℝ))).lintegral_prod_right'
6656      (ν := volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 t))
6657  have : (fun ω => ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 t, ENNReal.ofReal (traceNormForm (hsCovForm (Φ r ω) - sb r))) =
6658      fun ω => ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 t,
6659        ENNReal.ofReal (traceNormForm (hsCovForm (Φ (min r t) ω) - sb r)) := by
6660    funext ω
6661    exact setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Icc fun r hr => by rw [min_eq_left hr.2]
6662  rw [this]; exact h1
6663
6664lemma pc_detData (e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H) (t : ℝ) (sb : ℝ → (H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ))
6665    (hsb : IsDetCovDensity t sb) {Sb : ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H} (hSbm : OpMeas Sb)
6666    (hSb0 : ∀ r, r ∉ Set.Icc 0 t → Sb r = 0) (hSb : ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 t, IsSqrtOfForm (Sb r) (sb r)) :
6667    ∃ T : ℝ → ℝ, PCDetData e t Sb T := by
6668  set T : ℝ → ℝ := (Set.Icc 0 t).indicator (fun r => ∑' i, sb r (e i) (e i)) with hT
6669  have hTm : Measurable T :=
6670    (Measurable.tsum fun i => hsb.meas (e i) (e i)).indicator measurableSet_Icc
6671  refine ⟨T, ⟨hSbm, hSb0, ?_, ?_, ?_, hTm, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
6672  · intro r x
6673    by_cases hr : r ∈ Set.Icc 0 t
6674    · have := hasSum_inner_sq e (Sb r x)
6675      convert this using 2 with j
6676      rw [(hSb r hr).symm (e j) x, real_inner_comm]
6677    · simp [hSb0 r hr]
6678  · intro r hr x
6679    obtain ⟨T0, hT0, hb⟩ := (hsb.traceClass r hr).hasSum_basis e
6680    have h1 : ‖Sb r x‖ ^ 2 = sb r x x := by
6681      rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, (hSb r hr).sq]
6682    simp only [hT, Set.indicator_of_mem hr, hT0.tsum_eq]
6683    rw [h1]; exact hb x
6684  · intro r hr
6685    obtain ⟨T0, hT0, hb⟩ := (hsb.traceClass r hr).hasSum_basis e
6686    simp only [hT, Set.indicator_of_mem hr, hT0.tsum_eq]
6687    convert hT0 using 2 with i
6688    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, (hSb r hr).sq]
6689  · intro r hr
6690    simp only [hT, Set.indicator_of_mem hr]
6691    exact tsum_nonneg fun i => (hsb.traceClass r hr).nonneg _
6692  · refine hsb.int.mono' hTm.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
6693    refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Icc).2 (Eventually.of_forall fun r hr => ?_)
6694    have h0 : 0 ≤ T r := by
6695      simp only [hT, Set.indicator_of_mem hr]
6696      exact tsum_nonneg fun i => (hsb.traceClass r hr).nonneg _
6697    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg h0]
6698    simp only [hT, Set.indicator_of_mem hr]
6699    exact (hsb.traceClass r hr).tsum_basis_le e
6700
6701end PC12

6704/-! ### Corollary A.23: predictable polar coupling in Hilbert space -/
6705
6706section Polar
6707
6708universe uΩ
6709
6710variable {Ω : Type uΩ} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
6711variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
6712  [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]
6713
6714set_option warn.classDefReducibility false in
6715/-- The σ-algebra generated by a family of real processes (used for "independent of `𝒢`"). -/
6716def cylindricalPathSigma {κ : Type*} (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω → κ → ℝ) : MeasurableSpace Ω :=
6717  ⨆ (τ : ℝ≥0) (k : κ), MeasurableSpace.comap (fun ω => B τ ω k) inferInstance
6718
6719/- CLT-02c attempt 2, universe finding (NOT fixed here; statements are frozen).
6720`hilbert_polar_coupling` is FALSE as typed for `Ω : Type u` with `u ≥ 1`, because its enlargement is
6721`Ω' : Type` (and `ι : Type`) while `Ω` is universe polymorphic (`variable {Ω : Type*}`).
6722Counterexample sketch: take `Ω = Ω₀ × (Cardinal.{0} → Bool)` (a `Type 1`), `P` = (any admissible
6723data on `Ω₀`, e.g. `Φ = 0`, `M = 0`) times the fair-coin product measure.  `MeasurePreserving π P' P`
6724with `Ω' : Type` would give `|Cardinal.{0}|` many sets `π⁻¹{ω | ω i = true} ⊆ Ω'`, pairwise at
6725`P'`-distance `1/2`, hence pairwise distinct, i.e. an injection `Cardinal.{0} ↪ Set Ω'` into a
6726`Type`-sized type, which is impossible.  Same repair as `dds_coupling_conditional`: put `Ω'` (and
6727`ι`) in `Type u_1` (enlargement `Ω × Ω''` is then in the same universe, so the intended
6728construction below goes through).  `hilbert_martingale_w2` is true as typed, but its route needs a
6729coupling space in `Type u_1`, hence the repaired `hilbert_polar_coupling`. -/

6733`r : ℝ`, but `IsDetCovDensity t sb` constrains `sb σ` only for `σ ∈ Icc 0 t` (trace class there);
6734`IsSqrtOfForm.sq` gives `sb r x x = ‖Sb r x‖² ≥ 0`.  Counterexample (checked in Lean, derives `False`
6735from the statement): `Ω = PUnit`, `P = dirac`, `ℱ` constant, `κ = Empty`, `Φ = 0`, `M = 0`, `H = ℝ`,

6740ALL `τ ≥ 0`; for `τ > t`, `itoIntegral` of an integrand that is not `L²` on `[0,τ]` is an arbitrary
6741`Classical.choose` (`IsItoIntegral.approx` is vacuous there), so those conclusions are not provable.
6742Suggested repair: `∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 t, IsSqrtOfForm (Sb r) (sb r)` (and for `S`), and the two
6743`IsHilbertItoIntegral` conclusions only for integrands/times in `[0,t]` (e.g. `approx` for
6744`τ ∈ Icc 0 t`, or integrands killed after `t`).  `hilbert_martingale_w2` below uses only the last five
6745conjuncts (law of `G t`, its covariance, the `L²` bound) and `MeasurePreserving π`, so its proof is
6746unchanged by any such repair. -/

6749`hilbert_martingale_w2` are FALSE as typed; NOT fixed here, statements are frozen).
6750The defect of attempt 3 (hypothesis `IsHSIntegrand P ℱ t Φ` controls `Φ` only on `[0,t]`, while
6751`IsHilbertItoIntegral.approx` is over all `τ ≥ 0`) is fatal on the HYPOTHESIS side too: `itoIntegral` is
6752`if h : ∃ M, IsItoIntegral … then h.choose else 0`, so when the unkilled integrals have no continuous
6753version, `itoIntegral = 0` and `hM` holds for `M = 0`.  Counterexample: `Ω` the Wiener space of a one
6754dimensional Brownian motion `W` with its natural filtration, `κ = Unit`, `H = ℝ`, `t > 0`, and the
6755deterministic progressive `Φ r ω () = 1` for `r ≤ t`, `(t+1-r)^{-1/2}` for `t < r < t+1`, `0` for
6756`r ≥ t+1` (so `hΦ` holds: `L²` on `[0,t]`).  For `t < t' < t+1`, `Φ` is `L²` on `[0,t']`, so
6757`IsItoIntegral.approx` pins `M_{t'}` to the true integral `N_{t'}`, whose quadratic variation
6758`∫_0^{t'}Φ² ↑ ∞` as `t' ↑ t+1`; hence `limsup N = ∞` a.s. and no `M` with `cont` (for every `ω`) exists,
6759so `¬∃ M, IsItoIntegral` and `M := 0` satisfies `hM`.  Then the 5th conjunct of the conclusion fails:
6760`S_r = 1` on `[0,t]` is forced (the unique nonnegative square root of `Σ_r = 1`), so for `τ = t`,
6761`x = 1` the integral of the killed integrand against `B` has second moment `t > 0` (Itô isometry) but
6762must be `L²`-close to `⟨M_t,1⟩ = 0`.  Likewise `hilbert_martingale_w2` fails with `sb ≡ 2`,
6763`γ = N(0,2t)`: `W₂²(δ₀,γ) = 2t > t = covDiscrepancy`.

6765on every finite horizon) in both theorems; then every coordinate integrand is `IsProgressiveL2`, the
6766`itoIntegral` of `hM` is the genuine integral, and the route of the docstring below goes through; the
6767integrand of `hM` (unkilled) is compared with the killed integrand of the 5th conjunct by the block
6768property `itoIntegral_blockInt`.  (Alternatively: `hM` for the integrand killed after `t`.)  The helper block
6769above (`FragP1`-`FragR12`) contains the bulk of the construction for either repair. -/

6771/-- Corollary A.23 `M:B:lem:hilbert-martingale-w2` (source lines 10629-10654).  Let `𝒢 ⊂ ℱ_0`,
6772`W` a `U`-cylindrical Brownian motion, `Φ` a Hilbert–Schmidt integrand with
6773`E ∫_0^t ‖Φ_r‖²_{𝓛₂} < ∞`, `M = ∫Φ dW`, `Σ_r = Φ_rΦ_r^*`, and `Σ̄ : [0,t] → 𝔖₁⁺(H)`
6774deterministic, measurable, with `∫_0^t Tr Σ̄_r dr < ∞`.  Then on an enlargement of the filtered
6775probability space (`Ω'`, `π`, `ℱ'`) there is an `H`-cylindrical Brownian motion `B` (indexed by a
6776Hilbert basis `e` of `H`), Brownian with respect to the enlarged filtration and independent of
6777`𝒢`, such that `M_τ = ∫_0^τ Σ_r^{1/2} dB_r` for `0 ≤ τ ≤ t` (`B:eq:polar-Brownian-representation`,
6778with `Σ_r^{1/2}` characterised by `IsSqrtOfForm`), and, for `G_τ := ∫_0^τ Σ̄_r^{1/2} dB_r`,
6779`G_t` is centered Gaussian, independent of `𝒢`, with covariance `∫_0^t Σ̄_r dr`, and
6780`E ‖M_t - G_t‖² ≤ E ∫_0^t ‖Σ_r - Σ̄_r‖_{𝔖₁} dr` (the coupling behind

6797theorem hilbert_polar_coupling (ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
6798    (𝒢 : InitialSigma ℱ)
6799    {κ : Type*} [Countable κ] (W : ℝ≥0 → Ω → κ → ℝ) (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ W)
6800    (Φ : ℝ → Ω → κ → H) (hΦ : ∀ T : ℝ, IsHSIntegrand P ℱ T Φ)
6801    (M : ℝ → Ω → H) (hM : IsHilbertItoIntegral P ℱ W Φ M)
6802    (sb : ℝ → (H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ)) (hsb : IsDetCovDensity t sb) :
6803    ∃ (Ω' : Type uΩ) (mΩ' : MeasurableSpace Ω') (P' : Measure Ω') (_ : IsProbabilityMeasure P')
6804      (π : Ω' → Ω) (_ : MeasurePreserving π P' P) (ℱ' : Filtration ℝ mΩ')
6805      (ι : Type uΩ) (_ : Countable ι) (e : HilbertBasis ι ℝ H) (B : ℝ≥0 → Ω' → ι → ℝ)
6806      (S : ℝ → Ω → (H →L[ℝ] H)) (Sb : ℝ → (H →L[ℝ] H)) (G : ℝ → Ω' → H),
6807      (∀ τ, (ℱ τ).comap π ≤ ℱ' τ) ∧
6808      IsCylindricalBrownian P' ℱ' B ∧
6809      Indep (𝒢.1.comap π) (cylindricalPathSigma B) P' ∧
6810      (∀ r ω, IsSqrtOfForm (S r ω) (hsCovForm (Φ r ω))) ∧
6811      IsHilbertItoIntegral P' ℱ' B (fun r ω' j => if r ≤ t then S r (π ω') (e j) else 0)
6812        (fun τ ω' => M (min τ t) (π ω')) ∧
6813      (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc 0 t, IsSqrtOfForm (Sb r) (sb r)) ∧
6814      IsHilbertItoIntegral P' ℱ' B (fun r _ j => if r ≤ t then Sb r (e j) else 0) G ∧
6815      AEMeasurable (G t) P' ∧
6816      Indep (𝒢.1.comap π) (MeasurableSpace.comap (G t) inferInstance) P' ∧
6817      IsCenteredGaussian (law P' (G t)) ∧
6818      (∀ x y, covarianceBilin (law P' (G t)) x y = ∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 t, sb σ x y) ∧
6819      ∫⁻ ω', ‖M t (π ω') - G t ω'‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P' ≤
6820        ENNReal.ofReal (covDiscrepancy P t (fun r ω => hsCovForm (Φ r ω)) sb) := by
6821  classical
6822  obtain ⟨ι, hι, e, -⟩ := exists_hilbertBasis_ulift.{_, uΩ} (H := H)
6823  obtain ⟨S, ψ, hSsq, hSprog, hψprog, hψo, hψe, hψn, hψt⟩ := exists_polar_family e Φ
6824    (fun k => (hΦ 0).prog k) (fun r ω => (hΦ 0).summable r ω)
6825  obtain ⟨Sb, hSbm, hSb0, hSb⟩ := exists_sqrt_density e t sb hsb
6826  obtain ⟨T, hD⟩ := pc_detData e t sb hsb hSbm hSb0 hSb
6827  have hW₂ : IsCylindricalBrownian (wMeasure ι) (wFiltration ι)
6828      (fun t (ω : ι → WienerSeq) (i : ι) => wienerPath t (ω i)) :=
6829    fun F => isBrownianFiltration_wFiltration F
6830  have h𝔚 : IsCylindricalBrownian (P.prod (wMeasure ι))
6831      (prodFiltration P (wMeasure ι) ℱ (wFiltration ι))
6832      (sumFam W (fun t (ω : ι → WienerSeq) (i : ι) => wienerPath t (ω i))) :=
6833    isCylindricalBrownian_prod hW hW₂

6847  choose Bj hBj using hex

6849      (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := fun r ω' i j => hψo r ω'.1 i j

6851    isCylindricalBrownian_of_itoC h𝔚 hψctbl hBj hortho'
6852  -- S side
6853  have hfS : ∀ x, IsCtbl P' ℱ' (fun r ω' (j : ι) => if r ≤ t then inner ℝ (S r ω'.1 (e j)) x else 0) :=

6855  have hZ : ∀ x, IsItoC P' ℱ' 𝔚 (fun r ω' => pcXi t Φ x ι r ω'.1)

6858  have hΞ : ∀ x, IsCtbl P' ℱ' (fun r ω' => pcXi t Φ x ι r ω'.1) :=
6859    fun x => pc_isCtbl_comp hπm hπp (pc_ctbl_pcXi hΦ x t)
6860  have hsum : ∀ x r (ω' : Ω × (ι → WienerSeq)), Summable fun j : ι =>
6861      (if r ≤ t then inner ℝ (S r ω'.1 (e j)) x else 0) ^ 2 := fun x r ω' => by
6862    by_cases hr : r ≤ t
6863    · simpa [hr] using (hψn x r ω'.1).summable
6864    · simp [hr]
6865  have hE2 : ∀ x (s : Finset ι) r (ω' : Ω × (ι → WienerSeq)), HasSum
6866      (fun a => (pcXi t Φ x ι r ω'.1 a - ∑ j ∈ s, (if r ≤ t then inner ℝ (S r ω'.1 (e j)) x else 0) *
6867        ψ' j r ω' a) ^ 2)
6868      (∑' j, if j ∈ s then 0 else (if r ≤ t then inner ℝ (S r ω'.1 (e j)) x else 0) ^ 2) := by
6869    intro x s r ω'
6870    by_cases hr : r ≤ t
6871    · have h := hψt s x r ω'.1
6872      have e1 : (fun a => (pcXi t Φ x ι r ω'.1 a - ∑ j ∈ s,
6873          (if r ≤ t then inner ℝ (S r ω'.1 (e j)) x else 0) * ψ' j r ω' a) ^ 2) =
6874          fun a => (Sum.elim (fun k => inner ℝ (Φ r ω'.1 k) x) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) a -
6875            ∑ j ∈ s, inner ℝ (S r ω'.1 (e j)) x * ψ j r ω'.1 a) ^ 2 := by
6876        funext a; simp [pcXi, hr, hψ']
6877      rw [e1]
6878      simpa [hr] using h
6879    · have e1 : (fun a => (pcXi t Φ x ι r ω'.1 a - ∑ j ∈ s,
6880          (if r ≤ t then inner ℝ (S r ω'.1 (e j)) x else 0) * ψ' j r ω' a) ^ 2) = fun _ => 0 := by
6881        funext a; rcases a with k | l <;> simp [pcXi, hr]
6882      rw [e1]
6883      simpa [hr] using hasSum_zero
6884  have hbridge : ∀ x τ, 0 ≤ τ → Tendsto (fun s : Finset ι => ∫⁻ ω', ‖itoIntegral P' ℱ'
6885      (fun t ω' (k : s) => (fun t ω' j => Bj j (t : ℝ) ω') t ω' k)
6886      (fun r ω' (k : s) => (if r ≤ t then inner ℝ (S r ω'.1 (e k)) x else 0)) τ ω' -
6887        inner ℝ (M (min τ t) ω'.1) x‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P') atTop (𝓝 0) := fun x τ hτ =>
6888    pc_bridge h𝔚 hψctbl hBj hB hortho' (hfS x) (hΞ x) (hZ x) (hsum x) (hE2 x) τ hτ
6889  have hZB : ∀ x, IsItoC P' ℱ' (fun t ω' j => Bj j (t : ℝ) ω')
6890      (fun r ω' (j : ι) => if r ≤ t then inner ℝ (S r ω'.1 (e j)) x else 0)
6891      (fun τ ω' => inner ℝ (M (min τ t) ω'.1) x) := fun x =>

6900  refine ⟨Ω × (ι → WienerSeq), inferInstance, P', inferInstance, Prod.fst, hπp, ℱ', ι, hι, e,
6901    fun t ω' j => Bj j (t : ℝ) ω', S, Sb, G, ?_, hB, ?_, hSsq, ?_, hSb, hGI, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩

6941PLAN: `hilbert_polar_coupling` gives the coupling `(M_t ∘ π, G_t)` on `Ω'`; `law P' (M_t ∘ π) =
6942law P (M_t)` by measure preservation and `law P' (G_t) = γ` by uniqueness of the centered Gaussian
6943law with a given covariance (`HilbertCLTAux.charFun_centered_gaussian` and the characteristic
6944function determines the law, `Measure.ext_of_charFun`); conclude with `wassersteinE_le_of_coupling`
6945(`HRS/Prob/Metrics.lean`) and `ENNReal.rpow` bookkeeping (`wassersteinE` is `(∫⁻ ‖x-y‖^2)^{1/2}`). -/
6946theorem hilbert_martingale_w2 (ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
6947    {κ : Type*} [Countable κ] (W : ℝ≥0 → Ω → κ → ℝ) (hW : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ W)
6948    (Φ : ℝ → Ω → κ → H) (hΦ : ∀ T : ℝ, IsHSIntegrand P ℱ T Φ)
6949    (M : ℝ → Ω → H) (hM : IsHilbertItoIntegral P ℱ W Φ M)
6950    (sb : ℝ → (H →L[ℝ] H →L[ℝ] ℝ)) (hsb : IsDetCovDensity t sb)
6951    (γ : Measure H) (hγ : IsGaussianWithIntegratedCov t sb γ) :
6952    wassersteinE 2 (law P (M t)) γ ^ (2 : ℝ) ≤
6953      ENNReal.ofReal (covDiscrepancy P t (fun r ω => hsCovForm (Φ r ω)) sb) := by
6954  obtain ⟨Ω', mΩ', P', hP', π, hπ, ℱ', ι, hι, e, B, S, Sb, G, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, hGm, -, hGc,
6955    hGcov, hbound⟩ := hilbert_polar_coupling P ℱ t ht ⟨⊥, bot_le⟩ W hW Φ hΦ M hM sb hsb
6956  obtain ⟨hγp, hγc, hγcov⟩ := hγ
6957  have hMm : AEMeasurable (M t) P := (Measurable.mono (hM.adapted t) (ℱ.le t) le_rfl).aemeasurable
6958  have hMπ : AEMeasurable (fun ω' => M t (π ω')) P' :=
6959    hMm.comp_quasiMeasurePreserving hπ.quasiMeasurePreserving
6960  have := hγp
6961  have h1 : law P' (fun ω' => M t (π ω')) = law P (M t) := by
6962    show P'.map (M t ∘ π) = _
6963    rw [← AEMeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable (by rwa [hπ.map_eq]) hπ.aemeasurable, hπ.map_eq]
6964  have h2 : law P' (G t) = γ := by
6965    haveI := hGc.1
6966    refine Measure.ext_of_charFun (funext fun u => ?_)
6967    rw [HilbertCLTAux.charFun_centered_gaussian hGc, HilbertCLTAux.charFun_centered_gaussian hγc,
6968      hGcov, hγcov]
6969  have key := wassersteinE_le_of_coupling P' 2 (by norm_num) (fun ω' => M t (π ω')) (G t) hMπ hGm
6970  rw [h1, h2] at key
6971  have key2 := ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow key (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)
6972  refine key2.trans ?_
6973  rw [← ENNReal.rpow_mul]
6974  have h3 : ∀ ω' : Ω', ENNReal.ofReal (‖M t (π ω') - G t ω'‖ ^ (2:ℝ)) =
6975      ‖M t (π ω') - G t ω'‖ₑ ^ 2 := fun ω' => by
6976    rw [Real.rpow_two, ← ofReal_norm_eq_enorm, ENNReal.ofReal_pow (norm_nonneg _)]
6977  simp only [h3]
6978  norm_num
6979  exact hbound
6980
6981end Polar
