6983/-! ### Corollary A.24: adding the initial term and the remainder -/
6984
6985section Assembly
6986
6987variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
6988variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H]
6989  [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]
6990
6991/-! Route for Corollary A.24: `assembly_wp` is the triangle inequality for `W_p` through
6992`I_emp + M_t` and `I_emp + G_t` (identity coupling with cost `E‖R‖^p`, the given coupling with cost
6993`E‖M_t - G_t‖^p`, and `wassersteinE_add_indep_le`, the convolution contraction obtained by pushing a
6994coupling of `(Law I_emp, Law I)` forward under `(a, b, g) ↦ (a + g, b + g)` with `g ∼ Law G_t`
6995independent of `𝒢`). -/
6996
6997lemma law_add_indep (𝒢 : SubSigma Ω mΩ) (A G : Ω → H)
6998    (hA : Measurable[𝒢.1] A) (hG : AEMeasurable G P)
6999    (hind : Indep 𝒢.1 (MeasurableSpace.comap G inferInstance) P) :
7000    law P (fun ω => A ω + G ω) = ((law P A).prod (law P G)).map (fun z : H × H => z.1 + z.2) := by
7001  have hAm : Measurable A := hA.mono 𝒢.2 le_rfl
7002  have hIA : IndepFun A G P := indep_of_indep_of_le_left hind hA.comap_le
7003  have h1 := (indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map hAm.aemeasurable hG).1 hIA
7004  have hm : AEMeasurable (fun ω => (A ω, G ω)) P := hAm.aemeasurable.prodMk hG
7005  rw [← h1, AEMeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable (by fun_prop) hm]
7006  rfl
7007
7008lemma wassersteinE_add_indep_le (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (𝒢 : SubSigma Ω mΩ) (A B G : Ω → H)
7009    (hA : Measurable[𝒢.1] A) (hB : Measurable[𝒢.1] B) (hG : AEMeasurable G P)
7010    (hind : Indep 𝒢.1 (MeasurableSpace.comap G inferInstance) P) :
7011    wassersteinE p (law P fun ω => A ω + G ω) (law P fun ω => B ω + G ω) ≤
7012      wassersteinE p (law P A) (law P B) := by
7013  have hp0 : 0 < p := by linarith
7014  have hAm : Measurable A := hA.mono 𝒢.2 le_rfl
7015  have hBm : Measurable B := hB.mono 𝒢.2 le_rfl
7016  set γ : Measure H := law P G with hγ
7017  have : IsProbabilityMeasure γ := inferInstance
7018  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (law P A) := inferInstance
7019  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (law P B) := inferInstance
7020  rw [law_add_indep P 𝒢 A G hA hG hind, law_add_indep P 𝒢 B G hB hG hind]
7021  refine le_iInf fun π => ?_
7022  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := π
7023  have : IsProbabilityMeasure π := hπ.isProbabilityMeasure
7024  have hkey : ∀ (f : H × H → H), Measurable f → ∀ (ρ : Measure H), π.map f = ρ →
7025      ((π.prod γ).map (fun w : (H × H) × H => f w.1 + w.2)) =
7026        (ρ.prod γ).map (fun z : H × H => z.1 + z.2) := by
7027    intro f hf ρ hρ
7028    have e1 : (fun w : (H × H) × H => f w.1 + w.2) =
7029        (fun z : H × H => z.1 + z.2) ∘ (Prod.map f id) := by ext w <;> simp
7030    rw [e1, ← Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop), ← hρ]
7031    congr 1
7032    rw [← Measure.map_prod_map _ _ hf measurable_id, Measure.map_id]
7033  set T : (H × H) × H → H × H := fun w => (w.1.1 + w.2, w.1.2 + w.2) with hT
7034  have hTm : Measurable T := by rw [hT]; fun_prop
7035  have hcoup : IsCoupling ((π.prod γ).map T)
7036      (((law P A).prod γ).map (fun z : H × H => z.1 + z.2))
7037      (((law P B).prod γ).map (fun z : H × H => z.1 + z.2)) := by
7038    constructor
7039    · rw [Measure.map_map measurable_fst hTm]
7040      exact hkey Prod.fst measurable_fst _ hπ.1
7041    · rw [Measure.map_map measurable_snd hTm]
7042      exact hkey Prod.snd measurable_snd _ hπ.2
7043  refine (wassersteinE_le_cost hcoup).trans ?_
7044  refine le_of_eq ?_
7045  congr 1
7046  rw [lintegral_map (by fun_prop) hTm]
7047  have : ∀ w : (H × H) × H, ENNReal.ofReal (‖(T w).1 - (T w).2‖ ^ p) =
7048      ENNReal.ofReal (‖w.1.1 - w.1.2‖ ^ p) := fun w => by
7049    simp [hT]
7050  simp only [this]
7051  rw [lintegral_prod _ (by fun_prop)]
7052  simp
7053
7054lemma assembly_wp (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (𝒢 : SubSigma Ω mΩ)
7055    (Iemp I R Mt Gt : Ω → H)
7056    (hIemp : Measurable[𝒢.1] Iemp) (hI : Measurable[𝒢.1] I)
7057    (hR : AEMeasurable R P) (hMt : AEMeasurable Mt P) (hGt : AEMeasurable Gt P)
7058    (hind : Indep 𝒢.1 (MeasurableSpace.comap Gt inferInstance) P) :
7059    wassersteinE p (law P fun ω => Iemp ω + Mt ω + R ω) (law P fun ω => I ω + Gt ω) ≤
7060      wassersteinE p (law P Iemp) (law P I) +
7061        (∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (‖Mt ω - Gt ω‖ ^ p) ∂P) ^ (1 / p) +
7062        (∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (‖R ω‖ ^ p) ∂P) ^ (1 / p) := by
7063  have hIm : AEMeasurable Iemp P := (hIemp.mono 𝒢.2 le_rfl).aemeasurable
7064  have hI'm : AEMeasurable I P := (hI.mono 𝒢.2 le_rfl).aemeasurable
7065  have h1 : AEMeasurable (fun ω => Iemp ω + Mt ω + R ω) P := (hIm.add hMt).add hR
7066  have h2 : AEMeasurable (fun ω => Iemp ω + Mt ω) P := hIm.add hMt
7067  have h3 : AEMeasurable (fun ω => Iemp ω + Gt ω) P := hIm.add hGt
7068  have h4 : AEMeasurable (fun ω => I ω + Gt ω) P := hI'm.add hGt
7069  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (law P fun ω => Iemp ω + Mt ω + R ω) := inferInstance
7070  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (law P fun ω => Iemp ω + Mt ω) := inferInstance
7071  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (law P fun ω => Iemp ω + Gt ω) := inferInstance
7072  have : IsProbabilityMeasure (law P fun ω => I ω + Gt ω) := inferInstance
7073  have t1 := wassersteinE_triangle p hp (law P fun ω => Iemp ω + Mt ω + R ω)
7074    (law P fun ω => Iemp ω + Mt ω) (law P fun ω => I ω + Gt ω)
7075  have t2 := wassersteinE_triangle p hp (law P fun ω => Iemp ω + Mt ω)
7076    (law P fun ω => Iemp ω + Gt ω) (law P fun ω => I ω + Gt ω)
7077  have c1 := wassersteinE_le_of_coupling P p hp _ _ h1 h2
7078  have c2 := wassersteinE_le_of_coupling P p hp _ _ h2 h3
7079  have c3 := wassersteinE_add_indep_le P p hp 𝒢 Iemp I Gt hIemp hI hGt hind
7080  have e1 : ∀ ω, ‖Iemp ω + Mt ω + R ω - (Iemp ω + Mt ω)‖ = ‖R ω‖ := fun ω => by
7081    rw [add_sub_cancel_left]
7082  have e2 : ∀ ω, ‖Iemp ω + Mt ω - (Iemp ω + Gt ω)‖ = ‖Mt ω - Gt ω‖ := fun ω => by
7083    rw [add_sub_add_left_eq_sub]
7084  simp only [e1, e2] at c1 c2
7085  calc _ ≤ _ := t1
7086    _ ≤ (∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (‖R ω‖ ^ p) ∂P) ^ (1 / p) +
7087        ((∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (‖Mt ω - Gt ω‖ ^ p) ∂P) ^ (1 / p) +
7088          wassersteinE p (law P Iemp) (law P I)) := by
7089      refine add_le_add c1 (t2.trans ?_)
7090      exact add_le_add c2 c3
7091    _ = _ := by ring
7092
7093
7094/-- Corollary A.24 `M:B:cor:hilbert-wasserstein-assembly` (source lines 10672-10692), bound
7095`B:eq:hilbert-W1-assembly`.  `I_emp, I, R` are `H`-valued random variables with `I_emp`, `I`
7096measurable with respect to `𝒢 ⊂ ℱ_0`, and `(M_t, G_t)` are coupled as in Corollary A.23: on the
7097same space, `G_t` centered Gaussian independent of `𝒢` with covariance `∫_0^t Σ̄`, and
7098`E ‖M_t - G_t‖² ≤ D` (the enlargement of A.23 is the ambient space here).  With
7099`X := I_emp + M_t + R`, `Y := I + G_t`,
7100`W₁(Law X, Law Y) ≤ W₁(Law I_emp, Law I) + D^{1/2} + E‖R‖_H`
7101(in `ℝ≥0∞`; `E‖R‖` is a `lintegral`, so no integrability of `R` is presupposed).
7102
7103PLAN (lines 10694-10696): triangle inequality `wassersteinE_triangle` for `W₁` through
7104`I_emp + M_t` and `I_emp + G_t`: the first step is the identity coupling
7105(`wassersteinE_le_of_coupling` with cost `E‖R‖`), the second the given coupling with cost
7106`E‖M_t - G_t‖ ≤ (E‖M_t - G_t‖²)^{1/2}` (Jensen, `lintegral_rpow_mono`), the third the
7107convolution contraction: `Law(I_emp + G_t) = Law(I_emp) * γ`, `Law(I + G_t) = Law(I) * γ` by
7108independence of `G_t` from `𝒢` (`indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map`), and
7109`W₁(ρ₁ * γ, ρ₂ * γ) ≤ W₁(ρ₁, ρ₂)` (push an optimal coupling of `ρ₁, ρ₂` forward by
7110`(a, b) ↦ (a + g, b + g)` under `π ⊗ γ`). -/
7111theorem hilbert_wasserstein_assembly_w1 (𝒢 : SubSigma Ω mΩ)
7112    (Iemp I R Mt Gt : Ω → H)
7113    (hIemp : Measurable[𝒢.1] Iemp) (hI : Measurable[𝒢.1] I)
7114    (hR : AEMeasurable R P) (hMt : AEMeasurable Mt P) (hGt : AEMeasurable Gt P)
7115    (hind : Indep 𝒢.1 (MeasurableSpace.comap Gt inferInstance) P)
7116    (hGauss : IsCenteredGaussian (law P Gt))
7117    (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hcoup : ∫⁻ ω, ‖Mt ω - Gt ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P ≤ ENNReal.ofReal D) :
7118    wassersteinE 1 (law P fun ω => Iemp ω + Mt ω + R ω) (law P fun ω => I ω + Gt ω) ≤
7119      wassersteinE 1 (law P Iemp) (law P I) + ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt D) +
7120        ∫⁻ ω, ‖R ω‖ₑ ∂P := by
7121  have h := assembly_wp P 1 le_rfl 𝒢 Iemp I R Mt Gt hIemp hI hR hMt hGt hind
7122  have e1 : ∀ x : H, ENNReal.ofReal (‖x‖ ^ (1 : ℝ)) = ‖x‖ₑ := fun x => by
7123    rw [Real.rpow_one, ofReal_norm]
7124  simp only [e1, div_one, ENNReal.rpow_one] at h
7125  refine h.trans ?_
7126  gcongr
7127  have hm : AEMeasurable (fun ω => ‖Mt ω - Gt ω‖ₑ) P := (hMt.sub hGt).enorm
7128  have := lintegral_rpow_mono P (fun ω => ‖Mt ω - Gt ω‖ₑ) (p := 1) (q := 2) one_pos one_le_two
7129  simp only [ENNReal.rpow_one, div_one, ENNReal.rpow_two] at this
7130  refine this.trans ?_
7131  have h2 : (∫⁻ ω, ‖Mt ω - Gt ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P) ^ (1 / (2:ℝ)) ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal D) ^ (1 / (2:ℝ)) :=
7132    ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow hcoup (by norm_num)
7133  refine h2.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
7134  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg hD (by norm_num), Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, one_div]
7135
7136
7137/-- Corollary A.24, bound `B:eq:hilbert-W2-assembly` (source lines 10685-10690): if all variables
7138have finite second moments, `W₂(Law X, Law Y) ≤ W₂(Law I_emp, Law I) + D^{1/2} + (E‖R‖²)^{1/2}`.
7139
7140PLAN: as `hilbert_wasserstein_assembly_w1` with `wassersteinE_triangle` for `p = 2` and
7141Minkowski's inequality in `L²(Ω;H)` (`eLpNorm_add_le`) for the first two steps; the convolution
7142contraction for `W₂` is the same push-forward argument. -/
7143theorem hilbert_wasserstein_assembly_w2 (𝒢 : SubSigma Ω mΩ)
7144    (Iemp I R Mt Gt : Ω → H)
7145    (hIemp : Measurable[𝒢.1] Iemp) (hI : Measurable[𝒢.1] I)
7146    (hIemp2 : MemLp Iemp 2 P) (hI2 : MemLp I 2 P) (hR2 : MemLp R 2 P) (hMt2 : MemLp Mt 2 P)
7147    (hGt2 : MemLp Gt 2 P)
7148    (hind : Indep 𝒢.1 (MeasurableSpace.comap Gt inferInstance) P)
7149    (hGauss : IsCenteredGaussian (law P Gt))
7150    (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hcoup : ∫⁻ ω, ‖Mt ω - Gt ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P ≤ ENNReal.ofReal D) :
7151    wassersteinE 2 (law P fun ω => Iemp ω + Mt ω + R ω) (law P fun ω => I ω + Gt ω) ≤
7152      wassersteinE 2 (law P Iemp) (law P I) + ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt D) +
7153        (∫⁻ ω, ‖R ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
7154  have h := assembly_wp P 2 (by norm_num) 𝒢 Iemp I R Mt Gt hIemp hI hR2.aemeasurable
7155    hMt2.aemeasurable hGt2.aemeasurable hind
7156  have e1 : ∀ x : H, ENNReal.ofReal (‖x‖ ^ (2 : ℝ)) = ‖x‖ₑ ^ 2 := fun x => by
7157    rw [Real.rpow_two, ENNReal.ofReal_pow (norm_nonneg _), ofReal_norm]
7158  simp only [e1] at h
7159  refine h.trans ?_
7160  gcongr
7161  have h2 : (∫⁻ ω, ‖Mt ω - Gt ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P) ^ (1 / (2:ℝ)) ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal D) ^ (1 / (2:ℝ)) :=
7162    ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow hcoup (by norm_num)
7163  refine h2.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
7164  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg hD (by norm_num), Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, one_div]
7165
7166end Assembly

7168/-! ### Remark A.20: the DDS coupling given an initial sigma-field -/
7169
7170section ConditionalCoupling
7171
7172variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
7173
7174/-! ### Route for Remark A.20 (as formalised, on a probability space in `Type`)
7175
7176The coded path space of `dds_coupling_proof` forgets the original space, so the Brownian motion it
7177produces cannot be compared with `𝒢`.  Instead the DDS construction is run directly on the product
7178`Ξ × Wiener` (`Ξ` the original space): the filtration `liftFiltration` contains the pull-back of the
7179clean (completed) filtration, `liftExtData` verifies the hypotheses of the time change
7180(`ExtData`), `brownian_core_init` is `ExtData.brownian_core` together with the fact that the
7181time-changed filtration contains the time-`0` σ-field of the original filtration, and the Brownian
7182motion `β` is independent of that σ-field. -/
7183
7184section DDSLift
7185
7186/-- `exists_enlargement_indep` (`HRS/Stochastic/DDSCore.lean`) for a space `E` in an arbitrary
7187universe (the proof there does not use `E : Type`). -/
7188theorem exists_enlargement_indep_univ (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (E : Type*) [MeasurableSpace E]
7189    (μ : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] :
7190    ∃ (W : ℝ≥0 → E × (ι → WienerSeq) → ι → ℝ) (hW : ∀ t, Measurable (W t)),
7191      (∀ ω, W 0 ω = 0) ∧ (∀ ω, Continuous fun t => W t ω) ∧
7192      IndepFun Prod.fst (fun p t => W t p) (μ.prod (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => wienerMeasure)) ∧
7193      IsBrownianFiltration (μ.prod (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => wienerMeasure))
7194        (generatedFiltration (μ.prod (Measure.pi fun _ : ι => wienerMeasure))
7195          Prod.fst measurable_fst W hW) W := by
7196  set ν : Measure (ι → WienerSeq) := Measure.pi fun _ : ι => wienerMeasure with hν
7197  set W : ℝ≥0 → E × (ι → WienerSeq) → ι → ℝ := fun t p k => wienerPath t (p.2 k) with hWdef
7198  have hW : ∀ t, Measurable (W t) := fun t =>
7199    Measurable.of_eval fun k => (measurable_wienerPath t).comp
7200      ((measurable_pi_apply k).comp measurable_snd)
7201  have hW0 : ∀ ω, W 0 ω = 0 := fun ω => funext fun k => wienerPath_zero _
7202  have hWc : ∀ ω, Continuous fun t => W t ω := fun ω =>
7203    continuous_pi fun k => continuous_wienerPath _
7204  have hX₀W : IndepFun Prod.fst (fun p : E × (ι → WienerSeq) => fun t => W t p) (μ.prod ν) :=
7205    indepFun_prod (μ := μ) (ν := ν) (X := id)
7206      (Y := fun (ω : ι → WienerSeq) (t : ℝ≥0) (k : ι) => wienerPath t (ω k)) measurable_id
7207      (Measurable.of_eval fun t => Measurable.of_eval fun k =>
7208        (measurable_wienerPath t).comp (measurable_pi_apply k))
7209  refine ⟨W, hW, hW0, hWc, hX₀W, ?_⟩
7210  have hsnd : MeasurePreserving (fun p : E × (ι → WienerSeq) => p.2) (μ.prod ν) ν :=
7211    measurePreserving_snd
7212  have hev : ∀ k : ι, MeasurePreserving (fun p : E × (ι → WienerSeq) => p.2 k) (μ.prod ν)
7213      wienerMeasure := fun k =>
7214    (measurePreserving_eval (fun _ : ι => wienerMeasure) k).comp hsnd
7215  have hB : ∀ k, IsBrownianReal (fun t p => W t p k) (μ.prod ν) := fun k =>
7216    IsBrownianReal.comp_measurePreserving (hev k) isPreBrownianReal_wienerPath
7217      continuous_wienerPath
7218  have hpath : Measurable fun (ω : WienerSeq) (t : ℝ≥0) => wienerPath t ω :=
7219    Measurable.of_eval measurable_wienerPath
7220  have hind0 : iIndepFun (fun (k : ι) (ω : ι → WienerSeq) => fun t : ℝ≥0 => wienerPath t (ω k)) ν :=
7221    iIndepFun_pi (μ := fun _ : ι => wienerMeasure) (X := fun _ => fun ω t => wienerPath t ω)
7222      (fun _ => hpath.aemeasurable)
7223  have hind : iIndepFun (fun (k : ι) (p : E × (ι → WienerSeq)) => fun t : ℝ≥0 => W t p k)
7224      (μ.prod ν) :=
7225    iIndepFun_comp_measurePreserving hsnd (X := fun (k : ι) (ω : ι → WienerSeq) =>
7226      fun t : ℝ≥0 => wienerPath t (ω k))
7227      (fun k => Measurable.of_eval fun t => (measurable_wienerPath t).comp (measurable_pi_apply k))
7228      hind0
7229  exact isBrownianFiltration_generated (μ.prod ν) W hW hB hind hW0 hWc Prod.fst measurable_fst
7230    hX₀W
7231
7232
7233variable {Ξ : Type*} {mΞ : MeasurableSpace Ξ}
7234
7235set_option warn.classDefReducibility false in
7236/-- The Brownian part of the lifted filtration. -/
7237def liftWPart (W : ℝ≥0 → Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq) → Fin 1 → ℝ) (u : ℝ) :
7238    MeasurableSpace (Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq)) :=
7239  ⨆ (r : ℝ≥0) (_ : (r : ℝ) ≤ u), MeasurableSpace.comap (W r) inferInstance
7240
7241/-- `ℱ u = (comap fst (ℱ₁ u) ⊔ σ(W_r, r ≤ u)) ⊔ nullSets`. -/
7242def liftFiltration (Q' : Measure (Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq))) (ℱ₁ : Filtration ℝ mΞ)
7243    (W : ℝ≥0 → Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq) → Fin 1 → ℝ) (hW : ∀ r, Measurable (W r)) :
7244    Filtration ℝ (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq))) where
7245  seq u := (MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.fst (ℱ₁ u) ⊔ liftWPart W u) ⊔ nullSets Q'
7246  mono' := by
7247    intro u u' h
7248    refine sup_le_sup_right (sup_le_sup ?_ ?_) _
7249    · exact MeasurableSpace.comap_mono (ℱ₁.mono h)
7250    · exact iSup₂_mono' fun r hr => ⟨r, hr.trans h, le_rfl⟩
7251  le' u := sup_le (sup_le ((MeasurableSpace.comap_mono (ℱ₁.le u)).trans measurable_fst.comap_le)
7252    (iSup₂_le fun r _ => (hW r).comap_le)) (nullSets_le Q')
7253
7254theorem comap_le_liftFiltration {Q' : Measure (Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq))} {ℱ₁ : Filtration ℝ mΞ}
7255    {W : ℝ≥0 → Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq) → Fin 1 → ℝ} {hW : ∀ r, Measurable (W r)} (u : ℝ) :
7256    MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.fst (ℱ₁ u) ≤ liftFiltration Q' ℱ₁ W hW u :=
7257  (le_sup_left : MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.fst (ℱ₁ u) ≤ _ ⊔ liftWPart W u).trans le_sup_left
7258
7259theorem liftWPart_le_liftFiltration {Q' : Measure (Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq))}
7260    {ℱ₁ : Filtration ℝ mΞ} {W : ℝ≥0 → Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq) → Fin 1 → ℝ}
7261    {hW : ∀ r, Measurable (W r)} (u : ℝ) : liftWPart W u ≤ liftFiltration Q' ℱ₁ W hW u :=
7262  (le_sup_right : liftWPart W u ≤ MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.fst (ℱ₁ u) ⊔ _).trans le_sup_left
7263
7264theorem liftFiltration_le_generated {Q' : Measure (Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq))}
7265    {ℱ₁ : Filtration ℝ mΞ} {W : ℝ≥0 → Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq) → Fin 1 → ℝ}
7266    {hW : ∀ r, Measurable (W r)} (u : ℝ) :
7267    liftFiltration Q' ℱ₁ W hW u ≤ generatedFiltration Q' Prod.fst measurable_fst W hW u := by
7268  refine sup_le_sup_right (sup_le ?_ ?_) _
7269  · exact (MeasurableSpace.comap_mono (ℱ₁.le u)).trans le_sup_left
7270  · exact le_sup_right
7271
7272theorem liftWPart_le_comap_path (W : ℝ≥0 → Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq) → Fin 1 → ℝ) (u : ℝ) :
7273    liftWPart W u ≤ MeasurableSpace.comap (fun p τ => W τ p) inferInstance := by
7274  refine iSup₂_le fun r _ => ?_
7275  have : (W r) = (fun f : ℝ≥0 → Fin 1 → ℝ => f r) ∘ (fun p τ => W τ p) := rfl
7276  rw [this, ← MeasurableSpace.comap_comp]
7277  exact MeasurableSpace.comap_mono (measurable_pi_apply r).comap_le
7278
7279theorem martingale_lift (Q : Measure Ξ) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] {ℱ₁ : Filtration ℝ mΞ}
7280    {Y : ℝ → Ξ → ℝ} (hY : Martingale Y ℱ₁ Q)
7281    {W : ℝ≥0 → Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq) → Fin 1 → ℝ} (hW : ∀ r, Measurable (W r))
7282    (hind : IndepFun Prod.fst (fun p τ => W τ p)
7283      (Q.prod (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin 1 => wienerMeasure))) :
7284    Martingale (fun τ (p : Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq)) => Y τ p.1)
7285      (liftFiltration (Q.prod (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin 1 => wienerMeasure)) ℱ₁ W hW)
7286      (Q.prod (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin 1 => wienerMeasure)) := by
7287  set ν : Measure (Fin 1 → WienerSeq) := Measure.pi fun _ : Fin 1 => wienerMeasure with hν
7288  set Q' := Q.prod ν with hQ'
7289  have hfst : MeasurePreserving (Prod.fst : Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq) → Ξ) Q' Q :=
7290    measurePreserving_fst
7291  have hint : ∀ τ, Integrable (fun p : Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq) => Y τ p.1) Q' := fun τ =>
7292    hfst.integrable_comp_of_integrable (hY.integrable τ)
7293  have hfm : ∀ τ, StronglyMeasurable[MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.fst inferInstance]
7294      (fun p : Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq) => Y τ p.1) := fun τ =>
7295    (((hY.1 τ).measurable.mono (ℱ₁.le τ) le_rfl).comp
7296      (comap_measurable (Prod.fst : Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq) → Ξ))).stronglyMeasurable
7297  have hgm : ∀ τ, StronglyMeasurable[MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.fst (ℱ₁ τ)]
7298      (fun p : Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq) => Y τ p.1) := fun τ =>
7299    ((hY.1 τ).measurable.comp
7300      (comap_measurable (Prod.fst : Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq) → Ξ))).stronglyMeasurable
7301  refine ⟨fun τ => (hgm τ).mono (comap_le_liftFiltration τ), fun s r hsr => ?_⟩
7302  have hind' : Indep (MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.fst inferInstance :
7303      MeasurableSpace (Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq))) (liftWPart W s) Q' :=
7304    indep_of_indep_of_le_right ((IndepFun_iff_Indep _ _ _).1 hind) (liftWPart_le_comap_path W s)
7305  have hle1 : MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.fst (ℱ₁ s) ≤ (MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.fst inferInstance :
7306      MeasurableSpace (Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq))) := MeasurableSpace.comap_mono (ℱ₁.le s)
7307  have hle2 : (MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.fst inferInstance :
7308      MeasurableSpace (Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq))) ≤
7309      (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq))) := measurable_fst.comap_le
7310  have hle3 : liftWPart W s ≤ (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq))) :=
7311    (liftWPart_le_liftFiltration (Q' := Q') (ℱ₁ := ℱ₁) (hW := hW) s).trans
7312      ((liftFiltration Q' ℱ₁ W hW).le s)
7313  have e1 : Q'[fun p : Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq) => Y r p.1 | liftFiltration Q' ℱ₁ W hW s] =ᵐ[Q']
7314      Q'[fun p : Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq) => Y r p.1 |
7315        MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.fst (ℱ₁ s) ⊔ liftWPart W s] :=
7316    condExp_sup_nullSets (sup_le (hle1.trans hle2) hle3) _
7317  have e2 := condExp_sup_of_indep (P := Q') (𝒜 := MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.fst (ℱ₁ s)) hle2 hle3
7318    hle1 hind' (hint r) (hfm r)
7319  have e3 : (fun p : Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq) => Y s p.1) =ᵐ[Q']
7320      Q'[fun p : Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq) => Y r p.1 | MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.fst (ℱ₁ s)] := by
7321    refine ae_eq_condExp_of_forall_setIntegral_eq (hle1.trans hle2) (hint r)
7322      (fun S _ _ => (hint s).integrableOn) (fun S hS _ => ?_) (hgm s).aestronglyMeasurable
7323    obtain ⟨H, hH, rfl⟩ := hS
7324    have hHfull : MeasurableSet H := ℱ₁.le s _ hH
7325    have key : ∀ τ, ∫ p in (Prod.fst : Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq) → Ξ) ⁻¹' H, Y τ p.1 ∂Q' =
7326        ∫ ω in H, Y τ ω ∂Q := by
7327      intro τ
7328      have h1 := setIntegral_map (μ := Q') (g := (Prod.fst : Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq) → Ξ))
7329        (f := Y τ) hHfull
7330        (by rw [hfst.map_eq]; exact ((hY.1 τ).measurable.mono (ℱ₁.le τ) le_rfl).aestronglyMeasurable)
7331        measurable_fst.aemeasurable
7332      rw [hfst.map_eq] at h1
7333      exact h1.symm
7334    rw [key s, key r]
7335    exact hY.setIntegral_eq hsr hH
7336  exact e1.trans (e2.trans e3.symm)
7337
7338theorem liftExtData {Q : Measure Ξ} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] {ℱ₁ : Filtration ℝ mΞ} {t : ℝ}
7339    {M A : ℝ → Ξ → ℝ} (hc : CleanData Q ℱ₁ t M A) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
7340    ∃ (W : ℝ≥0 → Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq) → Fin 1 → ℝ) (hW : ∀ r, Measurable (W r)),
7341      ExtData (Q.prod (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin 1 => wienerMeasure))
7342        (liftFiltration (Q.prod (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin 1 => wienerMeasure)) ℱ₁ W hW) W t
7343        (fun τ p => M τ p.1) (fun τ p => A τ p.1) := by
7344  obtain ⟨W, hW, hW0, hWc, hind, hBF⟩ := exists_enlargement_indep_univ (Fin 1) Ξ Q
7345  refine ⟨W, hW, ?_⟩
7346  set P' := Q.prod (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin 1 => wienerMeasure) with hP'
7347  have hfst : MeasurePreserving (Prod.fst : Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq) → Ξ) P' Q :=
7348    measurePreserving_fst
7349  have hcomplete : IsCompleteFiltration P' (liftFiltration P' ℱ₁ W hW) := by
7350    intro u S hS hP
7351    have h1 : MeasurableSet[nullSets P'] S := MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_generateFrom ⟨hS, hP⟩
7352    exact (le_sup_right : nullSets P' ≤ _) S h1
7353  refine
7354    { bf := IsBrownianFiltration.of_le_of_adapted hBF (fun u => liftFiltration_le_generated u)
7355        hcomplete (fun u => ?_)
7356      ht := ht
7357      mart := martingale_lift Q hc.mart hW hind
7358      qmart := martingale_lift Q hc.qmart hW hind
7359      memLp := fun τ hτ => (hc.memLp τ hτ).comp_measurePreserving hfst
7360      adaptedA := fun τ => ((hc.adaptedA τ).comp
7361        (comap_measurable (Prod.fst : Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq) → Ξ))).mono
7362          (comap_le_liftFiltration τ) le_rfl
7363      zeroM := fun p => hc.zeroM p.1
7364      zeroA := fun p => hc.zeroA p.1
7365      contM := fun p => (hc.contM p.1)
7366      contA := fun p => (hc.contA p.1)
7367      monoA := fun p => (hc.monoA p.1) }
7368  exact Measurable.of_comap_le ((le_iSup₂_of_le u le_rfl le_rfl :
7369      MeasurableSpace.comap (W u) inferInstance ≤ liftWPart W (u : ℝ)).trans
7370        (liftWPart_le_liftFiltration (Q' := P') (ℱ₁ := ℱ₁) (hW := hW) (u : ℝ)))
7371
7372end DDSLift
7373
7374section DDSCoreInit
7375
7376variable {Ω₂ : Type*} {m₂ : MeasurableSpace Ω₂} {P₂ : Measure Ω₂} [IsProbabilityMeasure P₂]
7377  {𝒢 : Filtration ℝ m₂} {W : ℝ≥0 → Ω₂ → Fin 1 → ℝ} {t : ℝ} {M' A' : ℝ → Ω₂ → ℝ}
7378
7379/-- `ExtData.brownian_core` (`HRS/Stochastic/DDSCore.lean`) together with the fact that the
7380time-changed filtration contains the time-`0` σ-field of the original one (`𝒢_0 ≤ 𝒢_{S_v}` since
7381`S_v ≥ 0`). -/
7382theorem ExtData.brownian_core_init (h : ExtData P₂ 𝒢 W t M' A') :
7383    ∃ (ℱ' : Filtration ℝ m₂) (β : ℝ≥0 → Ω₂ → Fin 1 → ℝ), IsBrownianFiltration P₂ ℱ' β ∧ (∀ u, 𝒢 0 ≤ ℱ' u) ∧
7384      (∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc 0 t, IsStoppingTime ℱ' fun ω => ((max (A' τ ω) 0 : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ)) ∧
7385      (∀ᵐ ω ∂P₂, ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc 0 t, M' τ ω = β (Real.toNNReal (A' τ ω)) ω 0) := by
7386  classical
7387  have hT := h.tcData
7388  obtain ⟨hcomp, hadapt, hzero, hcont, hmart, hqv⟩ := timeChange_levy_hypotheses hT
7389  set ℱ' := timeChangedFiltration P₂ 𝒢 (Aext A' t) hT.adapted hT.contA with hℱ'
7390  set β0 : ℝ → Ω₂ → ℝ := tcProcess (Mext W M' t) (Aext A' t) with hβ0
7391  have hβ0max : ∀ u ω, β0 (max u 0) ω = β0 u ω := fun u ω => by
7392    simp only [hβ0, tcProcess, levelTimeR_max_zero (hT.zeroA ω)]
7393  have hmeas : ∀ u : ℝ≥0, Measurable (fun ω => β0 u ω) := fun u => hT.measurable_tcProcess (u : ℝ)
7394  have hcont' : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P₂, Continuous fun u : ℝ≥0 => β0 u ω :=
7395    hcont.mono fun ω hω => hω.comp NNReal.continuous_coe
7396  obtain ⟨Y, hYm, hYc, hYae⟩ := exists_continuous_modification P₂ (fun (u : ℝ≥0) ω => β0 u ω) hmeas hcont'
7397  set βs : ℝ≥0 → Ω₂ → ℝ := fun u ω => Y u ω - Y 0 ω with hβs
7398  have hY0 : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P₂, Y 0 ω = 0 := by
7399    filter_upwards [hYae] with ω hω
7400    rw [hω 0]; exact hzero ω
7401  have hβsae : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P₂, ∀ u : ℝ≥0, βs u ω = β0 u ω := by
7402    filter_upwards [hYae, hY0] with ω h1 h2 u
7403    simp only [hβs, h1 u, h2, sub_zero]
7404  have hβsm : ∀ u, Measurable (βs u) := fun u => (hYm u).sub (hYm 0)
7405  -- real-time version
7406  have hβsR : ∀ u : ℝ, (fun ω => ofNNRealTime βs u ω) =ᵐ[P₂] β0 u := by
7407    intro u
7408    filter_upwards [hβsae] with ω hω
7409    simp only [ofNNRealTime_apply]
7410    rw [hω, ← hβ0max u ω]
7411    congr 1
7412  have hβsad : ∀ u : ℝ, Measurable[ℱ' u] (fun ω => ofNNRealTime βs u ω) := fun u =>
7413    hcomp.measurable_of_ae_eq u (hadapt u)
7414      ((hβsm _)) (hβsR u).symm
7415  refine ⟨ℱ', fun u ω _ => βs u ω, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
7416  · refine levy_characterization P₂ ℱ' hcomp (fun u ω _ => βs u ω) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
7417    · intro u
7418      have hb := hβsad (u : ℝ)
7419      letI : MeasurableSpace Ω₂ := ℱ' u
7420      exact measurable_pi_iff.2 fun _ => by simpa using hb
7421    · intro ω; funext k; simp [hβs]
7422    · intro ω; exact continuous_pi fun _ => (hYc ω).sub continuous_const
7423    · intro k
7424      refine martingale_congr_ae hmart (fun u => (hβsad u).stronglyMeasurable) hβsR
7425    · intro k l
7426      have hkl : k = l := Subsingleton.elim k l
7427      subst hkl
7428      refine martingale_congr_ae hqv (fun u => ?_) (fun u => ?_)
7429      · simp only [ite_true]
7430        exact (((hβsad u).mul (hβsad u)).sub measurable_const).stronglyMeasurable
7431      · simp only [ite_true]
7432        filter_upwards [hβsR u] with ω hω
7433        simp only [ofNNRealTime_apply] at hω ⊢
7434        rw [hω]
7435  · intro u
7436    show 𝒢 0 ≤ (⨅ (v : ℝ) (_ : u < v),
7437      (isStoppingTime_levelTime 𝒢 (Aext A' t) hT.adapted hT.contA v).measurableSpace) ⊔
7438        nullSets P₂
7439    refine le_trans ?_ (le_sup_left : _ ≤ _ ⊔ nullSets P₂)
7440    refine le_iInf₂ fun v hv => ?_
7441    have := (isStoppingTime_const 𝒢 (0 : ℝ)).measurableSpace_mono
7442      (isStoppingTime_levelTime 𝒢 (Aext A' t) hT.adapted hT.contA v)
7443      (fun ω => levelTime_nonneg (A := Aext A' t) (ω := ω) v)
7444    rwa [IsStoppingTime.measurableSpace_const] at this
7445  · intro τ hτ
7446    have e := h.Aext_of_mem hτ
7447    have := isStoppingTime_max_level (P := P₂) (𝒢 := 𝒢) (A := Aext A' t) (hA := hT.adapted)
7448      (hc := hT.contA) hT.monoA hT.zeroA τ hτ.1
7449    rw [e] at this
7450    exact this
7451  · filter_upwards [hT.ae_const_on_const_of_qv_real, hβsae] with ω hconst hβω τ hτ
7452    have hAτ : Aext A' t τ ω = A' τ ω := by rw [h.Aext_of_mem hτ]
7453    have hu0 : 0 ≤ A' τ ω := by
7454      have h3 : A' 0 ω ≤ A' τ ω := h.monoA ω ⟨le_rfl, h.ht⟩ hτ hτ.1
7455      rwa [h.zeroA ω] at h3
7456    set S := levelTimeR (Aext A' t) (A' τ ω) ω with hS
7457    have hS0 : 0 ≤ S := levelTimeR_nonneg (hT.topA ω) _
7458    have hSτ : S ≤ τ := levelTimeR_le_of_le (hT.topA ω) (hT.contA ω) (hT.monoA ω) hτ.1
7459      (le_of_eq (by rw [hAτ]))
7460    have hAS : Aext A' t S ω = A' τ ω := by
7461      rw [hS, hT.A_levelTimeR_max' ω, max_eq_left hu0]
7462    have hc := hconst S τ hS0 hSτ (by rw [hAS, hAτ]) τ ⟨hSτ, le_rfl⟩
7463    have h1 : β0 (A' τ ω) ω = Mext W M' t S ω := rfl
7464    have h2 : M' τ ω = Mext W M' t τ ω := by rw [h.Mext_of_mem hτ]
7465    have h3 : βs (Real.toNNReal (A' τ ω)) ω = β0 (A' τ ω) ω := by
7466      rw [hβω, hβ0, show ((Real.toNNReal (A' τ ω) : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) = A' τ ω from
7467        Real.coe_toNNReal _ hu0]
7468    show M' τ ω = βs (Real.toNNReal (A' τ ω)) ω
7469    rw [h3, h1, h2, hc]
7470
7471
7472end DDSCoreInit
7473
7474section DDSAssembly
7475
7476universe uΞ
7477
7478/-- Remark A.20 for a probability space `Ξ : Type uΞ`, with the enlargement `Ξ × Wiener` in the same
7479universe (the original specification put the enlargement in `Type`, which is false for `Ξ` in a higher universe: an
7480enlargement in `Type` cannot exist in general, since a measure-preserving `π : Ω' → Ξ` forces
7481`P` to have a Type-small support): the coupling `G = β_v` with `β` the Dambis–Dubins–Schwarz
7482Brownian motion of the time-changed filtration, which contains `ℱ_0 ⊇ 𝒢` at time `0`. -/
7483theorem dds_coupling_conditional {Ξ : Type uΞ} {mΞ : MeasurableSpace Ξ} (Q : Measure Ξ)
7484    [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΞ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (𝒢 : InitialSigma ℱ)
7485    (M A : ℝ → Ξ → ℝ) (hM : IsContSqMartingale Q ℱ t M) (hA : IsQuadraticVariation Q ℱ t M A)
7486    (hint : Integrable (A t) Q) (v : ℝ) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
7487    ∃ (Ω' : Type uΞ) (_ : MeasurableSpace Ω') (P' : Measure Ω') (_ : IsProbabilityMeasure P')
7488      (π : Ω' → Ξ) (_ : MeasurePreserving π P' Q) (G : Ω' → ℝ),
7489      Measurable G ∧
7490      law P' G = gaussianLaw v ∧
7491      Indep (𝒢.1.comap π) (MeasurableSpace.comap G inferInstance) P' ∧
7492      ∫⁻ ω', ‖M t (π ω') - G ω'‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P' ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ ω, |A t ω - v| ∂Q) := by
7493  classical
7494  obtain ⟨M₁, A₁, hc, hMae, hAae⟩ := exists_clean hM hA hint
7495  obtain ⟨W, hW, hext⟩ := liftExtData hc ht
7496  set P' := Q.prod (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin 1 => wienerMeasure) with hP'
7497  obtain ⟨ℱ', β, hβ, hinit, hstop, hid⟩ := hext.brownian_core_init
7498  have hfst : MeasurePreserving (Prod.fst : Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq) → Ξ) P' Q :=
7499    measurePreserving_fst
7500  refine ⟨Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq), inferInstance, P', inferInstance, Prod.fst, hfst,
7501    fun p => β (Real.toNNReal v) p 0, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
7502  · exact (measurable_pi_apply 0).comp ((hβ.adapted _).mono (ℱ'.le _) le_rfl)
7503  · exact (hβ.hasLaw_coord (Real.toNNReal v) 0).map_eq
7504  · -- independence of `𝒢` and `β_v`
7505    have h1 : (𝒢.1.comap (Prod.fst : Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq) → Ξ)) ≤ ℱ' 0 := by
7506      refine (MeasurableSpace.comap_mono (𝒢.2.trans ?_)).trans
7507        ((comap_le_liftFiltration (Q' := P') (ℱ₁ := augFiltration Q ℱ) (hW := hW) 0).trans
7508          (hinit 0))
7509      exact le_sup_left
7510    have h2 : MeasurableSpace.comap (fun p : Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq) => β (Real.toNNReal v) p 0)
7511        inferInstance ≤ MeasurableSpace.comap
7512          (fun p => β (Real.toNNReal v) p - β 0 p) inferInstance := by
7513      have : (fun p : Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq) => β (Real.toNNReal v) p 0) =
7514          (fun y : Fin 1 → ℝ => y 0) ∘ (fun p => β (Real.toNNReal v) p - β 0 p) := by
7515        funext p; simp [hβ.zero p]
7516      rw [this, ← MeasurableSpace.comap_comp]
7517      exact MeasurableSpace.comap_mono (measurable_pi_apply 0).comap_le
7518    exact indep_of_indep_of_le_left (indep_of_indep_of_le_right
7519      (hβ.indep_incr 0 (Real.toNNReal v) zero_le).symm h2) h1
7520  · have hAm : Measurable (A₁ t) := (hc.adaptedA t).mono ((augFiltration Q ℱ).le t) le_rfl
7521    have hS0 : ∀ p : Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq), 0 ≤ max (A₁ t p.1) 0 := fun p => le_max_right _ _
7522    have hSint : Integrable (fun p : Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq) => max (A₁ t p.1) 0) P' :=
7523      hfst.integrable_comp_of_integrable (g := fun ω => max (A₁ t ω) 0) hc.intA.pos_part
7524    have hbound := brownian_stopped_L2_bound hβ 0 (fun p => max (A₁ t p.1) 0) hS0
7525      (hstop t ⟨ht, le_rfl⟩) hSint v hv
7526    simp_rw [toNNReal_max_zero] at hbound
7527    have hAnn : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ A₁ t ω := fun ω => by
7528      have h3 : A₁ 0 ω ≤ A₁ t ω := hc.monoA ω ⟨le_rfl, ht⟩ ⟨ht, le_rfl⟩ ht
7529      rwa [hc.zeroA ω] at h3
7530    have hint_eq : ∫ p, |max (A₁ t p.1) 0 - v| ∂P' = ∫ ω, |A t ω - v| ∂Q := by
7531      have hg : Measurable fun ω => |max (A₁ t ω) 0 - v| := ((hAm.max measurable_const).sub_const v).abs
7532      have h1 := integral_map (μ := P') (φ := (Prod.fst : Ξ × (Fin 1 → WienerSeq) → Ξ))
7533        hfst.measurable.aemeasurable (f := fun ω => |max (A₁ t ω) 0 - v|) hg.aestronglyMeasurable
7534      rw [hfst.map_eq] at h1
7535      rw [← h1]
7536      refine integral_congr_ae ?_
7537      filter_upwards [hAae t] with ω hω
7538      rw [max_eq_left (hAnn ω), hω]
7539    have e1 : ∀ᵐ p ∂P', M t p.1 = β (Real.toNNReal (A₁ t p.1)) p 0 := by
7540      have h0 := hfst.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae_eq_comp (hMae t)
7541      filter_upwards [h0, hid] with p h1 h2
7542      exact h1.symm.trans (h2 t ⟨ht, le_rfl⟩)
7543    calc ∫⁻ p, ‖M t p.1 - β (Real.toNNReal v) p 0‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P'
7544        = ∫⁻ p, ‖β (Real.toNNReal (A₁ t p.1)) p 0 - β (Real.toNNReal v) p 0‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P' :=
7545          lintegral_congr_ae (by filter_upwards [e1] with p hp; rw [hp])
7546      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ p, |max (A₁ t p.1) 0 - v| ∂P') := hbound
7547      _ = _ := by rw [hint_eq]
7548
7549end DDSAssembly

7554/-! ### Remarks 3.8, A.25 and A.32: several observation times through one vector martingale -/
7555
7556section MultiTime
7557
7558variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
7559variable (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ} {W : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ι → ℝ}
7560
7561/-- The integrand "killed after `t_a`": `1_{r < t_a} Φ_r` (Remark A.32's display
7562`B:newprob:stopped-integrands`, line 11043; Remark 3.8 says "extend the integrand by zero on
7563`(t_a, t_q]`", which differs only at the single time `r = t_a`). -/
7564def killAfter (Φ : ℝ → Ω → ι → ℝ) (ta : ℝ) : ℝ → Ω → ι → ℝ :=
7565  fun r ω => Set.indicator (Set.Iio ta) (fun _ => Φ r ω) r
7566
7567/-- The covariation density of the killed vector: `Σ^{ab}_r = 1_{r < min(t_a,t_b)} ∑_k Φ^{a,k}_r Φ^{b,k}_r`
7568(`B:newprob:stopped-integrands`, line 11044; `B:eq:qv-cross` with the extended integrands). -/
7569def killedCovMatrix {p : ℕ} (Φ : Fin p → ℝ → Ω → ι → ℝ) (ts : Fin p → ℝ) :
7570    ℝ → Ω → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ :=
7571  fun r ω => Matrix.of fun a b => if r < min (ts a) (ts b) then ∑ k, Φ a r ω k * Φ b r ω k else 0
7572
7573omit [IsProbabilityMeasure P] in
7574/-- Indicator of a measurable time set `S` applied to a progressive `L²` integrand is progressive
7575and `L²` (`1_S(r) Φ_r`). -/
7576theorem isProgressiveL2_indicator_set {Φ : ℝ → Ω → ι → ℝ} {S : Set ℝ} (hS : MeasurableSet S)
7577    (hΦ : IsProgressiveL2 P ℱ Φ) :
7578    IsProgressiveL2 P ℱ (fun r ω => Set.indicator S (fun _ => Φ r ω) r) := by
7579  refine ⟨?_, fun T => ?_⟩
7580  · intro i
7581    have hset : MeasurableSet[Subtype.instMeasurableSpace.prod (ℱ i)]
7582        {p : Set.Iic i × Ω | (p.1 : ℝ) ∈ S} :=
7583      hS.preimage (measurable_subtype_coe.comp
7584        (@measurable_fst (Set.Iic i) Ω Subtype.instMeasurableSpace (ℱ i)))
7585    have := (hΦ.prog i).indicator hset
7586    convert this using 1
7587    funext p
7588    beta_reduce
7589    by_cases hp : (p.1 : ℝ) ∈ S
7590    · have hp' : p ∈ {p : Set.Iic i × Ω | (p.1 : ℝ) ∈ S} := hp
7591      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hp (f := fun _ => Φ p.1 p.2), Set.indicator_of_mem hp']
7592    · have hp' : p ∉ {p : Set.Iic i × Ω | (p.1 : ℝ) ∈ S} := hp
7593      rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hp, Set.indicator_of_notMem hp']
7594  · refine lt_of_le_of_lt (sqIntegralOn_mono_of_enorm_le (fun s ω k => ?_) T) (hΦ.sq T)
7595    by_cases hr : s ∈ S <;> simp [Set.indicator, hr]
7596
7597/-- For `t_a ≥ 0` the killed integrand `1_{r < t_a} Φ_r` and `1_{0 < r ≤ t_a} Φ_r` have the same
7598`L²` difference on every `[0, T]`: they differ only at `r ∈ {0, t_a}` and for `r < 0`, which are
7599`dr`-null on `[0, T]` (for `r < 0` they are not in `[0,T]`). -/
7600theorem sqIntegralOn_killAfter_sub_Ioc (Φ : ℝ → Ω → ι → ℝ) (ta : ℝ) (T : ℝ) :
7601    sqIntegralOn P (fun s ω => killAfter Φ ta s ω -
7602      Set.indicator (Set.Ioc 0 ta) (fun _ => Φ s ω) s) T = 0 := by
7603  have hnull : ∀ᵐ s ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), s ∉ ({0, ta} : Set ℝ) :=
7604    ((Set.countable_singleton ta).insert 0).ae_notMem volume
7605  have hinner : ∀ ω, ∫⁻ s in Set.Icc 0 T, ∑ k, ‖(killAfter Φ ta s ω -
7606      Set.indicator (Set.Ioc 0 ta) (fun _ => Φ s ω) s) k‖ₑ ^ 2 = 0 := by
7607    intro ω
7608    have hae : ∀ᵐ s ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 T)),
7609        ∑ k, ‖(killAfter Φ ta s ω - Set.indicator (Set.Ioc 0 ta) (fun _ => Φ s ω) s) k‖ₑ ^ 2 = 0 := by
7610      refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Icc).2 (hnull.mono fun s hs hI => ?_)
7611      have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := fun h => hs (Or.inl h)
7612      have hsa : s ≠ ta := fun h => hs (Or.inr h)
7613      have hz : ∀ k, (killAfter Φ ta s ω - Set.indicator (Set.Ioc 0 ta) (fun _ => Φ s ω) s) k = 0 := by
7614        intro k
7615        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hsa with h | h
7616        · have hmem : s ∈ Set.Ioc 0 ta := ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hI.1 (Ne.symm hs0), h.le⟩
7617          simp [killAfter, Set.indicator_of_mem hmem, h]
7618        · have hnmem : s ∉ Set.Ioc 0 ta := fun hm => absurd hm.2 (not_le.2 h)
7619          simp [killAfter, Set.indicator_of_notMem hnmem, not_lt.2 h.le]
7620      exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k _ => by rw [hz k]; simp
7621    rw [lintegral_congr_ae hae]
7622    simp
7623  simp only [sqIntegralOn, hinner]
7624  simp
7625
7626/-- Remark 3.8 `M:B:rem:multitime` (source lines 1705-1707), the statable content: for terminal
7627pairs `(Φ_a, t_a)` with `0 ≤ t_a ≤ t_q` and progressive `L²` integrands `Φ_a`, the martingales
7628`M[Φ_a]` stopped at their terminal times form a single `ℝ^p`-valued continuous martingale over
7629`[0, t_q]` with respect to the common filtration (the vector Itô integral of the integrands
7630extended by zero after `t_a`); its value at `t_q` is the vector `(M^a_{t_a})_a` of the single-time
7631statistics, and `B:eq:qv-cross` holds with the extended integrands, i.e. its covariation density is
7632`killedCovMatrix`.  This is also the identification `(M^a_{t_a})_a = M̃_{t_q}` of Remark A.25
7633(lines 10698-10700) and the first assertion of Remark A.32.
7634
7635PLAN: `killAfter Φ_a t_a` is `IsProgressiveL2` (indicator of a measurable time set times a
7636progressive integrand; `sqIntegralOn_mono_of_enorm_le`); `itoIntegral_indicator_Ioc` with
7637`a = 0, b = t_a` (the integrands `1_{(0,t_a]}Φ` and `1_{[0,t_a)}Φ` differ on a Lebesgue-null set
7638of times, `itoIntegral_congr`) gives `∫ killAfter Φ_a t_a dW (τ) = M^a_{min τ t_a}` for all `τ`
7639a.s.; the covariation is `vectorItoIntegral_isVectorMartingaleWithCovariation` with
7640`covMatrixProcess (killAfter) = killedCovMatrix` pointwise (unfold; `Set.indicator` cases). -/
7641theorem multitime_vector_martingale (hW : IsBrownianFiltration P ℱ W) {p : ℕ}
7642    (Φ : Fin p → ℝ → Ω → ι → ℝ) (hΦ : ∀ a, IsProgressiveL2 P ℱ (Φ a))
7643    (ts : Fin p → ℝ) (tq : ℝ) (hts : ∀ a, 0 ≤ ts a ∧ ts a ≤ tq) :
7644    (∀ a, IsProgressiveL2 P ℱ (killAfter (Φ a) (ts a))) ∧
7645    (∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ∀ a, ∀ τ : ℝ,
7646      vectorItoIntegral P ℱ W (fun a => killAfter (Φ a) (ts a)) τ ω a =
7647        itoIntegral P ℱ W (Φ a) (min τ (ts a)) ω) ∧
7648    IsVectorMartingaleWithCovariation P ℱ tq
7649      (vectorItoIntegral P ℱ W (fun a => killAfter (Φ a) (ts a))) (killedCovMatrix Φ ts) := by
7650  have hkill : ∀ a, IsProgressiveL2 P ℱ (killAfter (Φ a) (ts a)) :=
7651    fun a => isProgressiveL2_indicator_set P (S := Set.Iio (ts a)) measurableSet_Iio (hΦ a)
7652  have hcong : ∀ a, ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ∀ τ : ℝ, itoIntegral P ℱ W (killAfter (Φ a) (ts a)) τ ω =
7653      itoIntegral P ℱ W (Φ a) (min τ (ts a)) ω := by
7654    intro a
7655    have h1 := itoIntegral_congr hW (hkill a) (isProgressiveL2_indicator_set P (S := Set.Ioc 0 (ts a)) measurableSet_Ioc (hΦ a))
7656      (fun T => sqIntegralOn_killAfter_sub_Ioc P (Φ a) (ts a) T)
7657    have h2 := itoIntegral_indicator_Ioc hW (hΦ a) (le_refl (0 : ℝ)) (hts a).1
7658    filter_upwards [h1, h2] with ω h1ω h2ω τ
7659    rw [h1ω τ, h2ω τ, itoIntegral_of_nonpos P ℱ W (Φ a) (min_le_right τ 0) ω, sub_zero]
7660  refine ⟨hkill, ?_, ?_⟩
7661  · filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.2 hcong] with ω hω a τ
7662    simp only [vectorItoIntegral, PiLp.toLp_apply]
7663    exact hω a τ
7664  · have hcov : covMatrixProcess (fun a => killAfter (Φ a) (ts a)) = killedCovMatrix Φ ts := by
7665      funext r ω
7666      ext a b
7667      simp only [covMatrixProcess, killedCovMatrix, Matrix.of_apply]
7668      by_cases h1 : r < ts a <;> by_cases h2 : r < ts b <;>
7669        simp [killAfter, h1, h2, lt_min_iff]
7670    have hvec := vectorItoIntegral_isVectorMartingaleWithCovariation hW
7671      (fun a => killAfter (Φ a) (ts a)) hkill tq
7672    rw [hcov] at hvec
7673    exact hvec
7674
7675/-- Remark A.32 `M:B:newprob:several-times` (source lines 11037-11055): if the `a`-th statistic
7676contains the stochastic integral `∑_i ∫_0^{t_a} K^{a,i}_r · dB^i_r`, take `T = max_a t_a` and
7677`M^a_t := ∑_i ∫_0^t 1_{r < t_a} K^{a,i}_r · dB^i_r`, `Σ^{ab}_r = 1_{r<min(t_a,t_b)} ∑_i K^{a,i}_r·K^{b,i}_r`;
7678for independent Brownian motions `B^i` this `Σ` is precisely the quadratic covariation density
7679of `M` in the sense of `B:newprob:bracket` (Lemma A.27's hypothesis, represented by
7680`IsVectorMartingaleWithCovariation`, including `E ∫_0^T tr Σ_r dr < ∞`), and
7681`M^a_T = ∑_i ∫_0^{t_a} K^{a,i} · dB^i` is the original statistic.  Hence all estimates of
7682Appendix A.4.4 apply to joint observations, including coincident observation times (the
7683"constants introduce no dependence on `T`" clause is visible in the statements of
7684`conditional_gaussian_interpolation` and `initial_sum_martingale`, whose constants are absolute).
7685The Brownian family is indexed by `ι` (`ι = Fin N × Fin d` for the particle noises `(B^i)_i`,
7686with `K^{a,i}_r · dB^i_r = ∑_{j<d} K^{a,i,j} dB^{i,j}`). -/
7687theorem several_times_covariation (hW : IsBrownianFiltration P ℱ W) {p : ℕ}
7688    (K : Fin p → ℝ → Ω → ι → ℝ) (hK : ∀ a, IsProgressiveL2 P ℱ (K a))
7689    (ts : Fin p → ℝ) (hts : ∀ a, 0 ≤ ts a) (T : ℝ) (hT : ∀ a, ts a ≤ T) :
7690    IsVectorMartingaleWithCovariation P ℱ T
7691      (vectorItoIntegral P ℱ W (fun a => killAfter (K a) (ts a))) (killedCovMatrix K ts) ∧
7692    (∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ∀ a,
7693      vectorItoIntegral P ℱ W (fun a => killAfter (K a) (ts a)) T ω a =
7694        itoIntegral P ℱ W (K a) (ts a) ω) := by
7695  obtain ⟨-, hae, hvec⟩ := multitime_vector_martingale P hW K hK ts T (fun a => ⟨hts a, hT a⟩)
7696  refine ⟨hvec, ?_⟩
7697  filter_upwards [hae] with ω hω a
7698  rw [hω a T, min_eq_right (hT a)]
7699
7700/-- A family of measurable maps into `E` gives a measurable map into the product `γ → E`
7701(the domain σ-algebra is taken from the hypotheses). -/
7702theorem hdsum_measurable_pi {α γ E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace E] {mα : MeasurableSpace α}
7703    (f : γ → α → E) (hf : ∀ c, Measurable (f c)) : Measurable fun x c => f c x :=
7704  measurable_pi_iff.2 hf

7706/-- Finite sums of progressive `L²` integrands are progressive `L²`. -/
7707theorem hdsum_isProgressiveL2_finset {β : Type*} (f : β → ℝ → Ω → ι → ℝ) (S : Finset β) :
7708    (∀ b ∈ S, IsProgressiveL2 P ℱ (f b)) →
7709      IsProgressiveL2 P ℱ (fun r ω k => ∑ b ∈ S, f b r ω k) := by
7710  classical
7711  induction S using Finset.induction_on with
7712  | empty =>
7713    intro _
7714    simp only [Finset.sum_empty]
7715    exact IsProgressiveL2.const P ℱ (fun _ : ι => (0 : ℝ))
7716  | insert c S hc ih =>
7717    intro hf
7718    have h1 := (hf c (Finset.mem_insert_self c S)).add
7719      (ih fun b hb => hf b (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hb))
7720    have e : (fun r ω k => ∑ b ∈ insert c S, f b r ω k) =
7721        (fun s ω => f c s ω + fun k => ∑ b ∈ S, f b s ω k) := by
7722      funext r ω k
7723      simp [Finset.sum_insert hc]
7724    rw [e]
7725    exact h1
7726
7727/-- Itô integrals of finite sums of integrands are the sums of the Itô integrals (a.e., for all
7728times). -/
7729theorem hdsum_itoIntegral_finset_ae {β : Type*} (hW : IsBrownianFiltration P ℱ W)
7730    (f : β → ℝ → Ω → ι → ℝ) (S : Finset β) :
7731    (∀ b ∈ S, IsProgressiveL2 P ℱ (f b)) →
7732      ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ∀ t, itoIntegral P ℱ W (fun r ω k => ∑ b ∈ S, f b r ω k) t ω =
7733        ∑ b ∈ S, itoIntegral P ℱ W (f b) t ω := by
7734  classical
7735  induction S using Finset.induction_on with
7736  | empty =>
7737    intro _
7738    filter_upwards [itoIntegral_const hW (fun _ : ι => (0 : ℝ))] with ω hω t
7739    simpa using hω t
7740  | insert c S hc ih =>
7741    intro hf
7742    have hS := hdsum_isProgressiveL2_finset P f S (fun b hb => hf b (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hb))
7743    have h1 := itoIntegral_add hW (hf c (Finset.mem_insert_self c S)) hS
7744    filter_upwards [h1, ih (fun b hb => hf b (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hb))] with ω h1ω h2ω t
7745    have e : (fun r ω k => ∑ b ∈ insert c S, f b r ω k) =
7746        (fun s ω => f c s ω + fun k => ∑ b ∈ S, f b s ω k) := by
7747      funext r ω k
7748      simp [Finset.sum_insert hc]
7749    rw [e, Finset.sum_insert hc]
7750    exact (h1ω t).trans (by rw [h2ω t])

7752/-- Pointwise Cauchy–Schwarz for finite sums of `ℝ≥0∞`-valued squared norms. -/
7753theorem hdsum_enorm_sq_finset_le {E γ : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] (S : Finset γ) (d : γ → E) :
7754    ‖∑ a ∈ S, d a‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ((S.card : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) * ∑ a ∈ S, ‖d a‖ₑ ^ 2 := by
7755  calc ‖∑ a ∈ S, d a‖ₑ ^ 2 = ENNReal.ofReal (‖∑ a ∈ S, d a‖ ^ 2) := by
7756        rw [ENNReal.ofReal_pow (norm_nonneg _), ofReal_norm]
7757    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((S.card : ℝ) * ∑ a ∈ S, ‖d a‖ ^ 2) :=
7758        ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (le_trans (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_sum_le _ _) 2)
7759          sq_sum_le_card_mul_sum_sq)
7760    _ = ((S.card : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) * ∑ a ∈ S, ‖d a‖ₑ ^ 2 := by
7761        rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg _), ENNReal.ofReal_natCast,
7762          ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun a _ => sq_nonneg _)]
7763        congr 1
7764        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => by rw [ENNReal.ofReal_pow (norm_nonneg _), ofReal_norm]
7765
7766/-- The squared `ℝ≥0∞`-norm of a finite `PiLp 2` vector is the sum of the squared coordinates. -/
7767theorem hdsum_enorm_sq_toLp {q : ℕ} {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] (v : Fin q → E) :
7768    ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 v : PiLp 2 fun _ : Fin q => E)‖ₑ ^ 2 = ∑ a, ‖v a‖ₑ ^ 2 := by
7769  have h := PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2 (fun _ : Fin q => E) (WithLp.toLp 2 v)
7770  simp only [PiLp.toLp_apply] at h
7771  calc ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 v : PiLp 2 fun _ : Fin q => E)‖ₑ ^ 2
7772      = ENNReal.ofReal (‖(WithLp.toLp 2 v : PiLp 2 fun _ : Fin q => E)‖ ^ 2) := by
7773        rw [ENNReal.ofReal_pow (norm_nonneg _), ofReal_norm]
7774    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∑ a, ‖v a‖ ^ 2) := by rw [h]
7775    _ = ∑ a, ENNReal.ofReal (‖v a‖ ^ 2) := ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg fun a _ => sq_nonneg _
7776    _ = ∑ a, ‖v a‖ₑ ^ 2 := Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => by
7777        rw [ENNReal.ofReal_pow (norm_nonneg _), ofReal_norm]
7778
7779/-- Joint measurability of the clamped squared norm sum of a progressive family. -/
7780theorem hdsum_measurable_tsum {κ : Type*} [Countable κ] {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
7781    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] (Φ : ℝ → Ω → κ → E)
7782    (hΦ : ∀ k, IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => Φ r ω k)) (T : ℝ) :
7783    Measurable (fun p : ℝ × Ω => ∑' k, ‖Φ (min p.1 T) p.2 k‖ₑ ^ 2) :=
7784  Measurable.ennreal_tsum fun k => ((measurable_clamp (hΦ k) T).enorm).pow_const 2
7785
7786/-- The `L²` size `ω ↦ ∫_0^T ∑_k ‖Φ_r ω k‖²` of a progressive family is measurable. -/
7787theorem hdsum_measurable_hsSq {κ : Type*} [Countable κ] {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
7788    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] (Φ : ℝ → Ω → κ → E)
7789    (hΦ : ∀ k, IsProgressive ℱ (fun r ω => Φ r ω k)) (T : ℝ) :
7790    Measurable (fun ω => ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 T, ∑' k, ‖Φ r ω k‖ₑ ^ 2) := by
7791  have e : (fun ω => ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 T, ∑' k, ‖Φ r ω k‖ₑ ^ 2) =
7792      fun ω => ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 T, ∑' k, ‖Φ (min r T) ω k‖ₑ ^ 2 := by
7793    funext ω
7794    exact setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Icc (fun r hr => by simp only [min_eq_left hr.2])
7795  rw [e]
7796  exact (hdsum_measurable_tsum Φ hΦ T).lintegral_prod_left' (μ := volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 T))

7798/-- A coordinate of a progressive `L²` integrand, paired with a fixed vector `x`, is a progressive
7799`L²` integrand on every finite set of indices. -/
7800theorem hdsum_isProgressiveL2_inner {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
7801    [CompleteSpace H] [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]
7802    {κ : Type*} (Φ : ℝ → Ω → κ → H)
7803    (hΦ : ∀ T : ℝ, IsHSIntegrand P ℱ T Φ) (x : H) (S : Finset κ) :
7804    IsProgressiveL2 P ℱ (fun r ω (k : S) => inner ℝ (Φ r ω k) x) := by
7805  have hc : Measurable fun v : H => inner ℝ v x :=
7806    (continuous_id.inner continuous_const).measurable
7807  have hx : ‖x‖ₑ ^ 2 ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.pow_ne_top enorm_ne_top
7808  have hsq1 : ∀ v : H, ‖inner ℝ v x‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ‖x‖ₑ ^ 2 * ‖v‖ₑ ^ 2 := by
7809    intro v
7810    have h : ‖inner ℝ v x‖ ≤ ‖v‖ * ‖x‖ := norm_inner_le_norm v x
7811    calc ‖inner ℝ v x‖ₑ ^ 2 = ENNReal.ofReal (‖inner ℝ v x‖ ^ 2) := by
7812          rw [ENNReal.ofReal_pow (norm_nonneg _), ofReal_norm]
7813      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((‖v‖ * ‖x‖) ^ 2) :=
7814          ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h 2)
7815      _ = ‖x‖ₑ ^ 2 * ‖v‖ₑ ^ 2 := by
7816          rw [mul_pow, ENNReal.ofReal_mul (sq_nonneg _), ENNReal.ofReal_pow (norm_nonneg _),
7817            ENNReal.ofReal_pow (norm_nonneg _), ofReal_norm, ofReal_norm]
7818          ring
7819  have hpt : ∀ r ω, ∑ k : S, ‖inner ℝ (Φ r ω k) x‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤
7820      ‖x‖ₑ ^ 2 * ∑' k, ‖Φ r ω k‖ₑ ^ 2 := by
7821    intro r ω
7822    calc ∑ k : S, ‖inner ℝ (Φ r ω k) x‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ k : S, ‖x‖ₑ ^ 2 * ‖Φ r ω k‖ₑ ^ 2 :=
7823          Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => hsq1 _
7824      _ = ‖x‖ₑ ^ 2 * ∑ k ∈ S, ‖Φ r ω k‖ₑ ^ 2 := by
7825          rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
7826          congr 1
7827          exact Finset.sum_coe_sort S (fun k => ‖Φ r ω k‖ₑ ^ 2)
7828      _ ≤ ‖x‖ₑ ^ 2 * ∑' k, ‖Φ r ω k‖ₑ ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ENNReal.sum_le_tsum S) zero_le
7829  refine ⟨fun i => hdsum_measurable_pi (fun (k : S) (p : Set.Iic i × Ω) => inner ℝ (Φ p.1 p.2 k) x)
7830    fun k => hc.comp ((hΦ 0).prog k i), fun T => ?_⟩
7831  have hle : sqIntegralOn P (fun r ω (k : S) => inner ℝ (Φ r ω k) x) T ≤
7832      ‖x‖ₑ ^ 2 * hsSqIntegralOn P Φ T := by
7833    calc sqIntegralOn P (fun r ω (k : S) => inner ℝ (Φ r ω k) x) T
7834        ≤ ∫⁻ ω, (∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 T, ‖x‖ₑ ^ 2 * ∑' k, ‖Φ r ω k‖ₑ ^ 2) ∂P :=
7835          lintegral_mono fun ω => lintegral_mono fun r => hpt r ω
7836      _ = ∫⁻ ω, ‖x‖ₑ ^ 2 * (∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 T, ∑' k, ‖Φ r ω k‖ₑ ^ 2) ∂P :=
7837          lintegral_congr fun ω => lintegral_const_mul' _ _ hx
7838      _ = ‖x‖ₑ ^ 2 * hsSqIntegralOn P Φ T := lintegral_const_mul' _ _ hx
7839  exact lt_of_le_of_lt hle (ENNReal.mul_lt_top (lt_top_iff_ne_top.2 hx) (hΦ T).sq)

7841/-- The `L²` size of the Hilbert direct sum of integrands is at most the sum of the `L²` sizes. -/
7842theorem hdsum_hsSq_le {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
7843    [CompleteSpace H] [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]
7844    {κ : Type*} [Countable κ] {q : ℕ} (Φ : Fin q → ℝ → Ω → κ → H)
7845    (hΦ : ∀ a, ∀ T : ℝ, IsHSIntegrand P ℱ T (Φ a)) (t : ℝ) :
7846    hsSqIntegralOn P (fun r ω k => (WithLp.toLp 2 fun a => Φ a r ω k : PiLp 2 fun _ : Fin q => H)) t
7847      ≤ ∑ a, hsSqIntegralOn P (Φ a) t := by
7848  refine le_of_eq ?_
7849  have htsum : ∀ r ω, ∑' k, ∑ a, ‖Φ a r ω k‖ₑ ^ 2 = ∑ a, ∑' k, ‖Φ a r ω k‖ₑ ^ 2 :=
7850    fun r ω => Summable.tsum_finsetSum fun a _ => ENNReal.summable
7851  have hmeasG : ∀ (a : Fin q) (ω : Ω), Measurable fun r : ℝ => ∑' k, ‖Φ a (min r t) ω k‖ₑ ^ 2 :=
7852    fun a ω => (hdsum_measurable_tsum (Φ a) (fun k => (hΦ a t).prog k) t).comp
7853      (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)
7854  have hpt : ∀ ω : Ω, ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 t,
7855      ∑' k, ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 fun a => Φ a r ω k : PiLp 2 fun _ : Fin q => H)‖ₑ ^ 2
7856        = ∑ a, ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 t, ∑' k, ‖Φ a r ω k‖ₑ ^ 2 := by
7857    intro ω
7858    have hpw : ∀ r : ℝ, ∑' k, ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 fun a => Φ a r ω k : PiLp 2 fun _ : Fin q => H)‖ₑ ^ 2
7859        = ∑ a, ∑' k, ‖Φ a r ω k‖ₑ ^ 2 := by
7860      intro r
7861      simp only [hdsum_enorm_sq_toLp]
7862      exact htsum r ω
7863    calc ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 t,
7864          ∑' k, ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 fun a => Φ a r ω k : PiLp 2 fun _ : Fin q => H)‖ₑ ^ 2
7865        = ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 t, ∑ a, ∑' k, ‖Φ a r ω k‖ₑ ^ 2 := lintegral_congr fun r => hpw r
7866      _ = ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 t, ∑ a, ∑' k, ‖Φ a (min r t) ω k‖ₑ ^ 2 :=
7867          setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Icc (fun r hr => by simp only [min_eq_left hr.2])
7868      _ = ∑ a, ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 t, ∑' k, ‖Φ a (min r t) ω k‖ₑ ^ 2 :=
7869          lintegral_finsetSum _ (fun a _ => hmeasG a ω)
7870      _ = ∑ a, ∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 t, ∑' k, ‖Φ a r ω k‖ₑ ^ 2 :=
7871          Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ =>
7872            setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Icc (fun r hr => by simp only [min_eq_left hr.2])
7873  calc hsSqIntegralOn P (fun r ω k => (WithLp.toLp 2 fun a => Φ a r ω k : PiLp 2 fun _ : Fin q => H)) t
7874      = ∫⁻ ω, ∑ a, (∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 t, ∑' k, ‖Φ a r ω k‖ₑ ^ 2) ∂P := lintegral_congr hpt
7875    _ = ∑ a, ∫⁻ ω, (∫⁻ r in Set.Icc 0 t, ∑' k, ‖Φ a r ω k‖ₑ ^ 2) ∂P :=
7876        lintegral_finsetSum _ fun a _ => hdsum_measurable_hsSq (Φ a) (fun k => (hΦ a t).prog k) t
7877    _ = ∑ a, hsSqIntegralOn P (Φ a) t := rfl

7879/-- Remark A.25 `M:B:rem:clt-complex` (source lines 10698-10700), the Hilbert-valued clause:
7880finitely many `H`-valued terminal fields fit the single-field statements by taking the finite
7881Hilbert direct sum `⨁_{a<q} H = PiLp 2 (fun _ : Fin q => H)`: if `M_a = ∫ Φ_a dW` are `H`-valued
7882Itô integrals, the direct-sum process `(M_a)_a` is the `⨁ H`-valued Itô integral of the direct-sum
7883integrand `(Φ_a)_a`, and the direct-sum integrand is Hilbert–Schmidt when each `Φ_a` is (its
7884`𝓛₂` norm squared is the sum).  Combined with `multitime_vector_martingale` (integrands killed
7885after the observation times) this realises statistics of several `H`-valued fields at several
7886times as one terminal value, to which `hilbert_polar_coupling`/`hilbert_martingale_w2` apply as
7887stated.  The complex clause ("a `ℂ^p`-valued martingale is an `ℝ^{2p}`-valued one") has no
7888content beyond the real-linear isometry `ℂ^p ≅ ℝ^{2p}` (Mathlib `Complex.orthonormalBasisOneI`,
7889`Complex.equivRealProdCLM`), under which laws, `d_{C²}` and `W_p` are preserved; it is recorded in
7890`coverage.tsv` as such.
7891
7892PLAN: unfold both predicates; the coordinate functional `⟨(M_a)_a, (x_a)_a⟩ = ∑_a ⟨M_a, x_a⟩` is a
7893finite sum of the coordinate limits (`itoIntegral_add` for the finite sum of integrands, and
7894`Tendsto.add` for the `L²` limits along `Finset κ`); continuity/adaptedness/zero are
7895componentwise (`PiLp.continuous_toLp`, `measurable_pi_iff`); the Hilbert–Schmidt bound is
7896`∑' k, ∑_a ‖Φ_a k‖² = ∑_a ∑' k ‖Φ_a k‖²` (`ENNReal.tsum_finsetSum`-type lemmas). -/
7897theorem hilbert_direct_sum_ito {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
7898    [CompleteSpace H] [MeasurableSpace H] [BorelSpace H] [SecondCountableTopology H]
7899    {κ : Type*} [Countable κ] (W' : ℝ≥0 → Ω → κ → ℝ) (hW' : IsCylindricalBrownian P ℱ W')
7900    (t : ℝ) {q : ℕ} (Φ : Fin q → ℝ → Ω → κ → H) (hΦ : ∀ a, ∀ T : ℝ, IsHSIntegrand P ℱ T (Φ a))
7901    (M : Fin q → ℝ → Ω → H) (hM : ∀ a, IsHilbertItoIntegral P ℱ W' (Φ a) (M a)) :
7902    IsHSIntegrand P ℱ t (fun r ω k => (WithLp.toLp 2 fun a => Φ a r ω k : PiLp 2 fun _ : Fin q => H)) ∧
7903    IsHilbertItoIntegral P ℱ W'
7904      (fun r ω k => (WithLp.toLp 2 fun a => Φ a r ω k : PiLp 2 fun _ : Fin q => H))
7905      (fun τ ω => (WithLp.toLp 2 fun a => M a τ ω : PiLp 2 fun _ : Fin q => H)) := by
7906  have hΨprog : ∀ k, IsProgressive ℱ
7907      (fun r ω => (WithLp.toLp 2 fun a => Φ a r ω k : PiLp 2 fun _ : Fin q => H)) := by
7908    intro k i
7909    exact (WithLp.measurable_toLp 2 _).comp (hdsum_measurable_pi _ fun a => (hΦ a t).prog k i)
7910  have hΨsum : ∀ r ω, Summable fun k =>
7911      ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 fun a => Φ a r ω k : PiLp 2 fun _ : Fin q => H)‖ ^ 2 := by
7912    intro r ω
7913    simp only [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2 (fun _ : Fin q => H)]
7914    exact summable_sum fun a _ => (hΦ a t).summable r ω
7915  refine ⟨⟨hΨprog, hΨsum, lt_of_le_of_lt (hdsum_hsSq_le P Φ hΦ t)
7916    (ENNReal.sum_lt_top.2 fun a _ => (hΦ a t).sq)⟩, ?_⟩
7917  refine
7918    { cont := ?_, adapted := ?_, zero := ?_, approx := ?_ }
7919  · intro ω
7920    exact (PiLp.continuous_toLp 2 _).comp (continuous_pi fun a => (hM a).cont ω)
7921  · intro i
7922    exact (WithLp.measurable_toLp 2 _).comp (hdsum_measurable_pi _ fun a => (hM a).adapted i)
7923  · intro τ hτ ω
7924    have h0 : ∀ a, M a τ ω = 0 := fun a => (hM a).zero τ hτ ω
7925    simp [h0]
7926    rfl
7927  · intro τ hτ x
7928    have hinnerM : ∀ ω, inner ℝ (WithLp.toLp 2 fun a => M a τ ω : PiLp 2 fun _ : Fin q => H) x
7929        = ∑ a, inner ℝ (M a τ ω) (x a) := by
7930      intro ω
7931      simp [PiLp.inner_apply]
7932    -- pointwise decomposition of the finite-index Itô integral
7933    have hae : ∀ s : Finset κ, ∀ᵐ ω ∂P,
7934        itoIntegral P ℱ (fun t ω (k : s) => W' t ω k)
7935          (fun r ω (k : s) => inner ℝ (WithLp.toLp 2 fun a => Φ a r ω k : PiLp 2 fun _ : Fin q => H) x)
7936          τ ω =
7937        ∑ a, itoIntegral P ℱ (fun t ω (k : s) => W' t ω k)
7938          (fun r ω (k : s) => inner ℝ (Φ a r ω k) (x a)) τ ω := by
7939      intro s
7940      have h := hdsum_itoIntegral_finset_ae P (hW' s)
7941        (fun a (r : ℝ) (ω : Ω) (k : s) => inner ℝ (Φ a r ω k) (x a)) Finset.univ
7942        (fun a _ => hdsum_isProgressiveL2_inner P (Φ a) (hΦ a) (x a) s)
7943      filter_upwards [h] with ω hω
7944      have e : (fun r ω (k : s) =>
7945          inner ℝ (WithLp.toLp 2 fun a => Φ a r ω k : PiLp 2 fun _ : Fin q => H) x) =
7946          fun r ω (k : s) => ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ, inner ℝ (Φ a r ω k) (x a) := by
7947        funext r ω k
7948        simp [PiLp.inner_apply]
7949      rw [e]
7950      exact hω τ
7951    have hmeas : ∀ s : Finset κ, ∀ a : Fin q, Measurable fun ω =>
7952        ‖itoIntegral P ℱ (fun t ω (k : s) => W' t ω k)
7953            (fun r ω (k : s) => inner ℝ (Φ a r ω k) (x a)) τ ω - inner ℝ (M a τ ω) (x a)‖ₑ ^ 2 := by
7954      intro s a
7955      have h1 : Measurable fun ω => itoIntegral P ℱ (fun t ω (k : s) => W' t ω k)
7956          (fun r ω (k : s) => inner ℝ (Φ a r ω k) (x a)) τ ω :=
7957        (adapted_itoIntegral P ℱ _ _ τ).mono (ℱ.le τ) le_rfl
7958      have h2 : Measurable fun ω => inner ℝ (M a τ ω) (x a) :=
7959        (continuous_id.inner continuous_const).measurable.comp
7960          (((hM a).adapted τ).mono (ℱ.le τ) le_rfl)
7961      exact ((h1.sub h2).enorm).pow_const 2
7962    have hbound : ∀ s : Finset κ,
7963        ∫⁻ ω, ‖itoIntegral P ℱ (fun t ω (k : s) => W' t ω k)
7964            (fun r ω (k : s) => inner ℝ (WithLp.toLp 2 fun a => Φ a r ω k : PiLp 2 fun _ : Fin q => H) x)
7965            τ ω - inner ℝ (WithLp.toLp 2 fun a => M a τ ω : PiLp 2 fun _ : Fin q => H) x‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P
7966        ≤ ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin q)).card : ℝ≥0∞) * ∑ a : Fin q,
7967          ∫⁻ ω, ‖itoIntegral P ℱ (fun t ω (k : s) => W' t ω k)
7968            (fun r ω (k : s) => inner ℝ (Φ a r ω k) (x a)) τ ω - inner ℝ (M a τ ω) (x a)‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P := by
7969      intro s
7970      calc ∫⁻ ω, ‖itoIntegral P ℱ (fun t ω (k : s) => W' t ω k)
7971            (fun r ω (k : s) => inner ℝ (WithLp.toLp 2 fun a => Φ a r ω k : PiLp 2 fun _ : Fin q => H) x)
7972            τ ω - inner ℝ (WithLp.toLp 2 fun a => M a τ ω : PiLp 2 fun _ : Fin q => H) x‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P
7973          = ∫⁻ ω, ‖∑ a : Fin q, (itoIntegral P ℱ (fun t ω (k : s) => W' t ω k)
7974              (fun r ω (k : s) => inner ℝ (Φ a r ω k) (x a)) τ ω - inner ℝ (M a τ ω) (x a))‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P := by
7975            refine lintegral_congr_ae ?_
7976            filter_upwards [hae s] with ω hω
7977            rw [hω, hinnerM ω, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
7978        _ ≤ ∫⁻ ω, ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin q)).card : ℝ≥0∞) * ∑ a : Fin q,
7979              ‖itoIntegral P ℱ (fun t ω (k : s) => W' t ω k)
7980                (fun r ω (k : s) => inner ℝ (Φ a r ω k) (x a)) τ ω - inner ℝ (M a τ ω) (x a)‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P :=
7981            lintegral_mono fun ω => hdsum_enorm_sq_finset_le _ _
7982        _ = ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin q)).card : ℝ≥0∞) * ∑ a : Fin q,
7983              ∫⁻ ω, ‖itoIntegral P ℱ (fun t ω (k : s) => W' t ω k)
7984                (fun r ω (k : s) => inner ℝ (Φ a r ω k) (x a)) τ ω - inner ℝ (M a τ ω) (x a)‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P := by
7985            rw [lintegral_const_mul' _ _ (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _),
7986              lintegral_finsetSum _ (fun a _ => hmeas s a)]
7987    have hlim : Tendsto (fun s : Finset κ => ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin q)).card : ℝ≥0∞) * ∑ a : Fin q,
7988          ∫⁻ ω, ‖itoIntegral P ℱ (fun t ω (k : s) => W' t ω k)
7989            (fun r ω (k : s) => inner ℝ (Φ a r ω k) (x a)) τ ω - inner ℝ (M a τ ω) (x a)‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P)
7990        atTop (𝓝 0) := by
7991      have h := ENNReal.Tendsto.const_mul (a := ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin q)).card : ℝ≥0∞))
7992        (tendsto_finsetSum (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin q)) (fun a _ => (hM a).approx τ hτ (x a)))
7993        (Or.inr (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _))
7994      rwa [Finset.sum_const_zero, mul_zero] at h
7995    exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds hlim
7996      (fun s => zero_le) hbound
7997
7998end MultiTime

8000/-! ### Appendix A.4.4: Gaussian approximation with random initial data -/
8001
8002section RandomInitial
8003
8004variable {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
8005variable {p : ℕ}
8006
8007local notation "ℝ^" p => EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p)
8008
8009/-- The test class of `B:newprob:metric` (source lines 10763-10773): `h ∈ C_b^3(ℝ^p)` with
8010`max_{1≤j≤3} sup_x ‖D^j h(x)‖_op ≤ 1` (`C_b^3`: `h` and its derivatives through order `3` continuous
8011and bounded; the MAX is over the orders `1, 2, 3` only). -/
8012def D3TestClass (p : ℕ) : Set ((ℝ^p) → ℝ) :=
8013  {h | MemCb 3 h ∧ ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ 3 → ∀ x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j h x‖ ≤ 1}
8014
8015/-- The metric `𝖽₃(U,V) = sup { |E h(U) - E h(V)| : h ∈ D3TestClass }` of `B:newprob:metric`,
8016on laws, in `ℝ≥0∞` (the supremum is infinite when the laws have no first moment; a real `iSup`
8017would then be the junk value `0`). -/
8018def d3DistE (μ ν : Measure (ℝ^p)) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
8019  ⨆ h : D3TestClass p, ENNReal.ofReal |∫ x, h.1 x ∂μ - ∫ x, h.1 x ∂ν|
8020
8021/-- `sup_x ‖D²h(x)‖_op` (a genuine supremum for `h ∈ C_b^2`). -/
8022def hessSup (h : (ℝ^p) → ℝ) : ℝ := ⨆ x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 h x‖
8023
8024/-- The trace-norm discrepancy `E ∫_0^T ‖Σ_r - Σ̄_r‖_{S_1} dr` of the finite-dimensional
8025statements (`B:newprob:conditional-bound` and following). -/
8026def covDiscrepancyMatrix (T : ℝ) (Sg : ℝ → Ω → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ)
8027    (sb : ℝ → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) : ℝ :=
8028  ∫ ω, (∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 T, s1Norm (Sg σ ω - sb σ)) ∂P
8029
8030/-- The integrated deterministic covariance `∫_0^T Σ̄_r dr` (entrywise). -/
8031def integratedCov (T : ℝ) (sb : ℝ → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ :=
8032  Matrix.of fun i j => ∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 T, sb σ i j
8033
8034/-- The hypotheses on the deterministic coefficient `Σ̄ : [0,T] → ℝ^{p×p}` of Lemma A.27
8035(lines 10797-10798): measurable, symmetric nonnegative, integrable. -/
8036structure IsDetCovMatrix (T : ℝ) (sb : ℝ → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) : Prop where
8037  meas : Measurable sb
8038  psd : ∀ σ ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, (sb σ).PosSemidef
8039  int : IntegrableOn (fun σ => s1Norm (sb σ)) (Set.Icc 0 T)
8040
8041/-! ### Route for Lemma A.27 (as formalised)
8042
8043Not by Itô's formula: the unconditional bound `multivariate_martingale_clt` (Lemma A.21) is applied
8044under `P[· | B]` for `B ∈ ℱ_0` (`isVec_cond`), to the translate `y ↦ h(x + y)` (same Hessian
8045bound), which handles an `ℱ_0`-measurable shift `X` with finitely many values (`shift_bound_simple`,
8046the independence of `G` from `ℱ_T ⊇ ℱ_0` identifying `∫_B h(x+G) = P(B) ∫ h(x+·) dγ`).  A general
8047`X` is approximated pointwise by `ℱ_0`-simple functions (`StronglyMeasurable.approx`), with
8048dominated convergence for the bounded continuous `h` (`shift_bound`).  The a.s. inequality for the
8049conditional expectations follows from the inequality on all `ℱ_0`-sets
8050(`ae_le_of_setIntegral_le_trim`). -/
8051
8052section A27Aux
8053
8054omit [IsProbabilityMeasure P] in
8055lemma setIntegral_fiber_sum {β : Type*} [DecidableEq β] {A : Set Ω} (hA : MeasurableSet A)
8056    (S : Finset β) (ξ : Ω → β) (hS : ∀ ω, ξ ω ∈ S) (hξ : ∀ x, MeasurableSet (ξ ⁻¹' {x}))
8057    {F : Ω → ℝ} (hF : Integrable F P) :
8058    ∫ ω in A, F ω ∂P = ∑ x ∈ S, ∫ ω in A ∩ ξ ⁻¹' {x}, F ω ∂P := by
8059  have hU : A = ⋃ x ∈ S, (A ∩ ξ ⁻¹' {x}) := by
8060    ext ω; simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
8061      exists_prop]
8062    exact ⟨fun h => ⟨ξ ω, hS ω, h, rfl⟩, fun ⟨_, _, h, _⟩ => h⟩
8063  conv_lhs => rw [hU]
8064  refine integral_biUnion_finset S (fun x _ => hA.inter (hξ x)) ?_ (fun x _ => hF.integrableOn)
8065  intro x _ y _ hxy
8066  refine Set.disjoint_left.2 fun ω h1 h2 => hxy ?_
8067  have h3 := h1.2
8068  have h4 := h2.2
8069  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at h3 h4
8070  rw [← h3, ← h4]

8072lemma isVec_cond {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ} {T : ℝ} {M : ℝ → Ω → (ℝ^p)}
8073    {Sg : ℝ → Ω → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ} (hM : IsVectorMartingaleWithCovariation P ℱ T M Sg)
8074    {A : Set Ω} (hA : MeasurableSet[ℱ 0] A) (hP0 : P A ≠ 0) :
8075    IsVectorMartingaleWithCovariation (ProbabilityTheory.cond P A) ℱ T M Sg := by
8076  have hac : ProbabilityTheory.cond P A ≪ P := ProbabilityTheory.cond_absolutelyContinuous
8077  have hc : (P A)⁻¹ ≠ ∞ := ENNReal.inv_ne_top.2 hP0
8078  have hzero : ∀ a : Fin p, (fun ω => M 0 ω a) =ᵐ[P] 0 := fun a => by
8079    filter_upwards [hM.zero] with ω h
8080    simp [h]
8081  refine
8082    { martingale := fun a => martingale_cond P (hM.martingale a) (hzero a) hA hP0
8083      zero := hac.ae_le hM.zero
8084      cont := hac.ae_le hM.cont
8085      sq_int := fun τ hτ => ?_
8086      sigma_meas := hM.sigma_meas
8087      sigma_adapted := hM.sigma_adapted
8088      sigma_psd := hac.ae_le hM.sigma_psd
8089      sigma_int := ?_
8090      sigma_pathint := hac.ae_le hM.sigma_pathint
8091      sigma_entry_int := hac.ae_le hM.sigma_entry_int
8092      covariation := fun a b => ?_ }
8093  · exact ((hM.sq_int τ hτ).restrict A).smul_measure hc
8094  · exact (hM.sigma_int.restrict (s := A)).smul_measure hc
8095  · refine martingale_cond P (hM.covariation a b) ?_ hA hP0
8096    filter_upwards [hM.zero] with ω h
8097    simp [h]
8098
8099lemma const_shift_bound (ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
8100    (M : ℝ → Ω → (ℝ^p)) (Sg : ℝ → Ω → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ)
8101    (hM : IsVectorMartingaleWithCovariation P ℱ T M Sg)
8102    (sb : ℝ → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) (hsb : IsDetCovMatrix T sb)
8103    (h : (ℝ^p) → ℝ) (hh : MemCb 2 h) (x : ℝ^p) {A : Set Ω} (hA : MeasurableSet[ℱ 0] A) :
8104    |(∫ ω in A, h (x + M T ω) ∂P) -
8105        P.real A * ∫ z, h (x + z) ∂(multivariateGaussian 0 (integratedCov T sb))| ≤
8106      (1 / 2) * hessSup h * ∫ ω in A, (∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 T, s1Norm (Sg σ ω - sb σ)) ∂P := by
8107  have hAm : MeasurableSet A := ℱ.le 0 _ hA
8108  by_cases hP0 : P A = 0
8109  · have : P.restrict A = 0 := Measure.restrict_eq_zero.2 hP0
8110    simp [this, Measure.real, hP0]
8111  · have : IsProbabilityMeasure (ProbabilityTheory.cond P A) :=
8112      ProbabilityTheory.cond_isProbabilityMeasure hP0
8113    have hMc := isVec_cond P hM hA hP0
8114    have hhx : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun y => h (x + y)) := hh.1.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id)
8115    have hH : ∀ y, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (fun y => h (x + y)) y‖ ≤ hessSup h := by
8116      intro y
8117      rw [iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left]
8118      exact le_ciSup (hh.2 2 le_rfl) (x + y)
8119    have hbdd : BddAbove (Set.range fun y => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (fun y => h (x + y)) y‖) :=
8120      ⟨hessSup h, by rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩; exact hH y⟩
8121    have hsup : (⨆ y, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (fun y => h (x + y)) y‖) ≤ hessSup h :=
8122      ciSup_le hH
8123    have hcore := multivariate_martingale_clt (ProbabilityTheory.cond P A) ℱ T hT M Sg hMc sb
8124      hsb.meas hsb.int hsb.psd (fun y => h (x + y)) hhx hbdd
8125    have hI : ∀ F : Ω → ℝ, ∫ ω, F ω ∂(ProbabilityTheory.cond P A) =
8126        ((P A).toReal)⁻¹ * ∫ ω in A, F ω ∂P := by
8127      intro F
8128      simp [ProbabilityTheory.cond, integral_smul_measure, ENNReal.toReal_inv]
8129    rw [hI, hI] at hcore
8130    have hp : 0 < (P A).toReal := ENNReal.toReal_pos hP0 (measure_ne_top P A)
8131    have hpr : P.real A = (P A).toReal := rfl
8132    have hJ0 : 0 ≤ ∫ ω in A, (∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 T, s1Norm (Sg σ ω - sb σ)) ∂P :=
8133      setIntegral_nonneg hAm fun ω _ =>
8134        setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Icc fun σ _ => traceNormMatrix_nonneg _
8135    have hH0 : 0 ≤ hessSup h := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hH 0)
8136    rw [hpr]
8137    set c := ∫ z, h (x + z) ∂(multivariateGaussian 0 (integratedCov T sb)) with hc
8138    set a := ∫ ω in A, h (x + M T ω) ∂P with ha
8139    set J := ∫ ω in A, (∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 T, s1Norm (Sg σ ω - sb σ)) ∂P with hJ
8140    have e1 : a - (P A).toReal * c = (P A).toReal * (((P A).toReal)⁻¹ * a - c) := by
8141      field_simp
8142    rw [e1, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hp]
8143    have hcore' : |((P A).toReal)⁻¹ * a - c| ≤ (1 / 2) * hessSup h * (((P A).toReal)⁻¹ * J) := by
8144      refine hcore.trans ?_
8145      have : 0 ≤ ((P A).toReal)⁻¹ * J := by positivity
8146      calc _ ≤ (1 / 2) * hessSup h * (((P A).toReal)⁻¹ * J) := by
8147            rw [mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
8148            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsup this) (by norm_num)
8149        _ = _ := by ring
8150    calc (P A).toReal * |((P A).toReal)⁻¹ * a - c|
8151        ≤ (P A).toReal * ((1 / 2) * hessSup h * (((P A).toReal)⁻¹ * J)) :=
8152          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcore' hp.le
8153      _ = _ := by field_simp
8154
8155lemma memCb_bound {h : (ℝ^p) → ℝ} (hh : MemCb 2 h) : ∃ C, ∀ x, |h x| ≤ C := by
8156  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hh.2 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
8157  exact ⟨C, fun x => by
8158    have := hC ⟨x, rfl⟩
8159    simpa [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero] using this⟩

8162lemma integrable_memCb_comp {h : (ℝ^p) → ℝ} (hh : MemCb 2 h) {f : Ω → (ℝ^p)}
8163    (hf : AEMeasurable f P) [IsFiniteMeasure P] : Integrable (fun ω => h (f ω)) P := by
8164  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := memCb_bound hh
8165  exact Integrable.of_bound (C := C)
8166    (hh.1.continuous.measurable.comp_aemeasurable hf).aestronglyMeasurable
8167    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => by simpa using hC (f ω))

8169lemma setIntegral_indep_comp {ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ} {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) {G : Ω → (ℝ^p)}
8170    (hGm : AEMeasurable G P)
8171    (hGind : Indep (MeasurableSpace.comap G inferInstance) (ℱ T) P) {φ : (ℝ^p) → ℝ}
8172    (hφ : Continuous φ) {B : Set Ω} (hB : MeasurableSet[ℱ T] B) :
8173    ∫ ω in B, φ (G ω) ∂P = P.real B * ∫ z, φ z ∂(law P G) := by
8174  have hBm : MeasurableSet B := ℱ.le T _ hB
8175  have hind : IndepFun (B.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) (fun ω => φ (G ω)) P := by
8176    unfold IndepFun
8177    refine indep_of_indep_of_le_right (indep_of_indep_of_le_left hGind.symm ?_) ?_
8178    · exact (measurable_const.indicator (m := ℱ T) hB).comap_le
8179    · rw [show (fun ω => φ (G ω)) = φ ∘ G from rfl, ← MeasurableSpace.comap_comp]
8180      exact MeasurableSpace.comap_mono hφ.measurable.comap_le
8181  have hX : AEStronglyMeasurable (B.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) P :=
8182    (measurable_const.indicator hBm).aestronglyMeasurable
8183  have hY : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => φ (G ω)) P :=
8184    (hφ.measurable.comp_aemeasurable hGm).aestronglyMeasurable
8185  have h1 := hind.integral_fun_mul_eq_mul_integral hX hY
8186  have e1 : ∫ ω in B, φ (G ω) ∂P = ∫ ω, B.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) ω * φ (G ω) ∂P := by
8187    rw [← integral_indicator hBm]
8188    refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => ?_)
8189    by_cases hω : ω ∈ B <;> simp [hω]
8190  rw [e1, h1]
8191  congr 1
8192  · rw [integral_indicator_const _ hBm]; simp [Measure.real]
8193  · exact (integral_map hGm hφ.aestronglyMeasurable).symm

8195lemma shift_bound_simple (ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
8196    (M : ℝ → Ω → (ℝ^p)) (Sg : ℝ → Ω → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ)
8197    (hM : IsVectorMartingaleWithCovariation P ℱ T M Sg)
8198    (sb : ℝ → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) (hsb : IsDetCovMatrix T sb)
8199    (ξ : Ω → (ℝ^p)) (S : Finset (ℝ^p)) (hS : ∀ ω, ξ ω ∈ S)
8200    (hξ : ∀ x, MeasurableSet[ℱ 0] (ξ ⁻¹' {x}))
8201    (G : Ω → (ℝ^p)) (hGm : AEMeasurable G P)
8202    (hG : law P G = multivariateGaussian 0 (integratedCov T sb))
8203    (hGind : Indep (MeasurableSpace.comap G inferInstance) (ℱ T) P)
8204    (h : (ℝ^p) → ℝ) (hh : MemCb 2 h) {A : Set Ω} (hA : MeasurableSet[ℱ 0] A) :
8205    |(∫ ω in A, h (ξ ω + M T ω) ∂P) - ∫ ω in A, h (ξ ω + G ω) ∂P| ≤
8206      (1 / 2) * hessSup h * ∫ ω in A, (∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 T, s1Norm (Sg σ ω - sb σ)) ∂P := by
8207  classical
8208  have hm0 : ∀ B, MeasurableSet[ℱ 0] B → MeasurableSet B := fun B hB => ℱ.le 0 _ hB
8209  have hξm : ∀ x, MeasurableSet (ξ ⁻¹' {x}) := fun x => hm0 _ (hξ x)
8210  have hξmeas : Measurable ξ := by
8211    intro s _
8212    have : ξ ⁻¹' s = ⋃ x ∈ (S.filter (· ∈ s)), ξ ⁻¹' {x} := by
8213      ext ω; simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_singleton_iff, exists_prop,
8214        Finset.mem_filter]
8215      exact ⟨fun h => ⟨ξ ω, ⟨hS ω, h⟩, rfl⟩, fun ⟨x, ⟨_, hx⟩, e⟩ => e ▸ hx⟩
8216    rw [this]
8217    exact Finset.measurableSet_biUnion _ fun x _ => hξm x
8218  have hMt : AEMeasurable (M T) P :=
8219    (hM.sq_int T ⟨hT, le_rfl⟩).aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable
8220  have hint1 : Integrable (fun ω => h (ξ ω + M T ω)) P :=
8221    integrable_memCb_comp P hh (hξmeas.aemeasurable.add hMt)
8222  have hint2 : Integrable (fun ω => h (ξ ω + G ω)) P :=
8223    integrable_memCb_comp P hh (hξmeas.aemeasurable.add hGm)
8224  have hintg : Integrable (fun ω => ∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 T, s1Norm (Sg σ ω - sb σ)) P :=
8225    LindebergAux.Iblk_integrable P ℱ hM hsb.meas hsb.int le_rfl le_rfl
8226  rw [setIntegral_fiber_sum P (hm0 A hA) S ξ hS hξm hint1,
8227    setIntegral_fiber_sum P (hm0 A hA) S ξ hS hξm hint2,
8228    setIntegral_fiber_sum P (hm0 A hA) S ξ hS hξm hintg, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
8229    Finset.mul_sum]
8230  refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun x _ => ?_)
8231  have hB : MeasurableSet[ℱ 0] (A ∩ ξ ⁻¹' {x}) := hA.inter (hξ x)
8232  have hBm := hm0 _ hB
8233  have e1 : ∫ ω in A ∩ ξ ⁻¹' {x}, h (ξ ω + M T ω) ∂P = ∫ ω in A ∩ ξ ⁻¹' {x}, h (x + M T ω) ∂P :=
8234    setIntegral_congr_fun hBm fun ω hω => by rw [show ξ ω = x from hω.2]
8235  have e2 : ∫ ω in A ∩ ξ ⁻¹' {x}, h (ξ ω + G ω) ∂P = ∫ ω in A ∩ ξ ⁻¹' {x}, h (x + G ω) ∂P :=
8236    setIntegral_congr_fun hBm fun ω hω => by rw [show ξ ω = x from hω.2]
8237  have e3 : ∫ ω in A ∩ ξ ⁻¹' {x}, h (x + G ω) ∂P =
8238      P.real (A ∩ ξ ⁻¹' {x}) * ∫ z, h (x + z) ∂(multivariateGaussian 0 (integratedCov T sb)) := by
8239    rw [setIntegral_indep_comp P hT hGm hGind (φ := fun z => h (x + z))
8240      (hh.1.continuous.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id)) (ℱ.mono hT _ hB), hG]
8241  rw [e1, e2, e3]
8242  exact const_shift_bound P ℱ T hT M Sg hM sb hsb h hh x hB
8243

8245lemma exists_finrange_approx_a27 {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} {X : Ω → (ℝ^p)} (hX : Measurable[m] X) :
8246    ∃ (ξ : ℕ → Ω → (ℝ^p)) (S : ℕ → Finset (ℝ^p)), (∀ n ω, ξ n ω ∈ S n) ∧
8247      (∀ n x, MeasurableSet[m] (ξ n ⁻¹' {x})) ∧ (∀ n, Measurable[m] (ξ n)) ∧
8248      ∀ ω, Tendsto (fun n => ξ n ω) atTop (𝓝 (X ω)) := by
8249  classical
8250  have hXs : StronglyMeasurable[m] X := hX.stronglyMeasurable
8251  exact ⟨fun n => hXs.approx n, fun n => (hXs.approx n).range,
8252    fun n ω => SimpleFunc.mem_range_self _ ω, fun n x => (hXs.approx n).measurableSet_fiber x,
8253    fun n => (hXs.approx n).measurable, fun ω => hXs.tendsto_approx ω⟩
