8255lemma shift_bound (ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
8256    (M : ℝ → Ω → (ℝ^p)) (Sg : ℝ → Ω → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ)
8257    (hM : IsVectorMartingaleWithCovariation P ℱ T M Sg)
8258    (sb : ℝ → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) (hsb : IsDetCovMatrix T sb)
8259    (X : Ω → (ℝ^p)) (hX : Measurable[ℱ 0] X)
8260    (G : Ω → (ℝ^p)) (hGm : AEMeasurable G P)
8261    (hG : law P G = multivariateGaussian 0 (integratedCov T sb))
8262    (hGind : Indep (MeasurableSpace.comap G inferInstance) (ℱ T) P)
8263    (h : (ℝ^p) → ℝ) (hh : MemCb 2 h) {A : Set Ω} (hA : MeasurableSet[ℱ 0] A) :
8264    |(∫ ω in A, h (X ω + M T ω) ∂P) - ∫ ω in A, h (X ω + G ω) ∂P| ≤
8265      (1 / 2) * hessSup h * ∫ ω in A, (∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 T, s1Norm (Sg σ ω - sb σ)) ∂P := by
8266  classical
8267  obtain ⟨ξ, S, hS, hξ, hξm0, hξt⟩ := exists_finrange_approx_a27 (m := ℱ 0) hX
8268  have hm0 : ∀ B, MeasurableSet[ℱ 0] B → MeasurableSet B := fun B hB => ℱ.le 0 _ hB
8269  have hAm := hm0 A hA
8270  have hξm : ∀ n, Measurable (ξ n) := fun n => (hξm0 n).mono (ℱ.le 0) le_rfl
8271  have hMt : AEMeasurable (M T) P :=
8272    (hM.sq_int T ⟨hT, le_rfl⟩).aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable
8273  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := memCb_bound hh
8274  have hbd : ∀ (f : Ω → (ℝ^p)), AEMeasurable f P →
8275      Tendsto (fun n => ∫ ω in A, h (ξ n ω + f ω) ∂P) atTop (𝓝 (∫ ω in A, h (X ω + f ω) ∂P)) := by
8276    intro f hf
8277    refine tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (fun _ => C) (fun n => ?_)
8278      (integrable_const C) (fun n => ae_of_all _ fun ω => ?_) (ae_of_all _ fun ω => ?_)
8279    · exact (integrable_memCb_comp (P.restrict A) hh
8280        ((hξm n).aemeasurable.add hf.restrict)).aestronglyMeasurable
8281    · simpa using hC _
8282    · exact (hh.1.continuous.tendsto _).comp ((hξt ω).add_const (f ω))
8283  have hG' := hbd G hGm
8284  have hM' := hbd (M T) hMt
8285  have hlim : Tendsto (fun n => |(∫ ω in A, h (ξ n ω + M T ω) ∂P) -
8286      ∫ ω in A, h (ξ n ω + G ω) ∂P|) atTop
8287      (𝓝 |(∫ ω in A, h (X ω + M T ω) ∂P) - ∫ ω in A, h (X ω + G ω) ∂P|) :=
8288    (hM'.sub hG').abs
8289  refine le_of_tendsto hlim (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => ?_)
8290  exact shift_bound_simple P ℱ T hT M Sg hM sb hsb (ξ n) (S n) (hS n) (hξ n)
8291    G hGm hG hGind h hh hA
8292
8293end A27Aux
8294
8295/-- Lemma A.27 `M:B:newprob:conditional-heat` (source lines 10788-10817), bound
8296`B:newprob:conditional-bound`.  `(ℱ_r)_{0≤r≤T}` a filtration, `M` a continuous `ℝ^p`-valued
8297(local) martingale with `M_0 = 0`, `[M^a,M^b]_t = ∫_0^t Σ^{ab}_r dr` with `Σ` predictable
8298symmetric nonnegative and `E ∫_0^T tr Σ_r dr < ∞` (`B:newprob:bracket`; the integrability makes
8299`M` a square-integrable martingale, line 10822, which is how `IsVectorMartingaleWithCovariation`
8300states it), `Σ̄` deterministic measurable symmetric nonnegative integrable, `X` an
8301`ℱ_0`-measurable random vector, `G` a centered Gaussian vector independent of `ℱ_T` with covariance
8302`∫_0^T Σ̄_r dr`.  Then for `h ∈ C_b^2(ℝ^p)`, almost surely
8303`|E[h(X+M_T) | ℱ_0] - E[h(X+G) | ℱ_0]| ≤ ½ sup_x ‖D²h(x)‖_op E[∫_0^T ‖Σ_r - Σ̄_r‖_{S_1} dr | ℱ_0]`.
8304(The source's "an enlargement can be used to define `G`" is the existence of such a `G` on
8305`Ω × ℝ^p`, cf. `exists_enlargement`; it is not part of the inequality.)
8306
8307PLAN (source proof 10819-10886 uses the backward heat equation and Itô's formula; the project's
8308route for Lemma A.21 avoids Itô calculus): conditional Lindeberg replacement.  For a bounded
8309nonnegative `ℱ_0`-measurable weight `ξ` it suffices to prove
8310`|E[ξ (h(X+M_T) - f(X))]| ≤ ½ ‖D²h‖ E[ξ ∫‖Σ-Σ̄‖]` with `f(x) := E h(x + G) = gaussSmooth h (∫Σ̄) x`
8311(`B:newprob:heat-definition` at `r = 0`), since `E[h(X+G) | ℱ_0] = f(X)` by independence of `G`
8312from `ℱ_T ⊇ ℱ_0` and `ℱ_0`-measurability of `X` (`condExp_indep_eq`-type lemma / Fubini).  Under
8313the tilted probability `P_ξ = ξ dP / E ξ`, `M` is still an `IsVectorMartingaleWithCovariation`
8314(tilting by an `ℱ_0`-measurable density preserves martingales, `condExp_mul_of_stronglyMeasurable_left`),
8315and `h̃(ω, y) := h(X ω + y)` is `C_b^2` in `y` with the same Hessian bound; run
8316`lindeberg_partition_bound`/`DM.lindeberg_discrete` (`HRS/Prob/MartingaleLindeberg.lean`) with
8317this `ℱ_0`-measurable random shift (the Taylor expansion of `gaussSmooth h̃` along the uniform
8318partition `unifPart T n` only uses `ℱ_{t_k}`-measurability of the shift, which holds for `ℱ_0`),
8319then `martingale_lindeberg_tendsto`, `gaussian_lindeberg_tendsto`, and the mollification step of
8320`multivariate_martingale_clt` (`gaussSmooth_approx`, `gaussSmooth_hessian`), finally remove the
8321regularisation of `Σ̄` as in A.21.  Conclude the a.s. inequality from the weighted inequality for
8322all bounded `ℱ_0`-measurable `ξ ≥ 0` (`ae_le_of_forall_setIntegral_le`-type lemma). -/
8323theorem conditional_gaussian_interpolation (ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
8324    (M : ℝ → Ω → (ℝ^p)) (Sg : ℝ → Ω → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ)
8325    (hM : IsVectorMartingaleWithCovariation P ℱ T M Sg)
8326    (sb : ℝ → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) (hsb : IsDetCovMatrix T sb)
8327    (X : Ω → (ℝ^p)) (hX : Measurable[ℱ 0] X)
8328    (G : Ω → (ℝ^p)) (hGm : AEMeasurable G P)
8329    (hG : law P G = multivariateGaussian 0 (integratedCov T sb))
8330    (hGind : Indep (MeasurableSpace.comap G inferInstance) (ℱ T) P)
8331    (h : (ℝ^p) → ℝ) (hh : MemCb 2 h) :
8332    ∀ᵐ ω ∂P,
8333      |(P[fun ω => h (X ω + M T ω) | ℱ 0]) ω - (P[fun ω => h (X ω + G ω) | ℱ 0]) ω| ≤
8334        (1 / 2) * hessSup h *
8335          (P[fun ω => ∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 T, s1Norm (Sg σ ω - sb σ) | ℱ 0]) ω := by
8336  have hm : ℱ 0 ≤ mΩ := ℱ.le 0
8337  have hXm : Measurable X := hX.mono hm le_rfl
8338  have hMt : AEMeasurable (M T) P :=
8339    (hM.sq_int T ⟨hT, le_rfl⟩).aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable
8340  set g : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => ∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 T, s1Norm (Sg σ ω - sb σ) with hg
8341  have hint1 : Integrable (fun ω => h (X ω + M T ω)) P :=
8342    integrable_memCb_comp P hh (hXm.aemeasurable.add hMt)
8343  have hint2 : Integrable (fun ω => h (X ω + G ω)) P :=
8344    integrable_memCb_comp P hh (hXm.aemeasurable.add hGm)
8345  have hintg : Integrable g P := LindebergAux.Iblk_integrable P ℱ hM hsb.meas hsb.int le_rfl le_rfl
8346  set U := P[fun ω => h (X ω + M T ω) | ℱ 0] with hU
8347  set V := P[fun ω => h (X ω + G ω) | ℱ 0] with hV
8348  set W := P[g | ℱ 0] with hW
8349  set c : ℝ := (1 / 2) * hessSup h with hc
8350  have hUm : StronglyMeasurable[ℱ 0] U := stronglyMeasurable_condExp
8351  have hVm : StronglyMeasurable[ℱ 0] V := stronglyMeasurable_condExp
8352  have hWm : StronglyMeasurable[ℱ 0] W := stronglyMeasurable_condExp
8353  have hUi : Integrable U P := integrable_condExp
8354  have hVi : Integrable V P := integrable_condExp
8355  have hWi : Integrable W P := integrable_condExp
8356  have hsetU : ∀ A, MeasurableSet[ℱ 0] A → ∫ ω in A, U ω ∂P = ∫ ω in A, h (X ω + M T ω) ∂P :=
8357    fun A hA => setIntegral_condExp hm hint1 hA
8358  have hsetV : ∀ A, MeasurableSet[ℱ 0] A → ∫ ω in A, V ω ∂P = ∫ ω in A, h (X ω + G ω) ∂P :=
8359    fun A hA => setIntegral_condExp hm hint2 hA
8360  have hsetW : ∀ A, MeasurableSet[ℱ 0] A → ∫ ω in A, W ω ∂P = ∫ ω in A, g ω ∂P :=
8361    fun A hA => setIntegral_condExp hm hintg hA
8362  have hSA : ∀ A, MeasurableSet[ℱ 0] A →
8363      |(∫ ω in A, U ω ∂P) - ∫ ω in A, V ω ∂P| ≤ c * ∫ ω in A, W ω ∂P := by
8364    intro A hA
8365    rw [hsetU A hA, hsetV A hA, hsetW A hA]
8366    exact shift_bound P ℱ T hT M Sg hM sb hsb X hX G hGm hG hGind h hh hA
8367  have h1 : (fun ω => U ω - V ω) ≤ᵐ[P] fun ω => c * W ω := by
8368    refine ae_le_of_setIntegral_le_trim P hm (hUm.sub hVm) (hWm.const_mul _) (hUi.sub hVi)
8369      (hWi.const_mul _) ?_
8370    intro A hA
8371    rw [integral_sub hUi.integrableOn hVi.integrableOn, integral_const_mul]
8372    have := hSA A hA
8373    rw [abs_le] at this
8374    linarith [this.2]
8375  have h2 : (fun ω => V ω - U ω) ≤ᵐ[P] fun ω => c * W ω := by
8376    refine ae_le_of_setIntegral_le_trim P hm (hVm.sub hUm) (hWm.const_mul _) (hVi.sub hUi)
8377      (hWi.const_mul _) ?_
8378    intro A hA
8379    rw [integral_sub hVi.integrableOn hUi.integrableOn, integral_const_mul]
8380    have := hSA A hA
8381    rw [abs_le] at this
8382    linarith [this.1]
8383  filter_upwards [h1, h2] with ω a b
8384  rw [abs_le]
8385  constructor <;> linarith

8387section A28Aux
8388
8389omit [IsProbabilityMeasure P] in
8390lemma D3TestClass.memCb2 {h : (ℝ^p) → ℝ} (hh : h ∈ D3TestClass p) : MemCb 2 h :=
8391  ⟨hh.1.1.of_le (by norm_num), fun j hj => hh.1.2 j (hj.trans (by norm_num))⟩
8392
8393omit [IsProbabilityMeasure P] in
8394lemma D3TestClass.hessSup_le {h : (ℝ^p) → ℝ} (hh : h ∈ D3TestClass p) : hessSup h ≤ 1 :=
8395  ciSup_le fun x => hh.2 2 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) x
8396
8397omit [IsProbabilityMeasure P] in
8398lemma D3TestClass.lipschitz {h : (ℝ^p) → ℝ} (hh : h ∈ D3TestClass p) (x y : ℝ^p) :
8399    |h y - h x| ≤ ‖y - x‖ := by
8400  have hd : Differentiable ℝ h := hh.1.1.differentiable (by norm_num)
8401  have h1 : ∀ z, ‖fderiv ℝ h z‖ ≤ 1 := fun z => by
8402    rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_one]; exact hh.2 1 le_rfl (by norm_num) z
8403  have := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := h) (s := Set.univ)
8404    (fun z _ => hd z) (fun z _ => h1 z) convex_univ (Set.mem_univ x) (Set.mem_univ y)
8405  simpa using this
8406
8407end A28Aux
8408
8409/-- Corollary A.28 `M:B:newprob:conditional-martingale` (source lines 10888-10900), bound
8410`B:newprob:retained-initial-bound`: under the assumptions of Lemma A.27 and for an integrable
8411random vector `R`,
8412`𝖽₃(X + M_T + R, X + G) ≤ E|R| + ½ E ∫_0^T ‖Σ_r - Σ̄_r‖_{S_1} dr`, where `G` is independent of `X`
8413(it is independent of `ℱ_T ∋ X`).  No moment assumption on `X` is needed.
8414
8415PLAN (lines 10902-10906): for `h ∈ D3TestClass p`, `|E h(X+M_T+R) - E h(X+M_T)| ≤ E|R|` by the
8416gradient bound (`norm_sub_le_of_mem_one`-type mean value inequality with `‖Dh‖ ≤ 1`); then take
8417expectations in `conditional_gaussian_interpolation` (`integral_condExp`, `hessSup h ≤ 1`) and the
8418supremum over the test class (`iSup_le`). -/
8419theorem retained_initial_law (ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
8420    (M : ℝ → Ω → (ℝ^p)) (Sg : ℝ → Ω → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ)
8421    (hM : IsVectorMartingaleWithCovariation P ℱ T M Sg)
8422    (sb : ℝ → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) (hsb : IsDetCovMatrix T sb)
8423    (X : Ω → (ℝ^p)) (hX : Measurable[ℱ 0] X)
8424    (G : Ω → (ℝ^p)) (hGm : AEMeasurable G P)
8425    (hG : law P G = multivariateGaussian 0 (integratedCov T sb))
8426    (hGind : Indep (MeasurableSpace.comap G inferInstance) (ℱ T) P)
8427    (R : Ω → (ℝ^p)) (hR : Integrable R P) :
8428    d3DistE (law P fun ω => X ω + M T ω + R ω) (law P fun ω => X ω + G ω) ≤
8429      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ ω, ‖R ω‖ ∂P + (1 / 2) * covDiscrepancyMatrix P T Sg sb) := by
8430  have hm : ℱ 0 ≤ mΩ := ℱ.le 0
8431  have hXm : Measurable X := hX.mono hm le_rfl
8432  have hMt : AEMeasurable (M T) P :=
8433    (hM.sq_int T ⟨hT, le_rfl⟩).aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable
8434  have hRm : AEMeasurable R P := hR.aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable
8435  set g : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => ∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 T, s1Norm (Sg σ ω - sb σ) with hg
8436  have hintg : Integrable g P := LindebergAux.Iblk_integrable P ℱ hM hsb.meas hsb.int le_rfl le_rfl
8437  have hg0 : 0 ≤ ∫ ω, g ω ∂P :=
8438    integral_nonneg fun ω => setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Icc fun σ _ => traceNormMatrix_nonneg _
8439  have hRn : 0 ≤ ∫ ω, ‖R ω‖ ∂P := integral_nonneg fun ω => norm_nonneg _
8440  refine iSup_le fun ⟨h, hh⟩ => ?_
8441  have hh2 := D3TestClass.memCb2 hh
8442  rw [show covDiscrepancyMatrix P T Sg sb = ∫ ω, g ω ∂P from rfl]
8443  refine ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_
8444  have e1 : ∫ x, h x ∂(law P fun ω => X ω + M T ω + R ω) = ∫ ω, h (X ω + M T ω + R ω) ∂P :=
8445    integral_map ((hXm.aemeasurable.add hMt).add hRm) hh.1.1.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
8446  have e2 : ∫ x, h x ∂(law P fun ω => X ω + G ω) = ∫ ω, h (X ω + G ω) ∂P :=
8447    integral_map (hXm.aemeasurable.add hGm) hh.1.1.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
8448  show |∫ x, h x ∂(law P fun ω => X ω + M T ω + R ω) - ∫ x, h x ∂(law P fun ω => X ω + G ω)| ≤ _
8449  rw [e1, e2]
8450  have hi1 : Integrable (fun ω => h (X ω + M T ω + R ω)) P :=
8451    integrable_memCb_comp P hh2 ((hXm.aemeasurable.add hMt).add hRm)
8452  have hi0 : Integrable (fun ω => h (X ω + M T ω)) P :=
8453    integrable_memCb_comp P hh2 (hXm.aemeasurable.add hMt)
8454  have hi2 : Integrable (fun ω => h (X ω + G ω)) P :=
8455    integrable_memCb_comp P hh2 (hXm.aemeasurable.add hGm)
8456  -- step 1: removing R
8457  have s1 : |(∫ ω, h (X ω + M T ω + R ω) ∂P) - ∫ ω, h (X ω + M T ω) ∂P| ≤ ∫ ω, ‖R ω‖ ∂P := by
8458    rw [← integral_sub hi1 hi0, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
8459    refine norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hR.norm (ae_of_all _ fun ω => ?_)
8460    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
8461    simpa using D3TestClass.lipschitz hh (X ω + M T ω) (X ω + M T ω + R ω)
8462  -- step 2: Lemma A.27 integrated
8463  have hcond := conditional_gaussian_interpolation P ℱ T hT M Sg hM sb hsb X hX G hGm hG hGind h
8464    hh2
8465  have hUi : Integrable (P[fun ω => h (X ω + M T ω) | ℱ 0]) P := integrable_condExp
8466  have hVi : Integrable (P[fun ω => h (X ω + G ω) | ℱ 0]) P := integrable_condExp
8467  have hWi : Integrable (P[g | ℱ 0]) P := integrable_condExp
8468  have s2 : |(∫ ω, h (X ω + M T ω) ∂P) - ∫ ω, h (X ω + G ω) ∂P| ≤ (1 / 2) * ∫ ω, g ω ∂P := by
8469    rw [← integral_condExp hm (f := fun ω => h (X ω + M T ω)),
8470      ← integral_condExp hm (f := fun ω => h (X ω + G ω)), ← integral_sub hUi hVi,
8471      ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
8472    have hb : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ‖(P[fun ω => h (X ω + M T ω) | ℱ 0]) ω -
8473        (P[fun ω => h (X ω + G ω) | ℱ 0]) ω‖ ≤ (1 / 2) * hessSup h * (P[g | ℱ 0]) ω := by
8474      filter_upwards [hcond] with ω hω
8475      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hω
8476    refine (norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (hWi.const_mul ((1 / 2) * hessSup h)) hb).trans ?_
8477    rw [integral_const_mul, integral_condExp hm]
8478    have := D3TestClass.hessSup_le hh
8479    nlinarith
8480  have : (∫ ω, h (X ω + M T ω + R ω) ∂P) - ∫ ω, h (X ω + G ω) ∂P =
8481      ((∫ ω, h (X ω + M T ω + R ω) ∂P) - ∫ ω, h (X ω + M T ω) ∂P) +
8482        ((∫ ω, h (X ω + M T ω) ∂P) - ∫ ω, h (X ω + G ω) ∂P) := by ring
8483  rw [this]
8484  refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans ?_
8485  linarith
8486
8487/-- The covariance `Q = ∑_i E[ζ_i ζ_iᵀ] + ∫_0^T Σ̄_r dr` of `B:newprob:total-covariance`. -/
8488def totalCovariance {N : ℕ} (ζ : Fin N → Ω → (ℝ^p)) (T : ℝ)
8489    (sb : ℝ → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ :=
8490  (Matrix.of fun a b => ∑ i, ∫ ω, ζ i ω a * ζ i ω b ∂P) + integratedCov T sb
8491
8492/-! ### Route for Lemma A.29 (as formalised)
8493
84941. `R` is removed at cost `E|R|` (`D3TestClass.lipschitz`).
84952. With `f := gaussSmooth h (∫Σ̄)` and `X = ∑ ζ_i`, the bound `|E h(X + M_T) - E f(X)| ≤ ½ E ∫‖Σ-Σ̄‖`
8496   is the G-free form of Lemma A.27 (`shift_bound_f`: Lemma A.21 under `P[· | B]`, `B ∈ ℱ_0`, for
8497   `ℱ_0`-simple approximations of `X`); no enlargement is needed.
84983. Lindeberg replacement of the `ζ_i` by Gaussians `N(0, E ζ_iζ_iᵀ)` on the product of the laws
8499   (`lindeberg_pi_sharp`, a copy of `HRS.Yurinskii.lindeberg_pi` with the sharp third-order Taylor
8500   constant `1/6`, `taylor_sharp`), `f` having a `1`-Lipschitz Hessian (`gaussSmooth_hessian`).
85014. The Gaussian third moment is at most `√3` times that of `ζ_i` (`gauss_m3_le_sqrt3`: Cauchy-Schwarz,
8502   `E|g|⁴ ≤ 3 (E|g|²)²`, Lyapunov).
85035. `∑ g_i + G ∼ N(0, Q)` (`pi_map_sum_gauss`, `gaussSmooth_add`). -/
8504
8505section A29Aux
8506
8507/-- Third-order Taylor bound with the sharp constant `1/6`, for `f ∈ C²` with `L`-Lipschitz Hessian
8508(integral form of the remainder). -/
8509lemma taylor_sharp {f : (ℝ^p) → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) {L : ℝ}
8510    (hL : ∀ x y, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖) (x v : ℝ^p) :
8511    |f (x + v) - f x - fderiv ℝ f x v - (1 / 2) * iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f x ![v, v]| ≤
8512      L * ‖v‖ ^ 3 / 6 := by
8513  have hd1 : Differentiable ℝ f := hf.differentiable (by norm_num)
8514  have hd2 : Differentiable ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) :=
8515    (hf.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiable one_ne_zero
8516  have hc2 : Continuous (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f)) :=
8517    (hf.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero
8518  set q : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) (x + s • v) v v with hq
8519  have hline : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => x + s • v) v s := by
8520    intro s; simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id s).smul_const v).const_add x
8521  have hφ : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => f (x + s • v)) (fderiv ℝ f (x + s • v) v) s :=
8522    fun s => (hd1 (x + s • v)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s (hline s)
8523  have hφ' : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => fderiv ℝ f (x + s • v) v) (q s) s := by
8524    intro s
8525    have h1 := (hd2 (x + s • v)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s (hline s)
8526    exact (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s h1
8527  set Ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => f (x + s • v) + (1 - s) * fderiv ℝ f (x + s • v) v with hΨdef
8528  have hΨ : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt Ψ ((1 - s) * q s) s := by
8529    intro s
8530    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => 1 - s) (-1) s := by
8531      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id s).const_sub 1
8532    have := (hφ s).add (h1.mul (hφ' s))
8533    convert this using 1
8534    ring
8535  have hqc : Continuous q := by
8536    have : Continuous fun s : ℝ => fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) (x + s • v) :=
8537      hc2.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const))
8538    exact (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ v).continuous.comp
8539      ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ((ℝ^p) →L[ℝ] ℝ) v).continuous.comp this)
8540  have hFTC : ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - s) * q s = Ψ 1 - Ψ 0 :=
8541    intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun s _ => hΨ s)
8542      ((by fun_prop : Continuous fun s : ℝ => (1 - s) * q s).intervalIntegrable _ _)
8543  have hB : iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f x ![v, v] = q 0 := by
8544    simp [hq, iteratedFDeriv_two_apply]
8545  have h12 : ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - s) = 1 / 2 := by
8546    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub intervalIntegrable_const intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_id]
8547    simp; norm_num
8548  have hR : f (x + v) - f x - fderiv ℝ f x v - (1 / 2) * iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f x ![v, v] =
8549      ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - s) * (q s - q 0) := by
8550    have e1 : ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - s) * (q s - q 0) =
8551        (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - s) * q s) - q 0 * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - s) := by
8552      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub]
8553      · refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun s _ => ?_
8554        show (1 - s) * (q s - q 0) = (1 - s) * q s - q 0 * (1 - s)
8555        ring
8556      · exact (by fun_prop : Continuous fun s : ℝ => (1 - s) * q s).intervalIntegrable _ _
8557      · exact (by fun_prop : Continuous fun s : ℝ => q 0 * (1 - s)).intervalIntegrable _ _
8558    rw [e1, hFTC, h12, hB]
8559    simp [hΨdef]
8560    ring
8561  rw [hR]
8562  have hqb : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, |q s - q 0| ≤ L * s * ‖v‖ ^ 3 := by
8563    intro s hs
8564    have : q s - q 0 = (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (x + s • v) - iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f x) ![v, v] := by
8565      simp [hq, iteratedFDeriv_two_apply]
8566    rw [this, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
8567    refine (ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm _ _).trans ?_
8568    have h5 := hL (x + s • v) x
8569    rw [add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hs.1] at h5
8570    simp only [Fin.prod_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
8571    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (x + s • v) - iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f x‖ * (‖v‖ * ‖v‖)
8572        ≤ (L * (s * ‖v‖)) * (‖v‖ * ‖v‖) := by gcongr
8573      _ = L * s * ‖v‖ ^ 3 := by ring
8574  rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
8575  refine (intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le zero_le_one
8576    (g := fun s => (1 - s) * (L * s * ‖v‖ ^ 3)) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s hs => ?_)
8577    ((by fun_prop : Continuous fun s : ℝ => (1 - s) * (L * s * ‖v‖ ^ 3)).intervalIntegrable _ _)).trans ?_
8578  · rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs (1 - s), Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith [hs.2])]
8579    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hqb s ⟨hs.1.le, hs.2⟩) (by linarith [hs.2])
8580  · have : (fun s : ℝ => (1 - s) * (L * s * ‖v‖ ^ 3)) =
8581        fun s => (L * ‖v‖ ^ 3) * s - (L * ‖v‖ ^ 3) * s ^ 2 := by ext s; ring
8582    rw [this, intervalIntegral.integral_sub, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
8583      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_id, integral_pow]
8584    · norm_num; linarith
8585    · exact (continuous_const.mul continuous_id).intervalIntegrable _ _
8586    · exact (continuous_const.mul (continuous_id.pow 2)).intervalIntegrable _ _
8587

8589structure SharpFn (K : ℝ) (f : (ℝ^p) → ℝ) : Prop where
8590  contDiff : ContDiff ℝ 2 f
8591  K_nonneg : 0 ≤ K
8592  bdd0 : ∃ M, ∀ x, |f x| ≤ M
8593  bdd1 : ∃ M, ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ M
8594  bdd2 : ∃ M, ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x‖ ≤ M
8595  taylor : ∀ x v : ℝ^p, |f (x + v) - f x - fderiv ℝ f x v -
8596    (1 / 2) * fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x v v| ≤ K * ‖v‖ ^ 3
8597
8598lemma SharpFn.measurable {K : ℝ} {f : (ℝ^p) → ℝ} (hf : SharpFn K f) : Measurable f :=
8599  hf.contDiff.continuous.measurable
8600
8601lemma SharpFn.continuous_fderiv {K : ℝ} {f : (ℝ^p) → ℝ} (hf : SharpFn K f) :
8602    Continuous (fderiv ℝ f) := hf.contDiff.continuous_fderiv (by norm_num)
8603
8604lemma SharpFn.continuous_fderiv2 {K : ℝ} {f : (ℝ^p) → ℝ} (hf : SharpFn K f) :
8605    Continuous (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f)) :=
8606  (hf.contDiff.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero
8607
8608section SharpLind
8609
8610variable {P}
8611
8612/-- Core estimate of one Lindeberg step. -/
8613lemma swap_step_sharp {X Y : Ω → (ℝ^p)} {K : ℝ} {f : (ℝ^p) → ℝ} (hf : SharpFn K f)
8614    (hX : Measurable X) (hY : Measurable Y)
8615    (hind : IndepFun X Y P) (hY0 : ∀ c, ∫ ω, Y ω c ∂P = 0)
8616    (hY3 : Integrable (fun ω => ‖Y ω‖ ^ 3) P) :
8617    |∫ ω, f (X ω + Y ω) ∂P - ∫ ω, f (X ω) ∂P -
8618      (1 / 2) * ∑ c, ∑ d, (∫ ω, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) (X ω) (EuclideanSpace.single c 1)
8619        (EuclideanSpace.single d 1) ∂P) * ∫ ω, Y ω c * Y ω d ∂P| ≤
8620      K * ∫ ω, ‖Y ω‖ ^ 3 ∂P := by
8621  obtain ⟨M0, hM0⟩ := hf.bdd0
8622  obtain ⟨M1, hM1⟩ := hf.bdd1
8623  obtain ⟨M2, hM2⟩ := hf.bdd2
8624  obtain ⟨hY1, hY2⟩ := Yurinskii.integrable_norm_of_pow3 hY hY3
8625  set g : Fin p → (ℝ^p) → ℝ := fun c x => fderiv ℝ f x (EuclideanSpace.single c 1) with hg
8626  set H : Fin p → Fin p → (ℝ^p) → ℝ := fun c d x =>
8627    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x (EuclideanSpace.single c 1) (EuclideanSpace.single d 1) with hH
8628  have hgc : ∀ c, Continuous (g c) := fun c => by
8629    simp only [hg]
8630    exact (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ (EuclideanSpace.single c 1)).continuous.comp
8631      hf.continuous_fderiv
8632  have hHc : ∀ c d, Continuous (H c d) := fun c d => by
8633    simp only [hH]
8634    exact ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ (EuclideanSpace.single d 1)).continuous.comp
8635      ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ((ℝ^p) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (EuclideanSpace.single c 1)).continuous.comp
8636      hf.continuous_fderiv2))
8637  have hgb : ∀ c x, |g c x| ≤ M1 := fun c x => by
8638    have := (fderiv ℝ f x).le_opNorm (EuclideanSpace.single c 1)
8639    rw [Yurinskii.norm_single_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
8640    exact this.trans (hM1 x)
8641  have hHb : ∀ c d x, |H c d x| ≤ M2 := fun c d x => by
8642    have h1 := (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x).le_opNorm (EuclideanSpace.single c 1)
8643    have h2 := (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x (EuclideanSpace.single c 1)).le_opNorm
8644      (EuclideanSpace.single d 1)
8645    rw [Yurinskii.norm_single_one, mul_one] at h1 h2
8646    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h2
8647    exact (h2.trans (h1.trans (hM2 x)))
8648  have hYc : ∀ c, Measurable fun ω => Y ω c := fun c => by fun_prop
8649  have hYcI : ∀ c, Integrable (fun ω => Y ω c) P := fun c =>
8650    hY1.mono' (hYc c).aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ fun ω => by
8651      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact Yurinskii.norm_coord_le _ _)
8652  have hYcdI : ∀ c d, Integrable (fun ω => Y ω c * Y ω d) P := fun c d =>
8653    hY2.mono' ((hYc c).mul (hYc d)).aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ fun ω => by
8654      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
8655      calc |Y ω c| * |Y ω d| ≤ ‖Y ω‖ * ‖Y ω‖ :=
8656            mul_le_mul (Yurinskii.norm_coord_le _ _) (Yurinskii.norm_coord_le _ _) (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
8657        _ = ‖Y ω‖ ^ 2 := by ring)
8658  have hfI : ∀ Z : Ω → (ℝ^p), Measurable Z → Integrable (fun ω => f (Z ω)) P := fun Z hZ =>
8659    (integrable_const M0).mono' (hf.measurable.comp hZ).aestronglyMeasurable
8660      (ae_of_all _ fun ω => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hM0 _)
8661  have hXY : Measurable fun ω => X ω + Y ω := hX.add hY
8662  have hlinI : ∀ c, Integrable (fun ω => Y ω c * g c (X ω)) P := fun c =>
8663    (hY1.mul_const M1).mono' ((hYc c).mul ((hgc c).measurable.comp hX)).aestronglyMeasurable
8664      (ae_of_all _ fun ω => by
8665        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
8666        exact mul_le_mul (Yurinskii.norm_coord_le _ _) (hgb _ _) (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
8667  have hquadI : ∀ c d, Integrable (fun ω => Y ω c * Y ω d * H c d (X ω)) P := fun c d =>
8668    (hY2.mul_const M2).mono' (((hYc c).mul (hYc d)).mul ((hHc c d).measurable.comp hX)).aestronglyMeasurable
8669      (ae_of_all _ fun ω => by
8670        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_mul]
8671        calc |Y ω c| * |Y ω d| * |H c d (X ω)| ≤ ‖Y ω‖ * ‖Y ω‖ * M2 :=
8672              mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul (Yurinskii.norm_coord_le _ _) (Yurinskii.norm_coord_le _ _) (abs_nonneg _)
8673                (norm_nonneg _)) (hHb _ _ _) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
8674          _ = ‖Y ω‖ ^ 2 * M2 := by ring)
8675  -- independence
8676  have hlin : ∀ c, ∫ ω, Y ω c * g c (X ω) ∂P = 0 := by
8677    intro c
8678    have hi : IndepFun (fun ω => g c (X ω)) (fun ω => Y ω c) P :=
8679      hind.comp (φ := g c) (ψ := fun y : (ℝ^p) => y c) (hgc c).measurable (by fun_prop)
8680    have := hi.integral_fun_mul_eq_mul_integral
8681      ((hgc c).measurable.comp hX).aestronglyMeasurable (hYc c).aestronglyMeasurable
8682    calc ∫ ω, Y ω c * g c (X ω) ∂P = ∫ ω, g c (X ω) * Y ω c ∂P := by
8683          congr 1; ext ω; ring
8684      _ = 0 := by rw [this, hY0 c, mul_zero]
8685  have hquad : ∀ c d, ∫ ω, Y ω c * Y ω d * H c d (X ω) ∂P =
8686      (∫ ω, H c d (X ω) ∂P) * ∫ ω, Y ω c * Y ω d ∂P := by
8687    intro c d
8688    have hi : IndepFun (fun ω => H c d (X ω)) (fun ω => Y ω c * Y ω d) P :=
8689      hind.comp (φ := H c d) (ψ := fun y : (ℝ^p) => y c * y d) (hHc c d).measurable (by fun_prop)
8690    have := hi.integral_fun_mul_eq_mul_integral
8691      ((hHc c d).measurable.comp hX).aestronglyMeasurable ((hYc c).mul (hYc d)).aestronglyMeasurable
8692    calc ∫ ω, Y ω c * Y ω d * H c d (X ω) ∂P = ∫ ω, H c d (X ω) * (Y ω c * Y ω d) ∂P := by
8693          congr 1; ext ω; ring
8694      _ = _ := this
8695  -- remainder
8696  set R : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => f (X ω + Y ω) - f (X ω) - ∑ c, Y ω c * g c (X ω) -
8697    (1 / 2) * ∑ c, ∑ d, Y ω c * Y ω d * H c d (X ω) with hR
8698  have hRb : ∀ ω, |R ω| ≤ K * ‖Y ω‖ ^ 3 := by
8699    intro ω
8700    have h := hf.taylor (X ω) (Y ω)
8701    have e1 : fderiv ℝ f (X ω) (Y ω) = ∑ c, Y ω c * g c (X ω) := Yurinskii.expand1 _ _
8702    have e2 : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) (X ω) (Y ω) (Y ω) =
8703        ∑ c, ∑ d, Y ω c * Y ω d * H c d (X ω) := Yurinskii.expand2 _ _
8704    rw [e1, e2] at h
8705    simpa only [hR, sub_sub] using h
8706  have hlinSum : Integrable (fun ω => ∑ c, Y ω c * g c (X ω)) P :=
8707    integrable_finsetSum _ fun c _ => hlinI c
8708  have hquadSum : Integrable (fun ω => ∑ c, ∑ d, Y ω c * Y ω d * H c d (X ω)) P :=
8709    integrable_finsetSum _ fun c _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun d _ => hquadI c d
8710  have hI12 : Integrable (fun ω => f (X ω + Y ω) - f (X ω)) P := (hfI _ hXY).sub (hfI X hX)
8711  have hI123 : Integrable (fun ω => f (X ω + Y ω) - f (X ω) - ∑ c, Y ω c * g c (X ω)) P :=
8712    hI12.sub hlinSum
8713  have hI4 : Integrable (fun ω => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ c, ∑ d, Y ω c * Y ω d * H c d (X ω)) P :=
8714    hquadSum.const_mul _
8715  have hRI : Integrable R P := hI123.sub hI4
8716  have hRint : ∫ ω, R ω ∂P = ∫ ω, f (X ω + Y ω) ∂P - ∫ ω, f (X ω) ∂P -
8717      (1 / 2) * ∑ c, ∑ d, (∫ ω, H c d (X ω) ∂P) * ∫ ω, Y ω c * Y ω d ∂P := by
8718    simp only [hR]
8719    rw [integral_sub hI123 hI4, integral_sub hI12 hlinSum, integral_sub (hfI _ hXY) (hfI X hX),
8720      integral_const_mul, integral_finsetSum _ fun c _ => hlinI c,
8721      integral_finsetSum _ fun c _ => integrable_finsetSum _ fun d _ => hquadI c d]
8722    simp_rw [integral_finsetSum _ fun d _ => hquadI _ d, hlin, hquad]
8723    simp
8724  have : |∫ ω, R ω ∂P| ≤ K * ∫ ω, ‖Y ω‖ ^ 3 ∂P := by
8725    calc |∫ ω, R ω ∂P| ≤ ∫ ω, |R ω| ∂P := abs_integral_le_integral_abs
8726      _ ≤ ∫ ω, K * ‖Y ω‖ ^ 3 ∂P := integral_mono hRI.abs (hY3.const_mul K) hRb
8727      _ = _ := integral_const_mul _ _
8728  rw [hRint] at this
8729  exact this
8730
8731/-- One Lindeberg swap. -/
8732lemma swap_diff_sharp {X Y Z : Ω → (ℝ^p)} {K : ℝ} {f : (ℝ^p) → ℝ} (hf : SharpFn K f)
8733    (hX : Measurable X) (hY : Measurable Y) (hZ : Measurable Z)
8734    (hindY : IndepFun X Y P) (hindZ : IndepFun X Z P)
8735    (hY0 : ∀ c, ∫ ω, Y ω c ∂P = 0) (hZ0 : ∀ c, ∫ ω, Z ω c ∂P = 0)
8736    (hYZ : ∀ c d, ∫ ω, Y ω c * Y ω d ∂P = ∫ ω, Z ω c * Z ω d ∂P)
8737    (hY3 : Integrable (fun ω => ‖Y ω‖ ^ 3) P) (hZ3 : Integrable (fun ω => ‖Z ω‖ ^ 3) P) :
8738    |∫ ω, f (X ω + Y ω) ∂P - ∫ ω, f (X ω + Z ω) ∂P| ≤
8739      K * (∫ ω, ‖Y ω‖ ^ 3 ∂P + ∫ ω, ‖Z ω‖ ^ 3 ∂P) := by
8740  have h1 := swap_step_sharp hf hX hY hindY hY0 hY3
8741  have h2 := swap_step_sharp hf hX hZ hindZ hZ0 hZ3
8742  simp_rw [hYZ] at h1
8743  set a := ∫ ω, f (X ω + Y ω) ∂P
8744  set b := ∫ ω, f (X ω + Z ω) ∂P
8745  set q := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ c, ∑ d, (∫ ω, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) (X ω) (EuclideanSpace.single c 1)
8746        (EuclideanSpace.single d 1) ∂P) * ∫ ω, Z ω c * Z ω d ∂P
8747  have : |a - b| ≤ |a - ∫ ω, f (X ω) ∂P - q| + |b - ∫ ω, f (X ω) ∂P - q| := by
8748    have := abs_sub (a - ∫ ω, f (X ω) ∂P - q) (b - ∫ ω, f (X ω) ∂P - q)
8749    calc |a - b| = |(a - ∫ ω, f (X ω) ∂P - q) - (b - ∫ ω, f (X ω) ∂P - q)| := by ring_nf
8750      _ ≤ _ := this
8751  calc |a - b| ≤ _ := this
8752    _ ≤ K * ∫ ω, ‖Y ω‖ ^ 3 ∂P + K * ∫ ω, ‖Z ω‖ ^ 3 ∂P := add_le_add h1 h2
8753    _ = _ := by ring
8754
8755
8756/-- Lindeberg telescoping over the hybrid sums. -/
8757theorem lindeberg_telescope_sharp {N : ℕ} {K : ℝ} {f : (ℝ^p) → ℝ} (hf : SharpFn K f)
8758    (V : Fin N ⊕ Fin N → Ω → (ℝ^p)) (hVm : ∀ t, Measurable (V t)) (hV : iIndepFun V P)
8759    (h0 : ∀ t c, ∫ ω, V t ω c ∂P = 0)
8760    (h2 : ∀ i c d, ∫ ω, V (Sum.inl i) ω c * V (Sum.inl i) ω d ∂P =
8761      ∫ ω, V (Sum.inr i) ω c * V (Sum.inr i) ω d ∂P)
8762    (h3 : ∀ t, Integrable (fun ω => ‖V t ω‖ ^ 3) P) :
8763    |∫ ω, f (∑ i, V (Sum.inl i) ω) ∂P - ∫ ω, f (∑ i, V (Sum.inr i) ω) ∂P| ≤
8764      K * ∑ i, (∫ ω, ‖V (Sum.inl i) ω‖ ^ 3 ∂P + ∫ ω, ‖V (Sum.inr i) ω‖ ^ 3 ∂P) := by
8765  classical
8766  -- hybrid sums
8767  let W : ℕ → Ω → (ℝ^p) := fun k ω => ∑ i : Fin N,
8768    (if i.val < k then V (Sum.inl i) ω else V (Sum.inr i) ω)
8769  let a : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => ∫ ω, f (W k ω) ∂P
8770  have hW0 : ∀ ω, W 0 ω = ∑ i, V (Sum.inr i) ω := fun ω => by simp [W]
8771  have hWN : ∀ ω, W N ω = ∑ i, V (Sum.inl i) ω := fun ω => by
8772    simp only [W]
8773    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by simp [i.2]
8774  -- one step
8775  have hstep : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ hk : k < N, |a (k + 1) - a k| ≤
8776      K * (∫ ω, ‖V (Sum.inl ⟨k, hk⟩) ω‖ ^ 3 ∂P + ∫ ω, ‖V (Sum.inr ⟨k, hk⟩) ω‖ ^ 3 ∂P) := by
8777    intro k hk
8778    set j : Fin N := ⟨k, hk⟩ with hj
8779    let s : Fin N → Fin N ⊕ Fin N := fun i => if i.val < k then Sum.inl i else Sum.inr i
8780    have hs_inj : Function.Injective s := by
8781      intro i i' h
8782      simp only [s] at h
8783      split_ifs at h with h1 h2 h2 <;> simp_all
8784    set X : Ω → (ℝ^p) := fun ω => ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, V (s i) ω with hX
8785    have hXm : Measurable X := by
8786      simp only [hX]
8787      exact Finset.measurable_sum _ fun i _ => hVm _
8788    have hXeq : X = ∑ t ∈ (Finset.univ.erase j).image s, V t := by
8789      rw [Finset.sum_image (fun i _ i' _ h => hs_inj h)]
8790      ext ω; simp [hX]
8791    have hnotl : Sum.inl j ∉ (Finset.univ.erase j).image s := by
8792      simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_univ, and_true, not_exists, not_and]
8793      intro i hij h
8794      apply hij
8795      simp only [s] at h
8796      split_ifs at h with h1 <;> simp_all
8797    have hnotr : Sum.inr j ∉ (Finset.univ.erase j).image s := by
8798      simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_univ, and_true, not_exists, not_and]
8799      intro i hij h
8800      apply hij
8801      simp only [s] at h
8802      split_ifs at h with h1 <;> simp_all
8803    have hindl : IndepFun X (V (Sum.inl j)) P := by
8804      rw [hXeq]; exact hV.indepFun_finsetSum_of_notMem hVm hnotl
8805    have hindr : IndepFun X (V (Sum.inr j)) P := by
8806      rw [hXeq]; exact hV.indepFun_finsetSum_of_notMem hVm hnotr
8807    have hWk1 : ∀ ω, W (k + 1) ω = X ω + V (Sum.inl j) ω := by
8808      intro ω
8809      simp only [W, hX]
8810      rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ j), add_comm]
8811      refine congrArg₂ (· + ·) ?_ ?_
8812      · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
8813        have hij : i ≠ j := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hi
8814        have : i.val ≠ k := fun h => hij (Fin.ext h)
8815        simp only [s]
8816        by_cases hlt : i.val < k
8817        · simp [hlt, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hlt]
8818        · have : ¬ i.val < k + 1 := by omega
8819          simp [hlt, this]
8820      · simp [hj]
8821    have hWk : ∀ ω, W k ω = X ω + V (Sum.inr j) ω := by
8822      intro ω
8823      simp only [W, hX]
8824      rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ j), add_comm]
8825      refine congrArg₂ (· + ·) ?_ ?_
8826      · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
8827        simp only [s]
8828        split_ifs <;> rfl
8829      · simp [hj]
8830    have := swap_diff_sharp hf hXm (hVm _) (hVm _) hindl hindr (h0 _) (h0 _) (h2 j) (h3 _) (h3 _)
8831    simp only [a, hWk1, hWk]
8832    exact this
8833  have hsum : a N - a 0 = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, (a (k + 1) - a k) := (Finset.sum_range_sub a N).symm
8834  have haN : a N = ∫ ω, f (∑ i, V (Sum.inl i) ω) ∂P := by simp only [a, hWN]
8835  have ha0 : a 0 = ∫ ω, f (∑ i, V (Sum.inr i) ω) ∂P := by simp only [a, hW0]
8836  rw [← haN, ← ha0, hsum]
8837  refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans ?_
8838  let B : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => if hk : k < N then
8839    K * (∫ ω, ‖V (Sum.inl ⟨k, hk⟩) ω‖ ^ 3 ∂P + ∫ ω, ‖V (Sum.inr ⟨k, hk⟩) ω‖ ^ 3 ∂P) else 0
8840  calc ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, |a (k + 1) - a k| ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, B k :=
8841        Finset.sum_le_sum fun k hk => by
8842          have hk' : k < N := Finset.mem_range.1 hk
8843          simp only [B, dif_pos hk']
8844          exact hstep k hk'
8845    _ = ∑ i : Fin N, B i := (Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range B N).symm
8846    _ = _ := by
8847        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
8848        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
8849        simp only [B, dif_pos i.2]
8850
8851lemma integral_comp_eval_a29 {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (μ : ι → Measure (ℝ^p)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
8852    (t : ι) (g : (ℝ^p) → ℝ) (hg : Measurable g) :
8853    ∫ ω, g (ω t) ∂(Measure.pi μ) = ∫ x, g x ∂(μ t) := by
8854  have hmp := measurePreserving_eval μ t
8855  rw [← hmp.map_eq, integral_map hmp.measurable.aemeasurable hg.aestronglyMeasurable]
8856
8857lemma integrable_comp_eval_a29 {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (μ : ι → Measure (ℝ^p)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]
8858    (t : ι) (g : (ℝ^p) → ℝ) (hg : Measurable g) (h : Integrable g (μ t)) :
8859    Integrable (fun ω => g (ω t)) (Measure.pi μ) := by
8860  have hmp := measurePreserving_eval μ t
8861  rw [← hmp.map_eq] at h
8862  exact (integrable_map_measure hg.aestronglyMeasurable hmp.measurable.aemeasurable).1 h
8863
8864/-- Lindeberg replacement on product measures. -/
8865theorem lindeberg_pi_sharp {N : ℕ} {K : ℝ} {f : (ℝ^p) → ℝ} (hf : SharpFn K f)
8866    (ρ γ : Fin N → Measure (ℝ^p)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ρ i)] [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (γ i)]
8867    (h0ρ : ∀ i c, ∫ x, x c ∂(ρ i) = 0) (h0γ : ∀ i c, ∫ x, x c ∂(γ i) = 0)
8868    (h2 : ∀ i c d, ∫ x, x c * x d ∂(ρ i) = ∫ x, x c * x d ∂(γ i))
8869    (h3ρ : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x => ‖x‖ ^ 3) (ρ i))
8870    (h3γ : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x => ‖x‖ ^ 3) (γ i)) :
8871    |∫ x, f x ∂((Measure.pi ρ).map (fun p => ∑ i, p i)) -
8872        ∫ x, f x ∂((Measure.pi γ).map (fun p => ∑ i, p i))| ≤
8873      K * ∑ i, (∫ x, ‖x‖ ^ 3 ∂(ρ i) + ∫ x, ‖x‖ ^ 3 ∂(γ i)) := by
8874  classical
8875  set μ : Fin N ⊕ Fin N → Measure (ℝ^p) := Sum.elim ρ γ with hμ
8876  haveI : ∀ t, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ t) := fun t => by
8877    rcases t with i | i <;> simp [hμ] <;> infer_instance
8878  set Q : Measure (Fin N ⊕ Fin N → (ℝ^p)) := Measure.pi μ with hQ
8879  let V : Fin N ⊕ Fin N → (Fin N ⊕ Fin N → (ℝ^p)) → (ℝ^p) := fun t ω => ω t
8880  have hVm : ∀ t, Measurable (V t) := fun t => measurable_pi_apply t
8881  have hV : iIndepFun V Q := iIndepFun_pi (X := fun _ => id) (fun _ => aemeasurable_id)
8882  have hcoord : ∀ c : Fin p, Measurable fun x : (ℝ^p) => x c := fun c => by fun_prop
8883  -- moments
8884  have e0 : ∀ t c, ∫ ω, V t ω c ∂Q = ∫ x, x c ∂(μ t) := fun t c =>
8885    integral_comp_eval_a29 μ t (fun x => x c) (hcoord c)
8886  have e2 : ∀ t c d, ∫ ω, V t ω c * V t ω d ∂Q = ∫ x, x c * x d ∂(μ t) := fun t c d =>
8887    integral_comp_eval_a29 μ t (fun x => x c * x d) ((hcoord c).mul (hcoord d))
8888  have e3 : ∀ t, ∫ ω, ‖V t ω‖ ^ 3 ∂Q = ∫ x, ‖x‖ ^ 3 ∂(μ t) := fun t =>
8889    integral_comp_eval_a29 μ t (fun x => ‖x‖ ^ 3) (measurable_norm.pow_const 3)
8890  have i3 : ∀ t, Integrable (fun ω => ‖V t ω‖ ^ 3) Q := by
8891    intro t
8892    refine integrable_comp_eval_a29 μ t (fun x => ‖x‖ ^ 3) (measurable_norm.pow_const 3) ?_
8893    rcases t with i | i
8894    · exact h3ρ i
8895    · exact h3γ i
8896  have key := lindeberg_telescope_sharp hf V hVm hV
8897    (fun t c => by rw [e0]; rcases t with i | i; exacts [h0ρ i c, h0γ i c])
8898    (fun i c d => by rw [e2, e2]; exact h2 i c d) i3
8899  -- identify the laws
8900  have hlaw : ∀ (g : Fin N → Measure (ℝ^p)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (g i)] (inj : Fin N → Fin N ⊕ Fin N),
8901      Function.Injective inj → (∀ i, μ (inj i) = g i) →
8902      Q.map (fun ω i => ω (inj i)) = Measure.pi g := by
8903    intro g _ inj hinj hg
8904    have h1 := hV.precomp hinj
8905    rw [iIndepFun_iff_map_fun_eq_pi_map (fun i => (hVm _).aemeasurable)] at h1
8906    have hmap_i : ∀ i, Q.map (V (inj i)) = g i := by
8907      intro i
8908      have := (measurePreserving_eval μ (inj i)).map_eq
8909      rw [← hg i, ← this]
8910    simp_rw [hmap_i] at h1
8911    exact h1
8912  have hsum : ∀ (g : Fin N → Measure (ℝ^p)) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (g i)] (inj : Fin N → Fin N ⊕ Fin N),
8913      Function.Injective inj → (∀ i, μ (inj i) = g i) →
8914      ∫ ω, f (∑ i, V (inj i) ω) ∂Q = ∫ x, f x ∂((Measure.pi g).map (fun p => ∑ i, p i)) := by
8915    intro g _ inj hinj hg
8916    have hsm : Measurable (fun p : Fin N → (ℝ^p) => ∑ i, p i) :=
8917      Finset.measurable_sum _ fun i _ => measurable_pi_apply i
8918    have hmq : Measurable (fun (ω : Fin N ⊕ Fin N → (ℝ^p)) (i : Fin N) => ω (inj i)) :=
8919      Measurable.of_eval fun i => measurable_pi_apply _
8920    rw [integral_map hsm.aemeasurable hf.measurable.aestronglyMeasurable, ← hlaw g inj hinj hg]
8921    exact (integral_map hmq.aemeasurable ((hf.measurable.comp hsm).aestronglyMeasurable :
8922        AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x : Fin N → (ℝ^p) => f (∑ i, x i)) _)).symm
8923  rw [← hsum ρ Sum.inl Sum.inl_injective (fun i => rfl),
8924    ← hsum γ Sum.inr Sum.inr_injective (fun i => rfl)]
8925  refine key.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
8926  congr 1
8927  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
8928  rw [e3, e3]; rfl
8929
8930end SharpLind

8933lemma D3TestClass.hess_lip {h : (ℝ^p) → ℝ} (hh : h ∈ D3TestClass p) (x y : ℝ^p) :
8934    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 h x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 h y‖ ≤ 1 * ‖x - y‖ := by
8935  have hd : Differentiable ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 h) :=
8936    hh.1.1.differentiable_iteratedFDeriv (by norm_cast)
8937  have h1 : ∀ z, ‖fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 h) z‖ ≤ 1 := fun z => by
8938    rw [norm_fderiv_iteratedFDeriv]; exact hh.2 3 (by norm_num) le_rfl z
8939  have := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 h)
8940    (s := Set.univ) (fun z _ => hd z) (fun z _ => h1 z) convex_univ (Set.mem_univ y)
8941    (Set.mem_univ x)
8942  simpa using this

8945lemma D3TestClass.sharpFn {h : (ℝ^p) → ℝ} (hh : h ∈ D3TestClass p)
8946    {Q : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ} (hQ : Q.PosSemidef) : SharpFn (1 / 6) (gaussSmooth h Q) := by
8947  have hh2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 h := hh.1.1.of_le (by norm_num)
8948  have hH : ∀ x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 h x‖ ≤ 1 := fun x => hh.2 2 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) x
8949  obtain ⟨hu2, huH, huL⟩ := gaussSmooth_hessian Q hQ h hh2 1 hH
8950  obtain ⟨hd1, -, -⟩ := LindebergAux.gaussSmooth_derivs Q h hh2 1 hH
8951  have hLu := huL 1 (D3TestClass.hess_lip hh)
8952  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := memCb_bound (D3TestClass.memCb2 hh)
8953  refine ⟨hu2, by norm_num, ⟨C, fun x => ?_⟩, ⟨1, fun x => ?_⟩, ⟨1, fun x => ?_⟩, fun x v => ?_⟩
8954  · have := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (μ := multivariateGaussian (0 : ℝ^p) Q) (C := C)
8955      (f := fun z => h (x + z)) (ae_of_all _ fun z => by simpa using hC (x + z))
8956    simpa [gaussSmooth] using this
8957  · rw [(hd1 x).fderiv]
8958    have := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (μ := multivariateGaussian (0 : ℝ^p) Q) (C := 1)
8959      (f := fun z => fderiv ℝ h (x + z)) (ae_of_all _ fun z => by
8960        rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_one]; exact hh.2 1 le_rfl (by norm_num) _)
8961    simpa using this
8962  · rw [← LindebergAux.norm_iter2]; exact huH x
8963  · have := taylor_sharp hu2 hLu x v
8964    simp only [iteratedFDeriv_two_apply] at this
8965    refine this.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
8966    ring

8968lemma gauss_m3_le_sqrt3 (ρ : Measure (ℝ^p)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ρ]
8969    (h3 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ^p => ‖x‖ ^ 3) ρ) :
8970    ∫ y, ‖y‖ ^ 3 ∂(multivariateGaussian (0 : ℝ^p) (Yurinskii.momentMatrix ρ)) ≤
8971      Real.sqrt 3 * ∫ x, ‖x‖ ^ 3 ∂ρ := by
8972  have h2 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ^p => ‖x‖ ^ 2) ρ :=
8973    (Yurinskii.integrable_norm_of_pow3 (P := ρ) (Y := id) measurable_id h3).2
8974  have hQ := Yurinskii.momentMatrix_posSemidef ρ h2
8975  set γ := multivariateGaussian (0 : ℝ^p) (Yurinskii.momentMatrix ρ) with hγ
8976  set m2 := ∫ x, ‖x‖ ^ 2 ∂ρ with hm2
8977  set m3 := ∫ x, ‖x‖ ^ 3 ∂ρ with hm3
8978  have hm20 : 0 ≤ m2 := integral_nonneg fun x => by positivity
8979  have hm30 : 0 ≤ m3 := integral_nonneg fun x => by positivity
8980  have hm2γ : ∫ y, ‖y‖ ^ 2 ∂γ = m2 := by
8981    rw [hγ, Yurinskii.integral_norm_sq_gauss hQ, Yurinskii.trace_momentMatrix ρ h2]
8982  have hb : ∫ y, ‖y‖ ^ 4 ∂γ ≤ 3 * m2 ^ 2 := by
8983    have := Yurinskii.integral_norm_pow4_le hQ
8984    rw [Yurinskii.trace_momentMatrix ρ h2] at this
8985    have e : Yurinskii.c4 = 3 := gauss_m4
8986    rwa [e] at this
8987  have i1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ^p => ‖y‖ ^ 1) γ := Yurinskii.integrable_norm_pow_gauss 1 (by norm_num)
8988  have i2 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ^p => ‖y‖ ^ 2) γ := Yurinskii.integrable_norm_pow_gauss 2 (by norm_num)
8989  have i3 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ^p => ‖y‖ ^ 3) γ := Yurinskii.integrable_norm_pow_gauss 3 (by norm_num)
8990  have i4 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ^p => ‖y‖ ^ 4) γ := Yurinskii.integrable_norm_pow_gauss 4 (by norm_num)
8991  set a := ∫ y, ‖y‖ ^ 3 ∂γ with ha
8992  set b := ∫ y, ‖y‖ ^ 4 ∂γ with hbdef
8993  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := integral_nonneg fun y => by positivity
8994  -- Cauchy-Schwarz
8995  have hcs : a ^ 2 ≤ m2 * b := by
8996    refine Yurinskii.sq_le_mul_of_quad (fun t => ?_)
8997    have h0 : 0 ≤ ∫ y, (t * ‖y‖ ^ 1 - ‖y‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 ∂γ := integral_nonneg fun y => sq_nonneg _
8998    have e : ∀ y : ℝ^p, (t * ‖y‖ ^ 1 - ‖y‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 =
8999        (t * t) * ‖y‖ ^ 2 + (-2 * t) * ‖y‖ ^ 3 + ‖y‖ ^ 4 := fun y => by ring
9000    simp_rw [e] at h0
9001    have j1 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ^p => (t * t) * ‖y‖ ^ 2) γ := i2.const_mul _
9002    have j2 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ^p => (-2 * t) * ‖y‖ ^ 3) γ := i3.const_mul _
9003    have j12 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ^p => (t * t) * ‖y‖ ^ 2 + (-2 * t) * ‖y‖ ^ 3) γ := j1.add j2
9004    rw [integral_add j12 i4, integral_add j1 j2, integral_const_mul,
9005      integral_const_mul, hm2γ] at h0
9006    linarith
9007  have hlya := Yurinskii.lyapunov ρ h2 h3
9008  have hm2c : m2 ^ 3 ≤ m3 ^ 2 := by
9009    have h1 : (Real.sqrt m2) ^ 6 ≤ m3 ^ 2 := by
9010      have := pow_le_pow_left₀ (pow_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) 3) hlya 2
9011      simpa [← pow_mul] using this
9012    have h2' : (Real.sqrt m2) ^ 6 = m2 ^ 3 := by
9013      rw [show (6 : ℕ) = 2 * 3 by norm_num, pow_mul, Real.sq_sqrt hm20]
9014    linarith
9015  have hsq : a ^ 2 ≤ (Real.sqrt 3 * m3) ^ 2 := by
9016    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)]
9017    calc a ^ 2 ≤ m2 * b := hcs
9018      _ ≤ m2 * (3 * m2 ^ 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hm20
9019      _ = 3 * m2 ^ 3 := by ring
9020      _ ≤ 3 * m3 ^ 2 := by linarith
9021  by_contra hlt
9022  push Not at hlt
9023  have := pow_lt_pow_left₀ hlt (by positivity) (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)
9024  linarith
9025
9026lemma shift_bound_f_simple (ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
9027    (M : ℝ → Ω → (ℝ^p)) (Sg : ℝ → Ω → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ)
9028    (hM : IsVectorMartingaleWithCovariation P ℱ T M Sg)
9029    (sb : ℝ → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) (hsb : IsDetCovMatrix T sb)
9030    (ξ : Ω → (ℝ^p)) (S : Finset (ℝ^p)) (hS : ∀ ω, ξ ω ∈ S)
9031    (hξ : ∀ x, MeasurableSet[ℱ 0] (ξ ⁻¹' {x}))
9032    (h : (ℝ^p) → ℝ) (hh : MemCb 2 h) (f : (ℝ^p) → ℝ) (hfc : Continuous f)
9033    (hf : ∀ x, f x = ∫ z, h (x + z) ∂(multivariateGaussian 0 (integratedCov T sb)))
9034    {A : Set Ω} (hA : MeasurableSet[ℱ 0] A) :
9035    |(∫ ω in A, h (ξ ω + M T ω) ∂P) - ∫ ω in A, f (ξ ω) ∂P| ≤
9036      (1 / 2) * hessSup h * ∫ ω in A, (∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 T, s1Norm (Sg σ ω - sb σ)) ∂P := by
9037  classical
9038  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := memCb_bound hh
9039  have hfb : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ C := fun x => by
9040    rw [hf x]
9041    have := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
9042      (μ := multivariateGaussian (0 : ℝ^p) (integratedCov T sb)) (C := C)
9043      (f := fun z => h (x + z)) (ae_of_all _ fun z => by simpa using hC (x + z))
9044    simpa using this
9045  have hm0 : ∀ B, MeasurableSet[ℱ 0] B → MeasurableSet B := fun B hB => ℱ.le 0 _ hB
9046  have hξm : ∀ x, MeasurableSet (ξ ⁻¹' {x}) := fun x => hm0 _ (hξ x)
9047  have hξmeas : Measurable ξ := by
9048    intro s _
9049    have : ξ ⁻¹' s = ⋃ x ∈ (S.filter (· ∈ s)), ξ ⁻¹' {x} := by
9050      ext ω; simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_singleton_iff, exists_prop,
9051        Finset.mem_filter]
9052      exact ⟨fun h => ⟨ξ ω, ⟨hS ω, h⟩, rfl⟩, fun ⟨x, ⟨_, hx⟩, e⟩ => e ▸ hx⟩
9053    rw [this]
9054    exact Finset.measurableSet_biUnion _ fun x _ => hξm x
9055  have hMt : AEMeasurable (M T) P :=
9056    (hM.sq_int T ⟨hT, le_rfl⟩).aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable
9057  have hint1 : Integrable (fun ω => h (ξ ω + M T ω)) P :=
9058    integrable_memCb_comp P hh (hξmeas.aemeasurable.add hMt)
9059  have hint2 : Integrable (fun ω => f (ξ ω)) P :=
9060    Integrable.of_bound (C := C) (hfc.measurable.comp hξmeas).aestronglyMeasurable
9061      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => by simpa using hfb (ξ ω))
9062  have hintg : Integrable (fun ω => ∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 T, s1Norm (Sg σ ω - sb σ)) P :=
9063    LindebergAux.Iblk_integrable P ℱ hM hsb.meas hsb.int le_rfl le_rfl
9064  rw [setIntegral_fiber_sum P (hm0 A hA) S ξ hS hξm hint1,
9065    setIntegral_fiber_sum P (hm0 A hA) S ξ hS hξm hint2,
9066    setIntegral_fiber_sum P (hm0 A hA) S ξ hS hξm hintg, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
9067    Finset.mul_sum]
9068  refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun x _ => ?_)
9069  have hB : MeasurableSet[ℱ 0] (A ∩ ξ ⁻¹' {x}) := hA.inter (hξ x)
9070  have hBm := hm0 _ hB
9071  have e1 : ∫ ω in A ∩ ξ ⁻¹' {x}, h (ξ ω + M T ω) ∂P = ∫ ω in A ∩ ξ ⁻¹' {x}, h (x + M T ω) ∂P :=
9072    setIntegral_congr_fun hBm fun ω hω => by rw [show ξ ω = x from hω.2]
9073  have e2 : ∫ ω in A ∩ ξ ⁻¹' {x}, f (ξ ω) ∂P = P.real (A ∩ ξ ⁻¹' {x}) * f x := by
9074    rw [setIntegral_congr_fun hBm (g := fun _ => f x) fun ω hω => by rw [show ξ ω = x from hω.2],
9075      setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul]
9076  rw [e1, e2, hf x]
9077  exact const_shift_bound P ℱ T hT M Sg hM sb hsb h hh x hB
9078
9079lemma shift_bound_f (ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
9080    (M : ℝ → Ω → (ℝ^p)) (Sg : ℝ → Ω → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ)
9081    (hM : IsVectorMartingaleWithCovariation P ℱ T M Sg)
9082    (sb : ℝ → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) (hsb : IsDetCovMatrix T sb)
9083    (X : Ω → (ℝ^p)) (hX : Measurable[ℱ 0] X)
9084    (h : (ℝ^p) → ℝ) (hh : MemCb 2 h) (f : (ℝ^p) → ℝ) (hfc : Continuous f)
9085    (hf : ∀ x, f x = ∫ z, h (x + z) ∂(multivariateGaussian 0 (integratedCov T sb)))
9086    {A : Set Ω} (hA : MeasurableSet[ℱ 0] A) :
9087    |(∫ ω in A, h (X ω + M T ω) ∂P) - ∫ ω in A, f (X ω) ∂P| ≤
9088      (1 / 2) * hessSup h * ∫ ω in A, (∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 T, s1Norm (Sg σ ω - sb σ)) ∂P := by
9089  classical
9090  obtain ⟨ξ, S, hS, hξ, hξm0, hξt⟩ := exists_finrange_approx_a27 (m := ℱ 0) hX
9091  have hAm : MeasurableSet A := ℱ.le 0 _ hA
9092  have hξm : ∀ n, Measurable (ξ n) := fun n => (hξm0 n).mono (ℱ.le 0) le_rfl
9093  have hMt : AEMeasurable (M T) P :=
9094    (hM.sq_int T ⟨hT, le_rfl⟩).aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable
9095  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := memCb_bound hh
9096  have hfb : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ C := fun x => by
9097    rw [hf x]
9098    have := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
9099      (μ := multivariateGaussian (0 : ℝ^p) (integratedCov T sb)) (C := C)
9100      (f := fun z => h (x + z)) (ae_of_all _ fun z => by simpa using hC (x + z))
9101    simpa using this
9102  have hbd1 : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ ω in A, h (ξ n ω + M T ω) ∂P) atTop
9103      (𝓝 (∫ ω in A, h (X ω + M T ω) ∂P)) := by
9104    refine tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (fun _ => C) (fun n => ?_)
9105      (integrable_const C) (fun n => ae_of_all _ fun ω => ?_) (ae_of_all _ fun ω => ?_)
9106    · exact (integrable_memCb_comp (P.restrict A) hh
9107        ((hξm n).aemeasurable.add hMt.restrict)).aestronglyMeasurable
9108    · simpa using hC _
9109    · exact (hh.1.continuous.tendsto _).comp ((hξt ω).add_const (M T ω))
9110  have hbd2 : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ ω in A, f (ξ n ω) ∂P) atTop (𝓝 (∫ ω in A, f (X ω) ∂P)) := by
9111    refine tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (fun _ => C) (fun n => ?_)
9112      (integrable_const C) (fun n => ae_of_all _ fun ω => ?_) (ae_of_all _ fun ω => ?_)
9113    · exact (hfc.measurable.comp (hξm n)).aestronglyMeasurable
9114    · simpa using hfb _
9115    · exact (hfc.tendsto _).comp (hξt ω)
9116  have hlim := (hbd1.sub hbd2).abs
9117  refine le_of_tendsto hlim (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => ?_)
9118  exact shift_bound_f_simple P ℱ T hT M Sg hM sb hsb (ξ n) (S n) (hS n) (hξ n) h hh f hfc hf hA

9120lemma integratedCov_psd {T : ℝ} {sb : ℝ → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ} (hsb : IsDetCovMatrix T sb) :
9121    (integratedCov T sb).PosSemidef :=
9122  LindebergAux.covBlock_psd hsb.psd (LindebergAux.sb_entry_integrableOn hsb.meas hsb.int hsb.psd)
9123    le_rfl le_rfl
9124
9125/-- The Lindeberg part of Lemma A.29: for independent centred `ζ_i` with finite third moments
9126and `f = gaussSmooth h Γ`, `|E f(∑ ζ_i) - ∫ h dN(0, ∑ E ζ_iζ_iᵀ + Γ)| ≤ (1+√3)/6 ∑ E|ζ_i|³`. -/
9127lemma initial_lindeberg {N : ℕ} (ζ : Fin N → Ω → (ℝ^p)) (hζm : ∀ i, Measurable (ζ i))
9128    (hζind : iIndepFun ζ P) (hζcent : ∀ i, ∫ ω, ζ i ω ∂P = 0)
9129    (hζ3 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun ω => ‖ζ i ω‖ ^ 3) P)
9130    {Γ : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ} (hΓ : Γ.PosSemidef) {h : (ℝ^p) → ℝ} (hh : h ∈ D3TestClass p) :
9131    |(∫ ω, gaussSmooth h Γ (∑ i, ζ i ω) ∂P) -
9132        ∫ y, h y ∂(multivariateGaussian (0 : ℝ^p)
9133          ((Matrix.of fun a b => ∑ i, ∫ ω, ζ i ω a * ζ i ω b ∂P) + Γ))| ≤
9134      (1 + Real.sqrt 3) / 6 * ∑ i, ∫ ω, ‖ζ i ω‖ ^ 3 ∂P := by
9135  classical
9136  set ρ : Fin N → Measure (ℝ^p) := fun i => P.map (ζ i) with hρ
9137  have : ∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (ρ i) := fun i =>
9138    (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff (hζm i).aemeasurable).2 inferInstance
9139  have hρ3 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x : ℝ^p => ‖x‖ ^ 3) (ρ i) := fun i =>
9140    (integrable_map_measure (measurable_norm.pow_const 3).aestronglyMeasurable
9141      (hζm i).aemeasurable).2 (hζ3 i)
9142  have hρ2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x : ℝ^p => ‖x‖ ^ 2) (ρ i) := fun i =>
9143    (Yurinskii.integrable_norm_of_pow3 (P := ρ i) (Y := id) measurable_id (hρ3 i)).2
9144  have hρ1 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x : ℝ^p => ‖x‖) (ρ i) := fun i =>
9145    (Yurinskii.integrable_norm_of_pow3 (P := ρ i) (Y := id) measurable_id (hρ3 i)).1
9146  have hQ : ∀ i, (Yurinskii.momentMatrix (ρ i)).PosSemidef := fun i =>
9147    Yurinskii.momentMatrix_posSemidef _ (hρ2 i)
9148  set γ : Fin N → Measure (ℝ^p) := fun i =>
9149    multivariateGaussian (0 : ℝ^p) (Yurinskii.momentMatrix (ρ i)) with hγ
9150  -- the moments of ρ
9151  have hζi : ∀ i, Integrable (ζ i) P := fun i => by
9152    refine Integrable.mono' (hζ3 i |>.add (integrable_const 1)) (hζm i).aestronglyMeasurable
9153      (ae_of_all _ fun ω => ?_)
9154    simp only [Pi.add_apply]
9155    rcases le_total ‖ζ i ω‖ 1 with h1 | h1
9156    · nlinarith [pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg (ζ i ω)) 3]
9157    · nlinarith [norm_nonneg (ζ i ω), mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg (ζ i ω)) (sq_nonneg (‖ζ i ω‖ - 1))]
9158  have h0ρ : ∀ i c, ∫ x, x c ∂(ρ i) = 0 := by
9159    intro i c
9160    have e1 : ∫ x, x c ∂(ρ i) = ∫ ω, ζ i ω c ∂P :=
9161      integral_map (hζm i).aemeasurable (by fun_prop)
9162    have := ContinuousLinearMap.integral_comp_comm (EuclideanSpace.proj c : (ℝ^p) →L[ℝ] ℝ)
9163      (hζi i)
9164    rw [e1]
9165    simpa [hζcent i] using this
9166  have h2ρ : ∀ i c d, ∫ x, x c * x d ∂(ρ i) = ∫ x, x c * x d ∂(γ i) := by
9167    intro i c d
9168    simp only [hγ]
9169    rw [Yurinskii.integral_coord_mul (hQ i)]
9170    rfl
9171  have key := lindeberg_pi_sharp (D3TestClass.sharpFn hh hΓ) ρ γ h0ρ
9172    (fun i c => Yurinskii.integral_coord_zero c) h2ρ hρ3
9173    (fun i => Yurinskii.integrable_norm_pow_gauss 3 (by norm_num))
9174  have hsm : Measurable (fun x : Fin N → ℝ^p => ∑ i, x i) :=
9175    Finset.measurable_sum _ fun i _ => measurable_pi_apply i
9176  have hvec : Measurable (fun ω i => ζ i ω) := Measurable.of_eval hζm
9177  have hind := (iIndepFun_iff_map_fun_eq_pi_map (fun i => (hζm i).aemeasurable)).1 hζind
9178  have hf := D3TestClass.sharpFn hh hΓ
9179  have hSmap : P.map (fun ω => ∑ i, ζ i ω) = (Measure.pi ρ).map (fun x => ∑ i, x i) := by
9180    rw [← show (Measure.pi fun i => P.map (ζ i)) = Measure.pi ρ from rfl, ← hind,
9181      Measure.map_map hsm hvec]
9182    rfl

9184  have e1 : ∫ ω, gaussSmooth h Γ (∑ i, ζ i ω) ∂P =
9185      ∫ x, gaussSmooth h Γ x ∂((Measure.pi ρ).map (fun x => ∑ i, x i)) := by
9186    rw [← hSmap, integral_map hSm.aemeasurable hf.contDiff.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable]
9187  have e2 : (Measure.pi γ).map (fun x => ∑ i, x i) =
9188      multivariateGaussian (0 : ℝ^p) (∑ i, Yurinskii.momentMatrix (ρ i)) :=
9189    Yurinskii.pi_map_sum_gauss _ hQ
9190  rw [e2] at key
9191  have hA : (Matrix.of fun a b => ∑ i, ∫ ω, ζ i ω a * ζ i ω b ∂P) =
9192      ∑ i, Yurinskii.momentMatrix (ρ i) := by
9193    ext a b
9194    simp only [Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, Yurinskii.momentMatrix, hρ]
9195    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
9196    exact (integral_map (hζm i).aemeasurable
9197      ((by fun_prop : Measurable fun x : ℝ^p => x a * x b).aestronglyMeasurable)).symm
9198  have hAsum : (∑ i, Yurinskii.momentMatrix (ρ i)).PosSemidef :=
9199    Matrix.posSemidef_sum _ fun i _ => hQ i

9201      (∑ i, Yurinskii.momentMatrix (ρ i))) =
9202      ∫ y, h y ∂(multivariateGaussian (0 : ℝ^p) ((∑ i, Yurinskii.momentMatrix (ρ i)) + Γ)) := by
9203    have := gaussSmooth_add (∑ i, Yurinskii.momentMatrix (ρ i)) Γ hAsum hΓ h
9204      (hh.1.1.of_le (by norm_num)) 1 (fun x => hh.2 2 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) x) 0
9205    simp only [gaussSmooth, zero_add] at this
9206    exact this.symm

9208    integral_map (hζm i).aemeasurable (measurable_norm.pow_const 3).aestronglyMeasurable
9209  rw [e1, hA, ← e3]
9210  refine key.trans ?_

9212    gauss_m3_le_sqrt3 (ρ i) (hρ3 i)

9216    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_

9218    rw [e4] at this ⊢

9220  calc 1 / 6 * ∑ i, (∫ x, ‖x‖ ^ 3 ∂(ρ i) + ∫ x, ‖x‖ ^ 3 ∂(γ i))

9227/-- Lemma A.29 `M:B:newprob:initial-martingale` (source lines 10908-10931), bound
9228`B:newprob:main-bound`: in the setting of Lemma A.27 (`M`, `Σ`, `Σ̄`, `ℱ`), let `ζ_1,…,ζ_N` be
9229independent, centered, `ℱ_0`-measurable random vectors in `ℝ^p` with finite third absolute
9230moments, `R` an integrable random vector, and `G_Q` the centered Gaussian with covariance
9231`Q = ∑_i E[ζ_i ζ_iᵀ] + ∫_0^T Σ̄_r dr`.  Then
9232`𝖽₃(∑_i ζ_i + M_T + R, G_Q) ≤ E|R| + (1+√3)/6 ∑_i E|ζ_i|³ + ½ E ∫_0^T ‖Σ_r - Σ̄_r‖_{S_1} dr`.
9233The constants are absolute (independent of `T` and of the smallest eigenvalues of `Q`).
9234No Gaussian `G` of Lemma A.27 appears in the statement: it is built in the proof.
9235
9236PLAN (lines 10933-10976): remove `R` at cost `E|R|`; build `G` independent of `ℱ_T` with
9237covariance `∫Σ̄` on the enlargement `Ω × ℝ^p` (`Measure.prod` with `multivariateGaussian`; the
9238hypotheses of `conditional_gaussian_interpolation` transfer to the product filtration
9239`ℱ_r ⊗ ⊥`, and `d3DistE` of the pulled-back laws is unchanged) and apply
9240`conditional_gaussian_interpolation` with `X = ∑ ζ_i`, integrating.  Then
9241`f(x) := E h(x + G) = gaussSmooth h (∫Σ̄) x ∈ C_b^3` with derivative norms `≤` those of `h`
9242(`gaussSmooth_derivs`), and the Lindeberg replacement `B:newprob:lindeberg-bound` of the `ζ_i` by
9243independent Gaussians `g_i ∼ N(0, E ζ_iζ_iᵀ)` on a further product space, one summand at a time,
9244with the third-order Taylor remainder `taylor_bound_of_mem`/`taylor_two_remainder` (cost
9245`(E|ζ_i|³ + E|g_i|³)/6`) and the Gaussian third-moment bound
9246`E|g_i|³ ≤ √3 (E|ζ_i|²)^{3/2} ≤ √3 E|ζ_i|³` (`B:newprob:gaussian-third-moment`: Gaussian fourth
9247moment identity `E|g|⁴ = (tr Q)² + 2 tr(Q²)`, `integral_norm_sq_mvGaussian`, Cauchy–Schwarz and
9248Jensen/`Real.rpow` monotonicity of `L^p` norms).  Finally `∑ g_i + G ∼ N(0,Q)` (`mvGaussian_conv`). -/
9249theorem initial_sum_martingale (ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
9250    (M : ℝ → Ω → (ℝ^p)) (Sg : ℝ → Ω → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ)
9251    (hM : IsVectorMartingaleWithCovariation P ℱ T M Sg)
9252    (sb : ℝ → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) (hsb : IsDetCovMatrix T sb)
9253    {N : ℕ} (ζ : Fin N → Ω → (ℝ^p)) (hζmeas : ∀ i, Measurable[ℱ 0] (ζ i))
9254    (hζind : iIndepFun ζ P) (hζcent : ∀ i, ∫ ω, ζ i ω ∂P = 0)
9255    (hζ3 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun ω => ‖ζ i ω‖ ^ 3) P)
9256    (R : Ω → (ℝ^p)) (hR : Integrable R P) :
9257    d3DistE (law P fun ω => ∑ i, ζ i ω + M T ω + R ω)
9258        (multivariateGaussian 0 (totalCovariance P ζ T sb)) ≤
9259      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ ω, ‖R ω‖ ∂P + (1 + Real.sqrt 3) / 6 * ∑ i, ∫ ω, ‖ζ i ω‖ ^ 3 ∂P +
9260        (1 / 2) * covDiscrepancyMatrix P T Sg sb) := by
9261  classical
9262  have hm : ℱ 0 ≤ mΩ := ℱ.le 0
9263  have hζm' : ∀ i, Measurable (ζ i) := fun i => (hζmeas i).mono hm le_rfl
9264  have hS0 : Measurable[ℱ 0] (fun ω => ∑ i, ζ i ω) :=
9265    Finset.measurable_sum (m := ℱ 0) _ fun i _ => hζmeas i
9266  have hSm : Measurable (fun ω => ∑ i, ζ i ω) := hS0.mono hm le_rfl
9267  have hMt : AEMeasurable (M T) P :=
9268    (hM.sq_int T ⟨hT, le_rfl⟩).aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable
9269  have hRm : AEMeasurable R P := hR.aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable
9270  have hΓ := integratedCov_psd hsb
9271  set g : Ω → ℝ := fun ω => ∫ σ in Set.Icc 0 T, s1Norm (Sg σ ω - sb σ) with hg
9272  have hg0 : 0 ≤ ∫ ω, g ω ∂P :=
9273    integral_nonneg fun ω => setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Icc fun σ _ => traceNormMatrix_nonneg _
9274  have hRn : 0 ≤ ∫ ω, ‖R ω‖ ∂P := integral_nonneg fun ω => norm_nonneg _
9275  have hζ3n : 0 ≤ ∑ i, ∫ ω, ‖ζ i ω‖ ^ 3 ∂P :=
9276    Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => integral_nonneg fun ω => by positivity
9277  refine iSup_le fun ⟨h, hh⟩ => ?_
9278  have hh2 := D3TestClass.memCb2 hh
9279  refine ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_
9280  have e1 : ∫ x, h x ∂(law P fun ω => ∑ i, ζ i ω + M T ω + R ω) =
9281      ∫ ω, h (∑ i, ζ i ω + M T ω + R ω) ∂P :=
9282    integral_map ((hSm.aemeasurable.add hMt).add hRm) hh.1.1.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
9283  show |∫ x, h x ∂(law P fun ω => ∑ i, ζ i ω + M T ω + R ω) -
9284      ∫ x, h x ∂(multivariateGaussian (0 : ℝ^p) (totalCovariance P ζ T sb))| ≤ _
9285  rw [e1]
9286  have hi1 : Integrable (fun ω => h (∑ i, ζ i ω + M T ω + R ω)) P :=
9287    integrable_memCb_comp P hh2 ((hSm.aemeasurable.add hMt).add hRm)
9288  have hi0 : Integrable (fun ω => h (∑ i, ζ i ω + M T ω)) P :=
9289    integrable_memCb_comp P hh2 (hSm.aemeasurable.add hMt)
9290  -- (a) removing R
9291  have sa : |(∫ ω, h (∑ i, ζ i ω + M T ω + R ω) ∂P) - ∫ ω, h (∑ i, ζ i ω + M T ω) ∂P| ≤
9292      ∫ ω, ‖R ω‖ ∂P := by
9293    rw [← integral_sub hi1 hi0, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
9294    refine norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hR.norm (ae_of_all _ fun ω => ?_)
9295    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
9296    simpa using D3TestClass.lipschitz hh (∑ i, ζ i ω + M T ω) (∑ i, ζ i ω + M T ω + R ω)
9297  -- (b) the interpolation with the shift `∑ ζ_i`
9298  have hf := D3TestClass.sharpFn hh hΓ
9299  have sb' := shift_bound_f P ℱ T hT M Sg hM sb hsb (fun ω => ∑ i, ζ i ω) hS0 h hh2
9300    (gaussSmooth h (integratedCov T sb)) hf.contDiff.continuous (fun x => rfl)
9301    (A := Set.univ) MeasurableSet.univ
9302  simp only [Measure.restrict_univ] at sb'
9303  have sb2 : |(∫ ω, h (∑ i, ζ i ω + M T ω) ∂P) -
9304      ∫ ω, gaussSmooth h (integratedCov T sb) (∑ i, ζ i ω) ∂P| ≤ (1 / 2) * ∫ ω, g ω ∂P := by
9305    refine sb'.trans ?_
9306    have := D3TestClass.hessSup_le hh
9307    nlinarith
9308  -- (c) Lindeberg replacement and Gaussian convolution
9309  have sc := initial_lindeberg P ζ hζm' hζind hζcent hζ3 hΓ hh
9310  have e2 : totalCovariance P ζ T sb =
9311      (Matrix.of fun a b => ∑ i, ∫ ω, ζ i ω a * ζ i ω b ∂P) + integratedCov T sb := rfl
9312  rw [e2]
9313  set X1 := ∫ ω, h (∑ i, ζ i ω + M T ω + R ω) ∂P
9314  set X2 := ∫ ω, h (∑ i, ζ i ω + M T ω) ∂P
9315  set X3 := ∫ ω, gaussSmooth h (integratedCov T sb) (∑ i, ζ i ω) ∂P
9316  set X4 := ∫ y, h y ∂(multivariateGaussian (0 : ℝ^p)
9317    ((Matrix.of fun a b => ∑ i, ∫ ω, ζ i ω a * ζ i ω b ∂P) + integratedCov T sb))
9318  have : X1 - X4 = (X1 - X2) + (X2 - X3) + (X3 - X4) := by ring
9319  rw [this]
9320  refine (abs_add_three _ _ _).trans ?_
9321  have hcov : covDiscrepancyMatrix P T Sg sb = ∫ ω, g ω ∂P := rfl
9322  rw [hcov]
9323  linarith

9325/-- Corollary A.30 `M:B:newprob:iid` (source lines 10978-10994): `x_1,…,x_N` independent with law
9326`μ` (on a measurable space `E`), `ℱ_0`-measurable, and `f ∈ L³(μ; ℝ^p)` deterministic; Lemma A.29
9327applies to `ζ_i = N^{-1/2}(f(x_i) - ∫ f dμ)` (`B:newprob:iid-vector`), with total covariance
9328`Q = Cov_μ(f) + ∫_0^T Σ̄_r dr`, and its initial-data term equals
9329`(1+√3)/(6√N) ∫ |f - ∫ f dμ|³ dμ` (`B:newprob:iid-third-moment`, first expression).  `f` and `μ`
9330may depend on `N` and on the observation times (they are arbitrary parameters here).
9331
9332PLAN: the `ζ_i` are independent (`iIndepFun.comp`), centered, `ℱ_0`-measurable, with
9333`E|ζ_i|³ = N^{-3/2} ∫|f - ∫f|³ dμ` (change of variables `integral_map`), so
9334`initial_sum_martingale` applies and `∑_i E|ζ_i|³ = N^{-1/2} ∫|f - ∫f|³ dμ`; the covariance
9335`∑_i E ζ_iζ_iᵀ = Cov_μ(f)` likewise. -/
9336theorem iid_initial_sampling (ℱ : Filtration ℝ mΩ) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
9337    (M : ℝ → Ω → (ℝ^p)) (Sg : ℝ → Ω → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ)
9338    (hM : IsVectorMartingaleWithCovariation P ℱ T M Sg)
9339    (sb : ℝ → Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) (hsb : IsDetCovMatrix T sb)
9340    {E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace E] (μ : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
9341    {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (x : Fin N → Ω → E) (hxmeas : ∀ i, Measurable[ℱ 0] (x i))
9342    (hxind : iIndepFun x P) (hxlaw : ∀ i, law P (x i) = μ)
9343    (f : E → (ℝ^p)) (hf : MemLp f 3 μ)
9344    (R : Ω → (ℝ^p)) (hR : Integrable R P) :
9345    let m : ℝ^p := ∫ y, f y ∂μ
9346    let Q : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ :=
9347      (Matrix.of fun a b => ∫ y, (f y a - m a) * (f y b - m b) ∂μ) + integratedCov T sb
9348    d3DistE (law P fun ω => ∑ i, (Real.sqrt N)⁻¹ • (f (x i ω) - m) + M T ω + R ω)
9349        (multivariateGaussian 0 Q) ≤
9350      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ ω, ‖R ω‖ ∂P +
9351        (1 + Real.sqrt 3) / (6 * Real.sqrt N) * ∫ y, ‖f y - m‖ ^ 3 ∂μ +
9352        (1 / 2) * covDiscrepancyMatrix P T Sg sb) := by
9353  intro m Q
9354  classical
9355  have hm0 : ℱ 0 ≤ mΩ := ℱ.le 0
9356  have hN0 : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
9357  set sN : ℝ := Real.sqrt N with hsN
9358  have hsN0 : 0 < sN := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hN0
9359  have hsN2 : sN ^ 2 = N := Real.sq_sqrt hN0.le
9360  -- a measurable representative of `f`
9361  set ft : E → (ℝ^p) := hf.aestronglyMeasurable.mk f with hft
9362  have hftm : StronglyMeasurable ft := hf.aestronglyMeasurable.stronglyMeasurable_mk
9363  have hfae : f =ᵐ[μ] ft := hf.aestronglyMeasurable.ae_eq_mk
9364  have hmt : m = ∫ y, ft y ∂μ := integral_congr_ae hfae
9365  have hft3 : MemLp ft 3 μ := MemLp.ae_eq hfae hf
9366  set φ : E → (ℝ^p) := fun y => sN⁻¹ • (ft y - m) with hφ
9367  have hφm : Measurable φ := (hftm.measurable.sub_const m).const_smul sN⁻¹
9368  set ζ : Fin N → Ω → (ℝ^p) := fun i ω => φ (x i ω) with hζ
9369  have hxm : ∀ i, Measurable (x i) := fun i => (hxmeas i).mono hm0 le_rfl
9370  have hζmeas : ∀ i, Measurable[ℱ 0] (ζ i) := fun i => hφm.comp (hxmeas i)
9371  have hζind : iIndepFun ζ P := hxind.comp (fun _ => φ) (fun _ => hφm)
9372  -- moments of `φ` under `μ`
9373  have hI3 : Integrable (fun y => ‖ft y - m‖ ^ 3) μ :=
9374    (hft3.sub (memLp_const m)).integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num)
9375  have hφ3 : ∀ y, ‖φ y‖ ^ 3 = (sN⁻¹) ^ 3 * ‖ft y - m‖ ^ 3 := fun y => by
9376    simp only [hφ, norm_smul, norm_inv, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hsN0, mul_pow]
9377  have hφ3i : Integrable (fun y => ‖φ y‖ ^ 3) μ := by
9378    simp_rw [hφ3]; exact hI3.const_mul _
9379  have hmapx : ∀ i, P.map (x i) = μ := hxlaw
9380  have kvec : ∀ (i : Fin N) (g : E → ℝ^p), Measurable g →
9381      ∫ ω, g (x i ω) ∂P = ∫ y, g y ∂μ := fun i g hg => by
9382    rw [← hmapx i]; exact (integral_map (hxm i).aemeasurable hg.aestronglyMeasurable).symm
9383  have kreal : ∀ (i : Fin N) (g : E → ℝ), Measurable g →
9384      ∫ ω, g (x i ω) ∂P = ∫ y, g y ∂μ := fun i g hg => by
9385    rw [← hmapx i]; exact (integral_map (hxm i).aemeasurable hg.aestronglyMeasurable).symm
9386  have hζ3 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun ω => ‖ζ i ω‖ ^ 3) P := fun i => by
9387    have h1 : Integrable (fun y => ‖φ y‖ ^ 3) (P.map (x i)) := by rw [hmapx i]; exact hφ3i
9388    exact (integrable_map_measure (measurable_norm.pow_const 3 |>.comp hφm).aestronglyMeasurable
9389      (hxm i).aemeasurable).1 h1
9390  have hφi : Integrable φ μ := by
9391    refine Integrable.mono' (hφ3i.add (integrable_const 1)) hφm.aestronglyMeasurable
9392      (ae_of_all _ fun y => ?_)
9393    simp only [Pi.add_apply]
9394    rcases le_total ‖φ y‖ 1 with h1 | h1
9395    · nlinarith [pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg (φ y)) 3]
9396    · nlinarith [norm_nonneg (φ y), mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg (φ y)) (sq_nonneg (‖φ y‖ - 1))]
9397  have hint_ft : Integrable ft μ := hft3.integrable (by norm_num)
9398  have hφ0 : ∫ y, φ y ∂μ = 0 := by
9399    simp only [hφ]
9400    rw [integral_smul, integral_sub hint_ft (integrable_const m), ← hmt]
9401    simp
9402  have hζcent : ∀ i, ∫ ω, ζ i ω ∂P = 0 := fun i => by
9403    simp only [hζ]
9404    rw [kvec i φ hφm, hφ0]
9405  have hA := initial_sum_martingale P ℱ T hT M Sg hM sb hsb ζ hζmeas hζind hζcent hζ3 R hR
9406  -- identification of the quantities
9407  have hFae : (fun ω => ∑ i, sN⁻¹ • (f (x i ω) - m) + M T ω + R ω) =ᵐ[P]
9408      (fun ω => ∑ i, ζ i ω + M T ω + R ω) := by
9409    have : ∀ i, (fun ω => f (x i ω)) =ᵐ[P] (fun ω => ft (x i ω)) := fun i =>
9410      ae_eq_comp (hxm i).aemeasurable (by rw [hmapx i]; exact hfae)
9411    have hall := ae_all_iff.2 this
9412    filter_upwards [hall] with ω hω
9413    simp only [hζ, hφ]
9414    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [hω i]]
9415  have hlaw : (law P fun ω => ∑ i, sN⁻¹ • (f (x i ω) - m) + M T ω + R ω) =
9416      law P fun ω => ∑ i, ζ i ω + M T ω + R ω := Measure.map_congr hFae
9417  have hQ : totalCovariance P ζ T sb = Q := by
9418    unfold totalCovariance
9419    congr 1
9420    ext a b
9421    simp only [Matrix.of_apply]
9422    have : ∀ i, ∫ ω, ζ i ω a * ζ i ω b ∂P = (sN⁻¹) ^ 2 * ∫ y, (f y a - m a) * (f y b - m b) ∂μ := by
9423      intro i
9424      have e1 : ∫ ω, ζ i ω a * ζ i ω b ∂P =
9425          ∫ y, φ y a * φ y b ∂μ :=
9426        kreal i (fun y => φ y a * φ y b)
9427          ((by fun_prop : Measurable fun y : ℝ^p => y a * y b).comp hφm)
9428      rw [e1]
9429      have e2 : ∫ y, φ y a * φ y b ∂μ = ∫ y, (sN⁻¹) ^ 2 * ((f y a - m a) * (f y b - m b)) ∂μ := by
9430        refine integral_congr_ae ?_
9431        filter_upwards [hfae] with y hy
9432        simp only [hφ, ← hy, PiLp.smul_apply, PiLp.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
9433        ring
9434      rw [e2, integral_const_mul]
9435    simp_rw [this]
9436    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc,
9437      inv_pow, hsN2]
9438    field_simp
9439  have hS3 : ∑ i, ∫ ω, ‖ζ i ω‖ ^ 3 ∂P = (sN)⁻¹ * ∫ y, ‖f y - m‖ ^ 3 ∂μ := by
9440    have : ∀ i, ∫ ω, ‖ζ i ω‖ ^ 3 ∂P = (sN⁻¹) ^ 3 * ∫ y, ‖f y - m‖ ^ 3 ∂μ := by
9441      intro i
9442      have e1 : ∫ ω, ‖ζ i ω‖ ^ 3 ∂P = ∫ y, ‖φ y‖ ^ 3 ∂μ :=
9443        kreal i (fun y => ‖φ y‖ ^ 3) (measurable_norm.pow_const 3 |>.comp hφm)
9444      rw [e1]
9445      simp_rw [hφ3]
9446      rw [integral_const_mul]
9447      congr 1
9448      refine integral_congr_ae ?_
9449      filter_upwards [hfae] with y hy
9450      rw [← hy]
9451    simp_rw [this]
9452    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
9453    have : (N : ℝ) * (sN⁻¹) ^ 3 = sN⁻¹ := by
9454      rw [inv_pow, ← hsN2]; field_simp
9455    rw [← mul_assoc, this]
9456  rw [hlaw, ← hQ]
9457  refine hA.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
9458  congr 1
9459  rw [hS3]
9460  field_simp
9461
9462lemma cube_tangent {a t : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : a ^ 3 + 3 * a ^ 2 * (t - a) ≤ t ^ 3 := by
9463  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (t - a)) (add_nonneg ht (mul_nonneg two_pos.le ha))]
9464
9465lemma cube_add_le {x b : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hb : 0 ≤ b) : (x + b) ^ 3 ≤ 4 * (x ^ 3 + b ^ 3) := by
9466  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (x - b)) (add_nonneg hx hb), mul_nonneg hx hb,
9467    sq_nonneg (x - b), mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hx hb) (add_nonneg hx hb)]
9468
9469/-- Corollary A.30, display `B:newprob:iid-third-moment`, second inequality (source lines
947010987-10989, proof 10996-10999): `∫ |f - ∫ f dμ|³ dμ ≤ 8 ∫ |f|³ dμ` for `f ∈ L³(μ;ℝ^p)` (Minkowski
9471and Jensen: `‖f - ∫f‖_{L³} ≤ 2 ‖f‖_{L³}`), so that the initial-data term is at most
9472`4(1+√3)/(3√N) ∫|f|³ dμ`; "if `f` is centered the factor `8` is unnecessary" is the identity
9473`f - ∫ f dμ = f` in that case.
9474
9475PLAN: `eLpNorm_sub_le` (Minkowski in `L³`), `‖∫ f dμ‖ ≤ ∫ ‖f‖ dμ ≤ (∫‖f‖³)^{1/3}` (Jensen /
9476`eLpNorm_le_eLpNorm_of_exponent_le` on a probability space), then cube. -/
9477theorem iid_third_moment_centering {E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace E] (μ : Measure E)
9478    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (f : E → (ℝ^p)) (hf : MemLp f 3 μ) :
9479    ∫ y, ‖f y - ∫ z, f z ∂μ‖ ^ 3 ∂μ ≤ 8 * ∫ y, ‖f y‖ ^ 3 ∂μ := by
9480  have hf1 : Integrable f μ := hf.integrable (by norm_num)
9481  have hn1 : Integrable (fun y => ‖f y‖) μ := hf1.norm
9482  have hn3 : Integrable (fun y => ‖f y‖ ^ 3) μ := hf.integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num)
9483  set a : ℝ := ∫ y, ‖f y‖ ∂μ with ha
9484  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := integral_nonneg fun y => norm_nonneg _
9485  set m : ℝ^p := ∫ z, f z ∂μ with hm
9486  have hma : ‖m‖ ≤ a := norm_integral_le_integral_norm f
9487  -- Jensen for the cube
9488  have hJ : a ^ 3 ≤ ∫ y, ‖f y‖ ^ 3 ∂μ := by
9489    have hs : Integrable (fun y => ‖f y‖ - a) μ := hn1.sub (integrable_const a)
9490    have h1 : ∫ y, (a ^ 3 + 3 * a ^ 2 * (‖f y‖ - a)) ∂μ ≤ ∫ y, ‖f y‖ ^ 3 ∂μ :=
9491      integral_mono ((integrable_const _).add (hs.const_mul _)) hn3
9492        fun y => cube_tangent ha0 (norm_nonneg _)
9493    have h2 : ∫ y, (a ^ 3 + 3 * a ^ 2 * (‖f y‖ - a)) ∂μ = a ^ 3 := by
9494      rw [integral_add (integrable_const _) (hs.const_mul _),
9495        integral_const_mul, integral_sub hn1 (integrable_const _)]
9496      simp [ha]
9497    linarith
9498  have hmb : ‖m‖ ^ 3 ≤ a ^ 3 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hma 3
9499  have h3 : ∫ y, ‖f y - m‖ ^ 3 ∂μ ≤ ∫ y, 4 * (‖f y‖ ^ 3 + ‖m‖ ^ 3) ∂μ :=
9500    integral_mono_of_nonneg (ae_of_all _ fun y => by positivity)
9501      ((hn3.add (integrable_const _)).const_mul _)
9502      (ae_of_all _ fun y => by
9503        refine (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_sub_le _ _) 3).trans ?_
9504        exact cube_add_le (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
9505  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_add hn3 (integrable_const _)] at h3
9506  simp only [integral_const, probReal_univ, smul_eq_mul, one_mul] at h3
9507  linarith
9508
9509end RandomInitial
9510
9511end HRS
